text: Recently there is this problem where some wins in the battle place aren't even registered. The rewards you get for winning x battles out of 5, even that is not given, which it should be, rightfully. Also, sometimes I teleport back and forth repeatedly to a place I've visited, but hours ago, and back to my original place. Also, sometimes even when I have a good network, when I battle Team GO rocket members, the screen just goes black and all 3 of my selected good pokemon have fainted.

The biggest problem that I have with this game, for almost as long as I have played it, is that your pokemon are just stuck in gyms for literal MONTHS. I can't get my pokemon back nor can I get any pokecoins. It would be really nice if you added a time limit for how long the pokemon can stay in a gym, and after its time has run out it automatically gwta knocked out.

When I click on anything in the app the screen goes completely black. I have done a force stop and also uninstalled/reinstalled the app. I even went as far as to restart our router and my phone. There is a limited time on some of the monthly events (that I actually paid for) and I am unable to do anything in the game. I am really frustrated because other family members in the house are not having any issues and one of them has the same phone as me.

It's come a loooooong way since it's glitchy & limited 1st gen days, but there's still a lot more work to be done. PVP needs a balancing overhaul, prices have almost doubled on everything, and it seems like the pokemon have become harder to catch. Part of me only continues to play because of all the time & money I've dumped into this game over the years, but at least it's an extra way for me and my girlfriend to bond. That, and it DOES still encourage outdoor exercise, despite how greedy it is.

The latest updates are so incredibly frustrating that I'm considering uninstalling. They introduced a "Reward Road" to give player items when you make certain purchases, but the Niantic website no longer has the page to redeem rewards and you can't do it in-app. I transferred Volcanion to Home and now I permanently can't complete research tasks. Oh, and on top of that, the AI support chat does not work at all! There's no way to report the issues with the AI.

As immersive as you allow it to be. The framework of the game is very outdated, but it gets the job done. Still a lot to be desired (better achievement system would be a great start), but I'm afraid a new game would have to be created to get a much better experience. Addictive, gets you out, gets you walking/running, and there are people playing it almost everywhere if you want to socialize. Amazing game.

The best this game has ever been. Generous update last year created so much extra space in all inventories for FREE. I highly recommend it! That being said I have to nick one star as there are some goofy glitches here and there. On occasion it loads halfway and just...stops loading? Occasional visual glitches on gyms. Sometimes game bugs when doing raids. In my case a relaunch fixes any of these things, but this is still annoying regardless.

Loving the game besides the problem after defeating gyms. When you win, the loading screen afterwards is way too long and other people take the gym from you, even when it says it doesn't happen. I've lost multiple gyms because of this and didn't have the power to defeat it all over again. If you get out of the loading screen quicker, same thing happens. Very disappointing, please change it.

Still a really fun (and addicting) game with more to do than ever. We all know what this game is at this point, so I'm not going to go into all the stuff you can do. However, I'm taking a star off for two reasons. One, after all this time, they still never solved the issue of the game never reconnecting if you lose your connection in the middle of catching a pokémon. And two, some features aren't well explained and involve far too much messing around to try to figure them out.

Basically a money scam now. Bugs with screen freezes, catch failures, glitches uploading, glitches downloading, and the update designed to "prevent cheating" just causes further errors. Not spending anymore money on this game, and it's basically Pay-to-Play now, so not really playing anymore.

Played on & off again since release in 2016. Game use to be amazing, everyone you saw played the game, it was fun to play for all ages. I got back on after quite a few months, maybe a year & there were significant changes that just seemed to change the aspect of the game🫤 You would think after nearly a decade of playing, you'd be close to catching them all but they keep creating new Pokémon that didn't even exist in the mainline. As i get older, this just isn't for me anymore. It has been fun

Now the recent update/upgrade is so good that you have to click on a gift multiple times before it will let you open it. guess it wants to make sure you want your friends gift? the new layout also is sus and was not broken so they decided it needed to be fixed for their own amusement. add the lag, glitching and inability to smoothly transition from WiFi to cell data, this is the game for you! Don't do anything you want to keep going from WiFi to cell data. it will crash just about every tim.

I have been playing this game since it originally launched and I really enjoy some of the changes that have been made over the years. One biggest complaint now is that the play with your pokemon feature has always been difficult to work with, and that's hasn't improved. It tells you to look for an open flat surface but then never gives me to foot steps to place a pokemon making leveling friendship and gathering gifts very difficult.

YIKES I played this game on release on my old phone, OnePlus 3. It heated up and drained the battery like crazy 8 years later I play it on my new phone, OnePlus 9. It heats up and drains the battery like crazy Sometimes the prompt buttons become unresponsive, it doesn't see the GPS, and continues having persistent issues I would imagine a game continuously developed for 8 years would address. Especially on the optimization side, since I don't even use the AR functionality

Update: My pokemon eventually returned from the gym after a couple of weeks however I did see in one of the gyms 2 pokemons that stayed there for over 95 days, this is unacceptable. Another thing is that on android phones you can't redeem codes in the app and have to go in a website unlike iPhone users who can redeem it in app in the poke store. This is a decent game however I'd like these problems to be evaluated. Please fix this Niantic.

The game is a lot of fun when the app works. It's pretty glitchy. I sometimes have to open and close it repeatedly to get it to load my location. The layout of the app needs attention. I can never find my rewards because they're scattered across four or five menus plus a couple of other places I wouldn't think to click. Having everything in one place would actually make sense.

This game has gone downhill hard. The best years are behind it, which sucks as this game was actually good. It started going downhill after the pandemic. The changes to the remote raid pass, the newer pay to win events, & of course the selling of the game to Scopely. All that among other things make this game no longer worth playing in 2025... which is extremely sad. I highly suggest all players save their Pokemon by transferring them to Pokemon Home then uninstall this game & never look back.

I love this game with a burning passion. My only issue with it really is when there's one pokemon in the middle of a couple others that you CANNOT check unless you capture the ones around it. There has to be some sort of fix for this. It's not a major problem just annoying when you want to see the pokemon and have to go through catching the others just to check it.

Just a bad game. Brings out the worst in people. Creators claim it supports community, but all it does is divide it. And like 8 out of 10 times you go to a gym it gives "gym under construction" error which has been going for months! They keep adding more to it but cannot even fix the most basic functions of the game, like throwing a pokeball...Just horribly managed and then they lie and capitalize on errors they create. Could be such a great game but it's not. Too bad.

This current version removes the navigation bar whole sale, this means I cannot use the home button or swap apps, or even use the back button on certain screens. Please consider instead an option to choose between. Doing so without asking trainers feels like a bad move in my opinion. The flee button is on the upper left hand corner which is far more inconvenient for catching in a full-screen mode.

I really enjoy Pokemon Go and have been playing since the release in 2016. Its a good excuse to get out and spend some time outside to "touch grass". However, the Android app has significantly more issues than the iOS app does. I have to sign out and back in on average about 4 times per week and deal with freezes daily. This would be a 5 star review if the app was more flushed out, but given the issues I have seemingly just playing the game I can't give more than 3.

Been playing for years. Got a new phone, worked for a week, and now will never come up again. I click on the play option it loads then gets to the screen where I press on or to where announcements are, and then it shuts down again. If they fix it, I'll change it.

Certain features like routes are still INCREDIBLY buggy even after a long time. Which wouldn't be a problem is evolutions weren't locked behind it. I can not recommend this app at this stage because it doesn't feel like the devs adds even trying to fix the issue. And THAT is why I have it such a low score.
super raids are terrible. that said, at least they seemed to comp a reasonable amount of mega energy.

Editing this to a one-star for one simple reason: They bricked the game on 32 bit android, and not everyone has the cash for a new phone with a better OS. Probably done with this franchise for good, and Skylanders was a better game series as a kid anyway.

Events are out of control now. They all last way too long because they all use a tedious battle pass model with bland rewards that you have to work too hard for. What happened to Timed Research that I could complete in a couple of days? Or events that lasted for a couple of days for that matter? Stop trying to force me to play like the hardcore players and let me do my own thing! Don't hold event rewards at ransom! Apparently my location data isn't enough!

Please fix the lags that are happening since the latest update. The app continually crashes, freezes, lags, and is generally unstable since the biomes were released. Pretty much every aspect of the game has been affected; catching, trading, opening/sending gifts, raiding, GBL... it's all unstable and it's making it less fun to play. Less fun for players means less playing - which equate to less money for y'all.

Absolutely disappointing during raids. Did 2 legendary raids with remote passes this morning after winning, I did not get a catch encounter. Followed their steps and submitted a ticket for assistance, but they replied and said I had the encounter or was reimbursed. Neither of those had happened as my journal showed no encounter, and I had to go buy more remote passes. There's no other way to get assistance apart from bots. This app glitches a lot, and this isn't the first time this has happened.

Bait and switch tactics. Bait purchases with rewards they cannot deliver on when "multiple different stops or gyms" are a requirement for special research. Remote players (I.E. Arctic Coast) are unable to complete special research for rewards specified in descriptions. They fail to disclose requirements beforehand, and will not refund purchase OR allow exceptions for research.

I enjoy the game, however when you took Giovanni out of the balloons, I don't get a chance to find him, so I can never finish those quests. It is quite frustrating when you don't have the time or ability to search for hours trying to find a pokestop where it might be him. I have also seen a lot of other complaints about how it is really broken and he isn't showing up at all. Hopefully you fix that soon.

Only tried this for pokémon champions! iyky This game would be awesome if it wasn't made to revolve around microtransactions. barely any bag space, not much space for pokemon either, and from what I've seen you can only buy pokeballs with gold if you run out. it's not like you're earning some sort of currency for beating gyms or team rocket grunts that you can use to buy different pokeballs, potions, ect. No that would make too much sense and make them less money. I don't recommend this game

I have played this game since release, and it has changed a lot. Now, you need to pay to play the game. One main thing I dislike is the fact that only one free raid is available every day. Players who pay in the game get so many perks and its expensive. Playing against those players is very unfair. Although most of the game is locked behind a paywall, its still fun, but older versions were better. Oh yeah and it lags a lot sometimes. Including odds, and the game is just a casino in the end.

I think this game is great. Because it is a fun way to connect with people and, pass the time. I like how there are friendship levels and, that you have to send gifts or battle with or against them to raise your friendship level I also think it is smart that it only goes up one point a day to keep players coming back on the game. The mechanics of the game are great but I think they can also improve the graphics of the game and improve the stitching of the Pokémon and blend the colors better. 👍

Customer service not paying attention to what I said, incorrectly correcting me, and what they are proposing won't solve my problem. There's a glitch where it won't let you catch your Pokémon on rewards. The first one, I "ran" and it sat there in rewards. After months of it being glitched it was finally successful. I forgot about it into now. It happened again, twice. One when I ran is still sitting for me to capture. The other when I "ran" it continued the quest. I lost my Mew. Support is bad

I just started playing this a week or two ago and was really getting into it pretty good I like the game however when I turn level 25 I was supposed to get several items for leveling up and that didn't happen I got a couple of the items but not all of them. i contacted support told them what was missing which was 15 ultra balls and 15 max revives Even had screenshot proof that they were not in my inventory. to be honest The other items I really wasn't worried ab so Idk if I got them or not.

I have been playing since 2016 and really love the game. I miss the old "Special Research" though. It allowed players to get the new releases without pressure to complete it in 5 days. It really helped when we were playing with children because they would get excited to get through the tasks too, but it definitely took them longer. Please bring this back! The game was so much more enjoyable!

I've been playing since day one. It was fun in the beginning and peaked during covid when it was easier to play. Game is glitchy now. Niantic and now scopely continues to make this game more and more unplayable. The weather is horrible outside in most places and now they expect us to search for Giovanni at PokeStops. No real quality of life updates that actually help disabled and rural players. Plus, making it impossible to get new pokestops and routes in areas. Finding it harder to play this.

im putting 2 stars because its extremely annoying once you get to a certain point in the game they make you follow routes. not everyone can do that. youre taking away half of the game creating challenges like ya. sure good idea.... but now I have 4 of my challenges being routes that I cant proceed on. at least allow them to be deleted and create a new challenge

Very fun game. i love the events, but I wish there weren't so many little ones, so I don't always feel like I'm missing out on something if I can't play, but the biggest issue of all is that the game is pretty much pay to win so if they could just fix that PLEASE or at least make it a little easier to get free coins than I would definitely give this a 5*

I really like this game! Though, it sucks for some people, like me as well! the game needs internet to play, but not everyone has that. So it is hard to go to Pokéstops or move around to evolve certain pokemon. Overall, it is super fun! but I wish you could chat with friends, especially with trading. And maybe have more pokemon spawn in diffrent places instead of the same ones every time. But, overall, it's not a half bad game! would recommend besides the small flaws

If it were up to just the fun of the game, this would get a solid 5, if not 6 stars! But the customer support that they have is not good at all. They will not do a thing to help except just tell you the same information. Also, its pretty glitchy, and I lost access to my campfire app. All in All amazing game, highly recommend to anyone who's thinking about getting it, just don't go to customer support if you need something because they won't help you.

this game used to be fun. however, it evolved to be another massive and sad dystopian cashgrab. they introduce A LOT of unnecessary mechanics/features, most of it for the sake of artificial rarity, and almost every one of those, no matter how tiny, is time-locked and money-locked. I don't mind spending money for a game, it makes me happy, and it supports the game's development. but this game's just unreasonably and immorally expensive. Good luck catching up unless you spend thousands of dollars.

Frequent glitches, knocked out of raids randomly with no chance to catch (which wastes raid passes I've paid for), and WAY too many updates. Constantly required or you can't play, taking up time and storage on my phone. It's all really ridiculous and takes the fun out of the game. Super disappointing. And also, as others have mentioned, the Rewards that you can't even access on the website.

The game is absolutely fantastic, but not quite perfect just yet. I have a few criticisms: 1. Please add a dark mode option. No reason for there not to be one this far into the game's life. 2. Remove the daily coin limit. Why is that a thing? The amount of coins I get should be proportional to the time my Pokémon were in a gym. 3. Better hair and face customization. I want my messy bun. 4. A new non-battle focused game mode. Maybe some mini games to play with your buddy pokemon and friends.

I have not spent a dime since the price increases and will not anymore. I continue to play because I've invested so much in the game but I'll no longer spend any $ on pokemon go. Updated. I still stand on not spending money on this company. Even when I purchase remote raid passes through coins i've accumulated through gyms, The pokemon flee back to back to back. This company knows how to scam you out of your money one way or another. I can see why ppl spoof and try to trick the system now. 😑

Game killed off by latest update. absolutely horrendous. It goes slow and glitches when trying to catch. Throw the ball and it goes about 1cm however when you catch after winning a raid(white balls) or Dynamax raid, it's totally fine. Gone through about 150 balls to catch about 5 Pokemon. It's now an unplayable. Great shame as it was great for years and now they've gone and destroyed it. Takes up tonnes of memory to so will have to sadly be deleted. Such a shame.

It's a very awesome game, I play it just about every day (either in the evening or night). Except for only one problem, the battery on my phone was 85% before playing for ~10-15 minutes. Then, after those 10-15 minutes, I went to check & it was at 27%... (Not sure, though, but it could've been from the location service) The battery drainage problem needs help fixing ASAP. Otherwise, you guys nailed everything else on the game. Thanks a bunch.

Played the game since 2016, still play it especially during Summers. I have recently had a problem with the weekly challenge in the social section though. I tried joining a group, and even had a friend invite me to one, but it doesn't seem to want to pair me into a group to complete the challenge. Already deleted and downloaded the game again, cleared cache, etc. Not really an option to address it in the "help" tab of the game so thought I'd write a review for possible help.

An AR action game. A good way to get exercise and enjoy doing it. You can battle with friends from all over. The game definitely has a hard time running consistently. There are lots of really cool aspects to this game. If you are in a big city this game is for you. If you live in the country, it's hard to get gifts ect. Overall there are glitches, most have quick fixes.

I stopped playing for the winter and all the game does is crash now. It crashes when I bring my buddy out. It crashes when I try to take a snapshot of that buddy. It crashes while trying to catch something. It lags all of the time. I've updated and tried many different parks and then I came here to read reviews and see that I'm not the only one who can't seem to go 10 minutes without the game crashing.

Redownloaded after not playing for a few months. App crashed twice. Turned off all notifications and still received several notifications. Discovered starly, one of the most common wild encounters, is the community day pokemon? Deleted the app again. (2026) Impressive how many game breaking glitches there still are. Regularly crashes, icons won't load, freezing, stuttering.

Excellent game, wish it had a pedometer widget or at least the pedometer worked better, according to pokemon go I've walked 1.7k since yesterday, but according to my pedometer I've walked 3k just today. update: they made it better. it now tracks my steps (it has for some time) and I'll open my app to a pleasant surprise of all the walking I've done during the day without noticing. 10 years later and I'm still playing with friends.

While this used to be my favourite game, it has become quite large and usually takes 2 minutes to load and the performance when catching pokemon and walking around is quite low. I've never had this game run smoothly except when I first installed it for a week or two. The game play itself is very fun though, and I think the challenges add a neat 100% aspect to the game!

Its a fun game which encourages going outside and physical exercise, however the game starts at a pretty slow pace in the beginning with limited tasks and not so powerful pokemon. It can also get very grindy. Plus in the middle of pokemon encounters the game can randomly glitch but not so often anymore. Otherwise it's a great game for low low price of free and a great and motivating way to catch pokemon and go outside, you need mobile data though. (if you have a phone it's fine)

Amazing experience! Feels like the Pokemon games, has a LOT of Pokemon and encourages everyone to get up and walk. There are literally NO ads at all and it's really easy to play. It drains a little bit too much battery from my phone but that's really just 🆗 judging the entertainment it gives me. Overall this app is very awesome and if ur planning to get it I'd tell you to go ahead.

The game has definitely become pay-to-advance. Now get the message in-game when on top of a Poke-stop that I am "out of range" when I am right next to it. The cons are starting to outweigh the pros. During battles, it's daft how many taps on the screen it takes for the charged attack to actually work, same with the Rocket Grunt/Leader battles. Just goes to show that Niantic is only bothered about one thing and it's not the fans.... it's the money.

Love it! This game is so cool and the Pokémon are so cute! This game also brings me motivation to work out! But, one feature that I HATE. I was just checking out the game and I saw that one route had my favorite Pokémon, Litten. So I had to walk about 3 kilometres and when I tried to catch it it fled away. Please, Pokémon team, remove Pokémon fleeing cause it's so frustrating and disappointing.

Lets break this down; in its latest set of latches, they shadow nerfed a good bit of the players abilities to catch pokemon. Pairing this with inconsistent throws, despite the pokemon, random disconnects during rare captures or harder raids. Not to mention how pay hungry they are getting for you to make progress, nerfing the catch rate like we would not notice, or making a creatures run chance increase with the rarer items being used. The state of this game, don't pay for a thing.

Honestly one of my top 5 mobile games. To anyone that loves Pokémon this is the game for you. You get to actively catch Pokémon while moving in real time, and this game can get your steps In really easy if you like that. With ther always fresh raids and challenges there's always something to do. In all this is a game i always seem to come crawling back to, and it keeps you active. 💯

Amazing game that allows for an immersive experience. As a day 1 player, I can say that this game improves over time. It helps motivate me and my peers to get out and socialize, even meeting with large groups in our community and having a fun time. It's even playable without spending any money, though it takes more effort. Definitely worth it, though.

Has been a motivator in going for walks. Edit: I had to dock stars after playing it longer. While I still use it as a fun diversion while walking, the limitations on the inventories for Pokemon, items, & postcards are frustrating. Coupled with your ability to earn the cash shop currency being capped at 50/day, it takes far too long to fix. Long distance friends have to buy special raid passes for $ in order to battle together, & you can only have 3 at most. Too many microtransactions/pay-to-win.

Do not recommend and absolutely do not download this app, it's a scam for the most part. The company will pay lock any little thing and pretty much force you to pay for regular things that normally have been included, this company is greedy and will not help with actual glitches or issues in the game. Making the most random UN-needed changes and completely ignoring glitches/issues that have been in game for years. DO NOT DOWNLOAD!!!!

The game is really good, and I like how it is based on real world! However, I have been getting some issues such as bugged map, and the fact that some 'common and uncommon' pokemon just turned out to be a rare common. This usually happens to Sprigatito, and I would request that some pokemons like these spawn a bit more frequently. that's all, thank you.

New battle system is a disaster. This game is riddled with bugs, minor and major, ranging from easy-to-fix graphical errors, to a horrible new battle system, ever-present connectivity issues, and of course the occasional raid pass lost to oblivion due to said connection problems. This is a game that has generated billions of dollars, yet the developers fail to do anything right with the hoard they sit on. Playing since 6 July 2016, I can't recommend this game for newcomers. Avoid.

Review update lots of Pokemon but they continue to be the same ones they need to be more of a variety to be able to continue to catch different ones and do the tasks. it would be nice to be able to actually catch a zapdos or Articuno or Moltres when they appear instead of getting one try and then they always bounce. how am I ever going to get one of you guys won't let me at least get a few chances to catch it.

I love this app so much, but it has problems. Not a lot but they exist. You can definitely play this game freely without paying but if you want everything you need to pay. The battle league is horrible and I'm one of the few who said it's fine. I like it, but it needs some work. If you like walking and need something to do while doing it pokemon go is perfect

I really enjoy playing Pokemon go, but there is one thing I don't like. recently the special research from the taken over events got replaced for future events by a go pass, which is timed. it makes it so that it's harder for people like me who don't play it obsessively to get rocket radars and participate in the taken over events. it's also annoying because it kinda feels like it's pay to win, if you pay, you get the rocket radar immediately. other than that, I really enjoy Pokemon go

Day 1 player here telling anyone who wants to play Battle League to forget it. That's strictly for a PC player. it's that busted. they want your time and money but won't fix the game. what's that about? no more money from me from here on out. they should be paying ME to play at this rate. it was fun but the party's over. Too greedy, too many cheaters, no fun anymore.

The game itself is good, have been a player since the first month it launched. But as years went by, they added pay-for-event tix and paid extras - ridiculous and greedy. Accessing the android app used to be fine until recent update(s); now I'm constantly toggling back and forth between wifi (full bars) and 5G data to try to continue game play or to log back on because it freezes so much, causing bottom screen buttons/icons to disappear and have to back out of app itself. Niantic, fix this bug!

FYI if you are on O2 <-- this is a big part of the problem, it's the worst network out there, change networks!Terrible game. "Unable to authenticate" "unable to sign in" doesn't load up, loads to 90% then stops. When it "eventually" loads up, no pokemon or stops are visable. Game freezes, goes to a blank screen and 9/10 you can't load it. Absolute trash, constant "GPS signal not found" errors as well

Its fun forsure. Pokémon is just money hungry though and so many things were added, yet it makes it useless to be a solo player which I am because of where I live. If your out in the middle of nowhere there should be chances for you to play without money being the only one. While we're at it and off topic; their low printing rates, scalpers because of it and the incredibly low hit rates are ridiculous. They know they have a "loyal" fan base but it ruined them in a way. Hello MTG! 😀

The game is a shell of its former self. Buggy beyond belief, constant soft-bans for just catching Pokémon or driving through town, paywalled content and p2w mechanics, updates that make the game visually unappealing, and more. I've been playing since 2016 and the game was in a genuinely better, more interesting, and fun state around 2016-2018. Now? Can't even recommend it even if you're just looking to dump Pokémon into Pokémon Home.

The battles become so irritating. You are about to win and then it completely freezes on you, and there's no way to report it for y'all to look deeper into the problem. It was just froze so long that our battle timed out. That's bs. Even if it's a cheat or whatever, there should be a way to report it for y'all who watch over the app can look into the problem. This happens way too often for there not to be a way for y'all to get reports on who to look into.

Was heated last time because I would throw a ball at low combat power pokémon with a green outline and it would still break out instantly. Game is actually fun and you kind of have to be on it a lot to be good. Only issue I have is that sometimes when I'm on the road or the sidewalk it will just have a lag spike and then I have to restart the game. Very fun game though. I recommend if you like to go outside, have a lot of spare time, or want to play a game with family.

Game is fun with a variety of activities and rotation of themed items. I can afford the occasional premium purchase as I don't play this day in and day out so I don't need many premium items. Since the updates in April 2026 though, the Quest listing, Event-themed and Monthly quests tab keeps blinking in and out when I try to scroll down the quest actions or even the list of prizes. This turns the game into a nightmare for strobe-sensitive players, so now I am playing even less often.

In app purchases removed from menu before redeeming. The company running this game is defrauding it's customers and players. They gladly accept your money for something called Timed Research Tickets. Even if you complete the research on time but fail to claim the reward within a specific time frame the items which you paid for and earned are removed from the games menus and you are unable to redeem however they still get to keep your money. It is completely ludicrous and asinine.

I played Pokemon Go when it first released and had a lot of fun with it. I stopped playing for a few years and decided a few days ago to try again. After 2 days of playing, my account got flagged for breaking rules which I haven't, tried getting support to no avail, it was a week so I decided ok I would wait and play again. That was 3 days ago, I opened the app today and got a second strike and can't even open it. Got flagged when not even playing. Support is useless, don't waste time on this.

Fundamentally, the problem with this game is that it has way too many systems and they interact with each other in a way that prevents progress. I have to spin stops to complete missions but my bag is full of items so I can't. If I delete the items I can't complete other missions that need the items, like catching or batting. Specialised pokemon like Zygarde and Gimmeghoul have complex requirements that can't usually be met. It's very RNG dependent. The game is eating itself.

LOVE IT. I love how they add new features and different ways to make the game better, but sometimes when I walk the game lags and says I'm across the city until it finds where I'm actually at. Sometimes if It's there long enough it's good with new pokemon and gyms or sometimes it just freezes there trying to find your real location.

I am giving this game a 5 star review, because it's really fun overall. The makers have improved the PvP system in some ways, while making it worse in other ways. I've lost 3 battles in a row due to glitches. I'm disappointed about Giavonni being removed from balloons,and I REALLY wish he'd be brought back. Now that the remote raid passes are very expensive I will not be raiding anymore I live to far from gyms and don't have people to raid with. This used to be a fun game now all they want is money so this gets 1 star and no money from me. my new 1 star review is because anytime I try to battle the team rocket grunts and or leaders it says network error kicks me from the fight and kills all 3 Pokémon i had it usually happens on the last of 3 battles when I'm about to win. I am barely able to get a buddy because the slowly show around a flat area thing hasn't worked.
Thete us a damn audio bug going on in this app. Every I played for 20 minutes, the audio just got mess up and cut off on uts own. I keep reporting the bug several times and they don't listen

I have enjoyed playing this game for years but since one of the newer updates all I get is a black screen when I load the game I really really enjoyed playing it but now I can't even load it on my phone and I'm not sure what to do on that note I mean I hope that they fix it in one of the new updates I really want to play again it is a really fun game. if the black screen glitch was fixed I would move it back to five stars

Pokemon go saved my life. Literally. I was about to do something pretty crazy, and then I got a notification from Pokemon go saying that I should step outside for a bit. That brought me back to reality for a second, and that's when I realized what I was about to do was stupid. So for me, I think this game's quite good. It's also a very fun game that I play regularly because there's always something new to do

dropped to 3 stars because I want to continue to like this app, but my issue is I went to take over a gym with no indication of a raid about to happen, all of a sudden I get kicked out mid gym fight saying the gym battle has already been completed and then the raid battle popped up!? please, please fix your app.

i like this games but got some issues and bugs, the support system doesn't even work properly i can't report bugs when the app crashes trying to catch pokémon. The support system needs more improvement. also this app is spyware.
Can't open the app. It immediately crashes, over and over. It was fine yesterday, what did you do?? Edit: And again, can't even open the app. Says there's a bug. Update please?

The game has a great initiative and concept. The only problem is you can never play longer than 15 minutes before you run into some kind of bug. Server issues continuously, constant connection issues, when you battle a gym 85% of the time you can't beat the boss because it glitches out and the boss won't die, at times game says there's no Pokemon around, and the list goes on. Also, when your team owns a gym, it's ridiculous how you have to battle your own gym just to place a Pokemon on it.

Good game overall in terms of gameplay. However, it fails in all other departments. Had an update that removes avatar items that you might have spent irl money for, along with numerous other issues as in items clipping through one another, deformation to body parts with certain items, skin tone selector broken, the list goes on. Overall I would not recommend this game, as judging by the history of updates, your progress in certain areas might be wiped by future updates.

Uninstalled due to doubling the price of remote raiding and limiting the number of remote raids a day. This is just the last straw in a string of changes designed to price gouge players. I've been an active player since 2017. This recent change seems like nothing more than greed wrapped in a package of "We want the game to go in another direction" from Niantic. Make the game more enjoyable, reliable, accessible, and less about greed and location data collection.

I posted a review back when the game first came out. Since then lots of changes happened, new content and whatnot. The game is more accessible in urban locations and has advantages depending on where you live or travel. That's my biggest problem is that either you live somewhere where Pokestops can be found more available, or you'll have to play the micro transactions game. While it has improved experience since I first, some players will always have an advantage.

Update 5/13/2020. Would be nice to be able to open gifts all at once and send them this way also. Also, why does there have to be a limit to how many gifts we can get each day? Lastly, having a star rating show for your Pokemon without having to click "appraise" would be time saving. Would like to see trading added soon. Also, the transfer button should be at the top of the menu so I can get rid duplicate Pokémon faster. Great game so far, just needs some fine tuning.

Entertaining... Until it stopped working on the third day of a fresh installation on a new phone. It was working fine the first two days, but now it just crashes as soon as I get to the map. I cleared cache, data, uninstalled, reinstalled. Would've been a fun way to spend some free time, but I'm glad I didn't have enough time to get too invested before it started crashing.

I've been playing this game since 2016. I did take a couple years off, but I started again about a year ago. My original rating was 4 stars. Then 3 stars. Now we're at 2. Somehow, there are at least as many bugs, if not more. With the new price hike on the remote raid pass, I'm finding less of a reason for this game to take up my time or battery life. Or the increasing amount of money. Please stop with the price gouging, Niantic.

The attraction of this game for me was the fact that it was less complex than standard Pokemon. That's no longer the case. Storyline and faction missions take forever to complete. Floating ad balloons will frequently work to inhibit your ability to tap on things near them -- rotate your screen to try and get a better tap angle on something else, and the balloon will shift with the rotation to stay in the way like it knows you're trying to tap something else. It's just gone so far downhill.

I love Pokemon games in general...always have, always will. But the Pokemon Go game on Android devices is a complete joke. At first I thought it was just my phone, but after trying multiple devices and game tweaks with little success, I've determined that it is the game itself. When I play Pokemon Go on other people's iPhones, it's perfectly smooth and quick to load. On my Android devices, it's perfectly still and doesn't ever load. It's been getting progressively worse since the game came out. I cannot tell you how many in-game items I have wasted (like pokeballs) just trying to have a chance at catching a Pokemon. Literally 75% of my throws glitch and land in absurd places. If you are trying to catch one of the Pokemon that appears further away than others, you're doomed. It will glitch and come up EXTREMELY short unless you have an iPhone. On top of that, the menus NEVER load. A huge majority of my time playing Pokemon has been trying to click on the Pokemon in my collection...no joke. If you ever want to scroll through your Pokemon on an Android phone, you're in way over your head... It's a shame because I love the game itself...the only problem is that the game only truly exists for iPhone users.

It's a really good game to play especially with friends. I just updated it an had to transfer some of my duplicates, every time I did, it would take me all the way back to the top of the list an I don't really like that. I wanna be able to transfer my extras without having to find were I was. An another thing, I tried to get some coins but it wouldn't accept my card.(Ik for a fact there was more then enough money on it so that wasn't the issue.)

I love this game from the start but I had to change my original 5 star review to 3 because every time there is an update I can play for a couple of hours then once I close my game and go to reopen it later, I can't. I get an "unable to authenticate" error. I know many other people who says this happens to them. I have met a few new players that said it started happening to them after a couple updates ago. Please fix this problem. The only way to get back in and keep playing is to change your password. Even then it takes a couple of hours for the error to go away. Sometimes when you fix it by changing the password it happens again a couple of days later. It is annoying and taking away from the game as someone may not want to play if they keep needing to do this, especially if they only have a limited amount of time in their day to play. They don't want to use half or almost all of that time resetting a password and waiting for it to work.

The first summer it was released was magical. Being able to track Pokemon and find them was SO much fun. You'd go out to a park, and someone would yell out, "there's an Electrabuzz over here!" And people would rush over hoping to catch it. There was something so simple yet engaging in its first version. But the constant bugs, removal of the tracker, and late updates really killed any momentum this game had of being truly remarkable.

I was able to play all day today, without any issues. Tried getting back on, and it wanted me to update the game. Okay, sure. Well now, like everyone else, the game either won't load, or crashes as soon as it gets past the front loading screen. Obviously can't play if the game won't even load 🤦‍♀️ Maybe they will fix this issue in the next day or two so we can play again..

The only thing I am unhappy about is the difficulty finding certain types of Pokemon, which seems to change at random. Especially when I have research quests demanding specific types, or very specific Pokemon. I'm also NOT thrilled with the region specific Pokemon. Aside from these the game play is pretty smooth, the graphics are phenominal, and the ability to play with my family as friends is a great benefit. Over all this is an exceptionally family friendly app, and a wonderful game

The game is fun, it has a lot going on. The mechanics work well and are very smooth, the game has taken off from it's starting date in 2016, no issues with gameplay itself. But I find it frustrating/unfair that things like raid hour and "complete 30 raids" type missions are ridiculously obnoxious, one raid pass a day, and it's 100 coins per pass. I don't want to spend two weeks doing what I have to just to complete one mission, personal lives and children make that quite hard.

I've played this since the beginning, July 2016. I've gone through all the bugs.. Just kept playing. However, the lagging, losing raid passes (not my fault) getting them back is really hard to do. Took me forever to figure it out. click here, and boom you take me to another spot and out of game..so I log back in try it again, again, again. I finally got it back. Niantic, you've become so greedy. You're one of the biggest games but you keep raising your store prices. You're losing us 1 by 1.

adventure sync is really bad at monitoring my km. adventure sync is on, high accuracy location and it still screws me out of rewards. I walk over 20 miles at my job alone and drive to places 250 miles away... still can't even hit 25km. please figure out how to make that more accurate for everyone or change the weekly goals to something a little more obtainable like 5km, 15km, 25km. other than that the game is amazing. I enjoy it and just got into pokemon go last year. fun goals and interactive.

It's a fun diversion built on the skeletal remains of Ingress. The flick controls are forgiving but inaccurate, making it tough to chuck a ball consistently. I quit for two years because I live in a rural area and there was nothing to do. There are still no stops or gyms near me, but at least pokemon finally show up and I get different varieties.

I love it!!!! Edit:. Redownloaded in 2019 and have been hugely addicted. Make your packs better value though. As mentioned in another review, it is cheaper to buy 100 coins for .99c than it is to buy the other packs which is terrible for apple as they lock you out of credit card for suspicious activity. We refuse to buy into the scam of 550 coins for $6.99 it just seems rediculous. Thanks for an awesome game otherwise.

Adventure Sync isn't working at all. I liked being able to log how much I walked during the day, since my job has me walking around a lot. But now, nothing, no eggs and no progress. I'm not going to keep the app open all day and drain my battery life. Get Adventure Sync working again!!!! It's still an option in settings.

Game is enjoyable but the character selection/features are lackluster, less than low budget games. And when I found out it was done intentionally, I was disappointed. Previously, before a certain update, the character selection was better and the artistry looked better. Pokemon Unite is another Pokemon Game and they have really cool characters to choose from and be, including changing styles. A nice portion of the game is individualizing your character, to take that away is a huge slip up.

PoGo is a deeply flawed as a game for many reasons that most people have covered here, but(!) It's perhaps the only game to recapture the sense of adventure and wonder we had as children. It feels like secrets are behind every corner and there's a whole world to explore. Playing this game has frustrated me no end with all the bugs and problems, but through it all it has also made me extremely happy and I've met many great people along the way. I thoroughly recommend it.

Originally had this game at 1 star because of Niantics terrible management of this game. Though this temporary event doesnt fix the main issues with the game (which is still plenty. Ie tracker, grinding, end-game goals) it's a step in the right direction. Editing my review to give props on the effort on their part. Still a long way to go though.

Pokemon Go. It really is a fun game. I've spent the last few days catching mons and taking gyms. But so far, I could only do it in the afternoon-night due to how loaded the server is during the day. Other than that, solid game. Edit: After multiple questionable decisions made by Niantic, such as increasing remote raid pass prices and actively hurting the accessibility that the game once had for its players, I can no longer recommend playing this game.

It has been a long time since I last reviewed this game, so since so much has happened since then, I decided to edit my review. While far from perfect, all the new features (research, friends, trading, etc) has made this game fun for me. I would very much like to see something to help me find raids in the town closest to me. My local group will find all the level 5, but I would like to be able to see some of the others without wasting gas to search in vain. And it would be nice if the EX eligible gyms would expand to include my local park which has 5 gyms, while the nearest eligible ones have 3 or less...just saying.

The game have greatly improved, but the PvP is poorly executed. If it was more traditional combat (as additional option) there would be even more people playing it. There is no tracking pokemon in the wild, only near pokestops. There is no additional (real) quest system. For example go to... (real place near you) find (some pokemon/team rocket/item) and a chance for the quest to escalate. Overall it is a good game, with room for improvement. Also where is the team battle system?

Thought I'd reinstall this game after 12 months. Waste of time, it was very buggy. No upgrades to the system what so ever I loved this game from the very beginning, but now it is a shadow of what it once was. The GPS system has a mind of its own, constantly freezing up during raids, and it has become a game of basically grinding on very boring and repetitive missions. The developers had a great game once, they have let the Pokemon community down.

Let's get this out of the way: I know that launching a large game is difficult, but the server issues caused by poor prediction of player base is frustrating and game-breaking. I expect Niantic to do better and they have to work hard to get to the level of quality expected of them. The server issues create a host of unexpected behavior, including unbeatable gyms and frequent halts, crashes, and generally broken gameplay. When the game works, it's a casual, fun way to enjoy the world of Pokémon.

Really great game! I really enjoy the concept of walking around town to catch the Pokemon. Edit: my current complaint is that 9 times out of 10, Pokemon Go won't connect to my GO-TCHA device. The device works just fine with its one app, and my phone's bluetooth is working properly, but I can almost never get Pokemon Go to connect to it and I find this extremely frustrating.

Well since the last update, which states "bug fixes". I'd like to know what bug fixes they're talking about. I've had the app as of 05/04/17 a little over a year and up until this update hadn't had any problems really. Since the last update 6 days ago I've had to log out, and restart the game many times in the last week. I never had to log out before. Pokemon before took maybe a few times at best to capture. After this update tiny pokemon with hp 100 get out of the balls 5, 6, 7 times. That's ridiculous... many issues it looks like and it appears I'm not the only one who thinks so. Hope Niantic gets the (bug fixes) done

I am an unashamed 45 year old woman who loves playing this game with my grown children!!!! However, as of 1/27/2020 gyms are either not showing up or showing up in the wrong locations unless I restart my game. I have also noticed issues with the renaming feature and I have frequent problems with the GPS shooting me off to unknown locations then bringing me back. Please fix the bugs. It would also be great to be able to tap on people in gyms and send friend requests.

I love the app, I was playing it almost daily up until recently until this last update (think it's the last one); I've tried updating it for about two weeks now and it just won't update. I've tried everything to get it to update so I can open the app and hatch my eggs, but it refuses. I keep getting notifications because I have eggs that are hatching, but can't open the app without having to update. This has become quit aggravating and I hope it can get fixed.

The biggest problem I see with Pokemon Go is the lack of a clear way to win. One can devote countless hours to the search for rare pokemon, battles in gyms, and the travel to pokestops. After those hours, you would still have an infinite number of hours left to continue to try and improve your arsenal. Also, there are updates (mandatory) to this game every week or 2. Very annoying. After years of playing this game, I have nothing to really show for it. Thousands of players are still stronger than me, which makes me wonder how many hours they have wasted as well.

As a big Pokémon fan, I played this game since the day it came out. The biggest problem is how much the game forces you to play in certain ways to complete certain tasks. I'm not a fan of the forced multiplayer for raids and forced walking for tasks which is not always convenient or safe in my area. Other similar games have more to do while you are not moving and this game sorely lacks that. Finally, the pricing and lack of opportunity to get in-game currency is disappointing.

The game implemented a bunch of great changes over the pandemic that made the game easier to play and more enjoyable. Since, they started rolling those changes back, and increasing the cost of raids and limiting how many you can do in a day. Quests often require you to see or catch pokemon that often aren't available for months at a time. As a player of many mobile games, this is one of the least friendly to players who don't have much money to spend.

Its okay, it definitely gives you something to do when you're out doing errands but it'd be nice if female characters could wear male items. Like the Fire red cap. Or backpacks that are only for male characters at the moment. I just feel female customization is very limited in comparison and male characters have so much more (better) options to choose from. 😭 I even switched to using a male character because of it. Even though I prefer having a female character.

This could have been great, and even was in some ways when it came out. However, through various updates and a lack of communication with the community, Niantic has ruined this game. Tracking has been removed after being bugged for weeks, making it harder to find pokemon. Additionally, spawn rates have been reduced, making it even harder to find them. Then, Pokeball capture rates decreased, while the pokemon jump/attack more often. Overall, players are being duped into buying more Pokeballs.

I love Pokemon Go. I just have one problem. It is so buggy. If any network request ever fails the whole UI can fall apart and stop responding. The game is worse now then when it launched. As time goes by, my patience for these issues gets less and less. It's very common to have to relaunch the game in order to deal with various bugs - unselectable gyms, pokemon not appearing, pokemon not being able to be selected, etc.

This game has gotten so bad now... I came back after a few months and it has really gotten bad. Even with my mobile data on and even on a stable wifi connection, it lets me login and the screen goes blank. It displays a message about wifi connection but, I do have connection. Unable to play doesn't even show my character or any options. I was looking forward to playing again but, sadly I'm leaving again. Good luck Niantic

Pokemons Go is a good game. Not great. But a good game. Some of the game play can get very tedious at times *cough the gym battles cough* but other than that everything pretty alright. 2 major problems however with the game are the login methods and lagginess. I've lost at least 3 accounts because you have to pass a massive security check. Second there's the lag. If you don't have mobile data, you're screwed. Overall good game but nothing amazing.

I still love the game but I am becoming increasingly frustrated with the lopsided RNG factor. I put in a ton of effort with little to no progress in some areas and it's becoming more of a constant letdown than anything. It seems as if the game is only recently beginning to pick up pace again. I'm hoping things continue towards positive.

The game has definitely improved and they have added a lot to make it more interesting. The only thing I have a problem with is while winners of a gym battle get first chance to put pokemon in the gym, if another team joins in while you do all the work to defeat it they can take it out from under you which is very frustrating. I've had many gyms I had to beat multiple times because someone stole it from under me.

Fun game, got hit with an error 6 that didn't go away even after restarting was messing with the screen. Had to reinstall. Could do with more rural pokestop help though. Not everyone has a pokestop near them so it make it hard on them and gives an unfair advantage to other people. Would be great if homestops were added to the game, make it personal, you can only spin it every 15 minutes and can't use lures on it (it will help players with not many pokestops around).

Unless you live in or near a big city the game could be frustratingly empty in regards to pokéstops. For those of you who don’t yet play the game, pokéstops are landmarks like statues, attractions, special buildings, and the like. They have stepped up their placement of pokestops in smaller towns, but many of the mechanics still heavily favor large metropolitan areas by nature of the games design. There's no real way to fully mitigate that but they're doing what they can to try.

The constant updates are very inconvenient and seem a bit unnecessary. I don't know about anyone else, but since this game takes up quite a lot of space, updating it is a huge hassle that usually prevents me from playing the game for a while, since I have to delete other apps in order to make room for the update. I would prefer larger updates that happen occasionally, rather than one every week.

Super sad the crown tundra pants were removed. When I tried to change my outfit the game glitched out my avatar, turing it into the default male character. When I changed everything back I looked for the pants and they were gone. The were the only bottoms I actually liked, so I am very disappointed that that are missing. I also wish there was an option to change the colour of the masks. Overall fun game.

Greatly improved since its launch. I am a returning player, and the pokestops as far as i am aware have increased significantly in frequency, as well as gyms. I can actually play now! The buddy system is very cute, the battles and GO Rocket battles are nice, and remote raids are a great addition. One issue I have now is that every time I go to catch a pokemon (literally, every time) it tells me to update ARCore, which WOULD be fine... If ARCore actually HAD an update for me to get. Pls fix!

I've been playing this game for a while and enjoying it, despite it being exceptionally buggy. Frequently, I would just be logged out and I'd have to jump through a bunch of hoops (such as deleting cache) in order to log back in. Whenever it needed an update I would actually need to delete and reinstall it. On its most recent update I can't even reinstall it. This is preposterously broken.

The app would have gotten at least 4 stars from me. I don't do reviews often but I was a fan of pokemon growing up and even with all the bugs that come with pokemon go I still enjoyed playing a lot. This all changed when the valentine's day event update was pushed through. I had seen 1 Chansey in the nearby list in the 7 months I had been playing, so I was very excited about the opportunity to catch 1. After the update the app crashes when I tap on a wild pokemon to catch it. Gyms still can be battled, pokestop can be spun but I cannot catch anything which is the whole point. I've sent many crash reports from my android and submitted support requests with no answer. I can only play with a tablet connected to wifi.

Was a fun game. The developers of the game keep making poor decisions that limit the game and the ways to play it, decreasing the value that players get. Cutting event times in half, removing rewards, increasing the price of everything in the boxes, and now the changes to remote raiding. Enough is enough for me, can't support this game anymore because all I can think of is everything they took away from me as a long time player who occasionally spent money on the game.

I love this game and have played for 2 years. However when I make nice/great/excellent throws with ultra balls, pokemon flee more often than when I land the poke ball outside the circle. Also, sometimes research doesn't register that I completed it. For example today I battled in a raid to complete a special resesrch task, didn't win, and the task is still incomplete. Poke ball reset still lags for android.

Updates happen often and the app is a memory hog, uses a lot of data and drains the battery quickly. You can paly once each update is completed. Plan for this. Updates are needed. They are working through the bugs. It is a fun game and you can play it for free once you learn how. i'm sure it is more gratifying when you spend some money.

It's been unstable and none of the updates have done anything to improve that, but I stuck with it and spent a lot of time and a fair amount of money - then we get to the anniversary event and supposed to be lots of bonuses but my account just stops working - not banned (I'm a stickler for the rules and no ban email) - just won't log in, tried multiple devices. So I'm missing out on all the anniversary bonuses, and I can get NO response from support, absolutely zero.

As if it is not bad enough that this game glitches out in terms of accurate GPS/location readings, but I have in the past purchased an item through Niantic for Pokemon Go, and activated it, only to have the game crash on me again. I contacted Niantic for a refund, as the item was unusable in this instance, and the company literally did not once try to rectify the issue; it was as if I didn't exist, but they were sure happy to take my money. How about responding to your customers, Niantic?

The game is excellent in every way, as far as time management, on the go, and is a great outting with friends. The only thing I really dislike about the Pokemon management system, is that for events, you can't transfer them during or after. So presently I have like 25 pikachus just sitting in my pokedex, and I'm waiting for an update that allows me to get rid of them. UPDATE-I figured out how to transfer pomemon manually.

The game is fine, the location based spawns definitely incentivize going to the city over actually exploring or walking. I think they should drop the whole walking thing to some level or add some feature specifically pertained to walking. The battles are simple at best and the ways you can interact with the world feels liiting. The 2 main things that make the game fun is pokemon and collecting. It's a collectors game, though i wish it was more. Atleast they put a lot of effort in anti-spoof.

The least polished game I've ever seen allowed to bear the Pokemon name. Turn off all the sounds, they're unbearable. Turn off battery saver and enable native framerate. It's capped super low by default, but doesn't actually appear to help the terrible battery drain. Also: after 8 years, they added some character customization, but it's the ugliest thing I've ever seen. How did it get approved? But hey, it gets me up and walking around places more than I otherwise would, so full credit there.

I've played since day one and loved it. Sometimes the changes to game play are rough, but it ended up being OK. However, in the last couple of years, but especially lately, it has become extremely expensive. You have to buy a ticket for almost every event, sometimes the events are exclusive to paid tickets, and I'm not talking the big Pogo events. THEN, your purchase isn't even guaranteed - You have to perform a ridiculous number of tasks in a certain time frame or you get nothing.

Core of the game is simple, you go out and catch Pokemon to gain a currency for that specific Pokemon, and raise Pokemon. Theres way too many bugs, particularly ones that block the player from getting resources, logging in, participating in the core of the game. The developers released this as a "Beta", so basically the modern equivalent of a fully released game with the excuse for as many bugs as they have. It's still fun, but the UX is terrible

It's a fun game overall, but it continues to have the same bugs that it has had for years, mainly errors for gym battles and raids, which are a pretty big part of the game. Frok the standpoint of a consumer, it seems like more effort is put towards new gimics and flashy content rather than fixing foundational issues, and it feels as though Niantic does not have the support staff necessary to provide for their consumers.

This game has had my attention on and off since its release in 2016, but my frustration begin to grow in the past several months as I kept experiencing more and more bugs where my game would freeze, or UI elements wouldn't show. The release of XL and XS Pokemon was an underwhelming feature that adds little to gameplay and they soon followed it by restricting the way people can play the game by changing remote raids . The game was at its best during the pandemic when they laxed restrictions

This game has improved so much from when I first started playing! It's a great source of enjoyment for me every day. Right now, the only improvement I can suggest is to take all the pop up notifications we get, telling us what a friend received from my gift or that our friendship level increased, and put that into a list that we can close out if we want to. It takes so long to get through all of those notifications when I first open my game, it's super annoying. Otherwise, I love the game! Ready for Gen 4 Pokemon!

Ok I really enjoy this game most of the time. However, it still has so many bugs and the app itself is way too large. A major issue is the drift that happens about 60% of the time when you stay still for too long. Another is when in a gym battle the game decides you should be using a different Pokemon than the one you've assigned even if it was half way dead. A problem with the game play that I have is vast disparity between instinct and the other two teams, and this mainly has to do with how the gym system and raid battles work off team participation so whenever there is a raid battle most of the time team instinct is in last. This situation leads to a larger gap showing between team instinct and other teams that is nearly impossible to over come. I would like to see a less team bases evaluation in raids. However I understand it's basically impossible to balance the gym system without giving buffs based on the percentage of each team in a certain area, with the lowest getting the biggest buff. One thing I hope is never done is allowing people to switch teams as I am nearly 100% certain instinct will go extinct the second it becomes an option. One feature I believe would greatly benefit a lot of players is a way to turn down the graphics. Honestly the game lags like the betrayer's layer of hell in dante's inferno. Hopefully being able to turn off all the extremely flashy effects would help with that. No offense but I don't need fireworks every time I feed my Pokemon at a gym. Lastly ADD A TUTORIAL THAT EXPLAINS THINGS! I can't count how many times I've had to find out about extremely important features through other people and Google instead of the actual game. There is nothing about how to earn poke coins anywhere, what the blue aura in the Pokemon screen is, and getting 7km eggs. I mean seriously there are new players to this game that aren't omniscient. I'm also gonna take a wild guess and say there was a lot of stuff missing from that list that I still don't know.

Was excited to get to play it as i know other people who use the app, unfortunately though, it seems i an unable to move anywhere. Even if i walk around, the game does not track my location and my character remains frozen in its spot. Cannot figure out how to fix this. Edit: i have figured out a tedious way to move around, by closing the app and reopening it in a different location. Gotta do this whenever i want to go somewhere, though.

Edit: Unable to authenticate tring to log in for the past month. Have tried reinstalling and changing my password. I can no longer get pokestops driving into town, so I'm uninstalling. I would have to drive far out of my way to wonder around a park for just 2 pokestops and it's just too inconvenient. This game barely offers anything, but continually makes it more difficult to do anything.

I used to regularly spend money on their boxes because they provided a good deal for getting incubators. Not any more. Sadly their pricing has changed and so has their boxes. Every week now they change and they are too expensive and not a good value. And they don't have the play coupon anymore through Google play. The only good thing is I will be saving money.

Had a pretty good time with the game, its fun and has alot to offer but sadly at some point it just stopped counting my steps. So now i have over 9 eggs i cant hatch and cant comeplete some quests because of this bug. I'm not the only one having this issue, but I am hoping it gets fixed soon. Would gladly play again once it gets fixed. Edit: Bug was fixed and back to playing again!

It's a pretty good game for the most part, but of course my favorite pokemon riolu is extremely if not impossible to get without spending real $, and a lot of time, and even then it's still a very small chance. I wish it was easier to trade, I don't have any friends I can trade with because all my friends are long distance. And it would be nice if Pokemon spawn according to their environment, like water pokemon near places with water, etc. And I would of liked having different hair styles.

Great casual game - competition is a focus, but you can avoid it and choose to not PvP. However, since day one, it's been targeted towards flagship model phones, and people who use mid to low-rage phones are generally unable to enjoy the game because it uses too much resources. Every asset is almost PS3 levels of detail by polycount alone, for Pete's sake! There is not even an option to downsize the resolution of the game - an option responsible yet smaller devs do for this game engine (Unity).

Overall... it wasn't too bad. The prices are quite reasonable, the cheapest coin pack is actually affordable, but the 550 coin pack is somehow more expensive that buying 5 100 coin pack, weirdly enough. The mission rewards weren't half bad, but somehow the mission progress was slower than my game progress. Also, I don't like that more than half the landmark aren't updated to the recent condition, and while grinding isn't easy in normal games, this one is much2 harder in real time.

I've reviewed this game a number of times over the years since it's been out. At this point, I'll leave it at...it's a good game, that could be much better. If you can deal with the bugs and glitches, & live in an urban area with gyms and pokestops, you'll enjoy playing with friends. If you don't like learning to live with new and odd bugs/glitches that come in with each update, or live in a rural area, you may not enjoy the game. Niantic could do better with the great base game they have.

Constant server issues, and now log in failures. Edit 7/2/23 I've been playing this game since it dropped. Now we're back to the same issues as when it first came out. I've been unable to log in 95% of the time and when the game does log me in, it freezes. I've tried every little trouble shooting tip Niantic provided and NOTHING. Absolute BS

I've had this game for years and put so much time and a little bit of money into it over the time. throughout the years they've leaned heavy towards the pay to play/do well side. about a week and a half ago, the latest update hit, and basically rendered the game useless, as it now immediately kicks me out saying the app has a bug. I am certain Niantic knows about it, but seems to refuse to fix it. there is also virtually no way to contact their support outside of the game.

This game has so much potential, yet the developers took this precious diamond of an idea and basically just make us use it as a paper weight. 2 years into development and it's the same throw & tap, just getting more and more rare shinys you'll never find and stupid unbalanced events that are either too good to miss out or too boring to even go out. It just sucks that the battle part of the game lacks almost everything that was cool about Pokemon. At least you get the chance to socialize with some awesome people, go outside and get some fresh air and exercise, thanks for that.

On one hand, being able to catch Pokemon in real life is awesome. On the other: the constant resets, bugs, failure of tracking system, server issues, balls that curve without prompt, and other things really kill this game. I'm pretty sure if it was Anything but Pokemon it would have failed on day one. EDIT 2019: waited a few years, it's mostly just an alright game, let's you play pokemon with people. Solid 3 stars for mediocrity

I think this game has a lot of potential. I'd like to see it become awesome. Update: Played this for several years, spent a lot of cash on it. Not worth it. They just add more pokemon for you to collect which dilutes the spawns for all of them, making it harder to catch the ones you want. Now events are locked behind paywalls. Tried so many times to get enough people for 5 star raids, next to impossible. So many things wrong with this game, frustrated, leaving

As a player who started on the day it came out, has been playing since then, and has actually spent money on the game.. it's just not worth it anymore. Niantic has taken a great game and just absolutely tried to squeeze every penny out of its user base. Between the remote raid pass changes and price increases, I've lost interest in leveling up, and my husband has too. Super sad. ☹️ This was a great game, Niantic, and you've ruined it.

As much as I love the game. I have not been impressed with the amount of challenges/events that Niantic has been adding to the game with the pandemic going on. Yes they have made it so you can play more of the game from home. To have it so I need to find a raid that I can solo while being under a stay at home order is a little ridiculous.

Was a player of this game from the beginning. Always loved the idea of walking around and catching pokemon. It's gotten to the point now that the game isn't enjoyable anymore. And everything they do to "help" the game I feel like they're getting farther from the point of helping. The spawns are the same, you basically have to pay to get the good or cool pokemon. Any package you can buy to get items to help speed up the game cost at an insane rate. Just nah man.

Since it just launched, the servers have been crashing. When it's running, it can still be slow especially when walking past pokestops. Also, I used an incense item right before a server crash which was a waste of the item. Can't wait to see how the game will end up, but right now it is pretty hard to play.

I'd seriously pay money if I could get the app to not crash and freeze 30 times a day, or even if it didn't take 2 minutes between clicking on something and it actually pulling up whatever I clicked on. If I had a dollar for every time a Mon popped up and I immediately click just to get an error reading "this item can't be used at this time." I'd be able to pay to fix this bull for you.

Update: I have still not been reimbursed for my wasted lure. I put a lure down and was immediately kicked from the app. In the half hour I had the lure down, I reset the app 20 times. I was only able to get in 3 times and even then, it took over 5 minutes to load each time. I caught 1 or 2 each time until the app froze. And then I wouldn't get the app to load for another 10 minutes. I love this game, but this update fixed absolutely NOTHING of significance and all it did was slow the game down more. So pissed that I wasted the lure that I paid for.

Some features need to be fixed. Minor bugs and some server issues, I don't think they were prepared for that much traffic. I'll still play in hopes that they fix the bugs and add battling and more Pokemon. I'd pay just to have more features and mini games with this. It could be a lot better. Still, helping me handle my alcohol problem by not sitting on my butt! Edit: This game has been ran into the ground by people that don't even play their own game.

I loved the first few weeks of the game the going out and seeing everyone playing together, now I've seen a bit of embarrassment at still playing it. My biggest problem is the lack of gyms and stops within a good walking distance. (traveling to play a phone game is out of the question) I guess it isn't the game for me. Oh bonus points on finally having a way to hatch eggs outside of having the game open.

DO NOT PLAY. Hypocritical game that only allows "one account per player" but allows multiple sign-ins per device. Only has one way to get free coins, but does not limit each account's time in the gym to 8 hrs 20 mins daily (to get the coins) and allows bullies to take over as many gyms as they want to without consideration for other players. The company will continue getting away with it because players generally don't stand up for one another.

This game is awesome, but there are a few issues. For example, I can't install the recent update, but it may be because of my phone and not the app. Also, I NEED Sylveon in the app! She is my favorite pokemon and the only Eeveelution not in the game! Finally, I would like to be able to talk with your friends or with people you battle with. Great game otherwise!

great game. Aside from breeding, it reflects most of pokemon gameplay in a more interactive manner. But the game is riddled with bugs. I noticed a premium pass disappeared from my inventory even though i hadn't done raids... And i'm pretty sure that despite being a lvl up reward, that it didn't have an expiration date. In the gyms when you click on the spin the game sometimes brings you through a bugged animation to an unusable screen. Just to name a few because i reached the character limit

just horrible. the last few months I've struggled to load in at all. there was a brief couple week period it seemed to be resolved, but now it's worse than ever. today for example, tried to load in for 30 minutes!!!!!! and you can't leave the loading screen lol. sometimes it would throw an error, sometimes it would just give me the silent treatment. it would give me juust enough hope by loading till halfway, every goddamn time. I'm so done with this

So far so good but getting too complicated now. Although, the Raid Boss and the legendary Pokemon makes the game more exciting. However, they are getting too complicated along with time.
