And yet every few months I can't play it anymore without spending money which at this point I am refusing to do. I have no room to catch or spin. I noticed a trend recently with my gameplay. I play every 2 to 4 months and only maybe one or two day. I used to play everyday. It sucks and makes me sad.

So, the most recent update has made it increasingly more difficult to edit the names of the pokemon and it closes the app every time I use the AR option. Also, the issue with your trainer just running away from your current location is absolutely frustrating. You'll even get kicked out of the raid/gym battle sometimes and your trainer will be somewhere else entirely. And it's not the GPS. It's the game. Fix. This.

When I started playing I loved it. Now it has lost its fun. As the game progresses more pokemon are added. This creates a massive storage problem. The only way to continue to play is to buy more storage or get rid your favorite pokemon. The ability to earn coins is low and not everyone wants to pay hundreds of dollars to play a game. I don't have time to take down 10 gyms in a day in hopes of getting a few coins. The cost of the game exceed the value of playing.

Downloaded this game in 2016 and played it all the time. After a while I uninstalled it as it didn't appeal to me as much. Yet here I am in 2021 writing a review. As you can probably already tell by this review I have reinstalled it recently and I must say, the game has not lost its touch. There are several new features and updates I never imagined would be part of Pokémon go and there are still so many things to do. Also my progress was not deleted despite a 4-5 year break. 5 stars 100%.

The game is highly addictive. It will make you walk for hours on end to hatch that one egg or catch that next pokemon. But with all of it, it still has a server error but once you get into the game its fun, only problem is the proximity to the Pokemon is off, it won't let you know if your getting closer or farther away and the only way to tell if your moving closer is by seeing if the pokemon moves up or down on the pokemon finder but won't tell you anything else, I hope they can fix thia

Its become way better. Now we can actually trade and give each other gifts. I like it a lot now. The quests aka researches can be challenging, but they can give you helpful items/pokemon. There are many more variety of pokemon and it is way more than the server crashing game most people remember. The raid/ex-raid system lets other trainers get together and create a mini society. Keep it up Niantic!!!🙂

Came in to edit my review after deleting the game for the first time since launch. This has been a game that brought a lot of fun to myself and family but at this point with the constant glitches every single update for the better part of a decade and the constant price hikes I'm just done. Niantic had no clue how to keep players happy and wouldn't care to even if they could because apparently the billions they make off pogo isn't enough. Sad to see it come to this.

This game is a mess. I watched a player of two weeks achieve a higher level then my two years of playing. I took a 4 month break, come back, and all that work I did was a complete waste. If you don't live in a big city, don't even bother. I live in a decent sized city but the poke stops are sparsely positioned, gyms are in hazardous areas, Pokemon spawns are repetative with the same Pokemon coming up with the very rare exception. Poke stops won't even give you poke balls so, you're out? Oh well

I've been playing since 2019 and it's been fun my only problem is that it's hard for players like me who don't live in cities, it was nice when the incenses had an increased spawn rate but since they've got rid of it it's been a lot harder to participate in events on days when I can't drive into town. I would like it to be friendlier to people in rural areas such as bringing back the increased spawn rate or lower levels for requesting pokestops. Also you should get PokeCoins from beating gyms.

The grind was actually pretty fun and pressure to spend money was light. Lately though the company has changed course and made some baffling decisions. Major aspects of the game just don't work anymore and the devs have been unresponsive - its clear to me that the game has moved into the point of its life cycle where it's just being milked for cash from the existing players and the devs have lost touch. Can't recommend to a new player.

Not a great app. First of all, they decreased the distance you can get pokestops/gyms WAY too much. I will be 10 feet from a stop and it still won't be close enough. Secondly, raids suck. You never get the invites on time or at all and it is super delayed. Also the pokestops frequently don't spin & give you error message. All in all, ONE STAR. Do better.

This game is fun... if you're not riding a bike. It would be a cool feature if the devs would add a "bike" in game for us who use bikes a lot (I myself use a cane to walk, and have a recumbent trike for exercise) to allow the speed limit to be raised. This would get a 5 star rating from me (But this game is still fun without a feature like that)

FINNAALLYY feels like the game should of felt like at launch! However, for a game that I have spent 0.00$ on and have played for two years I really can't complain. The staggered release of Pokemon as well as added features kept me playing for a long time but I can't help vut to wonder... "What Now?" Once I have every single possible Pokemon with a 90%+ IV I will probably lose interest..

while you've filled in some content and added some minor features this game is still shallower than a kiddy pool. needs more depth to the combat (not less like the new trainer vs trainer!) Gyms are bland, item collection is a rng grind. Raids are for select people only. Rural players are still getting shafted. when are you actually going to flesh this into a full fledged game. the potential to be amazing is still a possibility!

I used to love this game, when I lived in a large city. But I've moved to a rural area and experienced how much that changes the game in a negative way. The difference is massive. Niantic, please increase spawns in rural areas, valuable spawns too. Add more stops and gyms. Make tier 5 raids easier because we don't have as many trainers. As is, this game is only worth playing if you live in a large city. Unfortunately Niantic has ignored the rest of us.

Great game. I love finding Pokémon, catching them and occasionally trying to beat a gym or raid. It's fun to play with my friends and we can trade, send gifts and even battle! However, it would be cool to add a feature where (if the player allows it) you can see if friends are online and maybe where they are so you can meet and play together. I think another good feature would be a messaging system so you can message friends who are online to ask to meet or trade etc.

Adventure sync failed after the first day. Hasn't worked since. No surprise, battery saver still won't work correctly for very long. Lots of improvements since release, but only a few stay working. Plus, catching is only half of a pokemon game. The other half is battling, and this game failed so completely in that area.

So, I don't have room to include everything but I would say since the very beginning of this game, my biggest complaint is how hard it is to play and grind when you live out in the middle of nowhere. No pokestops for miles except maybe one if you're lucky...weak pokemon, no gyms, et cetera et cetera. Oh and PokeGo, when you have something good, don't get rid of it! That's design 101.

If the game worked properly, it would have 4 stars. Since it doesn't and hasn't since they had to add enhanced graphics it hasn't worked more than 5 minutes at a time. And that's just catching Pokemon. God forbid if I try to do a raid or even send a gift! Crashes every single time..before I even get into my gifts or a gym. This game isn't a game any longer, it's a chore.

Game is improving, as the "pay to win" feel at the same time. It will be interesting to see what happens next after the introduction of gen3. Battle, gyms and raiding system dynamics are incredibly simple and in desperate need of some depth. The weather influence was a good addition, but abilities will be needed at a certain point (i.e. soon). 95% of the pokemons are currently mere dex fillers with no actual use in the battle metagame.

Would play again if it weren't for the pay-in-game community catches. It was free for awhile when it first started onwards, but nowadays, you have to pay $0.99 just to participate! If you have money to spend go for it, but for people like me who don't like paying just to get a shiny pokémon, I suggest playing the actual games if have 'em. It's free.

Wish I could buy coins and share on multiple accounts. My kids picked their teams without giving it much thought and now they want to be the same team as me (Instinct). Now I have to go in and spend $10 on each of their accounts. I'd rather just spend $20 one time and get the additional change left over from buying a higher amount. I also don't want my credit card used on their devices. When I tried purchasing on the online store, it said you can't on children's accounts. 🤦

The game is not good. The servers have constant issues that have been around for months that have yet to be addressed. There are gps spoofers constantly that also aren't addressed. The customer service is terrible. And now the game is forcing me to play in AR+, even after I turn it off. It's broken on multiple fronts without even a hint of being fixed.

Update after update, it seems as though the developers want nothing more than to make the game less fun. I was the last of my friends who played this game. Everyone I know, on my 20+ friend list is inactive. I love walking and I love every unique species of Pokémon. It's so basic. I just want to be able to walk and catch anything and everything. And now, with the gym radius lessening, that has become ruined. I can no longer support this game with all its flaws. 1 star.

Yeah, I thought the game was already bad enough. I used to play a lot more about 5 years ago, and everywhere I went, there were at least 2 pokestops. As of today, I have to travel 10 miles to find one poke stop. This means I have no more pokeballs to even play the game, I have to pay for them. If that wasn't enough, whoever thought changing the player model was a good idea should be fired and Blacklisted. I genuinely hope Pokemon Co. Step In to fix this. Otherwise, the game is dead to me.

It's an overall fun game, but lately it's just been lagging HORRIBLY no matter what I am doing. I could be trying to catch a pokemon and it'll freeze up and make me waste pokeballs and/or berries. Also when you're in battles it lags so much when you're trying to use your charged up attack that by the time you actually used your opponent has done more damage to your pokemon!!!! It also lags at the moment you finished charging your attack. It needs to be fixed ASAP please.

As much as I enjoy this game, every time there's an update something seems to break. With the latest one, every time I'm away from PoGo for more than a few hours, the game is unable to load and I have to log out and log back in. If I have to do this every time I want to play the game, it should at least save my settings and permissions for my account, especially when I need to uninstall/reinstall at least every month because the app broke itself again.

Been playing since 2017 overall it's been a fun game to play. But more and more it feels like a pay to win. You can only really make the most out of the game if you have a very specific set of conditions. Gyms and pokestops near you, friends to play with and money to spare. Bugs are a minor problem aswell. Might install again if niantic makes some adjustments.

Fix the server issues please. I agree with complaints about how this doesn't feel like Pokemon without battling components for training. ***/***** Update: Many improvements over the years. I do wish that the trading system was updated and allowed for some distance trading, but hey, they've been playing catch-up for years now.

From playing this game, you will find many advantages despite little disadvantages. One of the advantages such as your health will be better as you are walking around to find a pokemon so it consider as exercise. Then, you can make a new friends when finding pokemon or at pokestop and gym. Anyway, got a little bugs that need to be fix but overall, this game is awesome.

Garbage, works purely on addiction factor and constant events trying to pull you in due to fear of missing something rare. Very little actual gameplay and mostly just going around hoping to get lucky. Loves to waste your time by making you spend 3-5 minutes tapping the screen in one place to "fight" a raid, then makes the catch rate so low you'll probably not catch the thing afterwards anyway. I'm giving it an extra star because the Pokémon are cute.

The more I play this, the more I realize how little Niantic knows about Pokémon. The trainer battles are a joke, you catch hundreds of pokémon to get nothing but bad stats, and it's becoming more pay to play. If you work, you don't have time to enjoy any of the events or go catch pokémon or get items. The worst part is if you don't have anyone to go to 3 star raids or higher with, you might as well forget catching that pokémon. If you love the RPG series, don't waste your time with this game.

The game is great, but one problem. I am always a passenger and can't get out much to place that have any stops or gyms I do catch stops just fine (there aren't any in my area, I need to go far for them) But gyms, when I was in a driving car I wanted to fight in a gym, the battle was about to start but what I can only assume to be from the fact we went too far, the game threw me out of the battle was said "The gym is completed " despite me not even getting to tap a single hit. Pls fix

The game itself is fine. Niantic is terrible. Don't waste your time. I uninstalled the game after playing for 6 weeks. I'm following all terms and policies yet Niantic blocks most of the content as if I'm breaking them. When I ask why, I only get generic answers that if I follow the rules there's no reason for concern. The block lasted 10 days at a time and happened 3 times while I had the app. I still don't know what I was doing wrong. Worst company ever!

5* when one fatal flaw is fixed! I think it's incredibly cool how much this game improves and the developers clearly respect their player base and have made updates based on feedback alone. My main complaint is that sometimes, if I'm in a pokemon confrontation and I use a berry on the pokemon, when I go to throw a ball it isn't responsive. I can leave the battle though, and close the game but can't select anything in the battle or be able to throw a ball! I've lost some good pokemon due to this.

The social aspect of this is atrocious. Having to download another app no one uses to try to connect for raids is silly at best. The use of team rocket to block stops would be fine if it wasn't SO often. At this point you don't get enough from the stop to warrant the loss in potions. I assume that's the point, so you have to buy more with real money. A dreadfully shameful tactic for a game kids play.

I don't recommend this game. Glitchy and laggy as always and always over price there stuff. They won't compensate those who already completed tasks that they say will automatically complete. I mean come on, you take so long to fix stuff that by the time you do fix it and say you will auto clear stuff it would be to late because we would have already cleared them. The game has always and will forever be a disappointment with the people controlling it. They say there sorry but not and won't be.

Been playing since the original release and absolutely love this game. That being said, the lack of both developer interaction and meaningful updates are killing my enjoyment of the game. I don't really have an issue with PokeStop changes, though I understand the negative effects it has on multiple players in the community. I just can't see myself investing more time or money into a game that doesn't seek change or improvement.

I've been playing since the VERY 1ST DAY it released!!!....... Now withing the last 2 days (3/7/24) it says there's a "bug" detected and I can no longer load my profile!!! Which is UNBELIEVABLY DISAPPOINTING considering how long I've been playing (and spending REAL, hard earned $$$ on "in game" purchases!)!!! Have no way of contacting Niantic (can only do it INSIDE the game!) to tell them about the "bug" issue!!!

Not the greatest of games or even a good pokemon game itself. It is a step in the right direction trying to incorporate healthy lifestyles and video games in one and did a lot for getting lots of kids up and out. That it self is to be commended. I will say it is hard to get stronger pokemon in areas you stay in and forces some travel, the point, which I believe to be one of the points behind the game. Definitely worth playing especially if you are a walker, runner, bicyclist, or hiker.

I can never put my pokemon in the gym. The players in this neighbourhood camps and kicks you out the moment it's not one of them. It's frustrating not being able to play, some people can take in all the coins while others can barely get anything. Its not a great feeling to have while playing, much like bullying. Maybe input a better capping system to help the spread more fairly. Overall it's still fun to catch things casually.

Game used to be good, but after the recent changes Niantic made I can no longer say that the game is worth it. There's barely any new "content" added. Prices were raised on raid passes, plus limits added, and most, if not all, rural areas suffer from a lack of new things or catchable Pokemon that aren't constant repeats of the same thing. It's not the same anymore.

Good game. Though with a phone with only so much storage it's almost impossible to play when there is updates every month. Just release the full game game it's done. Another problem is the cutscenes are too long. If your in a moving car and want to fight a gym. By the time the cutscene is done you already have drove past it. Plus with Pokestops only opening when your next to it, it's pretty annoying when the words "try again later" pop up. And, it's called Pokémon go. So why do you need wi-fi?

I think its good. Quite a good game to do while going out for minutes then going back home to stay in quarantine. But issues is lately. I had duplicates of the same pokémon in the area. Could try and make it so its less the same. And also hand out some codes so people can use them for items. Never be greedy for cash if we all stuck inside.

I've been playing since the beginning (2016). The game has tons of bugs and glitches, predatory pricing for in game items, a high focus on in real life experiences that are costly and unplayable due to bugs and server issues. On top of that, Niantic lately is removing game play options like it by the community, leaving behind a disappointed and unheard community. I won’t recommend you to download the game until Niantic resolve core issues with the game.

Good game, but it is difficult for players who don't live in a city. There is only one pokestop within reasonable distance from me, and it is in a cemetery. The adventure sync rewards was a good start, but it doesn't fully make up for pokestops. There should be a daily reward that is treated like a pokestop you have to spin, that builds up through the week like spinning the pokestop. The rewards can just be like any other stop, where at the end of the week there's a chance for an evolution item.

Decent piece of encouragement to go outside. You're pretty limited in what you can do if you don't have friends who live nearby (any raid 3 stars or above is near impossible). Listed as not taking up much space then immediately asks for extra data which is a pet peeve. You have to look down at your phone a lot with how short the encounter distance can be plus how fast Pokemon flee, so I don't know how people can use this in cities safely. Overall okay though.

The game is nice when you can actually play it and enjoy it. Most of the time the game glitches out or freezes up. Countless errors pop up with connectivity issues, "all your pokemon have fainted", and even "this gym has already been completed". Support does nothing. My mom has been playing and she has research issues. She could do a task on a new day and the game would tell her it's not done. She'd do it again and it would completely glitch out and mess up her week of tasks. Please fix this.

This game has so much potential!! But niantic does not fix the rural vs urban distinction. If players could get candies by battling, it would solve a bit of the issue. The battle system is lacking, we need more options in battle, more moves, abilities, moving forward back side to side, more pokemon. Go battle league only works half the time. Legendaries are supposed to be rare, not urban exclusive. Raids take away from the game since many people don't have other players to help them. Please fix

Dreampt of a way to catch Pokemon since I was a kid, and this game allows me to do that in the real world. Wish that Niantic would bring back some features of the game that made it worth playing like Legendary breakthrough research Pokemon, more effectiveness to incense while being stationary, etc.... I could go on and on. Overall still a good game just not as good as it use to be in my opinion.

I love this game, but so much of it is stuck behind pay walls, it's unbelievable. Plus Niantic is so stingy with coins, only letting you get 50 coins per day, so even if multiple Pokemon get knocked out, all you get is a fainted Pokemon and nothing else. Additionally, the lag on the catch screen is sometimes so unbelievably awful that I can't properly throw a pokeball and end up wasting 20 because the lag won't register the speed input of the throw. Aside from that, great game

I'd give this a higher rating if it was more fun. I play it once in awhile but now all the new stuff they added makes this game suck. They doubled the price of remote raid passes which sucks, and their "Global events" also cost a lot. Like how you gonna charge 15$ for a 2-day event. Also they put a limit on how many raids you can go on everyday. This game used to be fun but the creators obviously care more about money than the customer.

This game used to be a blast. I was totally addicted. But Niantic has failed to update game loops and give incentives to play those game loops. Plus to play the more attractive parts of the game, you have to buy PokeCoins. I say, you have to buy, because it's not viable to collect PokeCoins. I really wish they would be for the player rather than line their own pockets.

"You've walked 4.3 km this week!" No, because of my job I've walked at least 100 km but Adventure Sync hasn't worked since its release so all that walking doesn't count towards my rewards. And if you try to spin the stops too soon between each one, the game will basically tell you to piss off, which doesn't work well for me as the only ones I pass are on my way to work each day. This "game" specifically punishes anyone who doesn't live in a highly populated area with lots of attractions nearby.

Way to go Niantic. You once again proved that you care nothing about the players. Doubling the cost of remote raid passes! Ridiculous. I will not be purchasing any more raid passes. And then on top of that you limit us to 5 remote raids a day! Many players, such as myself, love in rural areas and have to drive at least 10 miles to get to a gym or PokeStop. This has made me want to play the game way less. I have been a loyal player since the game came out and I'm close to deleting the app

I've been playing since day one and used to love this game, but it's kinda miserable now, esp as a mainly free to player these days. Everything is so expensive, either in time or money and so much is locked behind paywalls (or was & is no longer accessible now, sorry new players!) I like to exercise. i love to walk and run and this game was great for that, but I've found myself just putting my phone away and not caring anymore. Bugs & predatory prices & exclusionary practices have made it suck

I was at level 41, over 100 shinies, 16 perfectly appraised Pokemon, and, all of a sudden, I can't access my account. Contacted Niantic, and they said they can't find my account, even though I took a screenshot from one of my other accounts, that showed the precise account I was trying to access. They said they couldn't find the account's email I was providing, even though I just accessed the account with that same email previously in the day. All that hard work gone. Thanks a lot Niantic.

Pokemon go is a game that most people will recognize already. Many people tried it when it first came out and it's rudimentary form. What people may not know is that it has changed a ton in the time since its release. I like the changes they have made since it's early days. It's much more social now and even though the mechanics of the actual catching and fighting continue to be super simple (too simple to be truly engaging for their own sake) the other aspects of gameplay (curating the collection, raiding gyms, special events) more than make up for it. If you have a collector's mindset this game is completely addictive! I love finding and trading the critters! The raids and the community are the best aspect! I have made a lot of friends playing this game - the type of people that you sit down and have a cup of coffee with and you can talk about your creatures but usually you end up talking about whole lot more than just that. Actual friends. From a "kid game". The other surprising aspect is that a lot of the players are around my same age. They are adults and though I meet a lot of young adults there are surprisingly few teens or kids that have stuck with the game. The statistics-driven collection mindset this game attracts is mostly really awesome geeky adults. It's a little more complex than most children enjoy.

Edit March 2020: I used to play this game a lot, let me get that out there. Used to being the prime words there. Many underlying issues with the game were never addressed, in my first review I had hope that the devs would fix them, they didnt. This game is not targetted at the majority of Pokemon fans and is instead geared toward the hardcore players. I log in now and again, but seeing as there is rarely an event or any interesting pokemon anywhere around where I live it is hard to get invested.

Wishing it was more. I don't know. Back to basics. Like. I want to battle wild Pokemon to level up the ones I want to use. Should have some kind of "trainers spotter" or something. Like see other people playing real time and if you want to trade or battle, should be able to. Capturing Pokemon as to level them up is outrageously unattractive.. Should be more like the games I grew up with. This leaves you feeling isolated and alone.

I like the game well enough, and I exercise regularly, so I dont mind walking. The problem is there's NOTHING near my house except woods. I run out of pokeballs easily and need to drive MILES if I want to find a pokestop to get more. I want there to be another way to "find" pokeballs. You should be able to find them on the ground like in the games. It could be a random drop from pokemon or something. I wouldn't even mind watching video ads daily if I could accumulate pokeballs.

It used to be fun to check on, even as a hypermonetized game, but every component has gotten more user hostile and you can't readily earn enough resources to keep up with costs that are constantly changing. Support also auto-denies requests now. I think it's criminal that this game is available to children, who will not just be annoyed but very tempted to purchase their way around the frustration that has become the entire game.

A little irked at this app's performance lately. It randomly shuts down and occasionally I can't move anything on the screen or tap on anything, causing me to miss catching the Pokémon because I had to restart the app. (edit: oh, now it's freezing on me too. I can't even access my items! 😡) I also kinda find it stupid how you need to buy more storage for both Pokémon and Items, although it does give people a reason to go beat each other's gyms.

THE GAME WAS SO MUCH FUN IN THE FIRST WEEK! Until you got rid of an actual tracker. Now walking over every single square inch of town is insanely frustrating and boring. With a tracker, we could hunt out Pokemon in groups and actually have fun. I'll change my rating to five stars when we have an actual tracker like the game originally had. You can't just put in a loved feature then delete and it act like nothing happened. Disappointing.

So many small things that could be fixed to make this game better. There is so much downtime and loading screens for no reason. Giving gifts shouldn't take 20 minutes. Eggs hatching should be able to be skipped. Raid lobbies should have a ready check instead of having to wait for a countdown in a full lobby. Distance should be increased back to what they had it at as it makes the game safer to play and more accessible. Listen to the players and not just investors.

A nice and interesting game, but I don't enjoy it quite as much as I would like to. This review is all bias. I enjoy the actual Pokémon games a lot. This one is different, and that is fine. However I don't see it competing with the other games. It's just a collecting game that depends on your location. Raids are a nice addition but ultimately boring. Same goes for trainer battles. There is no achievement in it for me, and basically no involvement either. Also it breaks a lot on my phone.

I played this game at release and I put out a review a couple days after its release and the game has evolved a lot since then so I felt it appropriate to update the review. the main thing about the review last time was that servers were constantly going down and connectivity was absolutely poor. these issues have for the most part have been completely fixed. the game has had multiple systems added to it to make it a more fun enjoyable and fair experience. Pokemon go has come a long way.

I used to have 4 stars on this. Not anymore. Niantic is running this game in the ground. PVP doesn't work right. Never has. They've taken away QOL functions that actually made this game better. Now price increases since they're losing money on their other games. My granddaughter and I are hanging up our accounts. We'll find other ways to fill in what used to be our pogo time. That's 2 less paying accounts. Congratulations, Niantic!

Game has gone downhill fast in the past 6 months. It's clear the game is not the focus for Niantic, it's simply a way to to collect and monetize location based player data. The game is getting more and more buggy, only the things important to gathering data get fixed quickly, the rest may or may not be dealt with in the future. Too bad, the game used to be fun.

As a day 1 player of Pokemon Go, I've gone through all sorts of game mechanic changes for the best and worst. Covid was definitely a challenge for all of us and Pogo even helped us escape reality for a bit. But the fact that some of the covid bonuses were already taken away and Niantic flat out said that the "increased pokestop interaction distance" will remain the same. It really bugs not only me, but the entire game community. "Go out and explore" the same places we've been going to for years.

Really, I was addicted to this game. However, there were many factors that weighed my love down in the long run, and one consistent problem was consummation of pokeballs and obtaining pokecoins. I get a need for profit, however a better mechanism would be to implement small portions of pokecoins into quests, which could help with the problem of pokeballs consummation. It's easy to go through all your available pokeballs in a short amount of time, leaving you unable to do much more than sit.

Overall, my experience with Pokemon GO has been rather positive. However, I recently experienced a very frustrating situation twice: I joined a raid through an invite (using the remote raid pass, which costs 195 coins, so at least four days of collecting), everything was cool until the game simply kicked me out of the raid, making it impossible for me to catch pokemon. Of course, I couldn't rejoin the raid.

The developers prove time and time again that nothing is forever. Raising prices and offering fewer incentives to play what was once a very fun and rewarding game. Money-grubbing garbage. Pretty much just a collector game. There's a lot of Pokemon to collect and they're always popping up every few minutes. Visiting pokestops and gyms give a few items each time, but not many pokeballs.
