After all the support and money we invest as players they do not care for us!!!!

l absolutely loved this game as I've always loved pokemon, however, i wished there were more variations of skills. It becomes very repetitive and can become quite dull at times, if there was more to the game than just walking around and battling (such as style options) then it would be far more enjoyable in my opinion. Regardless though, it is a very good game with a lot of depth.

I'm addicted to this game, except giving it 2 stars for this reason alone: the Pokemon you have to catch winning battles. It takes like 50 PokeBalls to catch this epic or mythical Pokemon like. And it's not even worth it to go through all that trouble. You just have to trade it anyway, because you can't have 5 of the same, unevolvable, untradable Pokemon in your inventory. And you can't battle until you catch it. Please fix that, it's very annoying.

Adventure sync for walking and hatching eggs isn't working at all. Plus this new five remote raids suck. What if you don't have people close to you that play and you need to invite friends that live in other places or friends you've met at fest. You are stopping us from being able to play which is the opposite thing I thought yall wanted and we all want. If we spend money on items why should it matter. We are trying to play as much to catch these Pokemon. Hence "gotta catch em all". Get it rite.

I've had several frustrating experiences playing this recently that I hope will be addressed quickly. Twice today, when conquering a Gym, it erroneously said all my pokemon had fainted. When battling in an otherwise easy raid, the game seemed to get out of sync somehow and reset the boss's health near the end. I've reported both issues as bugs but wanted to make sure others know to watch out for them too. In the meantime, I won't be wasting my time with raids or gym battles.

I hate leaving this game a bad review, but I'm hear again:(. First of all since the new update I drift a lot. I'm never where I'm supposed to be witch is annoying when I'm right by a gym ect and it's saying I'm across the road or out of range. The steps counter is still not reading properly. I did 27 mile the other day and it didn't read 15 of those miles. I've also noticed that it doesn't always register tasks e.g. hatch 5 eggs, make a great throw ect and I'll have to do them until it does.

Not sure what happened recently. The game has issues loading, causing you to close the app and reopen until you get in. I'm missing raid passes. The trading system is a little messed. My husband's phone will be done with the trade, and on my end it will still be thinking(we both have a brand new samsung galaxy s23 ultra). And there are way more people spoofing/cheating and nothing being done about it. There's enough real money being spent in game for these issues to be fixed immediately

Had some fun with the game since it's inception,spent some decent money on it too. But the missing pokemon from earlier generations, the recent lack of decent rewards in the last few years events , and now the recent fiasco shows this game is not the money machine Niantic really want it to stay as. If you feel like being milked of your money, enjoy. But I'm done.

1 star still remains. I tried to it again recently and...there's nothing of substance really. At this point there are so many Pokémon trying to evolve your chosen few is torturous. The "difficulty" at trying to catch some doesn't make any sense. One at 250CP a regular ball works but another at 250CP need an ultra ball and even then it might not happen. Also, the targeting for catching them is seemingly random so you waste a lot.

I've really enjoyed the game, overall it's a super fun game and adds some fun elements to the Pokemon world. I've been having a blast playing this game. It would be nice if they could implement Pokemon Centers in the game, even if it was limited to every few days or something. Pokemon Centers were always a big part of the game's so not having them feels odd in a way.

Suddenly getting "UNABLE TO AUTHENTICATE" error message. In my 10 years of playing, I have NEVER had an issue with this game. No bugs, glitches, nothing. Now all of a sudden with the new update, I can't even log into my account. At first I thought it was due to bad 📱 service, then I tried to login via WiFi and same issue. Tried to uninstall and install, force stop, clear data/cache, everything. Waiting for customer support to reply to my query. So far no luck. And I love this game. It's a shame

Been playing this game a lot more recently and it's safe to say, I love it. I'm finding a bigger variety of pokemon now in the same places I used to find purely Ratatas and Pidgeys. Game used to crash, freeze and loose connection all the time but now I've noticed it is so much better! I've not had the game freeze on me while I'm trying to catch a pokemon since the summer when it first came out. Love the buddy feature as it enables me to only have to find one (dratini) to be able to get more candies for it.

Good game, but just double the prices of a paid expendable item that is essential to the majority of the player base as well as put a limit a on how many times that item can be used per day. Therefore it widens the gap on the limits to players like myself who live in rural areas with a scarce amount of stops, gyms, spawns, etc. If Campfire was up and running and mildly successful the change would be understandable but it's still invite only and most people don't even know it exists!!

All in all couldn't handle the ridiculous glitches and lockouts, but this was the straw that broke the camel's back. Just got through sitting outside at the park in the heat for an hour waiting for enough people to show up so that I could battle/beat/capture moltres. We beat it the first time just to get a network error forcing us to start all over again. Round 1 of Wasted max revives/potions. I finally get to the point where I have it captured and a network error locks me out of the game for 10 minutes. When I finally am able to log back in I find that I have no moltres and for some reason no pokestops or gyms to be seen anywhere.I am so done with this glitch filled nonsense of a so-called game!

This game is highly addictive yet a great way to lose weight well you walk and catch Pokemon. When you meet up with other game players they're actually really nice even if they aren't on the same team as you. Edit ** over a year playing this game I have to say I get a little frustrated at the fact that it never tracks right. My character is always off in the middle of nowhere and not anywhere near where I am at. Also I upgraded my phone to be able to see the virtual reality function and still doesn't work.

The best idea for a mobile game, ruined. Niantic shows no concern for its customers and continually makes attempts to get more in game spending. The final straw for me was paying $15 for a special "research" to get a specific Pokemon and I caught a virtually useless version of that Pokemon. When I complained and requested a refund I was told stats are random and no refund could be applied. But people have hacked the game and seen it's not random. It's predatory to get you to spend more in game

I love the game, but something that does need to be fixed is the "swooping" in on Pokemon when you click. Because of this, you no longer see or get the spiral star animation for shiny Pokemon. This can be very difficult to tell if the Pokemon are a similar color. It's even more difficult with those if you're color blind like my friend.

This game hasn't changed in the nearly 10 years it's been out. Think how outdated some of the mechanics are after nearly a decade! Everything 'new' Niantic implements is a reskin of something they've done before. Plus the money grabbing that's become so prevalent in the last couple years. Niantic are one of laziest, greediest developers in the field- they'd be right at home with EA...

Updating my review, you guys have come a long way in the game and have done a pretty good job with it. I would say we need are 3 more things: 1- Let us battle wild pokemon with same battle style as pvp battles (this can be a turn on and off option) 2- Implement a Pokemon Center for us to restore our pokemon (at least 1 or 2 times a week of poke cebter availability) 3- Add an actual pokemart theme song to the shop and add more items like regular potions, super, hyper potions.

This used to be a really fun game still is sometimes if it loads or not be in the middle of a raid and it tells you to update it, buy incense and when you use them there's no Pokemon that shows up. it took away couple of my free boxes, it's just been a lot of glitches here lately and it's not fun anymore to spend money like that, and not be satisfied. I started playing when it first came out, quit then picked it back up. I do enjoy it just wished it was better on some things. 🙂

I understand that they don't want people playing while driving. As a passenger it is impossible to play, even at 20 miles per hour you cannot get poke stops, just get "try again later" unless you can hit it at least 3 times while in range, usually not possible, it is very frustrating! Just re-read my review they have done nothing for the passenger in vehicles. This game is still unplayable from a car, if your kids love it, don't plan on Pokemon Go keeping your kids busy on a long road trip, or any car ride for that matter

As mentioned in last review, that I would re-rate once major issues were addressed. So I rate from a 2 star to a 4 star. Game is quite more stable, however, I am still having some login issues from time to time. Other then that everything else has been fixed. Please provide more servers so login works almost all the time. Thanks.

The AR aspect makes pokemon catching difficult, since they often disappear and reappear all over the place so it's best to just not use that function. Sometimes it takes way to many pokéballs to catch, it shouldn't take 10 pokeballs to catch a Weedle. While the PVP trainer battles are fun and a welcome addition, it doesn't give you a notification when one of your friends wants to battle, so you each have to go on at the same exact time.

I think it is a fun app and all but developers if you read this can you make it more like the Pokemon games like in towns you can trare Pokemon and earn money from to buy items (like candy pokeballs and potions)  from the poke stops. Also spreading the poke stops out a bit more evenly so people can get to them without much travel  (the nearest one to me is five miles and I can't play while driving)  another great retire from the games is running into npc and fighting them for money it would be awesome if no where added as a pop-up when you got near them. Last thing is adding a swipe left and right for two more moves like in the game. If you could make it more like the Pokemon games in real life everyone would love this game and you would definitely get 1 billion downloads.

This game and the horse it rode in on can fornicate with a cactus. For 8 years I have toughed it out through glitches, crashes, errors, etc. but now I can't log in and it seems like I'm the only one, and there's no functional customer service department, and no announcement saying "some trainers might be having issues". Whatever. Go debug yourself.

As someone who goes to college, there's always pokemon and pokestops, and things to do. The only problem is when I go back to my parents place, there's almost nothing for a wide range of time. No gyms, the only thing to catch is a daily Rattata, and nothing new. But, being blessed into all the action, the game is really fun and engaging! I enjoy it, and would recommend it to people that live in populated areas. That's where the fun is.

I commend Pokemon Go for implementing features that allow for a more solitary game play during this pandemic. The rate of Pokemon appearing as well as faster egg hatching has helped considerably as well as the one time reduced item buys. On that note I'd like to request/suggest making more of these available especially pokeballs. For some who can't get out to the pokestops because of the pandemic it is very hard to get them or coins if not impossible which leaves the game dead in the water. 🤠

I enjoy the app and that it encourages people (including myself) to get out and about. However, I have been getting increasingly frustrated with the app. Quite frequently it sends me back to the sign in page; then says sign in failed. If I delete the app and re-download it, I am able to sign in. Sometimes it will let me play signed in for a couole days; other times it kicks me out after a couole of hours. Then I have to delete and re-download again if I want to continue playing.

Granted I'm biased. It has its problems for sure with server struggle, battery being eaten alive, and location can be wonky with finding pokemon. Regardless the concept is amazing and the drastic difference in the software bugs each day is remarkable. It may seem like a craze but I think in a month or two it'll be a lifestyle for many. I've walked more than 30 miles in 3 days, biked, been to multiple parks, injured myself all in the name of an app!❤ Edit: That was my review when this app first dropped. I stopped playing for about a year and started back. This app is incredible. From the changein how gyms work, to research tasks, to friendships, and a near future in battling. This app covers the world of Pokemon Pokemonin a slightly new style of lore while getting you out of the house, sociable with others, and now always something to work towards. Its brilliant.

WASTE OF TIME AND MONEY!! It's incredible how much this game has gone to trash. The app developers don't care and only see each player as walking dollar signs. From events that crash, glitch, and make the game unplayable, (which they REQUIRE you to pay 15 dollars to "enjoy") to lack of anything players actually want/ask for. As someone who has spent countless hours and money into this game. I have to say there's nothing but disappointment and greed left in Pokemon Go 2022

I enjoy it, I understand the foot mapping for Pokémon are off probably until they better their servers. I would suggest a better way to pick multiple pokemon to transfer and earn your multiplier of candies. If not multiple seperate Pokémon, same choice of that one would still be easier. A way to keep the app running for your eggs and not burn your battery even in power saver mode. Maybe some new items that could be found and maybe even purchased, but so far it's great, keep up the good work.

I use to love this game. I love the idea and concept. Even pre-COVID its very very disappointing that the only way you can reliably get a pokeball, the one with the lowest success rate, requires additional payment. When you've run out of pokeballs, and no poke-stop in sight, its time to turn off the game even when you find the pokemon you've looked forwards to.

First couple of days are really fun, but it quickly becomes pay-to-play, which is my most hated free-to-play style! What point is a game if you can't play it? Hugely disappointed. Would've possibly spent some money on skins/new pokemon, but not being able to catch pokemon or join battles after a few days 'trial' is stupid! The correct way to go with this style of game would be to have paid skins and speedups to reduce the time taken to hatch pokemon, or even buy. I simply cannot recommend.

great game overall, the developers are lovely and keep the playerbase active through events. they're generous with pokeballs and items needed to enjoy, a part from egg hatching you do realistically have to throw some money at if you want to hatch a lot, but this is not a necessity. there are some great bundles that come up from time to time which can be nice to pick up. you can also earn game currency through play so you don't necessarily need to spend money if you're a patient person. 5/5

My only thing is I have a few suggestions after talking with many if my fellow Pokemon players. We would really love for you to distribute 100 or more balls various ones such as regular,Mega,ultra,ect... because the freezing is persistent and I know I've lost a few hundred balls just because after I caught a Pokemon it froze.. which is really frustrating. But we understand this is a very new game. Also I thought you could implement a trade system for Stardust like extra evolution balls we have. Thanks.

I want to hop on here with others who are trying to be heard and mention the lack of care and respect from those who run the app. This distasteful attitude unfortunately leaches into the actual game, over years and months making it harder and less fun to play. [e.g less remote raids, free gift boxes] It comes across as greedy, and I know players are struggling. The game is cool, but it's getting worse and worse, and so are the people running it.

Loving playing this so far. Would be good if you could use a pokemon assigned to a gym to view the gym when youre out of range. (edit- they added this) Also friends, (edit- added) pvp (edit- also added)and fix the tracking. (edit- yea...sort of) I want to be able to find the pokemon nearby instead of wandering randomly till i find it. Overall im gonna be playing more. I like the walking im doing and its something else to drag my boyfriend out into the day star.

This is a great game but there are some features I would love to see added in the long run like the option to see other player's avatars and battle them just for fun. I detest the way the gym battle system works and miss the turn based battle style. Also wish you had to battle pokemon to weaken them like in the original games.

Fun game now as new content is being delivered frequently, however, I would still prefer if the original tracker were brought back. Previous review - 2016/17 Product cannot be used as advertised due to game functionality problems as of recent update. At launch the game was fun with a tracking system. Tracking was glitched so players resorted to 3rd party maps and tracking services. Now neither work. Barely average game at best, with a lower radius to scan for Pokémon, no ability to track, and few PokéStops for players outside of major cities. Needs serious improvement or it will lose a majority of it's player base. #FixTracker

Update 2023/04: After announcement of accessibility features being removed and reduced from the game along with other updates I can no longer support or recommend this game. Original: Although there are server crashes and some bugs, this might be the best mobile game I've ever played. I have no doubts the issues will be resolved and this will keep getting better. Update: the nearby feature has been removed. Finding Pokémon is next to impossible!

As a concept I think this is brilliant, having Pokemon overlaid on the real world is a neat idea. My kids love playing it and big bonus is they are getting outdoors, along with hundreds of others, I have even registered my own account. Bug fixes / updates are reasonably frequent. Still playing 4 years on, my kids have given up but it makes a daily walk a bit more interesting and some catches have become souvenirs of my travels.

Played this game for a long time but unfortunately the developers only seem care about money, making it so only players willing to buy lots of passes can participate in the community. Not to mention the disregard for those who play with disabilities. Most features they introduce are buggy, flawed or not user-friendly and one can only hope that they'll fix them at some point (they never do), and when they do implement a feature seamlessly you can be sure it makes the game harder and less fun.

Used to love this game, but that was before they removed all the rewards. I'm also quite annoyed I'm unable to complete primary goals in the game because I don't play in close proximity to other people, so I can't play parties, do trades, compete in battles together. I'm also not close to any routes, so I'm unable to complete those goals as well. Most of the timed quests require killing yourself or paying a fortune to even participate. If you're not playing this, don't bother honestly.

Great.... When it works. Most recent update has completely ruined the gameplay though. I track my runs on two other apps at the same time, and both show I've run ~12 km this past week, with another 5 k walking. All while Pokemon Go was open, yet Pokemon Go registered a total of 1.7k. literally 1/10th the reality. It also freezes frequently, and drains battery more than any other app I've ever used. But this distance tracking is enough to finally force me to uninstall.

A forthcoming update has made it all too clear that the company who develops this game, Niantic, is only interested in its players' personal GPS data. They are manipulating game mechanics to coerce the players to play the game a certain way which maximizes the type of GPS data other companies will pay big $$$ for. So, if you are interested in your privacy and not being used as Niantic's tool, please find another game to play.

I've been a player since day 3. I've put a lot of time and energy into this game. But as time goes on, I find myself less engaged. It's rinse and repeat, and the reward for that isn't all that great. Niantic doesn't seem interested in helping all its players. Only people in high population areas and lots of money to spend really get the "full" experience of this mobile game. If Niantic wants to keep people engaged, they need to do more for their players.

My last review disappeared? Seriously? The improvements in the spawn rate are nice right now. However, it's mostly unplayable for those of us in quarantine! We can't get pokeballs, berries, or participate in gym battles and I need to lvl my pokemon. This is supposed to go on for at least 18 months in the US and I'm sure that timeline is comparable around the world. We'll be stuck inside. Increased spawn rate isn't enough Devs. Make the game playable for everyone.

The game itself is really good. I've been playing it for around 4 years. But in my opinion, the bag limit should get removed. I participate in raids often, I do a lot of quests also and my item bag gets bigger and bigger each time. I don't have money to upgrade my bag. My bag reached around 1000/350 items, so I'm pretty frustrated that I can't pariticipate in league battles no more because I can't claim the item rewards.

Hey my review got deleted. Well I'm here again. This game is simplistic and repetitive, and you're more or less forced to play it if you have interest in creating a "living Pokedex" for the main-series Pokemon games. And dealing with it wouldn't be so bad if Niantic weren't utterly incompetent devs that show no interest in appealing to or listening to the playerbase. Seriously, design choices aside, there are still glitches from when the game first launched over five years ago. Avoid this game.

just a casual player which opens this game whenever they go out. As a casual game I think this game is great for pokemon lovers. I so far have had no problems with the game crashing and no glitches. But in reality I think the addition to scan pokestops is just something you dont want to be seen doing in real life. And also the system whereby in tracks distance for hatching eggs is fairly inaccurate.

Played on and off since 2016, but based on the decisions made by Niantic in the last six months alone, that switch is permanently off. Price-gouging, buggy events, lackluster pokemon pools, constant nerfs to qualify of life features, terrible Ex raid system, the list goes on. Uninstalled for legitimately the first time since release. Doubt I'll come back as there's no way Niantic isn't fully aware of what they're doing. They just don't care anymore.

Niantic took away the ability to do Raids from a distance w/o paying a ridiculous amount of money; and they capped it at only 5 long-distance Raids per day. As someone with a physical disability, this makes the game much more difficult. I started playing to have fun and escape stress for a while, but now it's more stressful than it is enjoyable. It sucks, I had to change this from a 5-star review (from 2020) to a 1-star review. The game has gone downhill big time!

Game is fun, but Niantic has gotten greedy as of late. The fact that they're expecting people to buy incense on top of the cost of a go fest ticket to get good spawns is absurd. And for how much money they make, the app sure is pretty buggy and featureless. Could stand to make a lot of QoL improvements. Like maybe an in game calender so I dont have to visit the stupid blog all the time to keep up with events. Or perhaps not freezing when I try to launch the app. Do better.

This used to be a great game and it wasn't something I was concerned with spending money on (mainly for incubators or remote raid passes). Working full time and being a dad, it's a little hard for me to consistently play, but the recent changes over the past year have made it much harder to play. Niantic is no longer catering to the casual players despite what they claim to make the game even for everyone.

Increased pricing and micro transactions have ruined this game. My wife, kids, and I used to go out for long walks, catching and raiding. However, we have all deleted the game due to its constant greed for more and more money. I get you have to pay for the creators of the game, but now the disparity between profits and pay are astronomical. It's a fun game that does have value, but not enough to justify increased costs.

I like how this game gets you outside and exploring. You can collect, battle, do routes, compete in showcases, raid, team up with friends, and really whatever else you feel like. The game has some minor bugs that can be annoying at times, but those aren't that common. I've gone to events and played for more than 6 hours with no issue at all. Overall, it's a really fun game if you like collecting and exploring. They've added a lot of new content and features lately, too. Fun stuff!

I used to get frustrated with this game and would never play because I could never get enough Pokéballs to play. I didn't know how to expand my inventory for items or Pokémon and I didn't know how to get free Pokécoins. Now, I have many friends and exchange the maximum amount of gifts daily if I can. All of these factors have enhanced my gameplay so much that I will surely play this game for the rest of my life. Ahh, they finally fixed GBL. I absolutely LOVE IT!! TYSM. If you love Pokémon, PLAY!

The game has a lot of potential! Bugs of course due to being first released, but that is like any other first released game. Is it possible to release re-character customization option? Oh and to fix the AR locating to be more wide spread? Sometimes I am not able to use it. Update: As the game releases more updates it is becoming more prevelant that niantic does not immediately listen to their consumers and are adding features that require more money spent to enjoy the game.

I've loved this game for years. It is honestly my escape from reality. The problem is sometimes the app locks you out, or says it cannot authenticate you. That's just depressing because so much effort has been put into your profile over the years. The fear of losing your hard earned Pokémon is quite stressful. I'm currently having that issue and hoping it gets resolved through reinstalling.

Even when I'm outside in open area, I cannot move. My location is enabled, but every time I try to walk my character spins in circles and goes nowhere. Everytime I try to play, I spend a solid minute clicking "dismiss" on all of the notifications. I may be getting a new phone soon, and when I do I'll try again, but if I have the same issue I am leaving this review as it is.

So the whole premise of this game is supposed to be tracking pokemon that are close to you so that you can find the pokemon and catch them. For weeks now, that system hasn't worked, which was fine and dandy for a little while as the game was still new. Instead of fixing the tracker, they just went ahead and removed it entirely!! What a joke. Do they think we're mindless sheep?? #fixtracker

Bland and grindy - it really is nothing but a chore. The things you do everyday is more or less the same, and the grinding part is ugly. Achievements take too much efforts to obtain! Some requires you to catch 1000 of the same thing, some straight up asks 15000 of hours in this already boring game, some unlocks rare items *in the shop*, meaning you still have to buy with premium currency to get that reward! There are other games that motivate you to walk - don't play this one.

I had a lot of fun with the original version, but all of the updates have stolen that fun away. We can't train, we have no idea which way to go to find Pokémon, and all in all there's just no fun in it anymore. It's more like wandering around aimlessly hoping we'll catch something instead of a treasure hunt to find the Pokémon that is approximately this far away. It's gotten spectacularly boring.

I love the game, I only found a couple bugs. The first one being this strange bug when I catch a Pokemon, the screen will freeze and zoom in like normal, but then it just stays like that, no shaking, I have to reload the game to get it working. But that's the main issue, there's also this glitch i think it's called Mystic? I've heard it's on a lot of people's games and I don't know much about it but it seems to make the person using it worse than cancer. Other than that the games great.

Great game with alright graphics, I just have a few issues with the game. Instead of focusing on adding pokemon, they should: -Make it so you must battle pokemon in order to catch them -Add a bit more storyline (more than just side quests) -Improve offline distance count -Add items you can attach to pokemon -Improve the CP system (or remove it altogether) These are just a few suggestions, and they are just my personal opinion. I know a lot of these would basically make the game like the original ones, and I know that might not be what they are going for, but like I said, these are just my suggestions.

Been playing since day one (on and off). Niantic has rolled out amazing improvements and kept my interest in the game for quite some time. Lately however they've been making it harder and harder for the average player to keep up. If you can't devote hours into physically going to gyms to raid (with in-person teams), battle, catch, you're not going succeed easily. If you live outside of major cities, you're going to have a harder time with remote raid passes increasing. Do Better Niantic

I love this game. But the only thing that really annoys me is the 50 coin daily limit. I had a Pokemon at a gym for almost a month, and because I already received my daily limit I didn't get anything for defending a gym for that long. There should be a 10 day threshold to earn let's say 100 coins. Make it to where it's actually beneficial to leave a Pokemon in a gym for that long. That's the only thing that really bugs me. Please fix this Niantic.

This game has had me going out every night to hunt down pokemon cus ya know, I wanna be the very best. But ever since the recent tracking bug with 3 paws always, it's not fun enough to be worth it. Shame Edit: well the tracker is not totally broken now, it just tells you where to go rather than give you the "warmer, colder" mechanic which I thoroughly enjoyed. Back to 4 stars.

I've played this game since the day it came out. There has been a lot of high points and low points throughout that time, and although I do really love this game, the steady stream of terrible updates and decisions made by Niantic have brought this game to an all time low. Every game I have ever seen with a dev team this out of touch has resulted in a game dying, and this I'm sure will follow eventually. Maybe things will change, but until then, it's time to find a game with devs who care.

The game used to be really fun where good items and Pokemon weren't too hard to get. Now almost everything you may want will cost so much money just to get. Niantic has really gotten greedy and raised the prices for everything. The main part of the game for me was the battling and that feels like it's set up every match, with you having to go against typings that are exact counters to yours. I miss when they first came out with it and the battling was COMPLETELY random with starter pokemon.

Its fun here and there, but it's meh. The game sets out to be what it is. But it could be alot better if more was brought to it, or even if features that they have now removed still remained. Like many of other reviews will tell you, the covid update added ease to the game and more reason to play it. Pulling back on those additions wasn't a great move. The games not quite as heartless as some of the hard review bombs will tell you however, atIeast in my opinion .

The game is okay. There are a lot of pretty small gripes I have that lower my rating. -You can't recall pokemon from gyms, ever, you just have to wait for them to get knocked out. -For some reason, you can't start a route while in a party, which is the most likely time you would do a route. -Some areas are just dead zones and make the game impossible to play as there are few gyms/stops and few pokemon spawn. Partys have a time limit, but you can't see it. There are so many things I want to say.

Been a pretty good game for the most part, some hits and misses since it's launch. But the next update making remote raids harder to get and can only do 5 a day really hurts a lot of people and is just greedy. Many people can't get out or have no where to raid nearby so Niantic is isolating people. Remote raids brought in a lot of people and made it easier to play with friends. So until fixed, staying a 1 star review.

Been playing this for some time now, they keep adding things to make you come back to it although the last month has been a little slow. The major floor I have found being someone who doesn't know very many people around me who play the game that it is going to be and has been impossible for me to complete tasks and pokedex when I cant battle 5 star raids as 1 or 2 people. Feels a bit unfair for those that are less social than others...

You could at least raise shiny odds if you're going to make this app choppy and unplayable. It has been SO laggy, I have lost many Pokéballs. It says "Pokémon can't be found" and ends encounters. Spawn rates have dropped significantly. WHAT are you guys doing over there? I loved this game so much, but it only seems to be getting worse and worse. You're trying too hard to add "new, cool things" that you're neglecting to make sure the app even functions.

It's a great game. It has SO much potential. it just seems unfinished. For example, the game should have been a lot more centered around using your pokemon in battle (even to catch pokemon), just like the originals. Pokemon centers should never have been left out of the game. And the map needs more detail, it looks plain and unfinished. There have been a lot of improvements since I quit playing back in 2016. I am glad to see that it's getting better.

It is good but needs a lot of improvement. For example,the loading screen 7/10 times gets stuck. Another example is that the price of the items now are not as good as they were originally. Before raid passes were 100 pokecoins, now there 190. Third, 400 candy for evolution is insane. At least make it 200 or something like that. But overall it's a 7.5/10

A really fun casual game, but its unfortunate how difficult some raids are as you can only beat them with other people, which can be difficult if you don't know anyone to play with or live in a small area with not a lot of other players. General gameplay is fun still and the more popular raids can be joined remotely so there is still the opportunity to beat them.

DO NOT PLAY!!! This game introduced features that made it accessible to many people, yet in the middle of an ongoing pandemic they REMOVED THEM!! Now if you want to reach gyms and Pokestops, you have to be super close to them--meaning that you might have to cross a busy highway or enter dangerous areas just to reach it. Good luck if you have a disability!! Niantic, this is unacceptable. You give us what we've been asking for and take it away. The pandemic is not over. Listen to your players!!!

2021: when my bf and I courted, we bonded over this game, we still have inside jokes from those times. Sad to say we just don't have fun playing it anymore bc it has gone so far down in quality, even veterans hardly wanna keep playing. Really sad to see that memory go but it was fun while it lasted. 2017: I tried to buy pokécoins/pokéballs to catch an awesome eevee and it froze the app! If impulse buying doesn't even work properly, you know the game is in rough shape. Y'all get no more $ from me

I walk with friends and we enjoy the events. I love that they added trainer battles and team rocket. I just wish I could trade long distance with some of my friends. Other than that. The game is pretty exciting. Looking forward to a breeding system and a few more features. Good job with the team rocket update!! I really like what you did. I wish the gym battles had a similar upgrade. I like the new player battle system.

No real customer support whatsoever. I've been playing this game since the day it came out, took a break and then returned. As I've done in the past I decided to purchase pokecoins to help things along but because the game is so unstable now, during the transaction an error occurred which caused me to be double billed. I was able to get one transaction refunded through Google Play. However Niantic also removed the coins from my account despite taking my money. Since then they've refused to help.

To many cheaters and no redress. I started playing again to help motivate me to go a little further everyday. The system of the game is reasonable, but it could be improved. The issue that I have is that Niantic blocks people for spoofing, but doesn't block people for hacking during battle arena. Start of the season, I encountered cheaters 2/5 battles. The biggest issue is that you have no way to report them. So, I uninstalled the game.

I originally had a really good time playing. I give them credit for all the changes they made during the beginning of covid but I'm concerned that their changing things back to early. I'm angry that you can purchase special researchs, that inorder to be completed you must be at lvl 40, with no warning before purchase. The catch rate for legendary pokemon are abysmal for raids, I have more than 1/2 run away. This game is set up to eat your money and I'm honestly close to just deleting it.

I adore this game! It genuinely motivates me to get outside and DO something, unlike many others. I've been playing basically since the start, and have enjoyed most of the gameplay elements, although I still can't land a decent curve ball. Lol Spoofers are an issue - along with people who drive and play, although that's definitely not as bad as it was. The cap on gold per day from gyms is a bit of a bummer - I usually only have a few incubators at a time because of it. Overall, great game.

This game is awesome. The help to access your account isn't. I tried to play again using my old account and got no help in logging back in. I got the error message and no help from the automated email system. I had to make a while new account and had issues doing that too. After 5 days, I was able to get a new account going. Two weeks later the game logged me out and when I logged back in, it took me to my old account. Which sucks, cause my daughter and I busted our butts to reach level 25

I've been playing since July 2016 and have accepted the many changes made to the game, good and bad. However, Niantic recently, greatly reduced Pokemon spawns across the globe, including my neighborhood, a nearby park, and the small town where I normally play. The now very limited amount of Pokemon in the wild ruins even basic gameplay. The rating reflects the current state of the game. I hope they are able to course correct and fix these issues.

A really fun game to play. I like it so much! 5 stars 😀 edit: I think Niantic needs to start working on fixing some bugs, but even if they don't fix them for a long time, I still will have this review 5 stars because it's always a fun game to play. Pokemon Go is the best! 👍👍👍 Also here are a few suggestions: 1. Add pokestops in rural areas. 2. Add more characters for tags.

Niantic sucks, they have made the game pay to play, reduced the rare quality pokemon, made encounter/catching some nearly impossible. They ignore feedback from players. If you have unlimited disposable income, this is the game for you. For the rest of us, who work at the times Niantic seems to think everyone should be available, on to the next.

I don't play any more. Developers have fallen so far away from what their fans wants. It's nice you want people to get out and play together but it's difficult. Loved that I could raid with friends out of state as much as we wanted. when they limited the amount and upped raid passes they killed the last enjoyable part of the game. There is nothing to keep you playing long term.

Updates are still very large and fill a hefty chunk of my phone's storage. The game was more fun when I didn't feel like the only way to have enough balls to catch any decent number of mons is to buy coins. The daily items given out are miniscule and barely offer any help in keeping stocked up. In the current atmosphere this game feels a little too demanding. I only occasionally play, if only to attempt to catch specific mons that are sword exclusive so that I can transfer them.

I'm really sad. I just recently started playing again after taking a break for a while. I was excited about the game again, it was fun. Immediately now my excitement has been crushed. I can't do 195 coins for a single remote raid pass. That's almost a week or more for me to get a single pass. I can't chance spending money on buying a pass because I don't have the best luck catching the raid Pokémon, they run after 16 or so great throws and golden raspberries more often than I catch. Very sad.

I been playing Pokémon Go since 2016... my overall experience from then to now is how there are many more ways to level up faster. Newer Pokémon to catch and acquire new items as well. Remote raiding changed the overall game play in a good way in my opinion. Adding friends, Trading and battling have been a plus! The only draw back is how they're introducing into the p2p era.

Improving and getting better!! However, the remote raids and other remote options need to remain in the game. COVID-19 is still a thing. It's also not good that the prices were increased for the Remote Raid passes. Also the times for the Enamorus raids suck. 2 times during the day when people have work. Then at night, I went to gyms and no one showed up to the gyms. If I could rate Pokémon Go at 0 stars, I would. It was way better when it started.

Gameplay is still fresh for the most part. A few questionable decisions quite a bit (example) research breakthrough = Trapinch.... Right after Trapinch was an event day with shinies quite common. Love the effort made to keep the game fun during lockdown. Keep up the good work, I look forward to the latest updates as the game expands further.

The game is great and certainly has come a long way since the beginning, especially for those playing in small towns. Although it would be better if we were able to recall Pokemon from gyms. Being in a small town, they can be stuck in a gym for months at a time before someone defeats them and they return to you. It makes earning coins much harder because you don't receive them until they return from the gym

It can never detect my orientation for the ar function and my gps seems to never be available even though it is on. Otherwise a fun game. Update: the problems I experienced before were due to my phone, not the game. Works great now that I have a new phone! Though I wish we could weaken the pokemon in the wild by battling or duel other players. A simple chat system or 'ping system' to alert nearby players of our presence at a raid would be helpful too. I'd like to be able to add people once I've encountered their pokemon at a gym and such. So far though, I'm loving it.

A few glitches but good innocent game for kids or for anyone. I enjoy playing this with my kids(5-21) and the hubby. Gets us out and we travel to different areas doing it. It's like board game night but all the time. Really is a great way to keep close with your family and friends. I do wish pokestops were easier to spin at traveling speeds so my kids can play when I am driving. There aren't a lot of pokestops in our small towns either so we have to use a lot of fuel to get to pokestops areas.

"Free to start" my cheeks. I live in a suburban area where you would expect them to have put something. Nope. During the initial release, there were no Pokestops or gyms for dozens of miles in my area so the game outright forced me to pay for supplies to get any use out of it. Since then, it hasn't proven to have gotten any better about hitting me with a big paywall at some point or another. Game is also very clunky and tends to glitch often. I don't know how this game has so many rabid fans.

Idk what is wrong with this glitchey app. Stuff will load in super slow, I've lost a few passes from "network errors" and or in the middle of raids being kicked out in thus also losing passes. Also, idk about anyone else but lately I've been getting a LOT of what I like to call ghost gifts. 🙄 I'll get people that appear to have a gift for me, only to click on it and it not appear. Then if you refresh the gift will suddenly disappear. A good number too.

Great game, heaps of fun building up the Pokedex but I (and many others) would love to see an update that focuses on rural areas within our communities. Things I think would improve the game, that do not include adding extra pokestops, would be things such as pokemon spawning next to you like the incense mechanic, even if it's only 1 random pokemon every 3 hrs. Random wild spawn locations that move and are not fixed to a single location so you might encounter a random pokemon at home (if lucky).

No longer lets me log into My game, since it doesn't have Facebook or even Google as an option to log in anymore. Just got Pokemon Go. I had my Pokemon Go linked to my Facebook. I sent an email and it just sent an automated message, which was of no help. I haven't been able to play for a long time because of this issue. I even opened a new account with Niantic and see if I can link my accounts. It still won't let me log in. You really need to fix it.

As buggy as it is, it just came out in US today. So I don't expect it to be perfect. However there are a few flaws I don't like, like no friends list, or you can't battle without being at a gym unlike advertised you can battle anywhere. I mean other than that, its just a walking simulator. 5/7 perfect score. Edit: Added friends list, trading, and battling. Changed the prices of remote raid passes and severely limited how many you can do a day. Sorry Niantic, but you done goofed...

You can't even battle wild pokemon, you just throw a poke ball at it. Where's the fun in that? This app still drains my battery really quickly. Please fix that. The new gym update is pretty incredible; it reignited my interest in battling and the badges are nice. The best part is that I no longer need to go to the shop to collect the poke coins from assigning a Pokemon to a gym, they are automatically entered into my account.

Fun, and nearly the closest thing to being a real Pokémon trainer achieveable with modern technology. That said, the in-app purchases have always been closer to necessary to actually play the game than they should be; if your place if residence is even moderately isolated, odds are you'll be running out if critical items unreasonably often, "encouraging" you to spend real money just to be able to play. Moreover, some recent events have been locked behind $8 tickets-- "pay-to-win" is seeping in.

Normally I would rate this about a 4 out of 5 stars, but recently they decided to up the prices in their shop making it now near impossible for the majority of players that don't have heaps of cash to use the shop in any meaningful gameplay way. Raising the prices of the remote raid passes, is only hurting this game's already lacking ability to play with other people. So much for trying to pretend that you want to connect people around the world.

A wonderful game that is a lot of fun, except when they start making terrible changes. They keep increasing the price of things, which makes it a lot harder for many people to play certain parts of the game. Theyll be Increasing the remote raid pass by nearly double soon, and it already isn't guaranteed to be able to catch the Pokemon at the end of the raid. The loading screen gets stuck sometimes too. Hopefully they'll rethink their decision to stop overcharging their customers.

Its alright, unless you live in a rural area. The old lore/scents used to allow at least some playability, but they were nerfed because... Niantic needs more money? Theres almost no RPG element to this, as even leveling seems cheapened. Events come and go. A bit lack luster. You can gather all these Pokemon, but theres no interaction with other games, thus its all isolated to one app. Battling other people isnt all that great either. Trading can be amusing if you can find people to 'play' with.

Been playing since the game came out, along with the whole family. Very interactive and I like that pokemon can be sent to other games and the experience is based on being out and about. It is so much better that we can finally communicate through Camp Fire, but this system could be made much better if friends were automatically added to our Camp Fire or if Pokemon Go had its own chat system. A few other things that I would like to see fixed: 1. Wasting Raid Passes due to others leaving without

Dropping to one star because my review seems to have vanished somehow. The game is fine, it works good and can be fun. I dont like it because I was expecting walking around to catch pokemon but still having a turn-based combat system. Turns out there really isnt much of a combat system at all and it slightly annoys me. You walk around, find a pokemon and just throw pokeballs at it... wheres the fun in that?

Started playing this game at launch, kept playing through the bugs. Now that I've been back to playing for about a year, I've been enjoying the remote raid passes as they allow me to play with my friends even when we're all travelling for work. They have recently begun disincentivising remote play and have been making the game less playable for most players. Between the price increases and elite raids(they require in person attendance) my friends and I are feeling forgotten.

Still enjoyable but certainly needs a lot of quality of life updates. Having to perpetually buy bag and Pokémon storage is a chore, you should be able to still swipe pokestops for the xp even if your bag is full. The 50 coins a day limit is too little, 100 would be ideal. The variety in Pokémon in the wild still isn't great. Limitations on trading is unfair and the inability to do anything with friends far away is restricting, especially when you can't complete the Pokédex if you can't travel.

I've been playing this game for a long time. (7 years), and I'm so fed up with how restricted it is. 7 years, and I'm only level 37. It takes too much exp to level, and the fact everything is based on your location makes it worse. You can be in the middle of nowhere, cutting off 60% (raids and gyms) of the game! And don't get me started on how un-handicap friendly the whole game is. My grandma loves pokemon but can't really play with because she can't walk!

This game has improved somewhat from it's dismal post launch mismanagement, but over the past few years Niantic's slow trickle of updates have never added much substance to keep players engaged. I wish they'd add more content in line with the core pokemon console titles. This has been a common dream of many players that, at this late point, just has no chance of happening.

I love the idea of this game but the gameplay is pretty tedious: trading gifts is a chore, the app takes a couple minutes to load on my phone, catching pokemon takes way too long, etc. I can't play in-person, the way Niantic wants, because I have no local friends who play anymore. I'm just tired of doing all the things daily. And then they make remote raids more expensive and more tedious. No thanks. I'm out.

Curve ball throws are currently glitched for me. No matter what I do, as soon as I go to throw the spinning ball it just instantly returns to the bottom of the screen like I wasn't throwing it, and no poke ball is consumed. The laundry list of rules about trading is also a real let down. With no way to trade and Gastly being rare by me, I've given up all hope of ever getting a Gengar. Just not a fun experience.

Although the game isn't as good as everyone thought it was during its first 2 months, it's still a decent game to play. What has kept this game fun were two things: probabilities and exploration. in 2018, the game feels much fresher and has many more features than initially, including PvP battles, quests, trading, event bonuses, raids, redone gyms, much more Pokemon to collect, Team Rocket battles, and an available 3rd move slot. I can finally say the game feels whole and completely playable.

The game used to be good, now after years, it is slow, still has quite a lot of bugs and a lot of features require spending money to be actually useful. The biggest problem being that you can catch whatever pokemon Niantic wants, and does not require you to walk to find the pokemon you want. A lot of the Pokemons are behind paywalls and you or locked behind a certain mechanic.

Mad disappointment I switched several devices just to be able to play this game.. Now while playing I cannot find half the things others in my group find they either don't show in the radar or I can be in the same location and they never appear for me. So frustrated tired of the disappointment and frustration and money gone down the drain. Makes me look crazy trying to keep up!!! Tired of no resolutions to my issues. I'm done after my coins are spent. Thanks for NOTHING

This game just keeps getting more annoying my rating went from a 3* to a 1*. Not only did they not fix the inventory bug but now I am unable to even select my DOB "Date of birth". It keeps sending me to web which is not only against their policy but they say they can't do anything about it. I've reached out to Niantic support and they said they can't do anything about it. I've easily spent 500$+ on this game and everything's gone. I'm done with Pokemon go. THE END! Ps I've tried using × devices.

Used to be a lot of fun. Niantic keeps citing user experience and their ongoing goals while making it harder to play for anyone who is disabled in any way, not well off in cashflow, not in an urban enviornment safe enough to walk and/or gather, and anyone who doesn't have lots of available free time. Plus, the app doesn't function well with increasing frequency. There are a lot of people who love Pokemon and love this game. It's too bad Niantic is destroying so much of what was good about it.

I really enjoy the game, I play it every day so dont get me wrong. But the sinnoh stone update is too difficult to get. Especially in a smaller town where pokestops and gyms are very limited so finishing research in an actual week is rare. There should be a way to get more pokestops in smaller areas without having to play ingress. Side note: almost every community day is glitchy. I've planned out my community day too many times just for it not to happen.

This game has exploded across the world, not just distance, but age, gender, and nationality. You'll be lucky if there is a rock unturned that hasn't heard of this game or seen the effects of it on others. Getting people active and out in the real world, interacting with other people, and reviving a dream many of us wondered would ever finally come true, this game is bringing highly unanticipated, mostly good changes to humankind, at least for the while it is hyped. Thank you, Niantic and Nintendo.

In-app purchases have risen by 95%. Makes daylight robbery seem attractive. Been playing this game since its release date and have never witnessed anything like this before. Penalising the mobility challenged community even more by limiting what they can and cant do in a game... A GAME!!!! Nope. No more for me, done with Niantic and their greedy ways.

It would be five stars if there wasn't a major glitch in the game that is becoming increasingly frustrating. Whenever I click on a pokemon to initiate a battle (usually rarer mons) I get presented with just a white screen, and then I can't catch pokemon for a couple of hours after because all I get is a white screen. It used to be every so often, and I didn't really mind, but bow it's almost every time I try and use the app.

A game that used to be top tier, and brought all types of players together, has sadly fallen into what seems like a corrupt scheme catering to only 1 type of player. While the casual player may still find some enjoyment in Pokemon GOandSpendMoney, they will constantly feel like they're missing out on a huge chunk of the game. Niantic lacks the Instinct to listen to it's players, and without the Valor to make changes, they'll turn you into a Mystic questioning why you still play Pokemon GO.

Played this game back when it launched and had a blast. It unfortnately wasn't rural friendly so had to uninstall for quite a while till Covid hit. Picked it back up and was SO excited for all the rural changes. It made it to where I could actually PLAY. Niantic has ruined that with the recent changes. Being rural means NO coins unless you pay money; no raids because well no gyms. Can't remote because nobody is doing that now due to the price hikes. If you're a whale, this game is for you.

The tracking system is worthless. Great idea for a game but sad execution. Their idea of minimum viable product for launch should've been re-evaluated. evaluated. no trading, no way to train Pokemon. I can walk around different places and catch the same 10 Pokemon over and over and over again. They don't seem to be improving possible ways of finding Pokemon. I'm going to retire my dream of being a Pokemon master and enjoy having a much longer lasting battery. Me and Pokemon go are breaking up.

I am with everyone else here on the new update... It is complete garbage. I have played for years and never had these issues even the "white screen of death " wasn't as bad as these problems. Being a level42 and having contributed my share of pay for play I feel slightly cheated. The thrill is gone challenges aren't worth it. I long for the days of nests, pokemaps, groups gathering at exraids, and having to actually work for that elusive pokemon character. Just ranting, but please fix it!!!!

So the game is fantastic, not gonna lie. But Niantic, you are seriously messing up trying to upcharge the remote raid passes. You make enough money already as is so why are you gonna go off and lose revenue from people that actually bought the bundle when it was 250. There is literally no incentive to buying to the bundle when you can get 3 singles for the same price. I don't know who made that move, but they messed up big time. Your fan base is extremely pissed off about it.

I have loved this game for a very long time. It has made me be more active in my everyday life, and it involves fun tactics to the gameplay. Alongside that, it is enjoyable to run into the shinies of the many different pokemon, and learn new mechanics as it's updated. The community days are fun as well, and battling in the raids can be enjoyable yet difficult. However, the game can be slow and laggy at times, as well as unfortunate as less pokemon appear in less populated places.

Game was great but they increased the price to raid remotely almost double. This severely hurts you completing 5 star raids. Would take 4 24hr periods of staying in a gym to get enough coins. Would not recommend if you cannot travel to gyms. Only meant for people that can spend the time to travel around your town. Do not download if you live in a remote area, are disabled, limited time due to family, work, or lack of transportation. Niantic does not listen to its player base. No one wanted this.

The game is great. Very addictive. The company , Niantic, they could care less about the players. I have had to contact them 2 times. Both times i got the same answer. We cant do anything. My account was hacked and stolen. They had the new email associated with my account. I showed proof that it was stolen, google alerts showing i was hacked. They said they cant help although they had the information needed. They could care less about dedicated players. And can be very rude. Good game, bad mgnt.

Leaving again. Price increase in the remote raids is unacceptable. Was enjoying it and close to level 40. Pretty good now. Bugs fixed. From a long time ago: Niantic is having lots of trouble keeping up with demand. They removed any ability to track Pokemon including outside apps. Their refresh is to slow for biking. Other than that the idea is pretty cool. Give it a try, maybe they have it all fixed by now...

I've thoroughly enjoyed this game I've even spent quite a bit of real money on it but the only thing that's bugging me is that since the raid battles became existent. I haven't been able to fight the pokemon. It loads and the countdown happens but as soon as it hits zero there's a connection error and I've missed out on legendary and equally rare pokemon alike.

I have been playing this game for a long time. The game is really great especially the "remote pass" that I can play with friends from abroad. but now, things have changed. they deliberately frame certain events like raids, so some are harder to get but claim they are all the same as your leech money. The price will be increased this April, if you have a family playing this game please keep them away from this app especially your children.

I tried to download it 3 years ago and had technical difficulties. I recently redownloaded it last month just for the heck of it and I am glad to say that I have been having a blast! I live in Houston (a big bustling diverse city) so there's tons of Pokéstops and gyms. Although it's not be the latest trend anymore, it's still fun, entertaining, and surprising to bump into other players while on adventures. I'm no gamer girl but I'd surely keep playing and exploring!

Great while it lasted. Loved being able to do remote raids as I live in a rural community and never get enough people to take on a 5* raid. With the recent price gouging that's going on with the remote raids, it's becoming too much of a chore to try and get enough coins for one remote pass. I've had pokemon stuck in guns for days and weeks at a time and then they'll all get knocked out at once so I only get 50 coins for 4-5 pokemon. When that happens, it makes it nearly impossible to get a pass.

Not worth the time or effort due to uncontrollable aspects of the game. Things like type of throw, fruit used, or even poke ball are minor factors in catching a Pokemon. Fight a Pokemon and wear them out, they're rare, so you go all in, and miss catching them after 25+attempts. Then you hear the same problem was experienced by other players. The frustration and effort are not worth it.

Long time Pokéfan, and a lover of Ingress. This combines the two beautifully. I'm more than happy about the change in playstyle, as it gives a fresh perspective on a deeply beloved franchise. I'm curious, though, as to whether the developers plan to add any content to interact with other trainers or not. Update: ABSOLUTELY loving the new additions. Trainer battles are insanely fun! if I could add another two stars, you bet I would! 7/5.

A few issues, 1) when I try to catch a pokemon sometimes it doesn't allow me to use any ball to catch it. This has become a fairly regular thing where restarting the game is the only way to sort it and I miss out on the pokemon. 2) a similar problem where sometimes when I join a raid it doesn't actually let me battle so I can take damage but can't attack them myself. This has led to missing out on catching some good pokemon and losing my raid passes too. Please sort it out.

I'm very of two minds about this rating, played as a casual game Pokémon Go can be great fun and a good way to encourage being more active. But if you want to play it as a game first, you run into events that continue to have load and stability issues 5+ years into the game's run and bizarrely tone-deaf responses from Niantic. Keep it to a light activity amusement and you can argue it's a five star app, try to go further than that and you may also find those stars vanishing in the dawn.

Played since day one, from the get go it was obvious Niantic built this game to be a cash cow and they never cared. At a certain point the game gets extremely repetitive and the amount of content - very limited. It feels like there is no point to waste weeks getting a pokemon that's 1% better. And for what? Hackers can do the same in minutes.

Please please please change the feature with the gifts where I have to scroll allll the way down to send/receive the next gift. Before, when we sent and received gifts, went back to the screen with the list of friends, we could pick up where we left now. Now, if I skip a friend's gift (to wait for ultra or best friends) and continue to send/receive gifts and go back to the "list of friends" page, it send me back allll the way up to the FIRST person that sent me a gift. This makes it a real big pain to keep scrolling down. Leveling up friendships through gifts already took long enough. With this update, it takes 3 times longer to finish sending gifts.

Doesn't use notification categories and the recent event notification spam can't be opted out from within the app. Bugs take forever to get fixed and sometimes regress. Most parts of the game just take too long to play (sending gifts, gym battles, especially PvP). Recent updates have been greedier (trying harder to guide you to paying to win). Has always had tons of cheaters that ruin any parts of the game that involve interacting with other players (e.g. gyms).

The game is fun, but when you live in rural areas it forces you to stop playing after a certain amount of time. There are no pokestops for miles, so the only way to get any supplies is driving around. But with pokestops having a speed limit for when you can spin them, even if you're a passenger, you can't spin the pokestops. Without being able to spin them, you eventually run out of supplies and you can't progress anymore, so you just can't play anymore.

It's a great game, although it does have a few issues. 1. Just recently I haven't received any coins from defending gyms, even though one was for over a week. 2. The fact that some of the pokemon are region specific is a joke, it makes it pretty much impossible to collect every single one unless you have a ton of money and spare time, or you own your own plane. 3. Vary the pokemon that appear from time to time, it's always the same ones you see. I still haven't even seen a bulbasaur, despite visiting forests and fields!

So much fun, seeing lots of places I never would've gone to. So many people I never would've met. The only issue might be the police issues there have been many folks are very oblivious to their surroundings and seem to be causing many disturbances. However it is amazing to see so many people out and about. Would be better if it buzzed out of app when a more rare pokemon was around or pokestop.

Fun and good way to pass some time. I've honestly been playing since it's release. Not something I log into every single day. But I do pretty often. Since the introduction of online battling it's a good way for me to kill as much time as I need too and rack up some stardust. I've rarley had issues with the game in general. The most recent updates have been awesome and have made the game much more enjoyable. I'm a level 32 steadily making my way to 40. Hope the raise the level cap soon though.

How have i not rated sooner? Pokémon GO is an Incredibly fun game that I have played on a regular basis since release!! If I wanted to complain, it would be about the constant updates, but I can't really hate on regular inprovement. No ads, which is rare these days! Sometimes a little slow, and hungry with data, but that is to be expected. Graphics are kinda buggy, but it's funny rather than annoying. Friendly community too. Great game to keep chuldren active, especially these days. Stay safe!

It's certainly a fun game (for long time players). In order to play free, you need irl people playing it or put together groups.. otherwise you're paying out of pocket to get certain Pokemon (any raid Pokemon aka legends and etc). 90% of content is behind a paywall as well. Many events are also catered toward higher level trainers. Overall, a lovely game but isn't for new players/ VERY pay-to-win/ collect. If you're a Pokedex completionist, expect to spend A LOT of IRL money in this game.

Works fine until it stops letting you login, about a week or so after you make a trainer club account. Been locked out of two accounts now because it says I failed to login. Very happy I never spent money on this - it would have been a complete waste. You're better off playing a real Pokemon game on a walk - at least you keep your progress.

Overall not bad. Big issue I have is that it seems impossible to catch rarely encountered pokemon. Use a golden raspberry, an ultra ball with a "great" throw and it immediately escapes and runs away. What's the point of the encounter if its impossible to catch? Needing to repeat those throws multiple times to catch is understandable for difficulty. But if it immediately runs away then it gives no opportunity for the catch. What even is the point then??

So the basics of the game itself is fun to play. See what pokemon show up near you and then throw balls at it. Trading and working friendship is also great, and helps with your Pokedex. Gym battle system has improved leaps since it came out. PvP will clinch it. My only complaint now with it is the tracker system; fix it so one can actually track specific pokemon without wandering around aimlessly and fruitlessly. Or let the 3rd parties take over again.

Fun for casual play, but if you're trying to catch legendary raid pokemon, forget it. Unless you happen to have extremely good RNG, the lack of consistency in space (how far the pokemon is from your "position"), the small number of pokeballs at your disposal, and the extremely low catch rate makes it extremely unfun and unfair. Despite having been playing Pokemon Go since launch, the only legendary Pokemon in my collection are story-based ones that are a guaranteed catch.

The game is fun, but I ran into two issurs since yesterday. MY AR camera doesn't work, it's just a black screen and then it crashes. My second issue is with the location. I can be at home, yet it says I'm in the next town over before switching to another town(one of which I have never been with my current account). Other than these? Good game, but the bugs need to be fixed since I can't even play with my buddy without it crashing everytime and having the reload the game.

So.... Firstly it's a great game and I love it as a long standing pokemon fan! It's so fun to play and great to get you out of the house more. You can also play WITHOUT having to make any online purchases which is fantastic as some games are almost impossible to play without spending real hard earned cash! It's really thought out , maybe a few lag issues here and there but I do have an older model phone and it still works really well. Overall, Great Job!

I have been playing this game since a few days after launch, staying through after the popular craze faded. Niantic has done a great job over the years with keeping the game fresh, offering new objectives, Pokemon, challenges, community events, etc. New ways to play are added every year. The gameplay is good for casual and dedicated players. Glitches are rare but fixed when they do arise.

Spring 2023 Update: (unfortunately due to googles word limit I'm having to replace my original 2 reviews). Pokemon Go has gone down hill. I've been a daily player for years and have seen a lot of good and some bad with the game. As of late its more bad than good. Remote raids have been capped at 5 per day and the price doubled. Niantic cares more about receiving player's location data then about the player base. Its sad to see a game going so down hill and the players being treated so poorly.

I play this game a lot but lately it hasn't been working for me properly, constantly freezes and kicks me off....I even got myself a new phone to play this game on to see if that was the problem only to find out it's even more difficult to play, can take about half an hour to even get it loaded and if I manage to catch anything it freezes and I have to reload again, my partner and myself encourage alot of raids through Facebook and when I get a chance to do a five star raid (17+people) it's freezes also and I can not participate, I'm so upset and I have done everything possible to make sure I have the right updates and a good phone and also great phone data only to find I'm spending most of my time loading and reloading, I have recently leveled up to 30....couldn't be more excited, can you guys help fix this issue

The game has changed from what it once was. That's not always a bad thing but in this instance this game has some poor and pay to win features. Collecting, raiding and catching Pokémon is fun. That core is always there and makes for a fun game. That said, the pricing of items with in the game do not make you feel like you are getting your money worth. Then there's the paid events that have also had major issues and their response to those issues have been poor. 2/10

Raids disconnect all the time or do not work correctly. Recently I used three remote raid passes, and after I completed the raid I got disconnected when I was going to capture the legendary Pokémon. Moreover, Niantic support said that after a "thorough" investigation I had already been compensated, which never happened. Please fix the connectivity issues while doing a raid, as I don't want to waste more money on in-game items that won't work.

I downloaded the game for my 8yo but due to WiFi boundaries, he couldn't play it, so i put it on my phone. I have become addicted to finding Pokémon. Unfortunately, I have had to log in numerous times and change the password even more. Now I am unable to even log in. Don't know what the issue is but I'm getting ready to toss the game. Something needs fixed.

Honestly, this game has become virtually unplayable recently. Each update brings more and more issues and errors. Crashing and freezing while trying to send gifts, lagging out after I've caught or evolved something meaning evolving with lucky egg is a no go, most recently it won't let me incubate eggs, constant errors during the current event such as not being able to log in for periods of time or pokemon vanishing when you click on them. Stop adding new stuff when you can't even fix existing errors!

Pokémon GO is a good way of spending time outdoors and discovering new things, monuments and important places and at the same time playing Pokémon. The Pokédex entries give you the feeling of completing something big, something you want to put effort in. It is sad that there is no way for you to play this without literally walking and going outside especially for those who live in small villages or towns where there aren't a lot of pokéstops or gyms (speaking from experience). Good game.

Edit. 22/04/2021. I've played Pokemon Go since the very beginning, and I must say it's the best free game out there. Yes I have purchased coins in the past, but if I'm honest, that was just me not being patient enough to earn the 50 coins per day! It doesn't use much data to play. And the games GPS is pretty good also. You do get occasional glitches and bugs but they're soon eradicated with updates. Great game.

Update: Distance tracking while walking, biking is still 3 to 1. Personal data collection in exchange for fixing errors with the game? No thanks, you ensured I'll never use Adventure sync. Read the patch notes. If you don't like spending money, this game won't be for you. You can get 50 coins a day, that's 1500 a month. Need a fix sync for Poke ball plus, Pogo plus and Gotcha.

Hi, I've been playing Pokémon GO for a long time, and the game itself is not bad. However, if you live in rural regions, it is pretty hard to progress. Even if I place my pokemons in the gym, it doesn't give me enough Poke coins to buy anything, making the game almost unplayable(quests).

Edited from 5 stars to 1 because of the latest update (April 2024) The "update" to the trainer models was a poor choice, not only are their proportions strange and a little uncanny valley/horror esque, it's almost impossible to get my trainer even close to her appearance when we still had the old (and more visually appealing) trainer models. Honestly considering uninstalling, because I don't want to play something or spend money on a game where my avatar is ugly and not what I want to look at.

I loved pokemon go when it first came out, it seemed like such a great idea, bringing pokemon into the real world and I eagerly awaited updates for new pokemon. But I dont really get to go out much, which isn't a problem of anyone's but my own, but I wish there was a pedometer system instead of a mileage/distance system.. I understand the aim is exploration but I'd like to be able to play and enjoy at least the egg hatching mechanics as I walk a lot at work.

Routes? This update is horrible I can't do the missions as these aren't available in my area at all. I spent money on event tickets and then didn't even get the items of the event. I love playing with my daughter and her friends. we enjoy battling together. awesome. it now gives you a bit of your walking when there is no game on nor little go unit monitoring (way too much battery to have them on constantly). if in small town you dont get enough ppl to battle big egg monsters so we wait once a year to do big battles down for sdcc. do not like the gifts being reduced and harder to get, but not like the egg drops are unique monsters a anyhow...

In the recent update, the game won't even load. It just gets stuck at 3/4ths of the game being loaded, before staying that way for who knows how long. A great Pokemon game that gets you out and about. In fact Pokemon fans have been waiting for this type of game for a while. I'm sick of how badly Niantic treats it's pokemon go players. Recently I have had a number of instances where a raid did not work due to a fault with the game.
