I love the game, hands down one of if not thee best mobile game out there, that being said the one main problem with the game that I've found alot and I mean ALOT of ppl(myself included) have with the game is how money oriented it is. You can only earn 50 coins a day from gyms and no other way to earn coins and the smallest (discounted) box they have is 480 coins. Which means you have to save for 10 days to buy said box. I think that's pretty ridiculous.

The pokecoin mechanic really needs a change, no reason to have a pokemon in a gym for longer than 8 hours. Master league only has 6 pokemon in the meta, making it very boring when it's the only league available. Besides those two points, the game is taken care of with events, new additions to the pokemon you can catch, and new ways to get items, like AR scanning. Pretty good game.

After three years of playing, the game still has it's clutches in me. The game is constantly updated providing additional content. The bare bones game was already fun in its own right, but since it's release, we've seen amazing additions that made game play so much better. Every time the game begins to get stale, Niantic releases an update to breathe new life into the game. This game beats all other AR games on the market and is the best Pokemon game available on Android.

it's a fun and awesome game... if you live in a city. installed this a few months ago and just got so, so disappointed that they didn't put pokestops and gyms in rural areas. city people are packed with those but rural people like me can't enjoy the game really well. i understand that there's this nominating for a pokestop but I'm still at level 17 and it's a really long way before i get to 38 to finally be able to nominate. please do fix that, niantic. i don't wanna uninstall this game.

The game is cool but it's poorly made, would have been better if they made it like a Nintendo game where we can walk around in game with some joy stick and be able to travel around the world in game, not everyone has the luxury to travel to places especially with gas prices high. I have been a loyal customer, and truly enjoyed the game. That is, until my account was charged numerous times from an unknown source. Although the gameplay is good, there are a couple of bugs. For example, today I had 850 storage spaces and 247 coins. I bought an extra 50 storage spaces for 200 coins. I started having sign in issues every single time I logged in after the major update this year, and now I'm getting an error message 15, and I was told that my account was suspended. All the things added that make the game more accessible they have removed. They are making it more difficult for people with various accessibility issues to play. I've literally gone to 20 different pokestops and they've all said "Try again later", I didn't get any items from them. Everything else in the game was working except for when I spun pokestops. The overall game is fun but there's alot of problems that can cause others to not have as much fun an example of this is people who live in more suburban type areas there's barely anything there, this is probably why some people resort to spoofing. I've been trying for three days to fix my game. It's not counting steps towards egg hatching or buddy journies. Makers seem to be doing all they can to frustrate players. If they want to shut down tracking sites the least they could do is fix the in-game tracking first. Not a lot of fun to be found 'hunting' pokemon unless you use a 3rd party app in tandem. The lack of variety of pokemon being found is turning me off the game very quickly. I've been playing off and on since 2016 and I used to love it . Love the concept but it left out some of main features of Pokemon, (such as battling, and trading. You can only battle in the gym. All of the features mentioned in my original review have been added to the game and the wait has been worth it.(updated 2/21/19)

This game is worthless without the ability to spoof my location. I'm a gamer. I sit at home and spend way too much time and money on games so I don't have to leave the house. This game has so little substance as it is but then limiting even that to the players unless they go walk for hours is missing the mark entirely.

Haven't played this game in years, but I got back into it recently and it's great! There's also a power saver mode, which definitely makes a difference, albeit slightly. They've also (obviously) added more Pokemon since I had last played, including the starters from Scarlet and Violet and some Hisuian Pokemon, but from what I can tell, no Hisuian evolutions.

It is a good app, rather my only complaint is that the pokeballs or anything else that you'd expect to be free or at a small cost is not, and the only way to get these items are to pay, and it doesn't help when you aren't looking to spend any money into it and only looking for pokemon to transfer, i would love for Niantic laps/game freak to make a in-game currency like every other pokemom game, but other then that love the app (probably will delete it after awhile 🤫)

If you don't live in a city or active community, you won't get the most out of this game. I was having a lot of fun with Pokemon Go when I first started playing. But over the last year, Niantic has been making changes that have been hindering the enjoyment I used to feel. As a rural player, remote raiding is the only way to get legendary Pokemon and Niantic has now limited raiding and more than doubled the cost of the item needed for it. The game is becoming very unfriendly to players as of late

Much has improved over the last couple of years. pvp, shiny/lucky 'mon, field/special research, raids, events... etc... still a long way to go than just button mashing but dev's are clearly focusing on the main aim of pokemon; battling 'mon against other trainers. Still plenty of bugs in game, eg; vanishing pokemon, caught pokemon changing, freezing, crashing, amongst others (don't get me started on adventure sync!!!) but a vast improvement and I'm happy playing again

For the most part, this game is great. It gets me and my kids out walking when the weather is nice. The gameplay is engaging. Anything less than 3 stars isn't worth keeping because the attack, defense, and hp stats are too low.

Have been playing for years and never had any issues until the recent update. Now the game crashes more than it works. This is seriously frustrating and in the past, Nantic has been responsive to complaints, but surprisingly now they are nowhere to be seen. Overall a fun way to pass the time, but I wish there was a way to suggest qol improvements to the dev team. I would give this more stars but It's already froze three times while trying to catch pokemon in the area. I love pokemon and all, I've been playing it since I was a little kid. But nowadays its starting to bother me because of many things. The game used to be fun and not so predatory, but it crashes often, freezes on loading, and prices have almost doubled for remote raids. The berry thing in the gyms is broken. Too many squatters. Nothing to prevent teams from taking all gyms in the area and hoarding them. Glitchy. Network error. Questionable RNG. Money grab. I started playing this game on day one. As someone who grew up playing Pokemon I absolutely loved the game. However, with the recent change in remote pass cost I can't continue to play. Great game! I've been playing since it's release. New features are being added every now and then. And now with the pokestop submissions, we can add more stops/gyms on rural areas. I'm giving it 3*. I've been playing since launch. It's been a big part of my free time since 2016. They've introduced rockstar updates that the player base loved, then took them away. Can you please give us an option to hide the "Raid Nearby!" and "X received Y items from your gift!" notifications? I'm can't connect my Go Plus, because the notifications cover the icon. 3 step glitch has been going on for a long time now. No communication about how or even if they will fix it. Basically it takes the tracking out of this game. Very expensive for such a glitchy game. This game used to be great, but the bugs have gotten out of hand, & Niantic has made it increasingly difficult for rural players like me to acquire good Pokémon. Remote raids were the only way I could acquire legendary Pokémon. Uninstalling due to cost increase.

The field research as well as the community days and new trainer battles have kept this game relevant. The only thing I would change is special research. It would make special research less frustrating for those that cannot play as much or are in areas with few pokemon spawn locations and gyms.

I have played since 2016. Niantic refuses to listen to real players, and everyone voiced what they'd like added/fixed. I really wish the game was more accessible to accommodating to all players (young, old, active, disabled...). This can easily be the big game that everyone plays if they listen.

It used to be such a good game, no events, no raids, and you could just enjoy the basic features. It was cool to see new gens come into the game, but now it's turning into a pay to win. You want pokeballs? Pay money. You want to do an event? Pay money. The game even makes it harder to catch pokemon to keep players hooked onto the game. Its sad what this game has become.

The closest we're currently going to get to going outside and catching pokemon. You will come to a point where you will feel pressure to spend money due to low item and pokemon storage. And the grind to leveling up and refilling up items after battles may be too much. But a fun game to play to get you to go outside (when its safe) and play with other players in your community. People out in rural areas will have more difficult playing the game sadly.

I suggest that you should create a pokecenter in the game because not all the time we have potions, one thing is that potions are rare to get in stops, you could only a bunch of them when you leveled up but since it is not that easy to level up, our pokemon remain ill haha and remain unusable until we leveled up or find potions. I hope you read and think of this well.

It's a great game but I can't give it five stars until the footsteps are fixed because I've seen rare Pokemon in my neighborhood but can't find them do to the steps not changing from 3 to 2 or 1. Also for those of us that live a few minutes from a town or city can you add pokestops to the beginning of the neighborhoods so we don't have to travel a good distance to replenish items.

Could be a lot better, it has a lot of potential, there's just some serious problems. The insane loading times, combined with constant lag and crashes, is probably the most infuriating thing you can imagine. You can't really even battle due to the lag, which is a huge issue itself. There's no reason this game should take so much to run properly, and they've had plenty of time to fix it. The PokeBalls are too rare and expensive for how easy it is to miss or for Pokemon to break out over and over.

I've loved pokemon since I was a kid. The game is great & fun. If there is any glitch or problem in the game the customer support is worthless, the staff is incompetent and you will get no help. Several times I've had problems with the game, several times support did nothing and I got screwed out of a limited pokemon or money. Good game to play horrible game to pay. When they hire people that understand why this is my review then I'll change my review from 1* I would give none of I could.....

There are some nice elements, and the developers are always working to add new elements to the gameplay. Also kudos for the social aspects and encouraging physical activity. However, the application itself isn't very robust - often just sitting there spinning as though it has no connectivity, even though the network is fine. This usually requires a restart to resolve, which quickly becomes annoying.

I absolutely love this game! However, I have several issues with it right now. First and foremost, the server issues since day 1. Second and almost more importantly, due to the server issues when I purchased a $40 pack of pokecoins I had to select to purchase something multiple times before the purchase would be completed. Then, occasionally, the purchase would go through instantly but say there was an issue, I would try again only to receive the same error. I lost 2300 coins because of this.

I've waited so long for this to happen, and I've finally got it! The only downside is the Pokémon wind up being in backyards, and you can't get to them. Also, having a hard time finding gyms and other things. There should be a guide for your "region" (neighborhood/city), but that's just my thoughts. Also WAY too many of the same Pokémon. Other than that? Amazing!

The game can be fun, has potential to be better. Have had lots of issues with freezing up, loading/updating bugs ect. makes it hard to enjoy and makes me lose interest. It is fun for those that enjoy collecting things, and love pokemon. They have updated and made tasks and gyms a bit more accessible for individuals playing by themselves versus with a group of friends.

Updates are ridiculous. They come out a few times a month, sometimes every week, and constantly require more and more space. I can barely have any other apps on my device and i have to clear for space every time & i do a remote raid, after our team wins, my game crashes. I have to reopen the game and once i do, i no longer get the chance to catch the raid pokemon. I waste raid passes and lose the chance to catch the pokemon. Exteremly frustrating, especially on legendary pokemon during go fest.

overall I like it, but GPS can be a huge pain during critical moments of the game. Character spawns take some of the excitement away at time with how difficult and sometimes how illogically they appear. Very frustrating when you are trying to complete game tasks. Would like to see an extended search feature that let's me lookup in game common areas for pokemon locations. Would make my phone feel like a real pokedex.

Quite entertaining...when it works. The game is pretty good, but has a habit of kicking you out and not being able to reconnect to the server. The only solution I've found is to uninstall it completely and then reinstall. As this is getting old very quickly, (and the reason I stopped playing for over a year previously), I can't see me doing it much longer. This longstanding login issue needs to be fixed.

The game started out great - I've played since the very beginning - but recently there has been a clear developmental departure from the ethos of the game and pokemon, which included systematically inflating prices to disadvantage rural and disabled players. The majority of the enjoyable, community aspects of the initial game have been spoiled at this stage. For these reasons, I would hesitate to recommend the game to new players.

Don't get into this game. Niantic just keeps making changes that negativily impact user experience and engagement. I've played this game since it came out, and despite the added features along the years that kept the game fresh and fun, all the recent changes since 2020 have been in the name of profit margins at the cost of quality of life for the player. It doesn't matter how much you've invested in this app, it will never be enough. Unistalled and may the whales feed this money black hole.

I generally enjoy playing the game. My biggest issues with the game generally is the cost it takes to play because of loot box rng mechanics when it comes to getting most non wild shiny pokemon. Yes you can technically play the game for free, but you will be missing out on almost everything for most events. Currently my biggest complaint with the game is the rework of avatars that no one asked for that completely butchered female avatars and female cosmetics. Even most male cosmetics look awful.

The game is quite good. Great development, however when getting inside to the (Ar mode) to catch some pokemon. It seems like to catch the pokemon, the phone needs to be near the eyes. Since if it is far, it is hard to catch, also the payment is a bug, since to get 100 pokecoins is 5000, while to get 550 is 75,000, the diffrence is so big. So that is why i give it as a 3 star..... 😭😭😭

I don't think I've ever played a game that the developers didn't want you to play this much. Niantic is constantly creating barriers to game play. Want to battle? Too bad, there's a limit to battles. Want to raid? Too bad, you need these limited passes. Want to revive your pokemon? Too bad, you need these limited coins. They constantly add new features that are more glitchy than they are fun or worthwhile. I want to love this game but Niantic apparently doesn't want me to play it. Disappointing.

Have been playing for about a year and had a lot of fun, but one of the latest updates caused an issue and now the game crashes immediately upon loading. Thankfully I transferred a bunch of my rare and shiny Pokémon to Home, but there are still some lost to me. Doesn't help that what I've seen from the update online makes the game look like absolute dog water. Can't play, so can't recommend.

As an avid Pokemon player for the last 20 years, I'm a little biased. I love the game and greatly enjoy the motivation to get out. The interface is pretty straight forward and the short tutorial gives enough to help you stumble through what it doesn't cover. However: the frequent server issues are annoying. There is also an issue with the Battery Saver mode which essentially kills your screen and prevents interaction after returning to the game.

The game requires you to be engaging and you meet other players that range from really young to old. I think the game was a great thing but the only reason it's not a 5 is because the deals aren't that great, and they're adding new Pokemon in too quick, and not giving enough time to catch, organize, and increase space/items.

I have played this game since day one. I have encountered problems here and there which can be frustrating. However tonight has me completely livid. I went to log in and it asked me to update. It wouldn't allow it. I did all the troubleshooting and decided to delete and redownload well now I can't get the app at all! I went to the support down below and sent a message to the support and I get a reply stating I need to log in to troubleshoot! Are you serious! How is anyone supposed to get help!

It wont let me log in for days on end. Occasionally i get to uninstall it and reinstall and it'll work again, but it doesnt always fix it. Incredibly annoying when you're out and about I've tried contacting support multiple times for the past few months but noone ever replies. Very disappointed, i enjoy the game but it literally won't let me play it.

Its a good game. Adventure sync got me playing it again, but it doesn't always work. Also, as of late, every time I've loaded the game for the past few weeks, I've had the same 'GPS Signal not found' error, and just so you know, my location is turned on. Not sure if my device is incompatible, or if the GPS signal is just buggy 100% of the time. I can still battle and do the other non-gps signal related things. Sometimes spontaneously crashes, but I put that down to my phone, and not the game.

I love Pokémon over all and love the idea of being able to go out and find pokemons but the one thing that makes me lose interest is that you can't customize your character to look like you. There's only 1 haircut and 1 eye shape. To get more clothing options you have to pay money. Even with the amount of time this is out it was never updated.

With the amount of time and energy users are required to spend on this app I seriously think the developers need to take a step back and rethink almost the whole game. The battle interface is utterly terrible, no matter what you do, the game decides who wins. If you look at a the current games for Mobile, PokémonGo still has a very, very, very far way to go. Stop urging people to make in-app purchases and start fixing your ridiculous excuse for a Pokémon Game.

Niantic has proven time and again to have no idea what their players want. Most paying customers are people who don't have the time or ability to drive to where others are playing. Instead of developing ways for more players to be able to participate, Niantic is constantly pushing an agenda of excluding players and trying to charge them more for less.

It's one of the worst behaving apps I've ever tried. It gets stuck, it hangs, it's crashes whenever there's less than perfect network conditions or GPS reception. It's slow, has inaccurate controls, lags... as no other application however bad was made that I tried. The game story is good and seems to improve over time but implementation is terrible. Sorry :(

Wow, came back after a break to a much worse game. The core gameplay loop is still fun so I'll give a star for that. The character models are bad. They don't match the arts type of the rest of the games NPCs, and little seems done to make sure cosmetics/animations look ok with the new models. Clothes clipping into skin, skin texture bugs, the works. Remote raiding is also worse, a problem that only gets worse as active players dwindle. wish I had more characters, but those were the most jarring.

Lately there's been a bug with Android users unable to continue their game without logging out and back in again. Can try closing as reopening, trying again and again, But only thing that works this far is to log out and back in. If you typo your password (at least 8 letters, capitals, lowercase, and a symbol!)then you can't log in until you force the app closed due to authro problems. It's really annoying and taxing. Keep hoping this gets fixed but it doesn't. It's infuriating. Each time you log out Judy so you can log in so you can play..., your app forgets your sound settings. You log out out and back in the game and the app will destroys your ears. I don't even understand how that's an oversight.. Please allow the app to remember settings. Either way. Not Enjoying having to log in 30 times a day.. I have battery saver off, sturdier permissions given to the app to keep it open, why does it have to keep closing the moment I go to another app?

Overall, I have had fun playing the app, but recent company decisions have prompted this low review. After numerous failed launches of events, as well as the continued refusal to address long-standing issues with the game (such as with battling), and the now the sharply increased prices of shop items, I have to rate the app poorly. It is obvious that Niantic only cares about profit, not quality of game play or player experience, as is evidenced by them blatantly ignoring player feedback.

Been playing on-and-off since 2016, and it's finally fully playable for rural players, with newer game additions alloweing for spawns to your location. Being able to battle other trainers remotely is cool too, so hopefully they can do the same with trades. My favourite addition has to be the remote raids, so I hope they make remote passes more accessible.

Okay one thing I wish that there was is a lower amount of space needed to have this on my phone. Some of us have a lower storage capacity and then have to uninstall other apps to have this game on their phone. If there was like a companion game, like one that had a lost of what pokemon were nearby and didnt show the map and you could have the choice to catch them from the list. And there could be a check mark if it's been caught and put in the pokedex. Honestly this game takes up so much space

I usually don't rate things but I figured I should after this last update I haven't been able to login in due to being sent right back to the login in screen after being able to login. Contacted support and have been getting gaslighted for the past week about not having the correct username or password when I have played this game almost on a daily basis since it started. Their support team is the worst and has yet to actually listen to me about the problem.

Found a really weird glitch. I'm on the melotta quest fro 2021. Idk why but it just came across my quest list. There's no sound for the singing portion and I can progress with the quest. It shows up as a random encounter and it's just a loop. Throw 3 plain poke balls and on the 3rd it fled but it's still there as an encounter and I can do the quest after like taking a snapshot it just keeps looping here than an error message "pokemon could notnbe found".

I like how this game makes you feel like your in the pokemon world but i don't like that u cant interact and battle with other random players that are playing the game around you. For example my boyfriend and i play the game next to each other but we cant see each other on the map and we cant battle each other. They only way to do that is through the gym. I hope they add it in later. That way your pokemon can level up with each battle and the game is more interactive.

They keep raising the prices of in game items while offering worse deals with the boxes. They never disclose rates, legendaries can run away leaving you with worthless items, recent events are boring, new content is added at a snail's pace, game is super buggy, and the recent changes to raiding are absolutely awful. I've uninstalled after playing for the past 2 years and haven't touched it in a month. Genuinely awful management and the game gets progressively worse.

Would rate 1* if they weren't taking action to scrub reviews. #hearusniantic. This game was fantastic for so long but now that they are raising prices exponentially and providing no authentic new content for over a year now. I can no longer say this game is worth the commitment. The game has also been rife with bugs and UI issues for years now and is getting worse. Niantic, it's not too late to fix the damage done, but it needs to be fixed.

Over the years it has kind of gotten better, but it still suffers the following problems - Pokemon that can break out of the first throw and run away. Feels really cheap and like they're just out there to waste your balls - Performance is awful in the friends list. Even on high end devices it runs horribly - Tap detection is awful in many areas. Often I'm trying to select a pokemon but end up tapping a gym or stop instead I hope these can be fixed in the future at some point

Pros: Fun Cons: Incense changes makes it basically useless. Gets stale at times since it's the same pokemon spawning over and over and they don't change things often (shadow Pokemon remain the same for a long time). Greedy, things in the store are expensive, expansions are expensive, game passes and whatnot are expensive (for what they return). Some bugs but none that I've noticed to make it unplayable.

Little update on my old review. Was 3, now 2. There's been an uprising in errors for myself and a friend, who can't even access the app anymore. The shop doesn't work. I have to open the app 4 or 5 times to properly play the game without it saying 'try again later' for a few minutes at most. I feel like there should be a lot more Pokestops/gyms, or a daily bonus we can get, unlike the free shop items each day. Please sort out the errors most of all.

Love getting back out and about again after my interest in Ingress lapsed, but ugh, this app is horrendous. If you can actually log in at all it constantly freezes when capturing Pokemon, the gyms don't load or kick you out as soon as the battle starts and the tracking system is useless. I'd say we should've expected better but it IS a Niantic product after all. D-

Definitely a money grab. But functional. Make it more like the Pokemon games though, Pokemon centers, item stores for in game (non-gold) currency, give us TRADITIONAL Pokemon gyms, maybe NPC trainers. It's come a long way, I have played since release and I am level 32 so there is appeal, but it's feeling quite transparent as a microtransaction farm aimed at children and juveniles. You can play for free, but boy is it a slog.

Pokemon Go certainly had it's issues during in launch period in 2016. Tracking was non-functional, servers constantly crashed, and bugs galore. In 2018, 4 generations in, the game is great. Trading, raids, friends, hundreds of Pokemon, quests, and much more. Fantastic game for any Pokemon fan that helps get people active.

Niantic is reverting some positive changes they had promised to keep, like increased gym/stop interaction distance. This is a huge let down for everyone, especially us who've been playing regularly for years. Old review: Occasional visual bugs, sometimes I need to reinstall or clear cache/data, but overall it's a great game and I love participating in raids and trades with my local community.

Really enjoy the game but I hate the change they have made to the landscape colours. Living in Scotland it rains a lot. When I play and its raining the whole landscape is a depressing grey colour which is factually incorrect. All around me are lush green trees, bushes and grass. Quite the opposite to how it is reflected in Pokeman go, don't like playing therefore when it rains. Doesn't leave much playing time therefore. Hope the developers look at their depressing colour pallet.

Good concept, poorly executed. Most important issue are trainer battles, the way they are now is just stupid. If it were up to me I'd change the battles to be like in the ds and gameboy games. I feel like it should be a bit easier to get candies for your Pokemon, multiple buddies would be nice. Another big issue is that when you unlock new clothes from achievements you have to pay for the clothes, which I think is stupid.Adventure sync is buggy,rare candies useless,overall decent game Needs work.

The game is better with expanded radius for gyms and stops, although users who aren't near either are at a distinct disadvantage. Niantic s slow to react to pandemic developments and needs to retain the radius changes as if everyone is o in the most restricted situation. Disappointing recent paid event didn't deliver nearly the value for the amount paid. Better spawns without incense would be nice. I still enjoy playing and remote raids have increased the ability to play with friends.

Pokémon Go; more commonly known by it's customer base as "walking around aimlessly to find what may or may not be near by," or "look another Drowsy, " or "ugh, my GPS signal is not working again." It is absurd to have made such an obscene amount of money off of your customers and still have so many insufferable bugs. This idea was great but is quickly fading because of your absolutely horrendous support (or lack thereof).

New Review:  I play it because I like the franchise and I have an overly obsessive need to complete collections.  Secondly, this game can be played in small or large increments (min to hr), fitting well with my really erratic and often dynamic schedule.  The only reason I can't give this game 5 stars, is I can't enjoy it to the fullest.  Would I like to raid? Sure.  Can I? Rarely, because the window for raids daily is atrocious.  It starts with morning rush hour and ends with the evening rush hour.  And because I can't give purchased raid passes to another player, means I can't get those cheapskates around me to raid.  So raiding is whatever I can solo, whenever I find a lucky chance during the active daily window.  If Niantic fixes those issues, I will gladly ignore the other minor issues, and throw in the next star.

Overall the game is addicting with consrant events so you always have something to do, what I think could be a helpful feature is a chat log with friends, it has it's pros & cons but it would make joining raids, trading, battling and communicating alot easier since invites have a time limit and sometimes you can't join in time or you don't get the notification at all, other than that the game is amazing, definitely recommend.

PLEASE HELP!!!! This game is awesome but it has not been optimized for foldable phones, particularly Microsoft Surface Duo. Instead of shrink to fit, it has been expanded and the bottom half of everything is cut off leaving me no opportunity to share gifts and make necessary choices that are placed at the bottom. Please reply soon I will be more than happy to change the rating for a patch.

I was always a big fan of this game. Been playing since 2016 with minor breaks, but the last couple updates show, that Niantic does not give a flying F about the players or their opinions. I was very happy to spend money on this game, cause it felt like i could get some value for my buck. But not anymore, im not gonna spend a single € ... thank you Niantic for building one of my favorite games, and then destroying it with overmonetization.

I used to love this game, been playing since the first month it came out. Niantic does not care about its players and making the game enjoyable for them, has turned into a big money grab for Niantic. Anymore their changes just take things away from the players and increase cost for them. Events always have glitches. Guess I'll be saving money now and have more free time for enjoyable things, it was fun until it wasn't.

I used to have my rating as 5 star but my experience has gone downhill a lot over the last 1-2 years. It has become more of a pay to play game with so much more micro transactions involved now. Also they are rising the price of everything in the store so it either takes you a lot longer to buy things or you need to pay more to have it

I sunk 2 years into this game. Good times, met a ton of new people, had my fun. Now, they're holding gen 4 over my head too much. I just wish they'd release most of them, straight up. But I love the PVP. Took 3 years lol, not much into it now, but I had to update my previous 3 stars from when it first came out. It seems like they ironed out most the bugs and lags. Thanks for the memories, PoGO!

Used to be a fun game. Now it's just full of bugs, synchroadventure not working, getting kicked out of remote raids, no response from niantic support (still waiting for an issue reported 3 months ago), slot of errors when trying to catch Pokémon, eggs hatching only one pokemon all the time, events les entertaining, the list just goes on and on.

I am editing my original review after playing on and off for several years. Originally my complaints were about the variety of Pokémon being trash and them being too hard to find. It seems they've fixed these issues since then but my new complaint is the game has become entirely pay to win. If you really want to catch them all, be prepared to spend way more than the game is worth on raid passes just to watch your dollars go to waste as you fail to catch the thing after 30 perfect throws. 😑

This game is just amazing! It is a game that lets me join the world of Pokémon which is almost everybody's childhood. Other than a person's childhood, the game also encourages people to do excersice as well as be more social. Since this game required physical movement it helps you. The other reason is that it can possibly enhance social skills as you might need to interact with other players while teaming up for a Raid. This game is just amazing.

Game is a lot of fun... it is good that a game finally figured out how to get people up and moving. This is also a great way for my son and I to bond. He looks forward to our Pokemon hunting adventures. Not really a big fan of the new buddy system... I don't like that I can't earn Candy unless he is fed and out. My berry supply is already limited due to not being able to spin stops all the time (my location and daily life keep me from it not an in game issue)

Game Devs have no interest in bettering the game, and will make the game more difficult, and inaccessible intermittently. Update: Still making the game worse. Update 2: Costs have increased from 2-4x for various items and services, promised features are limited compared to the past, and most promises are broken in one way or another. Update 3: Costs have gone up again, with no features or benefits to compensate.

Initially I enjoyed it greatly, but it gets stale very quick. No long term goals other than "catching them all". More aspects from the GBA game series should be incorporated, stats, moves etc.. Turning real life locations like schools/hospitals into their game counterparts, Gyms/Pokemon Centers. A better interaction mode with your pokes/buddies, tomagochi style.

I loved playing with my roommates, and being disabled, this game helped me get more active. However, with a LOT of the recent updates(Feb 2024-Recent), the game constantly crashes during raids, won't log me in, and refuses to connect to the GPS signal. I've been playing this since the game released, but now I can't anymore? And the troubleshooting is abysmal. Don't count on niantic to help. They're busy shilling out their other apps.

The new changes you've implemented will cause a hardship on many, many players; including myself. If you look at my game play, it's significantly increased since the pandemic changes occurred. It increased because I was able to do far more than I had before. I am disabled. Removing those features will again put me in the once in awhile check the app. It will completely stop me from purchasing coins. Here we go again impacting homebound players. Nice move Niantic...

I've been playing this game since the first summer it was released. My favorite app by far. But I have not been able to log in after the last update, I just remain at the Niantic logo no matter what. I've done everything possible, from clearing the cache to uninstalling and reinstalling the app, but nothing works. Please fix this so I can start playing my favorite app again.

They fix something they break something. This game will never be fully functional to play in its entirety considering whenever they released new content something breaks and features that should be there are not. Here, play our game, wait you can't because we've introduced another issue that makes it difficult if not impossible for you to do so. Please test in a sandbox environment before you release updates, thanks. Other than that, I'll continue to play because I love Pokemon.

This game has serious potential, but if you live rurally, you will rarely see even common Pokemon, and never see a single Pokestop, which have been made central to the game's function. It's definitely a game meant for high population areas, which is really disappointing to discover and prevents me and others like me from really enjoying the game.

This is my updated review of Pokemon GO. I originally rated it one star but have revised it now to three stars. Although tracking only works if you are tracking a Pokemon to a pokestop. Stability of the app has improved over time and the addition of multiple generations of Pokemon has added a lot of flavor. Things still aren't perfect but it is much better than it was during the first gen. There are still a huge lack of pokestops in my area and the only way to suggest a new stop is if you lvl40

Rewriting my original review. This game is super fun and has definitely improved over the years. Got my 9 year old a phone so he can play with me when we go out because its simple enough for children to play. Yet there are so many quest lines and events to work with it doesn't get boring. The addition of team rocket is the cherry on top, be a real Pokémon master and defeat team rocket? Yes please!

This game has become so disappointing. First the take away in game tracking systems, then third party trackers, THEN make it so people who live in rural areas cant drive around (with my wife playing both phones) and find pokemon. This game has turned out so badly and they keep updating dumb things. Who cares if the eggs are different colors? I loved this game until they made it so if you reach "driving speed" pokemon wouldn't show up. Lame waste of a great idea. Thanks Niantic.

I used to have a lot of fun with this game, but now, a lot of the time, the game won't even open now, and prices of everything in game are going up. I just don't really like it anymore and am considering Uninstaller. Plus, remote players have a huge disadvantage in terms if comm days and catching (good) pokemon or doing raids.

I can't seem to log in ever so had to take it off recently. I'll try again in a few days or so but if I can't ever log in especially after a few hours on wifi something is definitely going on. Other's in my friend group are starting to have troubles like this too. Hopefully it'll be fixed as Pokemon Go really helps get me active. Otherwise besides from the log in issues the game is very fun and would recommend it big time!

There are a lot of bugs and you have to wait too long in between updates. There's a glitch that prevents throwing pokeballs, or even attacking in raids or trainer battles. Wasted at least 5 remote passes from pokecoins I bought with real $us & Niantic would only give me 1 replacement. The game is as glitch now as it was when first launched, or even worse than when first launched, and that's really saying something. I've spent $100s on this damn game and they can't allow me to play properly 0/10

Pretty much impossible to have fun if you're free to play like myself. Niantic just wants money and doesn't care about user enjoyment anymore. Item prices are too high, you have to pay for low quality events that are impossible to achieve in the timeframe they give, and the app glitches all the time. I used to love this game but I'm over it.

The game used to be novel and fun, if very basic. There used to be an active community of players. But the last few years the developers have been intent on making the game less attractive to players. Without the active community, this is just a sub-par exercise in mobile game grinding. And if your schedule doesn't allow for you to participate in the limited in-game events, well, you miss out on all the good content. It's been fun while it lasted, but I can't recommend jumping in now.

Whatever they did to this game recently they have ruined the ability to login. I keep getting login failure or unable to authenticate account when attempting to login. The only fix is uninstalling the game and reinstalling it. But that doesn't always work. When I close the program it sometimes stops working as well, even after a reinstall. They also ruined the game by changing the character models and taking out genders.

I enjoy the collecting part of the game, but battling is a bit of a nightmare due to all the glitches and freezing. Really disappointed about the raise in price of remote raid passes, I live in a small town where there are very few players so raiding in person just doesn't happen. I will not be paying twice the amount for a remote pass so will have to just reduce the amount of raids I do.

The walking part of the game is fine, but the Go Battle League is terribly made and maintained. It's based on 'gaming the system' and manipulating the lag with cryptic unseen variables like "move lag, CMP ties, real attack stats" etc that are not visible in the game, but must be looked up on external websites. Also, the top-rated battlers are frequently 'pay to win' very limited-time or legendary Pokemon and are structured in a way to make you spend ($) resources to compete. Truly awful. Scam.

Pokemon Go is still Pokemon 'No' to me two years later. That isn't to say the game hasn't improved tremendously. It has with Community Days, trading, battling trainers, step counting, and a plethora of creatures to capture as each generation comes, though it feels as if some killer apps and features could have come earlier on. Easily a title for towns and cities with a lot of historical value and the walkers, but not for the sedentary. Give it a Go, but it still, for people like me... 'No'.

On my Pixel 6, the game is completely unusable. I have friends with other model phones that do not have any issues at all. SUPER disappointing when I'm trying to join a raid and it won't even load the raid. EDIT: Things have improved marginally, but what hasn't improved is Niantic's greed. They roll back useful features and then make it harder to play this game for free. If they want their free players to stop playing, they've accomplished their goal. Congrats, I guess.

Randomly deleted from my phone, and when I reinstall it, I can't sign in. This is the second time I have had trouble signing in. The first was months ago so you can't use the excuse "the servers are down". Just a pile of finicky trash that was popular popular for a week in 2016. Better off with one of those free games with an add every 30 seconds.

This game has been a lot of fun in the past, but it seems they're really stretching to make players pay to play. They just doubled the prices for some of the raid passes. You have to spend coins to expand the amount of pokemon and items you can carry, and you rarely earn coins without having to pay for them. The speed sensors are kind of frustrating, and it can take forever to evolve some pokemon due to how much candy you have to collect. They need to fix the bugs and make it less pay to play.

Changing my rating. I understand the goal is to get out and explore. But it's at a point where Niantic is PENALIZING players who don't have that opportunity. Must be nice to be wealthy & healthy, and have unlimited resources for getting out there. Btwn increasing remote raid pass cost and "fixing" a "bug" that allowed players to see more spawns, I'm just angry. Wouldn't it be more player-friendly to incentivize "going places" rather than penalizing those who can't? Do you even listen to people?

Pokemon Go used to be such a fun way to play Pokemon with friends and be motivated to go outside and exercise. Unfortunately recently things have gone downhill. They ruined avatars with the most recent update, there are tons of glitches, and hiking up prices of some items, most notably the remote raid passes. When I originally heard they were doing a big update, I was excited because I was taking a break with the game becoming stagnant, but unfortunately not. Please fix Niantic

After the last update, I started having problems with gyms and raids. When I'm battling a gym, the battles freeze randomly preventing me from finishing a battle even if the opponent has no health left. In raids, I get kicked out of lobbies/raid battles resulting in me losing my remote passes. Also, I can't join other players in the same lobby, even if we joined at the same time.

If you don't already know about this game and what it's about by now, my review probably won't change that. I love this game because I'm a collector type. I don't like fighting stuff or fast-paced action. It's fun, easy, and interactive. There's some stuff that requires a bit of teamwork, but 95% is solo, another aspect I prefer. And of course I just love Pokemon.

The worst gaming experience I've ever had. When you lose a 11 win streak to lag like the game let him freely beat me when I definitely was about to fire off my charge move, then next thing its frozen and somehow I lose without even getting a fair chance to keep my win streak. So frustrating seeing you guys make all this money, add things into the game without fixing the core issues and aspects of the game, still money hungry after being out for some years now? Lol

I love playing Pokemon Go since its first release, and as much as I always wanted to stay, I am always quitting the game due to location issue. Tried to fix my phone/s, modify my gps and improve it. But still the location services is not accurate and I am jumping on a location near my current location even if I am not moving! Please fix this so that I can return on the game and enjoy it once more.

The Developers Don't Listen to their Players. I love the game but can't respect the blatant disregard for the greater player bases desires going unheard and unacknowledged by the developers. If you're playing to have fun, the novelty can wear off quickly without others around. If you play in a rural area, they have made a point to not make the game for you which is sad to see. I'd only recommend this game if you've already invested 1+ years into it.

Big MEH. I played a lot of this game since it launched and they've done some beat things with it. It's cool to catch pokemon and make them stronger and level up along the way but once you get to the point of raiding and participating in gyms, you see how lackluster they are. Without going into too much detail there's a need for an overhaul on how those work. They also raised their prices on raiding passes and that's part of why I'm on hiatus.

one of the most popular games for IPhone and Android around by any margin. there are many glitches and issues that occur with every update but it's constantly being improved upon. They always add new Pokemon, raid battles field research and rewards for daily play and regular use. the downside is the game is quite repetitive and sometimes the game feels like you have to spend real money to upgrade and get items unless you regularly play it. definitely much better when the game was first released

The game is great, but the support is terrible. I love the game; it's like stepping into one of the old Pokemon games I grew up playing. They have done a good job adding new features and improving the game. Occasionally when I try to log in, I get an error and an option to retry or log out. Either way I can't log in, usually for several days. It's very frustrating. With no individual customer support, all I can do is wait for the problem to fix itself.

The game worked fine up until recently, if you ignored the lag spikes while playing the battle league and issues with the raids, but now it's a nightmare to play any part of the game. The battle league is far more laggy now than it was before. Now every single match has lagging issues causing attacks to miss. Even the main part of the game has issues with the game stopping for a few seconds frequently and the price of some items going up. I can't keep trying to play when it doesn't work properly

With Niantic taking out the step mechanic and reducing the scan area, finding nearby Pokémon  is really more luck based than anything else. A Raichu spawned outside my apartment last night and my friends and I went out to find it. Ended up walking around aimlessly for about 10 minutes before it disappeared from the nearby list completely. This is not the game Niantic advertised in the first couple weeks of launch and I don't see how to play it if these features stay removed.

There was so much promise for this game. Why features like trading or battling aren't included is a mystery to me, then removing the ability to track down the ones you want? So now it's just walk around in heavily populated areas and wait till things appear or your eggs hatch. I'd hoped the game would get progressively better, not progressively worse...

Never has a development team started with a great idea for a game and made continuous decisions to run it in the ground like Niantic have. Every single event and update adds more bugs and worse gameplay. Remote raids may be that final terrible decision that push people away. Take it from a 7 year player who's quitting, this game isn't worth it for the Pokémon name.

Sick of this game. Keep getting kicked out of raids-both remote and on site-with no return of raid pass. This issue was supposed to already be fixed, per Niantic FAQ, but it isnt. Report sent to niantic twice (once with Niantic "autoreply" saying i needed to report it: duh, it was the thing i just did; and once with attached photos and other, more specific info sent) still not resolved. No update/info on when it might be. Plus, weird teleporting, and long load times made me uninstall.

You aren't gonna have a player base for this game much longer if you keep this up. Tracking breaks so let's just remove it. Oh, then let's say pokemon tracking sites take the fun out and have them shut down too. Let's completely ignore the players and not say anything about any updates, patches, or even the fact that you're working on it. As far as I'm concerned, you've given up. You got your money and you don't care what happens now. It's too bad. I really hate to see great ideas thrown away.

I enjoy this on and off, but it sucks when you live in a very rural area. The house I was staying at pretty much never had any wild pokemon sightings unless you used a lure. :/ Most of my catches are via this method when I have any. Otherwise, I have to wait until we need something in town. On this same note, raids are also out of the question and there weren't any nearby gyms either. I've moved now, but seriously. :/

I have spent a lot of time and money playing the game on my own and with friends. Ever since they nearly doubled the prices of many of the items in the game, and still have not made it easier to naturally get coins in game, I have quit playing. Too often do I feel as though they have blatantly disregarded the community, the fans, and the playerbase. Plus the game's quality has seemingly reduced as it has login issues and crashes too often.

I've been playing this game since launch and overall it's alot of fun. It's good initiative to go out and explore the world around you. I recommend playing with family & friends. It's hard to manage storage without upgrading often so expect to end up putting money into this game to fully enjoy it. This is very time consuming so expect to put a ton of time in. Additionally you cannot obtain regional Pokemon, unless you have the means to travel everywhere, so don't expect to fill your Pokedex.

What's not to like about the idea behind it? You go catching pokemon outside. It gives gamers an excuse to actually get some exercise. What I don't like (and why I haven't given 5 stars) is because it drains your battery horrendously quickly and the servers crash a lot. I expect the server issue is just a teething problem though as nobody could have expected this level of popularity

I really enjoyed playing this game, been playing since release. For a while I was active but to get the most of this game you need to be out and about all the time (I have to drive to get to pokestops and gyms). What brought me back ironically was the pandemic and the changes they made, which I had been wanting since launch. The pandemic is still not over, but Niantic is pretending it is. They can make this right by keeping the changes they made. The community wants and deserves it.

So I've been a PoGo player since 1st month of release, on and off a few times. For the last 2 or 3 years I really enjoyed the game. But withing the last year, the game has taken a big down hill dive. Niantic keeps making changes to the game that make it harder for people with actual lives, full time jobs, and disabilities to actually be able to play the game. Game has just turned into a big money grab by Niantic. Literally overnight doubling the price of remote raid passes. Shame on you PoGo

While it's not the ideal "pokemon in real life" scenario we wanted, it is a worthwhile app. The idea behind it is in the right place and with some patches and updates it could be great. Five and a half years later I'm getting back into pokemon go. Trading, battles, and team rocket were the ipdatws I was looking forward to back in July of 2016. Pokemon Go is better than ever.

This free game is really expensive to play; the price increases, among other things are making it not fun anymore. It glitches out often. Loading screens which never come to fruition. I've spent money to raid only to be kicked out randomly mid-raid. It's pretty non inclusive for rural and disabled players. Overall, this could be wonderful game is a big thumbs down. Big sad.

I've been playing this game since it's introduction in 2016. As an OG player, I would say thanks as at last I have chance to collect all Pokémons in single game. To complete Pokedex in single game is as satisfying as to collect all the Pokémons. I hope Niantic can overcome these 2 issues that plague the game ever since: 1) Lag - especially during gym and trainer battle. It's very hurt when you lose because of it. 2) Loading time. Please. Why I need to restart to see Pokémons appear around me.

I spent quite a long while registering my account because i couldn't log in my previous account. Then when i opened the app. It keep on saying i need to catch a Pokemon but where the pokeball? It didn't appear. And also said cannot detect my location. But i had opened my GPS and can even use it for Uber app. So nothing wrong with my GPS. I give up! Wasted one hour of my time.

A fun way to explore the city! I've found a lot of neat places in Spokane while playing. The spawn ratio of Pokémon needs adjustment. Some Raid Pokémon are overpowered and the style options for avatars are limited. ( One hair style? I'm sorry, but changing hair color isn't enough variety. Grant us different hair cuts!) Would be nice if the game alerted you when a friend was close enough for trades or battles, and a broader diversity of ways to gain evolution items would be great!

Fun... Sorta. If you haven't played an AR game, they are fun and get you moving. And anything Pokemon is awesome. BUT this game has pretty much constantly crashed, kicked me out of gyms during raids, and otherwise made it hard to play when I'm not on wireless. Seriously. It works best when I'm not going. The Pokemon bosses and catches start to get stale after about 6 months or so as well. I'll still play because my husband does but I've largely moved on to other games for my own entertainment

Been playing on and off since 2016. I always end up coming back to it because it's a great incentive to stay active. I used to think this was a 5 star game but there's just more and more features being added that require more and more grinding, especially when it comes to evolving pokemon. Great incentive for staying active but just not that fun anymore.

Niantic had, HAD lightning in a bottle with this game but blew it. I shared this game with my young son and he loved it, but then the crew at Niantic started putting restrictions onto us, like not being able to do anything while moving over 15 MPH. I can not give the device to him to play while I drive because the game soft locks and nothing spawns and he can not spin pokestops. It is really unfortunate that the game's worst enemy is the developer, but that is exactly what is wrong with Pokemon Go.

Company never listens to its customers, doesn't care what we want, refuses to refund purchases that it makes invalid, and rolls out "updates" that ruin the game for us. Also, most of the in game purchases are insanely overpriced. Stopped playing for years, and really regretting coming back to it. Will be uninstalling again unless serious changes are made.

Pokemon IRL sounds fun, but this game tries to convince you otherwise. Years after launch, the game may be a minimum viable product; basic features are missing or barely there, and advanced features like bulk trading will probably never exist. If you play, learn to "quick catch" Pokemon; slow animations waste your time to inflate "engagement." Store prices are ridiculous. The recent avatar update ensures everyone can look like themselves...if they're giant androgynous potato children.

Ages since I played this... lol. Man! I was upset when I wrote that first review. 😂 I reckon they fixed a lot... 3 ⭐ now. Old rev: Buggiest app. Freezes or crashes whilst capturing Pokémon. Designed to lose your hard earned pokeballs and goodies so they can rip you off in the store. Navigation and Pokémon grid tracker useless. Professor gives only one candy for any trade, even for powerful Pokémon! Haven't found Pikachu! Need to find him to recharge my phone's battery while playing this game.

Due to recent changes, the game is no longer playable for me because of living in an area with low a player base. I've been playing since day 1. Sucks to have so much time and effort get thrown in the trash because of poor decisions based on greed. This doesn't even take into account all of the bugs. Seems Niantic is going to the way of most major developers. Greed first, quality product second. Whatever.

It's awesome for all ages! You can hatch eggs, catch mysterious pokemon, battle in raids, and battle with team rocket at pokestops + if you win, you can get a chance to catch one of pokemon that you battled! I think it is one of the best games in the world. You can only level up to 40 levels but you can still play even though you finished the game. I give it a five-star review because of these reasons. Thank you Niantic for all your hard work and effort. I really appreciate all of your hard work

I spent around $40 for coins for remote raiding before they announced their price hikes. I feel like I wasted money and will not be getting the value I paid for. I used the app a lot for walks, but remote raiding was my favorite add-on at night before bed. $2 for a CHANCE to catch a digital creature is outrageous. I am uninstalling off my phone, but I wish I could also get my money back because the game is no longer worth it; it's no longer fun, just frustrating.

After a four year break I returned to Pokemon Go. They certainly solved the issue it use to have of lacking content. Now you can battle, catch multiple generation of pokemon, trade, ect ect it'd great BUT! Now the issue is the app itself (can't have your cake and eat it too). Now I have pokemon that don't show up in my roster. I get kicked out of raids. Mega evolved pokemon disappear and support refuses to reimburse me. It's just a mess! Nothing ruins immersion like a poorly maintained app.

Was great. But lately it keeps requiring updates at which point you're locked out of the game. When I go to update it brings me to Google Play Store, but there is no option to update the App, only to install. So the only way to update is to uninstall and reinstall....sorry but im not wasting my time doing that every time they decide to update the game, which seems to be more frequent lately.

I love the game. I've been playing since 2016. But, Niantic has issues. If you're casual, it's fun and addictive. If you're at all hardcore, it's irritating. The game crashes. Items dissappear. Pokémon you spend hours finding never show up. If you spend money and have an issue, you get little compensation. My main issues are with how the game is run, and if you only play minimally, you may be fine. But for me, the rating can't be higher until all the glitches are solved/compensated.

Played it on my friends phone. It's a good game, but they need to get full tablet support and support for similar devices. They're really missing out on a higher rating because of this, tbh. Most people with tablets aren't able to get past the character creation screen and it will crash when it tries to load up. So, if you're part of the unlucky group that only owns a tablet, we're going to have to sit and wait around for it to get support.

Game was fun, then became something that I opened in a new location I was visiting. Enjoyed the buddy system and appreciated the ability get candies for evolving with just exercising but the new need to feed the Pokemon candies for "limited" buddy system effects is probably the thing that is going to have me delete the game. I just don't have time to dedicate to playing and the one thing that kept it installed is now more of a pain than it's worth.

Failed to log in, network error, lost gps, dont tresspass, you're in a car, infinite spinner, random lockups. Don't you people test this app? Think about the user experience, its terrible. I spend most of my time in the app waiting for the app to connect or otherwise get situated. Even if i leave the app and come right back. So annoying. Give us options to turn off your parental controls.

Love hate relationships with Niantic. I've played PoGo since day 1. Even with all the bugs this game was still worth playing. Catching, getting out and exploring were just the foundation. The real reason we all play is the community. Niantic had the chance to make this the greatest game of all time. Sadly lack of communication, bugs, and money grab events may be the downfall of this game. I have gone f2p at the moment and if things don't change soon many will begin to stop playing all together.

So much of the game is based on FOMO that I couldn't keep going. Ironic, since this game basically cured my agoraphobia. Other than that, the game is very cool. The community that I've interacted with has been very positive and fun. I feel like a lot of the ticking clock mechanics introduced make it less enjoyable, but that may be an individual preference.

Quite a few bugs have been fixed over the years. The game is what you make it, you can still level up and catch many Pokemon without spending money or lots of time. It's a shame that the raid battles require you to make Pokemon Go friends, so for this reason they get 4 stars, as you can't actually Catch Them All, without P.Go friends. Also, they will request that you need to download updates without a days notice.

Lots of fun but there's bugs.. When raiding I wish we could invite more people when one is invited to a raid, the limit is set anyways. Also have a way to look up username for codes since we can't find the same friend we miss on Raids when invited. And have a limit of trading times for a pokemon just not once! just have a some limit like the mega rest period before trading the pokemon again, most of the time becomes a weaker even when it was really special, so dissipating and sad.

Good game! I had it when it first came out until I ran out of pokeballs, this game has come a long way. Kinda glitchy on Samsung devices, I've found you have to restart the game or device alot and the Poké stops don't register when I'm there. I'm level 15 and have almost 150 Pokémon. It's a good way to waiste spare time, fun to play with friends. If you like Pokémon I would highly recommend this game, it doesn't take too much data, and there is minimal adds which is always important too me. Thx

New update erased my teams, removed the ability to paste into the name field, can't place the cursor in the name field (must delete from end to error point) and now it powers down my screen. The new defender/streak functionality is nice but I'd give it back in a heartbeat for the ability to manipulate the name text as it used to be. Not well thought out.

Just noticed that I'd given GO a 5-Star -- well, not any longer. Niantic is so unreasonably obsessed with the way THEY want the game to be played, the result is they mostly ignore their player base and sometimes willfully flip them off. It's sad, really. At 6 years, if they don't find new ways to play the game, ways their players WANT to play the game, they're gonna eventually lose it all, and it will be no fault but their own. 😒💙

I really enjoy this game. It's something the whole family plays together. I'm changing my review to three stars because every time the app has an update for minor bug fixes it takes multiple attempts to download. I delete stuff, restart my phone, delete stuff, restart my phone and it's still mysteriously will not download due to an unknown error.

I have loved this app and playing until this new tracking came into play.  I would constantly be checking my nearbys then go out for a walk. Now I  only get to see what is near the only pokestop in my neighborhood. By the time I walk there,  everything would be gone.  Meanwhile there are good Pokémon right by my house that no longer show up in the nearby so i have no idea to go out.  I guess I'll be playing a lot less now.  Please put it back the way it was.

It was good day one when we could use the Dpad we could explore the entire world from the comfort of a chair. Now it has to many glitches and loading errors, kicks me out every 2 minutes and I haven't been able to log in for a long time. Hated It ! 2017 Well Well Well ! Its 2019 and I gave pokemon go a second try, I was pleased to see all the pokemon I captured in 2016 - 2017 are still here. I am know enjoying the game. I have captured 100's of pokemon completed some challenges I'm having fun

So, this has improved greatly. Though there are still some niches to be worked out, it has really moved into the right direction. I believe there are some functions that need to be looked at a bit more (battle system, raiding) as there seems to be lag issues that grant advantage/disadvantage to anyone...this one is my main concern. There are others, but one step at a time. Progress is key, and we are seeing it. Rated this a 1, it's now a 3 for me...we'll see soon enough if I can give this the 5.

As much as a like this game it has a few large flaws that are hard to ignore. 1: Server issues. This game has been out for a while and I'm still running into server issues. I haven't even been able to log in for the past 2 days. 2:Raid battles. Yes, I know, they are suppose to be for large groups of people, but as I don't have many local friends raid battles are impossible. They don't need to be easier, but having a diffrent mechanic to catch the legends would be nice to a single player.

It truly is unfortunate what this game has become. What was one of the best games available has turned into a bug filled money grab. Features are rolled out that don't work (routes) and new glitches appear almost weekly (KMs are now subtracted versus being added with your buddy). It seems customer satisfaction has taken a backseat to making a penny. What they fail to realize is that happy customers actually lead to making a penny. Too bad, too, for a game that has been so good for so long

I've played since 2016 and was working on level 50. I think there were a ton of great changes made COVID, I ended up going from 15 to 195 friends, and was active all the time and friend rejoined the game. However, recently it seems Niantic is trying to destroy that. From changes to lure modules movement, pokestop ranges, remote raid/box cost & limitations to the number of raids. They also keep changing to permissions first camera acces for buddy pics, now it was access to google. Nope, Done.

Loved the game since 2016. Recent updates doubling the cost of remote raid passes has completely taken away any desire ive had to play this game. I live in an area with not many pokestops much less gyms. Remote raids where how I got certain pokemon. Now I feel its pointless to play. Thanks for introducing something awesome Niantic...just to take it away. Disappointed is an understatement.

My first review was 1 star due to lack of end game. I am changing it as I have checked back after about a year or so to find a lot of improvements to the end game and targets/goals for players. I still think more needs to be done on assessing Pokemon though. The ingame appraiser is vague, and while the intent to keep some mystery is understandable, the reality is that all players check IV calculators as it is too expensive to evolve pokemon which are not going to turn out well. If the hope is that players will gamble on their pokemon, then the resources needed for this need to improve.

People are complaining in other reviews that it's not as cool as other Pokémon games, but it's a free app. It's unreasonable to expect it to be as good as games that were made to be sold for consoles. Also, people say your Pokémon can't get stronger without spending money, which is also not true. I will admit that the servers get overwhelmed a LOT, and this makes battling gyms VERY difficult, as well as catching pokemon. I will come back to rate this 5 stars if they end up fixing that.

I am one of the first player who played this game when it was released on 2016. To my disappointment, I stopped. After 6 years, I've reinstalled the app, hoping there's a lot of improvement. But no, it never failed to disappoint me. There's still a lot of improvement needed for this game. No world chat to communicate with other player, no competitive gameplay that needs skills, no ranking system, no buy and sell option. Imagine this game if the interaction of players will be improved.

This game is highly addictive and really fun to play. The main issue I am currently having is the adventure sync, it doesn't work well. I know I walk more than what the game is saying, but it just doesn't catch it I guess. One more thing, I cannot connect my Switch with my account so I can connect it to Let's Go: Eevee.

This game was buggy enough when you just were trying to catch Pokemon, now that you guys introduced your buggy raid system it is approaching unplayable. I've worked hard to reach level 32 but I'm done playing until I hear that you guys worked out some of these issues. I played Ingress from beta and even in beta it still had ten times the playabity. update have picked it back up after this long and it has gotten better so it restored my faith in letting players decide for themselves.

The game is great but Niantic needs to ditch the appraisal system and spring for a legit IV calculator (see Pokegenie and IVStats) as well as crack down on GPS spoofing. Edit: the spoofing and botting have gotten so bad in my area you can't even get in a single gym. My rating is staying at a 1 and I'm not dropping another dime on this game until I see something done. Update: things are improving and spoofers aren't as bad but still out there. The rating system still sucks and we just need a straight stats and percentage system.

The most buggy program I have used to date. Not even the notification dots work. What's worse, some players have the ability to change Pokemon at will during battles, giving them an advantage hard to beat. When I see they have this ability, I highly tail it out of the battle There are around a thousand different Pokemon and they never seem to show up so feel that catching them all ia impossible . Sometime it can take over ten balls to catch, very monotonous!

Well after spending more than two years playing I'm revising my earlier review. The game overall has kept my son and I greatly entertained. It still has the occasional bugs but what game doesn't? The only downside is the amount of time it takes to power up Pokemon and the occasional task that is just ridiculously repetitive. Quantity of time spent doesn't equate to quality of time? Hence the four out of five stars.

I love this game though I don't play as much as when it first came out. Although it's really starting to be a problem in how huge this game is on storage. I can't even download it to my SD card. Iphones seem to be the only ones able to hold such a game without having issues with needing to delete other apps first before updating... Now is one of my times of either deleting the game... AGAIN... Or deleting an app that I use frequently to keep the game.

This game is a great and unique one. Not only does it encourage you to go out, but it isn't as distracting as other games. You are not tempted to open your phone and play this game, because you need to go out to do so. The only reason why I am giving a 4 star is because I have heard numerous players bump into light posts and pillars while they are playing this game. I would suggest adding a reminder into the app which would remind payers occasionally to check their surroundings.

Niantic has made substantial changes and fixes. Many good, others are simply different. My main frustrations with the game remain: The battle system is a shallow imitation of the gameplay Pokemon fans have come to expect from the series. Money sinks are everywhere, which is standard fare for a f2p game, but the core gameplay is so devoid of substance that the only sense of progress comes from building your inventory, which is exactly where Niantic builds their paywalls.

Played the game for a long time. Was level 28. Have spent almost 200$ on it. Recently was locked out of my account and basically was just told by Niantic that I'm screwed. They can track my every step but can't get me in my 4 year old account. Will not be starting over. Which sucks. All me and my girlfriend have done for months is play this game.

I love this game. New things often being added it's simple enjoyable and fun to catch and train pokemon. Also nice to meet people through raiding gameplay where more than one trainer is needed. I should also add that I have contacted support a couple of times when game issues have affected my gameplay. In over 2 years of playing I have only felt the need to do this twice. Both times I have found them to be responsive and i was nicely compensated with in game things to make up for my troubles.

Play points don't work on it..ok it's been over a month now still can't use play points yet again no reply yet.. guess I'll delete the game. Also it would be a great game if you skip the GPS altogether. In other words joystick adventure to other places you'd never get to in your lifetime.. I could imagine the places in the world but never go there super imposed cities around the world that you can visit like your there. Taking on people in those countries.. also add a friend search hub.please.

I have played Pokemon go since the first hour of its release. Their ability to keep me playing all this time later is impressive, with constant updates, consistent changes to the game,beautiful graphics,and being able to bring people together and make new friends like no other game out there, Pokemon go, for me,can be summed up with four simple words. I JUST WANT MORE
