Don't get me wrong, the game is fun and the concept of making people get outside to play and make them walk for rewards is great. But the game is pretty empty on terms of stuff to do and every other time I capture a good Pokémon the game freezes and I dong get it. Seem to spend 70% of my time restarting it or charging my phone because it drains the battery like there's no tomorrow.

I spent real money on lucky eggs and incense, yet the servers would be down 30 minutes at a time. The timer would continue to run! You put a product out for your customers but yet it's not ready?! I want poke coins or incense added to my account. Easily lost a third of my items because servers kept crashing. Only reason I didn't rate 1 star is because I actually enjoy the game! When it works properly. Will change to 5 when I am compensated for my losses.

Great game but the new battle feature is majorly broken. Can't do any attacks at all. Also the trading has become pointless. I had a simply amazing pokemon that my dad needed and he had one I needed so we traded and they both ended up being "may not be great in battle" why would anyone want to trade if they can't even have a simply amazing pokemon. Needs to be fixed for a higher rating.

Edit: 5/1/2019 - raised my rating because the game has only gotten better. Trading and battling are part of the game now, and it's still seeing very frequent updates and quality-of-life improvements that keep it a must-play for casual walkers and Pokemon Masters alike. Still a fun activity when walking around town from day to day. It's great that the game is still getting regular updates. Here's hoping we soon see the trading and battling systems I know other players are still gunning for!

I enjoy the game, and I'm excited for the upcoming additions of being able to add pokestops and the synced movement tracking... the only things I can think of to add at this point would be the ability to exchange items for coins (like in the games) so when you have a full inventory and need to get rid of excess items you get something for the stuff you are getting rid of. I'd also love to see the ability to battle trainers outside of gyms.

Like everyone else, I left the game in 2016 because of bugs, lame battles, lag, no multiplayer, terrible gyms, and an overall unprepared app that spit in the face of my childhood. I deleted the app with anger. However, I'm learning to love again. Things are better now. Not perfect. But things are better. My new demands asks that there are more level 1-2 raids. I ask for, step count=distance NOT location tracking=distance, no stardust for learning new moves. Want a 5 star? Give in to demands.

Recent changes have caused the game to lose its appeal. For example adventure sync no longer works so my activity does not help with hatching eggs, the increase in remote raid passes price and the limit per day makes it where you cannot get enough people for raids and shows how greedy Niantic has become. The final thing I have noticed is Niantic has reduced the shiny rate as well as the catch rate for pokemon.

Played since 2019 enjoy it alot. It has improved alot and went down hill at same time. Price increases on remote raid passes, could use a sell back feature like the original game. Instead of just 🗑 the items. To get best experience with Pokémon go other apps will be needed... Pokémon home, campfire, poke genie. Also FYI if you buy a pass /gift for someone make sure the don't have it before hand. If you don't they will not refund your money at all. I have screen shots to prove it.

Update! Recent update made Dynamax gyms freeze. Now I get a blank screen! Now level 45 but losing interest as it's getting more for groups of friends to play. As a solo player I'm missing out on lots of bonuses. Unfair system. Too much on battle/trading. I cant trade any! So can't complete some special tasks. So now 3 star instead of 5 as originally I'd put 2 yrs ago. Better now can get to level 50 n power up favourite mons. Still shame no one battles nr me as getting legendary I have no chance.

I would give it more but the augmented reality doesn't seem to work. It could just be my phone not being good enough but it takes all the fun from the game. I have a Samsung galaxy core prime model number sm-g631f. Edit: I've since got a new phone and there have been many updates. Can't complain at all, and very much enjoy the game. The AR and AR+ features both work really well, though I tend not to use them. Thanks for a good game!

I really do love this game, the bugs have mostly been worked out and I really have seen it grow. Unfortunately the recent update has caused the same problem as most of my fellow gamers. When I am either training with a gym leader or attempting to battle against one of my friends the game essentially freezes and I cant attack. I had to let a Magiccarp beat my Raikou before I could even attempt to attack only to be stopped by a special move being used multiple times. Once the bugs in PVP are fixed I'll be happy.

Limited pokestops and 1 gym near where I live, when I go through similar size villages and they have 3 times the stops and gyms seems a bit off. Could do with reducing some stops in town and moving them rural to give us a better chance. I have been playing since launch and just hit level 38, if you live in a town you could do the same in a few weeks. Also as a suggestion could do with a ready button to finish the count down when in the raid lobby.

Every update has a problem. Galaxy s10. Can't use the new feature to play with pets. It just force closes every time. At least the actual game is working. Still a fair amount of GPS issues though. Watching my character ping pong blocks away is loads of fun when you're trying to battle a gym and get kicked out of it for GPS problems.

After January's Community Day, there must've been an update with how Single Sign-On with Google works. I can't log in anymore, and I was told to remove the Gmail account I had registered with that has a "." to the same one minus the period. It doesn't work. The Google account still adds the "." back in, so I can't login and get an "unable to authorize" message.

Its great for having something to do while walking but it definitely can make you made. When finding a Pokémon it can glitch out and you cant catch it or the server lags and you have to close the app and start it up again. This can and is one of my problems with this game because ive found some good Pokémon i couldn't catch because of these problems.

Go battle league needs fixed. Even when I'm connected to wifi (fast wifi) I will almost always get the "weak connection" message and die to lag, because my opponents apparently have no lag whatsoever. And half the time when I try to use a protect shield it doesn't register and I die to a charged attack. This game is fun, but it would be a lot more fun if I could beat people instead of just being a free win. I have plenty of storage space on my phone, so the problem must be the game itself.

I've been playing the game f2p for a long time and my love for pokemon as let me justify starting to spend money as I played more. But from a game standpoint, I can not support a nerf via increasing the real money cost of items and play the game feeling how I used too. It would be one thing to add more rewards to in person raiding or more fun mechanics to encourage it over remote. But to make remote raids (the most common type) MORE expensive is a blatant attempt at maximizing profit.

Absolutely love this game! It brings the nostalgia back if your a 90's kid! If u were a parent for that generation and even growing up now you know who Pokemon are and especially Pickachu! I am very happy with this game! I like that you can customize your character too. Of course that part costs money but that is understandable for an app game. The only thing that bothers me is that you have to keep pokemon in gyms for at least a day if u want to get any real profit towards buying something in the shop. Otherwise, it's a really fun game you can play alone or with friends! Plus it encourages exercise, which I like a lot because I never was motivated on my own lol.

Downloaded this game just over a year ago, am still completely hooked. I play daily, and have walked over 2000km playing in a year. Great game, and can be completely free (in app purchases are not essential to completing that game in any way). The game has massively improved since it was first released, and has far more for.players to do each day.

Thankfully they've been adding new features. There are constant updates that eat through some of my data. Game eats through my battery life as well. Wish that adventure mode would actually sync with Google Fit like it says it does. It would be even better if it would sync to Fit Bit. Overall enjoyable even though the game and company has some unsatisfying quirks.

It really is. Augmented Reality is possibly the new way to entertain as it allows you to go anywhere amd still play. See news sites, learn bout the world...it a lot bigger than just capturing monsters and fighting. It to explore...no issues with the idea of this game. However would love to see more pokemon and poke stops in rural areas. If it only expands on the city...the rest of the world wont be able to experience such fine idealism of the game. Thank you and I will keep supporting you. -Clest

I hardly ever participated in raids before 2020. The remote raid option actually increased the contact I had with friends to play the game. Now that the price of remote raid passes is much higher it is putting me back to when I hardly did raids. The game has always been biased for players in urban areas and Niantic is doubling down on this bias. But from what I have heard, even players in urban areas are finding it much less enjoyable. I've uninstalled the app. I have other games I can play.

After 8 years you'd think Niantic could build a stable game that does freeze or experience horrible frame drops, but NOPE! They are far more concerned with doing the bare minimum while trying to squeeze as much money out of the player base as possible! Do you enjoy catching your favorite pokemon? If so just go fork over the money for an actual game... you'll have to grind incessantly and align your schedule with all the little events that happen. Don't play this game

Game glitched out and made items and in game currency (which I paid for) disappear. I've been trying to communicate with support for over 48 hours and have recieved absolutely no help whatsoever. DO NOT SPEND ANY MONEY ON THIS GAME! If they game bugs out and loses money or items consider them gone. Just a glorified money grab. Now let's see if this comment gets deleted.

Trainer Battles sucks! me (Android) and another player (iOS) were side by side, connected in the same WiFi network and I had a HUGE delay in the game, so much that he has defeated my three Pokemons and I was still seeing my first Pokemon half full and a message to choose about using some shield movement or not. Connecting in different networks didn't changed anything or this horrible experience, even after 4 trials in a row... I still got the same HUGE delay...

Was great during Covid. When things chilled out company got way too greedy. It's fun at first if you buy Pokemon and item storage, but good luck getting legendaries later if you live in a rural area with either no community or worse, a rotten one. Game does nothing about cheaters, so you'll get knocked out of gyms with nobody in range. Also had the opposite, being followed aggressively (fast, quick brakes) from gym to gym by someone obsessed with making sure I didn't get coins for the day.

The game is "perfect" if life is "normal" and "safe", but there are days when it's best to stay home. It's too bad there's no way to spin a Pokestop if one stays at home. Streak bonuses can easily be broken. Also, pokestops mostly don't give gifts which can be frustrating if I want to give gifts back to friends who send me gifts.

Nice game, but a lot of improvements can still be made, especially regarding the connectivity problems, gps-signal problems, login/logout/server problems. It's nice that you've added the adventure sync in with Google fit, but it doesn't (seem to) sync when you walk while not connected to the internet. Google fit does register it though, would be nice if it would sync to Pokémon Go the moment you're connected again (not everyone who plays pokemon go has a mobile subscription/large data pack).

Good job on the new coming updates of almost doubling the prices on raid passes. From this point forward I will only play the free options and I spend alot of money on here. The thing about it is is that all niantic is doing is doubling there own personal money in there pocket. I have played this game more than I should have because I have always loved it but you guys lost a good paying customer. Niantic is greedy and I am out.

Ordinarily, Pokémon used to spawn around my house all the time, but with recent updates, only a crummy little Barboach will spawn... Is that a glitch or did you guy decrease spawns purposely? Either way, it's been too boring for me to even want to play as of late. Not only that, but the events are pretty lame and the touch sensitivity in the Pokémon storage is too wonky. Please fix. Would really appreciate it...

It has changed so much along the way and the in game charges are and restrictions on the game have become ridiculous. It's a shame the game could have been so much more at this point but instead greed has taken over. Wake up Niantic drop those prices back to where the kids can play and give us back the ability to remote play with our friends that aren't able to be right next to us for those raids that need more than 2 or 3 players. Sorry I had to drop this game down 2 stars🥺

I have been playing for almost 2 years now and it is just as fun and interesting as when I first started. Lots of different types and areas of gameplay, updates include new content and characters everytime, and game experience scales depending on player level. So there is something for everyone, not just fans of the show or earlier versoins of the game on other platforms. I play with friends my age and with my kids too. I am approaching end game content and never needed to spend $ to progress.

Brand new s9, got it last week. Full battery, not charging while playing, and the phone gets SO HOT while I play. I always have ar turned off. I play several other games that would seemingly be harder on my system, but this is the only one that fries my phone - in below freezing temperatures. This is the reason why I could never really get into playing. I don't want to destroy my phone.

I have had a lot of bugs with the game. The 2 eggs I've been hatching will not start hatching at all and I've made sure to fix the setting to make sure they are always hatching as long as I'm moving. The gifts my buddy brings me also just disappear and my item bag isn't full so I don't understand why they just poof. But I don't hate the game I've also had other bugs in the past.

My Facebook account was hacked and deleted. I tried to get my GO account back right away as they were connected. They said that they couldn't help in any way because I had "punishments" for not following their "Terms of Service" for which they couldn't tell what I didn't follow. Ultimately, they said it was my fault I got hacked (they gave me a list as to why is was, but none were accurate to the situation) and to just start a new account. Pretty garbage communications team.

This game used to be great, but for the last several weeks it's been near-impossible to log in via Trainer Club. It'll go entire days without authenticating, which makes the 7-day streaks impossible to get. Edit: I have managed to find a way to log in via Google instead of Trainer Club and had no login issues since. Now i just wish i could participate during winter without getting frostbite. :-P

The fun is kind of lost if nothing can be tracked. I would also love the option to trade pokemon with people,  as well as, battle with friends nearby and battle at a gym closest to you on the map. We should also be rewarded more for training and battling, I mean that is also a huge focus of Pokemoning, right? Also, why are we being timed in battles? More pressure and less reward. Finally, it drains my battery like crazy! Even bringing the brightness down doesn't help.

Fun to get into. Now all it needs is a way to message your friends ether in a gift or stand alone. I meet friends everywhere amd dont get numbers would like to talk 2 them. Also more options for gifts. Such as, being able to send pokeballs to your friends, or atleast your team members! Last but not least, a way to help your friend get xp points in a stand alone way. Not just by battles or rewards being xp points. More like, being just to send them points!

When a game is marketed as "go out and find and catch pokemon", it shouldn't be "go out and hope pokemon you want come to you" overall, I like the concept. But no matter where you are in relation to a pokemon, it will only show 3 paw prints. You can't even find a pokemon that shows up on the radar because you don't know which direction it is. And I can understand the servers being backed up, but seriously, fix the nearby system.

I enjoy the app the the community around it and how it motivates me to get outside a little bit more throughout the week. Where I live doesn't have a lot of options for outdoor activity, but using the app has made my regular boring walks a little more exciting. I wish there was an option to see your entire password as you type it in.

About the newest update. Sigh. I don't mind the biomes. I don't even mind the super weird new avatar designs too much. What I do mind, however, is the game opening just fine but then completely freezing on me the second it's open. Restarting the phone helped the first few times, but does nothing now. I'd report it as a bug, but apparently you can only report bugs through the app. Which I cannot interact with, because it's frozen. Shame, this game is really fun when it's playable.

This new update have many bugs. 1)I can't open any gifts or trade with friends without the keep on crashing, 2) when click on a pokemon I can't even throw the pokeball with all the lagging, 3) the pvp & rockets battles are also lagging switching out are too slow, charge attacks are not responding well and my game freeze while the opponent keep attacking. Please fix these problems!

Honestly I really.like this game but it is turning out to be a huge pay to play money grab. Also the game has serious issues loading. The gyms are in need of a serious overhaul. They are almost impossible to stay in long enough to get coins which force you to, once again, pay to play. The developers have no interest in the "players interests" despite their claims. This will no doubt go down in history as the WORST Pokémon game to ever be developed.

The game itself is cool when it's not crashing on you. I have to close and reopen the app several times a day. I even take it a step further to uninstall it as well. Its extremely inconvenient when the game itself is so addicting. I hate when I am about to add a new pokemon to the pokedex and everything freeze or crashes. Please fix this.

This game had the potential to be something great, but Niantic as a company is entirely incompetent. With the game becoming more and more of a cash grab and Niantic taking previously granted rights away from their player base, they've continuously made the game less accessible for players during pandemic times and people who don't often have the ability to traverse longer distances. No support from the devs whatsoever, and no updates on what they're doing with the game or why. They do not care.

When I first heard of this game. I was so excited but didn't have much high hopes for it. I got it when it came out and played for a few months. Then stoped. start stoped for a few years now. All they have done is make this game less like Pokemon. No wild battles. And any form of battle is just a tap fest. Even PvP has limited strategy. Most of the player base still spoofs GPS, and still use scanners to get perfect IV/rare Pokemon. Guess mobile game Gunna mobile game

Amazing app to play with friends! Me and my girlfriend get so much exercise in by walking and catching Pokemon. Doing raid battles are also so much fun if you're a die hard Pokemon fan and want to complete the pokedex. Research challenges also enhance the game to go for legendary Pokemon and experience. This app continues to amaze, and it has to be one of the best applications to have on your phone, especially if you want to go for walks! This app is a must have, and you cannot deny it!

Player since launch. But in the last 2 years this app has turned into a glitchy Data mine/cash grab. Ridiculous price increases, nerfs to just about everything, a total disregard to the ACTUAL player base are just a few of the recent issues. They want you to "go out" in order to get that "sweet sweet data". The geo location data must be worth more waay more money than we realize. To screw a dedicated player base or even lose the money from in app purchases like this is crazy! Uninstalled.

I don't even know why I still play. The game is flawed over and over again. This whole train with a full party idea just made all the gyms in my town level 10 permanently. By the time i heal up its back to level 10. I dont even have pokemon over 1400 because all i find are junk. If i see a different one cant find it. Update: Returned to try again. Some things improved however most things just got worse. Mainly I hate the fact that most of the time i only get 1/2 - 1/3 of the distance.

With the most recent few updates the game has been buggy and crashes frequently. My phone isn't powerful but it used to work fine. Most recent update causes game to immediately crash upon opening. Can't do anything, even after troubleshooting. Very disappointed. Considering uninstalling it for a few to let these bugs be worked out. If they aren't then this may be the last time I play... Ever.

Played since release. It was fun for quite a while, but now I just login once in a while, see what around me and log off. Nobody wants to do raids so I dont join them. theres no point in purchasing anything. I think for game longevity things need to change. Maybe solo raids could be a thing. Add items to target farm specific pokemon. That kind of stuff. Hope the game gets better.

Love it but... Game play seems slower lately. Takes longer to load a second ball etc. I'm also wondering if a recent update broke the ability for the pokeball plus to connect? All of a sudden mine won't connect. It's charged, send to be functioning but will not connect no matter what I do. I've even reset it. It will pair to my Bluetooth but Pokémon go will not connect to it. I've tried on several devices. It's really frustrating. The very little game play I get now would be better with my ball.

Addictive and frustrating in equal measures. Collecting is addictive, the PvP element is great (still needs some work, though) and the Ex-Raid system is often frustrating. It's easier and a lot more enjoyable to play if you live in a city. Community Days, quests, solo raiding, special raid days, events, festivals...it's all good. Still, it's pretty much up to you how you play.

Great game with great story, cool characters. Sadly Niantic has turned this fun game into a frustrating mess. You'll have fun when your not bombarded by pop up messages right before you spin a pokestop or try to catch one while riding in a car. Or GPS stops working. Edit: still had it's problems but the community is what makes this game great. Niantic has tried and it shows. They still have a bit to go but it's improving. Still needs work tho

daily player, game is going down hill. Niantic stops giving you research after level 35 and expects you to pay $5.00 for new research they release. Items you earn through research aren't even worth it, the same stuff you recieve through friend gifts. Tuesday spotlight hours have been pretty lame as well, not really much to look forward to. Also pretty annoying that they released a pokemon you can only obtain if you own or know someone with a Nintendo switch and the game "violet or scarlet".

Love the game. However, I keep getting "Failed to Login" or "Unable to authenticate" errors for no sensible reason. Lately, only reinstalling the game seems to fix the problem, which is bad news whenever I'm on carrier data. The problem seems to affect only PTC accounts, but with my current progress, there's no way I'd create a new one using another service

The recent update killed the ability to use my Poké Ball Plus that I paid $50 for. This always happens. I don't know why I spend any money on Niantic. But it stops now. I have a brand new back-up Ball [a gift] and the original toggle that won't connect, either, and the game won't let me play older versions before this update. After all of these years you'd think this wouldn't be an issue.

Can't play if I can't log in :( My login is based on my Facebook account and the app just hangs trying to log in, maybe every once in a while it works on the 3rd or 4th time, terrible way to try to play a game. If I hadn't already built up so much in game and had a few other friends playing I wouldn't even bother, especially with the increased price of remote raids. Feels like a waste of time and money right now.

Player battling please... I see all these updates of new Pokemon.. adding in the other generations are nice... But we NEED a better battling system. What is the point of catching the Pokemon just to have and start a collection? Why not collect the many different stamps in the world too. What I am trying to say.. collecting is nice.. but actually using these Pokemon would be nice too. You may be trying to develop a camera experience battle system that's fully 3d but by the time that gets finished (if your actually working on it) their will be such a small player base. It's really sad. This game was supposed to be the game changer for Pokemon. But it's just basically a "sticker collection" game.

The revert to interaction distance is one of the worst decisions they could have made, doesn't make any sense, doesn't make people go out more, but instead want to stay inside and not play at all. The game is basically unplayable when you have to zigzag between pokestops and need to be on the exact spot the pokestop is to hopefully get the stop.

The reason I gave it two star's is because it's still fun to play but the update has made the game just alot less enjoyable. having the range bonus go down was something that was just idiotic in lots of the player eye. I'd say for more remote players who don't have gyms and PokeStop in there community the change effected them the most. Being on of those players I hope Niantic changes the range to how it was .

The developers have ruined this game. Been playing this game since launch since 2016 and have absolutely loved this game when it actually works. Consistent bugs, crashes, and errors in the game make it unplayable at times. Developers have made increasingly worse decisions with the game making it nearly impossible to play unless you have 4-5 phones, tons of free time and money, and live in a place with a lot of stuff nearby. If you have not started this game, don't try it.

This game is no longer worth playing. I do not understand why we have to cycle through the same raid bosses all the time, meanwhile there are pokemon that no one has ever seen and can't find. Those pokemon are never a raid boss. The same pokemon spawn over and over even with different lures. Then when there is an event, you have pay $14.99 for a few hours and you may or may not get the new pokemon or item. You have to fight the same team rocket bosses over and over. Just worthless.

I started playing day one, through 2016/17 and stopped due to being busy with college. Figured I'd come back and give it another try and Jesus, they've done nothing to make this game friendly for anyone who doesn't live in the middle of a city center surrounded by poke stops and gyms. This game absolutely sucks if you don't live in an urban area, and even if you do it's definitely more ptw than it used to be. Depressing.

Fun game, except when you actually achieve something on the 'goals' and the system doesn't recognize it, the fact that it has huge updates on the app and sometimes they happen to frequent, and then the price to play this games with items necessary along with items too many (needs to have option to exchange unwanted items for items preferred or option to request trade item) But it is my 'go to' game on the daily.

Fun game. My only critique is that it doesn't display all the stats for each Pokemon very easily. You have to click through the appraisal to find out how many stars your Pokemon is. They should display the stars on the Pokemon screen. They should also display the strengths and weakness for each Pokemon and all other pertinent stats in an quick access stats menu, but they don't do that.

In the begining, dispite glitches, it was awesome. Then they ruined it by removing main features. Then they added some nice little features trying to make you forget what they took. They still haven't replaced some core features, and it makes it hard to play more then 5 mins at a time. There is no way to chase down pokemon, you just hope they find you. I don't want to play now, I only keep playing because this game is the closest thing to real life pokèmon and I feel that if I stop, my inner child will die.

Fun game, but Niantic has put up too many paywalls by raising the price of remote raid passes. I used to recommend this game to friends, but now I would purposely say to avoid downloading and starting the game. I get that inflation has affected most prices for everything, though I don't see why prices must nearly double increase in size for something people continuously bought and now less people will over all spend money to buy. It's like the want let users to play whether for free or not.

It Keeps freezing after battles with team rocket or other players. Doesn't let you use charged attack when fully powered up. Takes a lot of data with frequent updates. After being invited to a raid and you've fought the Pokémon it freezes on the summary screen, it doesn't let you catch the Pokémon because you have to restart the game.

By all means, download and have a go if you have space - it's very heavy on internal storage. Have fun catching some basic Pokémon. Then delete. Don't even try and catch 'em all. It will get boring quickly, and you'll end up using up a lot of Pokeballs catching same old, same old. You'll do plenty of walking, sure, but you'll do it with your nose glued to your phone. Better off going for a hike. Look at nature.

Game was great, even got my sister to convince me to come back after not playing for years. After my surgeries i haven't really been able to walk much. Bought a 100 pokeballs to compensate for not being able to reach stops 3 logins ago. On the next login 80 of my pokeballs were missing from my account & i was still billed for the gold coins i purchased to acquire it. Tired of these companies & their scams. I DO NOT RECOMMEND THIS GAME. IT IS A $$ GRAB.

This game is fun to play, however I wouldnt recommend this game to anyone as it is highly annoying and frustrating that you cannot recall your own pokemon from a gym and I find it discouraging especially for people in rural areas. I hope they fix this soon because with this being a big aspect of the game I will lose interest waiting for my Pokemon to finally be battled and released after 50 days

Really love the game and used to play it whenever I could. However, for over the past month my game will not connect to the GPS (GPS error 11). I've tried everything from checking my app permissions, uninstalling and reinstalling the game, and even reporting it; but nothing. My character is in a constant state of perpetual nothingness and makes the game utterly useless.

We all know the issues. Fix the tracker and catching mechanism. The egg hatching is pretty terrible as well. Walked a mile in 1 direction and only received .5k recognition. Pretty irritating.(9/2016) So more recently this game is much better. adding the research goals and challenges was a great idea to add more reasons to play daily. most of the issues from my initial review have been resolved as well.

This is not a real pokemon game. Niantic has 0 talent, and instead, builds off the back of a better known IP to offer a vague attempt at what should look and feel like pokemon, but rarely often does. The format, when it works is fun and light. When it doesn't, it's asking for more money for "items" or "remote raid tickets, or allowing that shiny to flee your encounter, forced in person raid days, and a slew of other things. This is a repository for things you missed out on from other gens. Avoid

When it actually works, it's great. **update** It still refuses to acknowledge PokerStars for me often, and it is impossible to beat the big raid Pokémon unless you are able to acquire an army of Poketrainers, which never happens for me, so I cannot complete some quests. Other quests are another issue: trying to obtain Pokémon that NEVER appear, and if they do, it is a single appearance and they never return. I don't play often anymore due to these issues.

Niantic has seriously grown out of touch with the playerbase. The artificial scarcity of things is way too apparent, and the game is really a chore to play unless you have money to spend. (Gas isn't cheap and pokestops disappear everyday) Also unlike other apps, you can get arrested for trespassing or be killed. Yet millions of people go out and play every day. Pretty depressing that Niantic is more concerned with wringing pennies from you, than your well-being or enjoyment of the game.

This game is full of "scam" opportunities, Niantic often increases rates of certain pokemon and shinies (without ever telling you the rate ofcourse) only for them to either shadow change the rates or just claim it as a "bug", it's a constant occurence and not one time things, usually resulting in most of the player base spending more money to get these "increased chances". This game was enjoyable until the company decided to take away the perks put in place due to the pandemic. The new games are a little better but it's still lags and it freezes and I've lost a lot of a lot of pokemon from freezing in prison and kicking me out. stuff like that .It's a fun game I've been doing it since 2016 I'm almost to a 41 But it sucks when everybody else is a late stronger and matter not quite as strong and it's hard to find people to play with .It's update all the time.

This has to be my favourite mobile game! I am constantly on it!!! Massive fan of Pokémon and have been since I was a kid and now I'm nearly 30! Updating my review since I first started playing. I love all the new raids and new features. There's so much more thats been added since I started playing back in 2016. It still lacks a lot of the charm the original handheld titles have, but the improvements over the years are solid and they've made many improvements to the game. On release I was sorely disappointed because many of us we're hoping it would be more like the RPG titles on handheld platforms, but once that shock wears off it becomes a reasonable casual experience and can lead to you finding interesting landmarks or becoming friends with like-minded strangers. I'd still wish for more depth and gameplay mechanics, but I also understand that this is completely intended to be completely casual for non-gamers to try to get them interested in real Pokemon games.

Amazing app for anyone who enjoys Pokemon. I've spent thousands of hours (not an exaggeration) exploring my city getting exercise catching Pokemon. I've made lots of friends by meeting other PoGo players and forming a local community for events and raids. The game is simple and intuitive for anyone to enjoy but if you want to dive in deep there's just as much number crunching, min-maxing potential as any main series Pokemon game. Edit: it's also not pay to win. About half of players are entirely free to play.

Although I am giving a one star review on this game, I would like to say that I personally love playing the game. I think it's a fantastic idea to make a game where part of the mechanics is to actually go out and do things in the real world to advance. The graphics are visually appealing especially compared to some mobile games, the gameplay is satisfying, and although microttansactions are a feature in the game they are not overly intrusive as you can still earn the exactly what you're paying for just at a somewhat slower rate depending on your ability to defend a gym. My problem however, comes from the lack of support for players being affected by bugs. For example, I have recently run into an issue where I had just gotten my ursaring back from defending a gym for my team. When i had received a notification that my pokemon had returned with fifty coins. Excitedly i opened the shop happy to finally get the bag upgrade I've wanted for the past while, only to noticed i received no coins what so ever. I then went to the "support page" of pokemon go to see if others had the same problem which as it seems, others have also not received the coins they were supposed to be given. At the bottom of the page when viewing the details of the bug the developers inadvertently called people making the claim liars by stating they could not recreate the bug themselves, and therefore because it didn't happen to them whole defending a gym it was impossible that it happened to anyone else. I then decided to report the bug myself, only wanting an answer to why the glitch had happened, rather than the coins only to notice that I needed to confirm that I accept that I am not going to receive a reply blfrom anyone. If any of the developers are reading my review than please do respond to this review, just to explain why the glitch occurred if there is any information as to why it happened. I would then gladly change my review to five stars, because I still do absolutely love playing pokemon go.

Niantic and Nintendo, you should be ashamed with the state of this release. I would like to comment on the game, but hardly can do to freezes, hangs, and crashes. When it first came out I would have given this a 4. I'd recommend not downloading this game until that changes.

Today is the 3rd or 4th day I have tried to install the latest update and it does not work, no matter what I do. Rated 2 because I cannot play this game anymore but I did have fun.

Its a great game that makes it fun to be outside playing with your friends, or while meeting new people to compare which wild pokemon are about. Just remember, EVERYONE wants to play at the same time. Servers can only take so much, so until everything is up and running, give them a break. Trading and battles are also a great touch ;) almost like the full pokemon experience.

I love pokemon Go but have too many bugs to say that I am having a good player experience. My current bugs are: Pokemon GO Battle League: 1. Lag. My opponents are able to score extra attacks and beat me 2. "Weak connection" symbol even though my wifi is strong and I am next to the router. This causes further lag 3. Switch in delay. I have to press a switch 2-5 times before I actually switch. This makes timing very difficult. 4. Charge attack delay. I have to press a charge attack many times before it will actually attack. Frequently this queues me before my opponents attack and can cost me games. 5. Battle entrance freezing. The battle freezes on the "GO" symbol or on one of the numbers for like 10 seconds and then I see my pokemon is getting defeated badly. 6. Switch in charge attacks. It is a common tactic to have a pokemon with a fully charged attack switch in and attack. Other players seem to be able to do this, I cannot. I literally have a fully charged attack and the attack takes several seconds. This gives my opponents plenty of time to switch out of a pokemon from a supereffective attack. 7. (Rarely) My opponent somehow uses three shields. All in all, every single one of my losses AND wins feels like it somehow is tied into the lagginess of the battle league. The battle league has become one of the worst player experiences imaginable and I only do it for items and rare pokemon encounters at this point. The battle league would be a much better experience overall if it was turn based. All that would need to be implemented would be a speed mechanic, which could be part of the charge move themselves instead of the pokemon. That way my fingers would also not hurt after tapping too much. Other bugs: 1. AR reading sometimes get stuck on my screen after scanning a gym or pokestop so I have to kill the app 2. The app takes forever to load. Sometimes it takes 5 minutes just to open the game. 3. Pokemon GO frequently gives me the "unable to sign in error" for over 12 hours at a time, meaning I cannot play when I want to. I really hope these bugs are fixed in a new update because they make the game experience MUCH worse

Pokemon Go is a next level game. Niantic's previous game Ingress laid the groundwork for location based gaming that Pokemon Go uses. The player walks, runs or cycles to and from locations in the real world known as pokestops in order to catch Pokemon. The core of this game is to throw pokeballs and catch creatures known as Pokemon. Some locations are special and are called gyms. This later addition to the game becomes important as it is the way players can earn coins. You may purchase coins but the game was made such that you never have to, though it becomes tempting as the game only gives the player a single incubator (used to hatch eggs that you collect from pokestops or gifts from friends). The game will get you out and about the town, visiting art and sponsored locations. Playing with friends or family is entertaining so long as you have a good data plan.

While I love the game, there is one MAJOR problem. I live in an area where there is no pokestops or gyms, so I run out of items very often and have to rely on gifts. It sucks when I see people who live in areas where theres hundreds of pokestops in a small area and I have around 10 in a 4 mile radius of me. Please add more pokestops for players who want to play the game without hacks and legit.

As a whole, this game takes entirely too much storage space.

I've played this game ever since the beginning. My wife and I would play strong for awhile then would need a break with how repetitive it would get but then would eventually get back in and play more. More and more I've seen the greed and the prices of items go up and enough is enough. I'm sick of these games with these micro transactions and sadly I have paid money on this game not a ton but more then I should have. Plus all and all with the Pokémon rotation this isn't a true Pokémon game. RIP

Even if you switch your pokemon types to completely different types from before, you start seeing pokemon with advantages to the new team that you had not seen before with the old team. There are also many bugs that hinder the overall experience of the game. Niantic couldn't care less about quality so long as it's making them money.

I used to play the game a lot, but over the past few years I switched to barely playing. I went from raiding every day or being upset, to raiding twice per week and not caring if I miss those. It's just obvious Niantic cares more about selling their wayspot data than about the game. They are just using the popularity of Pokemon to further their ultimate agenda. If you download the game just realized you will be bombarded by ways to help them further their agenda, whether you realize it or not.

I haven't played it consistently since launch, but I've been playing up until now. For some reason, they recently changed the naming system so that ❤️ no longer shows as a heart in the name (which is how I would identify high IV Pokemon) Also, erasing the name used to put the original name of the pokemon back. I never learned these Gen 5+ Pokemon names, so that was really helpful. Now it just puts the previous nickname. Bring both of these back for naming, and I will rate 5 stars

tried to make a link from their page and it keeps telling me there's an error. I love the game. But there is always an update and they aren't good ones. Like only being able to win 50 defending a gym a day. And that's all together. Not 50 per gym. And not to mention the go battle leagues.... I can hardly play. It continuously says weak connection but my phone data and wifi are strong. And it doesn't do it battling team rocket. Doesn't do it battling in a gym or raid. Only battle league. It's caused me to loose alot of games and that alone is about to make me stop playing.

This game is amazing!!! It will motivate you to get out of house by rewarding walking distances and youll find new places you didnt know existed in your area! I only ever spend a buck or 2 here n there. The game gets easier and more fun as you level up and collect/evolve rare pokemon. Spinning pokestops, fighting gyms and completing a different challenge each day 7 times will get you rare encounters with hard to catch pokemon! I really enjoy the amount of walking I do because of this game :)

I re-download this game after about a year and it's fun again. Biggest complaint is its hard to find the special stones, the adventure tracking doesn't work unless the game is the main screen and it still freezes frequently. I do like the new features of giving gifts, battling, and trading.

So i started playing this game since it launched and unfortunately went away and uninstalled it after trouble with connecting and kicking me out. I came back to the game and wanted to see if it better. I can say i don't have problems connecting no longer but i do have the problem with gyms and stops since there are two in my area but there to far, i would appreciate at this point more stops because really no one goes to the stop for facts at all they just want items.

Niantic only want your money and don't care about players. If you have an issue with something in the game their customer service is appalling, even if it's something you have paid for, you just get brushed off with automated responses basically saying they're not interested so jog on and no one looks into the issues properly. I have been playing for 7 years, the level of issues rise year on year, and the quality of service goes down proportionally.

The game is great! It's fun to play, the controls are easy, the graphics and sound are amazing, and there are no ads! That said, if it is your only exposure to the Pokémon franchise, please know that it is nothing like the canon games (that's right, I don't consider it canon- that's how different it is)! My only complaint is that it can be pretty laggy sometimes!

Good for passing time. Way too many notifications for players with a lot of in game friends. It takes minutes to cycle through a bunch of notifications I neither care about or have the ability to turn off. Same for announcements....forced to click them to get it to leave me alone. I just want to play the game.

Been waiting for this game for ages! So pleased with how it works so far. Still slightly buggy, but overall perfect. My friends and I are stoked! Update: with everything going on with the pandemic, I love that they've implemented things like remote raids, but trading is still an annoyance. I have friends across the country and world and I can't trade with them. I feel like adding unlimited range of your friendship is high enough would be a useful quality of life change.

This game used to be so great. I've played pokemon since the original Red and Blue released when I was 8. So it was an easy decision to get this game. And for several years it was a daily thing for me. But recently the quality of this game has suffered. I have to spend, on average, around 5 minutes closing the app and reopening it just to get it to load. A d when it does load, its so bugged out that its almost nonenjoyable. It really feels like Nyantic cares more about making money that quality

Why would one ask to update the game in the middle of my playing, especially when I've got my inscence turned on? That is just absurd. Also, the app registers nothing of the distance I've travelled while on my car. There are no Pokestops/gyms within 10 mile radius of where I live. Been contacting their team about these issues and haven't had an appreciable response yet, and it's been years.

The only way I've been able to do Legendary/Mega Raids have been through inviting people and hosting raids. With the added limit of remotes we can do a day and doubling the price of remotes, I and many others have significantly fewer people to rely on to be able to do these raids. Im always confused and disappointed as to why Niantic decides to using nerfs as a means to get us to play how they want, instead of incentivising us by adding good things to the game. Niantic's decisions are dreadful.

Lots of fun to be had, played for a long time. Big complaint with developer choices. Impossible to do some things without tons of in real life friends meeting up at places to fight bosses so people who live far away from their friends or in places where everything is further away like anywhere not in the city seems impossible. Regret giving Niantic any of my money as all their choices seem to deliberately ruin my experience. Shenanigans on all of this. Game could have been 100x more fun.

I love this game. But two times this week. My pokeballs we're completely emptied and I know for a fact I did not throw away 70 pokeballs. Twice!!! I got lucky and was working near a PokeStop and collected all day and later that day they just disappeared. A few days earlier same issue. Not as many but I missed out on rare finds that day. Ok, this is an app that unless you're a whale with several phones/accounts, it means you will never raid beyond a 3* raid. Secondly, getting a complete collection is almost impossible as many pokemons are unobtainable unless you started playing in 2016. Last drop is reversing the distance. In my town you can't physically reach a lot of landmarjs with the old distance dye to them being inside extensive private grounds. Any improvement to that was welcome but niantic decided to reverse. Uncool

I really like the the game I've been playing since it came out except for the time my phone wouldn't support it. What would make the game more amazing would be if you're playing you can see other trainers walking around while they are playing and if you could click on them and you could battle. And in each city there is like a mega gym that is ai operated and when you defeat them you get a gym badge to give us something else to work for

I'm a level 40+ player. The game glitches and customer support is poor, no solutions so we have taken a break... It might be permanently... If I'm investing time and money into a game to play it to the best it can be played it's discouraging when problems can't be resolved to make it a positive experience. I lost out on over 1.5 million XP when the game glitches and didn't recognize a egg drop and gifts opened where I should have got double XP for advancing in friendship level. Big👎🏼 and 0⭐

The issue I have is that if I can't log in for whatever reason, either I briefly lose signal trying to log in or I log out and try and log back in, it comes up with 'unable to authenticate' which means that I can no longer log in... Ever. The only solution I find is uninstalling the game and reinstalling it. Which is REALLY annoying. Please fix the log in problems. Then I might rate higher than 3 stars as I do enjoy the game

The updates made this game AWESOME!!! The original release was boring because there was nothing to do but collect pokemon. Not with battling, trading, and the new generations, this game is fantastic. I CANT STOP! There is a few things that would make this game even more awesome. ITEMS! Items for the pokemon would take this game to the next level. Niantic, put ALL your coins on this game, this is where the money and potential is. Thanks! (More cosmetics and character customization would be great)

Fun but I wish the battle system was the same as the old Gameboy systems. Game is lacking in almost every way, and they seem to push the " pay to play" button a lot ( game guides you in a way that your inventory space will never be enough and lacks any ways to get free healing for your pokemon) also there is really only something to do in game once every 14 days to sometimes a month.

The only thing that can put this game into accurate description would be to say that its literally unplayable. I solve one problem only to be riddled by another, more unsolvable, broken, and unnecessary bug that won't even let me play the game. I finally decide to give this game a try and its been nothing but a headache since ive downloaded it. Terrible. Simply terrible.

I love this game! It's so much fun, and it's something my family and I all enjoy and can talk about. My only issues with it are the facts that you have to have a data plan in order to play on the go, that walking to hatch eggs or to get candy with your buddy doesn't just use your GPS location, it also needs an internet connection, and you don't get unlimited regular pokeballs. They gave would be more enjoyable and less frustrating if these things were changed/added.

I love it so much, some things can be difficult. But that's good in a game. However I would really really really love it if they could give new hairstyles for the player character. 1 of my favorite parts of a game is getting to design the character i play as. And since I have to look at it all the time in this game. I would prefer if I could make it look better but the hair keeps ruining it. especially on the female one. Keep in mind this is just my opinion. I'm sure some people love the hair...

It could be so great, but Niantic continually makes disappointing choices. They raised remote raid pass costs past the point of it being worth the money because you're not guarenteed to catch the pokemon after battling. Feels like a scam. Avatars you cant really customize which is sad by current gaming standards. There's research you can't actually complete without traveling around the world or waiting years. Battles are just tapping. My suggestion, get a Switch and play a real Pokemon game.

Initially I was pretty bummed when I installed the app because it turns out I live in a place with no markers of any kind for many, many kilometers around But then I picked it back up when I discovered in the next city over, that I not only could play with a friend at last, but that there are lots of markers there! It's the only pokemon game I've ever gotten to play, so I've no idea what it's like compared to other games, but I'm thoroughly enjoying it I hope they put in Dragapult one day

Due to the covid distance changes being reverted (cut in half), a lot of my favorite spots to relax after a long walk have become useless because they're too far away from the pokestop/gym now. The increased distance was the main reason I started playing this game again after a couple years and this new change will be the reason I stop playing again.

I have been playing from the start. Still have my original Pikachu. Overall it's a good game. It's really great to use as a geolocator I've used it myself to search parks and cities I've never been to before. Here's my major complaint, the trainer battle system is a nightmare. There are so many lag cheaters it's scary. What's worse is there is no way to report cheaters. You can even figure out who've you have battled unless you record your battles to review. 1 star

I've played Pokemon go on and off since launch and honestly it still brings me the same joy as it did back then. Returning to the addition of routes was especially nice! Ive never had any huge bugs but the loading in screen can take a while sometimes My main critiques are: more effective incense- I mainly use them when I can't get out to walk but it doesn't help much. And a long distance trade feature; even if limited to one LD trade per month etc would be a huge plus as many friends are LD

I'm not sure if it's the game or my dodgy HTC One m8 but I have lately been stuck on the niantic screen, I've tried everything but when I am able to play it's fantastic! My brother and I joined in 2016 when the game was beginning and we stopped playing after a year but we started playing again December last year and we love the game! I just started playing this and I wasn't expecting to like it, which explains why I am a newbie, but I love this app/game. But I HATE the "weak connection" issue in the battles that causes me to lose every single time while my team stands frozen. I have troubleshot everything on my end and lowered the graphics completely down. Now having read some other reviews, I see I am not the only one experiencing this problem. Would give 5 stars if this were fixed.

you really need to add more features that make it more of a Pokemon game and less of a money grab, grind game that you need to literally travel around to play properly when it's impossible to access some places if you don't have a car or transportation. Pokemon is about the connection between Pokemon and trainer and this game doesn't have that if there's no way to level up, it's just get a better one, discard previous one.

Bad design. Takes forever to get candies, especially walking with your buddy. Only one unlimited incubator, and no chance for another one (unless you spend $). The research tasks are really difficult most of the time (catch a Ditto ×2, seriously?). The raids are extremely hard without friends. Pokémon are really inconsistent, so farming candies is hard. Always too many Pokéballs, but can never find Great or Ultra Balls.

More problems every update. I work outside and am constantly walking at work. With Adventure Sync, I was able to hatch many eggs, get candies from my buddy, and do walking research A LOT. Now, it doesnt work at all. Customer service is just as crappy. When I mention a problem, all I get is, "We're working on it." or "We've already given you as many items as we're allowed." (They've given me ONE remote raid pass from battle connectivity issues and that's it. One. Apparently that's too many.)

Pokémon Go! is an adequate time waster that rewards you for going outside. The deimplementation of the original tracking system was the worst thing to happen to the game. Integration with Google Fitness is great. The gym system is less oppressive than it was in its first year, though actual battle gameplay leaves something to be desired. Trading with friends was a welcome addition, but friend battles would be cool if they improve battle gameplay. Large cities are favored over rural areas.

I started playing again a couple months ago as I was able to reach a gym without leaving the house due to the pandemic. I even dropped money on this app for the first time since the game has been out for the Go Fest and some extra storage. However, due to the recent decrease in range and decreased incense effectiveness, I will no longer be playing the game or buying extra items in the app. It is no longer pleasant to play the game, esp as the temp here is +100°F on the daily.

This game is fun. But when you like change another account to catch a Pokemon and it will appears a white screen (like a glitch) for more than 3 mins. And another thing is sometimes when you sign out your account and signing in your account again it just wont let you in. Although my Wifi is good, but still cant. My aunty happens like this too, she signs in after 1 months the glitch, she only can go in. Pls fix all this bug/glitch.....

I'm always up for more customization options, but the new avatar/character models look really bad. Surely there is a way to make them look less janky and creepy? If there was a way to add the old model type back and have that be available while still keeping the new customization options open I think that would be appreciated a lot more. Also all my saved outfits were deleted which is very annoying. The game is too massive and makes a lot of money so I don't understand why the models look so bad

I love playing the game, but it's gotten so many bugs. At first it made sense, and they made it better. However, after the most recent update my game has become so glitchy. My trainer won't walk with me, the game will randomly close, and I'll even have the game not even being able to load. I really love the game, though, and I really hope these things are fixed.

This game worked flawlessly on my old Galaxy Note 10+. Ever since I updated to the new Galaxy S24 Ultra, it crashes multiple times a day, mostly at the most inconvenient times (like battling a grunt, catching a pokemon, or fighting in a raid.). Would really love to see this bug fixed, but it seems like it's taking quite a while. Not sure if it's worth playing anymore if I can't go more than 10 minutes without a crash. Hoping the developers come up witha solution quickly.

This game was super fun to play with friends and family, go on walks during nice weather and see what you get! However, a recent update has rendered it impossible to play for myself and most of my friends! For some reason it's no longer compatible with our devices? Or it just crashes! Nothing has fixed it so far. Can no longer play. Very disappointed.

I love it but it sucks that when you're traveling in a car, bus, train, etc. the game doesn't count the distance you're moving. Some people can't be walking everywhere all day. And I understen how that can be good or bad for some people but there has to be some balance, i mean, you can count a percentage of the distance traveling, for example: 1 mile in a car is like .5 mile walking or something. Either than that the game is the best.

"Be mindful of your surroundings and remember to not trespass" or whatever the warning thing that pops up says. Well that was def easy to do with the covid distance update but now that it has been rolled back you can't hit the majority of the pokestops without trespassing thus removing the use of the majority of pokestops. C'mon Niantic!! Give us back the distance!! Also, the new tracking system that only shows pokestop pokemon needs to be removed. Bring back the original tracking system!!

Your battle feature is really bad, been trying it a few times and it's super unfair. Click on the power attack a hundred times before it actually works and then what is that, attack incoming? Shiny catch is also very unfair! While some players get shinies all the time, the rest of us playing every day catch nothing. I've been playing from the start, but I am really annoyed at this game now more than ever.

I've been playing pretty much from the start and I still love this game to this day. I'm really happy with the battle league system and ninantics adaptability to current situations. There are bugs here and there but nothing that takes away too much from the fun. My only issue is living in a small town and missing out on all the 5* raids because we dont have the people to do it. Other than that I'm still having a blast and finally put a little bit of money into it for storage and battle passes

After coming back to the game after years of not playing. It has for sure improved. Now in my opinion it hasn't improved enough in the 4 plus years it's been out. If feels almost as if nothing has changed. The worst the game has to offer is the fact that it takes so long to hear any feedback from the Developers. I'm glad they took steps and hopefully I will rewrite this review in the future once I see better communication.

I love this game, it has its flaws but it can only get better. I am having a big issue at the moment, the game freezes on every drowzee I see, I was  in the middle of leveling one up, so sightly annoyed. It does lag but that's because it's needs signal and some places have none. Hope they keep improving it, don't want more than the original 150 Pokemon though

Promising game that delivers nothing but frustration. I have been a long time pokemon fan and had high Hope's for the game but its frustrations make it something I don't want to pick up again. Raids will freeze ruining timed battles that take large groups. Also revives won't show at stops. I sat between 3 of them spinning for 3 hours and never got one. I have over 50 pokemon fainted that I can't do anything with. Implement something to heal without revives. Like a poke center. I could go on but,

6 years later and there's a decent amount of pokemon and stops/ gyms now. But I would I like a companion app for my smartwatch to get the eggs to hatch. I don't have much time to go out and walk around but I walk a lot at work without my phone. The quests are a big way to keep interest in the game but now every quest I have requires a raid battle or to win a raid battle. Something I can't do in my small town. So the game is basically two minutes a day for me.

The game itself is amazing, but I ran into one problem. when I had a lot of pokemon I needed to transfer, it was a VERY slow process, and I feel if you guys made it a mode to scrap pokemon instead of having to do it one at a time, it would make it a lot faster in my opinion, if you could add this, I would thank you

I rate it two cause one, the trading system kinda lessens the way original pokemon is played out cause your friend(s) have to be so close to each other, but when you add people from different states or countries you don't need to be that close and I kinda want that feature to be changed cause it seems pointless to trade from a lot of friends you know around the world. also two, dont make it where you can't trade back, that's kinda dumb if you ask me. I'll rate it better when this is fixed.

The game itself is great but it still has its bugs. for example, sometimes when i catch a pokemon the game will just freeze, the music will still play and the leaves will still fall in the background, i have to close the app completely and when i do, i lose the pokemon i was trying to catch its really annoying.. another bug i ran into is when i'm near pokestops, sometimes it'll say try again later, remain blue and still spin. Update: cant battle in raids the boss doesnt load

The game has been around for a while and like many longstanding games, it has gotten repetitive. While I get the reason for the price hike for remote raid passes, the needs of the players are not met. Increase remote passes? Fine but limiting the amount of remote raids we can do was not necessary. I love the game but I advise everyone to play at their own risk.

It's a simple game, not without its share of problems - be they technical or balancing - but it hits the nostalgia hard. I can't wait to see how it evolves, much like how Ingress became something far larger than my beta test experience was able to perceive. Edit: It's evolution has been rough, particularly of late with it clawing back the pandemic QoL improvements and doubling down on monetization.

I like the game but unless you live in the city it's a little hard to find any good Pokemon. With out the tracking feature it's even harder to find anything. Hopefully in a future update they fix this but it doesn't sound like they really care. Anyway nice game still drains battery and lacking anything that's makes you want to keep playing

Game has been crashing A LOT since the last update. I've gad 60+ crashes just on the last 4 days (android sytem pop up for every 10 crashes - now at "60 errors occured in 1 week"). Raids are impossible to do anymore since i can't stay on game long enough. 5min top most of regular gameplay just catching pokemon, usually crashes instantly upon joining a raid lobby or while organizing my team, often both back to back. Please I've been having fun for so long do something about it.

I grew up playing this game with my parents, lots of memories, traveling around in my area catching Pokemon and doing raids. Just got to the point where there was nothing new, same old game, no new actual updates, other than big fixes. But it is a entertaining game. I feel like it would be better if you could play offline, especially if it's even a couple Pokemon around your neighborhood that you wanna catch but can't because there's no way to play while being offline. And it's very repetitive..

I used to have the S21+ and the game worked fine. But since upgrading to the S24+, the game is basically unplayable. It crashes multiple times a day, and usually at the most inoportune times, like when I'm in a raid or battling. I thought this would be a quick fix, but I've had the phone for almost 3 weeks, and there has not been another update and it seems like the issue has only gotten worse. It's really frustrating.

I loved this game in 2020 when I started playing, but it's kinda frustrating when you maybe dont pay for service and have to use wifi and can't go anywhere because wifi only has a certain range so you can't even go to a pokestop or gym to do what you would need to do to progress in the game. Other than that great game keep up the good work.

There are very few pokestops nearby which severely limits how much I can play. I can't get to pokestops, or gyms easily (they are on a highway) and therefore most of the time I don't have poke balls to use. It's irritating. If you live in a city you're fine, but if you live in the suburbs or anywhere rural, good luck.

Super addictive! Only thing that could be better is making your own gifts (putting your own number of things into a gift before sending it). Keep getting slingshot around my map when I go into then out of my menus though, and there's no reporting system for a badly placed pokestop (i.e. having a pokestop on a underpass artwork on a busy street, not good). Overall super fun to play if you want to get out more.

The reduction in poke stop spinning made it much harder to spin while I am on my 10k runs. By the time the game realizes I'm at a stop, it's too late and I ran past it. (The gps has pinpoint accuracy on my running app, so it's not the gps). I also used to restock my PokeBalls and gifts while at lunch at work and now that came to an end as the 4 stops are now unspinnable. I started playing in April 2021 after leaving in 2016. I guess it's time to put the game down for another 5 years.

Game is too large. Need a pocket version. With every update I struggle to keep it on my phone, and I can no longer make the space no matter how hard I try. But there's also so many new features I dont use. The only way I could play it in the future is if they make a smaller version or o get a new phone. Its bit perfect, but I love this game and in really upset even though none of my friends play it anymore.

I honestly have played it almost everyday for years. Every game has it's points of frustration. It is a perpetually updating game so technical issues happen. They do try to adjust the game to what the players want. Lots of events to help you fill out your pokedex and plenty of free items if you go out and play the game and visit "Stops/Gyms". I've never spent a penny on the game but know plenty of friends that have. All in all, an excellent game.

Fun game, I've played for several years. Unfortunatly, the creaters, Niantic, have made a series of decisions for years which have significantly impacted player experience. The company has a track record of ignoring players, and it's disheartening that they continue to make decisions that negatively impact player experience. I can't recommend the game to the disabled, folks in rural areas, folks without a car, or people who are unwilling to spend large amounts of money for a premium experience

Despite the amazing things this game does, I find that it's still rather buggy at points. I frequently get GPS errors, graphical bugs, and issues when battling (especially gyms). However, the game is pretty fun and helps me get out of the house for a bit. It is a real time sink however, so be wary when picking it up.

Seems like the special quests have become far and in between, haven't seen one in months but I have seen a lot more pay to play events, which inhale profusely. This is a casual game for me and I don't plan on spending a bunch of money on this game. So it would be nice to have the events that start as free events would stay free events and if you want to create new tasks that cost money thats fine but allow the people that have been playing since the beginning the right to pick and choose when th

Not happy with the changes back to how the game played before the Covid pandemic. Incense and lures are a complete waste of money now. I spent a lot of money on these items during the pandemic when the spawn rate was turned up with the pandemic.I won't be spending any money now with the change back. Thank you Niantic for making my decision not to spend money on your game easy. I loved walking around, playing. Your rigid management style and not listening to the player base is a big problem.

Had a great thing going, even with the footprints glitching out, the community was still able to use tools and apps to track and have fun. Forcing pokevision to shut down, as well as getting rid of footprints means you have ZERO methods of tracking Pokemon. You simply have to take the Pidgeys and Ratattas they give you. Biggest disappointment of the year. edit- fixes are rolling out nicely, still not great, but swiftly returning to fun EDIT 5-1-2019 3 years later and I still play every day.

The UI is not intuitive, I am on my feet walking literally 9 hours a day and it does not count that as walking, and it lags like crazy during gyms such that I have lost several Pokemon (successfully caught in ball, game froze my phone and had to force quit or restart). I am very sad that Pokemon has allowed such a horrible representation of their brand prolificate like this. I am only reinstalling to transfer anything I have caught to let's go Eevee.

Pokemon Go is a game that survives through it's ties to the pokemon franchise. If it didn't have the pokémon branding to along with it, I would be surprised if the game were still around. The game relies on FOMO to get you playing, and if you miss an event, it's hard to tell when you could get a catch-up event (special moves, for example). Niantic's vision for a community like 2016 leads to a restricted playstyle for the game. Niantic doesn't care about having a good game. Don't play.

The changes over the last two years basically made this game impossible to play for anyone who works full time, doesn't have a group of friends to regularly play with and isn't willing to pay money for upgrades. This only adds to the problems I had before: annoying healing system, battle system, no chat no way to transfer eggs and so on. They screwed this game up so much, I'm finally gonna quit playing. And I know I'm not the only one.

I'm really disappointed in the new update. It's extremely glitchy, map view details not being displayed also unable to evolve. It's really fun to catch a bunch of pokemon and as a long-term pokemon fan it's nice to see that this is a different style to the original games although the evelution system is kinda bad as you need to catch a TON of pokemon if you don't encounter the fully evolved version for example , pokemon like stufful and wimpod need 400 candy to evolve,and that means you need to find like more than 100 of that species or encounter an evolved version. The idea and some features are great.... but.... the feature where you can't play if you are going over a certain speed is stupid. I can't ever play when I'm in the car (not driving). Niantic has had a lot to deal with but I think they have had very poor solutions to their problems and they could have handled things so much better than they have. the implementation of pvp and monthly events is great so are the quests

I really thought Pokémon Go would live up to the reviews, and boy, was I wrong, and so were others. I just started playing the game, and when I try to catch my starter, it just doesn't even work! It just gets stuck on map view with all the starters and my character stuck in one spot while I rapidly to mash the "Catch a Pokémon" button. I searched up the bug to troubleshoot, and a lot more other people had the same error, with no avail. Saddening.

it's not bad. I still can't use it on a rooted device (which, by the way, is discrimination (look up the definition)), however on a crappy burner phone it works just fine, aside from the odd force close issue (that doesn't actually close the game. Adventure Sync is a feature that should have been in from day 1. I would rather be able to use it on my daily phone though.

I'm having an issue where as soon as i tap on a pokemon near by to try and capture it, as soon as it goes into battle mode my screen turns white, i can't see the pokemon, throw a ball at it (they just fly off in a random direction), and some random arrows keep popping upon the right side of my screen. It says some kind of mode is activated but its not working so it asks if i want it turned off. I click yes and then nothing happens. The only thing i can do is flee from the fight. This is pissing me off, please fix it game developers.

Wanted to update my review. Played 6 years now and its way better than when they started this. I love how you brought down the nomination lvl to 37, events are super fun and I enjoy quests. Some bad things: I had to reinstall the game, cause I got an issue, and now I lost all my saved teams for gyms and battles. Can you make them Not-device saved but acc saved? Also, hairstyles, so many custom option except hairstile option. And I don't like that remote raid passes are only buyable now.

I love the concept and the quality of the graphics. But there are core pieces that massively affect gameplay that simply don't work. Server can't handle the load, GPS tracking is inconsistent, and the nearby Pokemon tracking system is just flat out broken after the second to last update. It seems they were in a rush to release globally and underestimated the volume of people that were going to play. They just can't keep up with it.

Great game overall. The gameplay is a bit buggy when the ball counts as a hit when it's hits air, others when it goes through the pokemon. There's also a bug where the character doesn't move while your walking, this happens alot everyday to both me and my friends. The controls are good, but can be annoying while trying to do a curveball throw, it resets the ball. Also I have experienced a curveball throw happening when I throw the ball straight forward without spinning the ball, causing the ball

There's been a definite improvement in the game since last year's big update. The addition of research tasks gives you an incentive to play daily, and the rewards are good. Even with that there are still plenty of bugs that can hinder progress, adventure sync seems to pick and choose when it wants to track steps and raid battles can be difficult since the timer will still count down even after you've beat a pokemon which can cause you to lose a battle you've already won.

It's overall great, but there are some bugs.
