Like when you leave the app for a few seconds and then open it again, it will either restart the game completely, or everything will be normal except pokestops and gyms won't appear for a few seconds. Another issue is with the A.R. mode. When I turn it on during a wild catch, the UI will appear, but everything else is black. And if it's not too much to ask, maybe raise the coin max from gyms, because the max is 50 and it's the only way to get coins.

If you like a good hike and meeting up with old friends this is the app for you, unfortunately it lacks in help support. It bugs out sometimes and sometimes won't let you play the game for weeks...and you can't get ahold of Niantic Support if you can't get to the settings menu which is after the beware of your surroundings screen. Hopefully I get to play again soon.

This app has become 💩. It is laggy, there are constant notifications and emails. Battling works half the time or it works and does not let you attack. The leveling scheme is killing (always has been to be fair). The constant events get monotonous and are essentially the same every time with very little variation. To put it simply it has become a pay to play poser of a game.

"Game is a great concept, but it crashes and freezes way too often" -is what I wrote back in 2016. 2.5 years later, that's still my opinion. They've added more great concepts, and I play regularly, but this game freezes and crashes for, like, no reason. It soft locks sometimes when you tap on a Pokestop, when you try to interact with a gym, or even just randomly. It's really disappointing that with all that has been added, these bugs still persist and detract from playing. There can be several times that I need to restart the game in an hour. This game is fun to play, but will easily frustrate you with its bugs.

Yeah, I had hoped that this game would have improved a bit after all this time. Here's a hint, after 3 throws, regardless of difficulty, either run away or auto catch. If it's out of my possible range, don't even show up. There's absolutely nothing fun about repeating failure using the highest grade pokeballs I've got with berries and all. 3 times, then end.

This game has gone downhill. Don't waste any time playing it. It went from an extremely enjoyable game to completely infuriating. Problems with syncing steps lead to inaccuracies that cost progress towards prizes. I proved the step error and they didn't correct. Trainer battles are the absolute worst. Everything freezes despite great internet connection and you always lose without having a chance to defend yourself. This was once an enjoyable game but they had to go and ruin it. It's the worst.

This game is incredibly buggy. Frequent crashes and freezing. The game play is very simplistic and "grindy" as many mmos frequently get, but it does not have many cooperative features to play with friends, extending the enjoyment. It deliberately puts in road blocks to completing missions just to artificially prolong your enjoyment with "you can only do this once a day for a week" type achievements. I find myself playing out of habit, not from any real enjoyment. There's also very little I formation given regarding the forced update pushes. "Bug Fixes" isn't enough info if you are forcing me to update this and allow changes to my phone.

I had high hopes for this game as someone who grew up with pokemon. For some reason this app never works for me. My boyfriend plays it as well and has no issues. Example: this new step counting, I just updated and waited 30 min and the new content is nowhere to be seen on my app. I uninstalled and reinstalled to see if that would fix the issue. NOTHING. Extremely disappointing. This game does have potential which is why I didn't give it 1 star. We'll see how long it takes to access.

The game is a lot of fun, but sufferers from a few problems. First, the adventure synce isn't the most accurate. Misses lots of walking. Would also be awesome if I could use my S-Pen to play. Why you do dis? The animations alone have cost me tons of Pokéstops. App sometimes freezes in the more elaborate animation like gyms opening. An option to turn those off would be a good addition. All this aside, it makes bouncing around town, and walking fun. Go catch them all. You'll have plenty of fun. 😊

After 2 years of come back after a series of updates and the game is in a much better place. There are still some balance updates that could be made, especially with the increase in available battles. It's worth playing, helps add a few extra steps on a walk so you can hit a few extra stops. Only real issue that remains is the crazy battery drain, but given it has to poll GPS and data semi-constantly I'm not sure that will ever change.

Game can be addicting, but there is some flaws. The loading times can take a very long time, and there are some glitches, but there are events like every week, and new pokemon/shines are always coming out. with the newest update it's been harder to spin stops and casually play, since I cant go anywhere myself it's good play in the car, but now it's hard to do.

The game works on and off throughout the day, being server issues or just not loading right. But when it does work, i cant pull myself away, its so exciting to be walking through a park and all of a sudden, BOOM a wild arcanine. Considering the game was just released, i expected a few bugs, but theres just so many taking away from the overall experience. I hope they patch things up soon.

I have played this game since release but stopped after they changed the gym system. I picked it up again back in March of 2020. I loved the extended reach for the PokéStops and Gyms. It felt like a good general quality of life update and it meant I didn't have to get close to other people while playing. Now that they rolled back to the original size, and the pandemic is still ongoing (especially in my area), I have uninstalled it again. It is not worth having to compromise my safety to play.

I played it again 2 years after the initial release, and it feels like a whole game now. I wish this was the game we got when it first came out. Needless to say, fantastic game. Edit: The pandemic changes to increase ranges and spawn rates was the best change to game Niantic ever made. There are bugs and performance issues that have existed since the game came out that are still here. But I guess making the game more inaccessible is a bigger priority.

I like the game. The many updates of this last year are amazing, made me come back to the game after a little break. But infortunately adventure sync doesn't work with me. I have google fit installed and recording data but it is not syncing and sharing data with pokemon go. Everything is still at 0 and its been 3-4 weeks since it was released I think. Hope you can fix this problem. Thank you !

Definitely a Pokemon game of its own while borrowing key features from classic games. At the time of this review, still waiting on some anticipated key features (trainer battles, trade system) and there are still persistent connection bugs and GPS lag. But overall, simple and solid and the updates have been addressing numerous problems in previous versions.

I honestly wish I found this game fun. Niantic has done a great job at adding new features that the community wanted, but nothing ever gets improved to where it needs to be. For example: The battle system is boring, clunky and has no strategy. Trading is so held back by stardust requirements that I hardly do it, I've never seen a raid in my city with a more than a couple people and I've been aying for years. These problems aren't super hard to fix, but they make the game really hard to enjoy.

Updated yesterday. Now 4 times out of 5 when I open the app it freezes, extremely disappointing. Fix this asap and I'll change my rating. It's still doing it. I have to uninstall and reinstall every time I want to play! Please fix this! Edit. Everything has been working well for awhile now, I just never got around to editing. EDIT, Feb 2021: It forced me to update and now it's frozen at "pending". I'm in Disney and want to play! Changing my rating until this is fixed!

Started this game back at launch, returned to it a few years later. Honestly found it more engaging than the mainline franchise, which has been declining in quality. However, Niantic has recently been making some pretty big changes, that negatively impact the experience. They've removed quality of life improvements implemented during the pandemic, and increased the cost of items in the store. I hope they start taking their player base's feedback seriously, because this was a great app.

I just did an update for the application, and now I can't join any party and scan like how I was able to two days ago. I can't even put in the party code when i type it in. When i hit join party, it doesn't work at all. I am also having location issues, and my location stays on 24/7, and it's preventing me from hitting pokéstops. The last time I did a two star rating was back in 2017 about an error message that kept popping up after doing an update. Please fix this issue.

Great game over the years It would be nice that on a later update it could be added the option to convert regular pokemon candy to candy XL since is rarely obtained when catching pokemon,just a suggestion,but awesome game that has had lots of improvements over the years

Putting a cap on the amount of coins we can get per day I cannot justify. That tells me the creatures really want us to have to spend money to play the game and that's not enjoyable for anyone. I had 3 pokemon return from gyms in the same day and I had already reached my daily limit so I couldn't get any more coins. I spend a lot on coins as it is. I spent a lot of time collecting pokémon for the holiday trade challenge and got nothing for it, customer support basically told me I was lying.

Slowly adding features that are making this game pay to play or win. Some challenges require you to pay for the opportunity to play it. Some "rewards" require you to catch stuff, and if you don't have enough balls you are prevented from continuing other battles without either spending money or going out during a stay at home order and snow. "Rewards" should enable more play, not bring it to an abrupt halt.

I loved this game aside from server issues at first and I thought that it could only get better from there. I had so much fun with friends and couldn't wait till things smoothed out. Well, nearly a month into it and the app still frequently crashes and freezes, glitches still occur mulitple times a day, they didn't fix the 3 step glitch, but were lazy pieces of garbage who did away with the system and broke the game. I have also received no refunds for the money I spent on the game while servers were down.

This game just keeps getting more frustrating. It's one thing to deal with covid changes and then back to square one, now im dealing with update issues. This is the third time it has wanted me to update, when I try, the pending circle just spins for hours. The first time it did this I uninstalled the app and then it would not let me install it (like it just disappeared) I tried for almost a year. Then finally out of the blue I could download it. This time it's happening again, and Im just done!

The game has improved in playability since it's earlier days when it was plagued by lag and server issues. I have that they took the original footprint tracking out, and the stardust is way too much grind for the cost of using it and what you get it out of it. But other than that, all the features implemented up to this point have made the game pretty decent. Oh... NEED MORE CHARACTER CUSTOMIZATION OPTIONS. Not just clothes. Hairstyles, facial expressions, etc too.

Love the game and have been playing since the beginning not getting problems with the app like other have but it would be pretty cool to have a chat option with our friends so we can talk about raids and other things without physically being together. It sucks having to jump back and forth between messaging friends and the app. Would be save time and be very helpful.

The gps tracking is buggy and not accurate. The player on the map jumps around the area, and the mileage is inaccurate when incubating eggs. I was traveling 60 miles going home from work and it only logged 2 miles... The app takes a lot of energy (as with any gfx intensive app) and crashes a lot. It was even able to shut down my phone once right after i restarted it.... Good concept. Lots of opportunity for growth. But there is a lot of work to be done to make it stable and less frustrating.

At the moment it's not working properly. The first few minutes work fine when I go in. Though once I go to my friend list for example I can't exit the game. If I do anything else like spin a pokestop the map freezes but my character keeps moving. I have to keep restarting my phone every time the game doesn't work. It's been like this since the game updated to the new version last night.

Very good app. i would give it five but it crashes after it loads up, that is not a bad problem, the main problem is it lags like mad on my acatel one i'm pretty sure it is not my storage as it is 16 GB. I have a second one which is 8 GB one and it has the same problem. lagging all of the time. i recommend that you do not play on an acatel as it is really laggy but it could be the app

A super fun and addicting app! It's real easy to get started collecting pokemon and battling at gyms. The inclusion of trading/PvP battles was a life saver. There are still some bugs left over from the beginning however, i.e. inaccurate GPS, crashing at crucial points, etc. Overall, a great game and great improvement over the launch version, keep up the good work!

The game will not work on my OS, and when I try to click the "Learn More" link on the error page, it does not work. My phone should be supported, as it meets none of the restrictions on the list for supported devices. Edit: Figured it out was because I had a root app installed without my phone being rooted. After uninstalling, the app loaded properly. The "Learn More" page was still unavailable last I checked, so that's still an issue.

Go outside and become a Pokémon Trainer! This interesting addition to the franchise requires you to explore the real world to catch them all and battle other trainers. I don't recommend giving out your phone number to every stranger you battle, though. =] As this is a new app, there are some connection issues, but I don't recommend giving up until you've had a chance to play.

So many bugs, but good content. I'm a returning player that really loves the new battle league, rocket battles, trades, and remote raids, but there are still bugs everywhere in all those areas. Fun game regardless. Adventure sync should also not ask for location while the app is off. Edit: they're actively killing their game by continuously placing more limitations on when/where you can play. I didn't want to stop playing, but it just was too difficult for me to slot into my life anymore

This game has made me walk way more than I used to! While I like the gameplay in general, it has serious usability shortcomings (even bugs) in the friends list and in showing (=not showing) Pokémons' game stats. I hope they'll pay more attention to the usability issues. It's a fun game and makes people talk on the street with each other, that's a good thing :-)

The game is descent overall, but there are things holding it back. Pokeballs aren't the easiest to come by (unless you drop cash) so when I'm trying to throw curveballs and they ramdomly fly off the screen, it's kinda frustrating. Having one available option to strengthen pokemon makes it very difficult for new players to improve. I have to pass on all the special raids because the legendaries are far too strong. Bugs with connectivity occur for me too. It's still fun all in all though.

So, I really like Pokemon GO. I love how it pretty much makes another boring day out walking fun; it just gives you something to do. However, I have two issues. Firstly, I do not like the egg system. It's a glorified Loot Box system that either needs to be changed or removed. Loading times are also still a big issue since he games launch. I really like the game, but there are issues that need to be fixed.

The game continues to go downhill. They continue to remove boxes and quality of box items. Decreasing the ease of gameplay, for the claim that this is going back to the way they intended before lockdown. But lockdown did happen, people got used to, and enjoyed the additions due to it. Taking them back now because of their previous intent only takes away from the experience. It's not really about what they want. It's about what we want and they'd do well to realize it. For now I'm done playing.

Originally i left 5 stars, im doing an edit bc of many issues. One being that the game crashes...a lot, my adventure sync doesnt work and hasnt since the LAST update, battles constantly mess up, and the updates are insane and constant. Fix the bugs that are there before putting new concepts into the game would be a great idea. I love playing it, but it use to be a lot better.

Fun game, but wished they showed actual map or at least 3d builings and 3d roads. Little to none ads, so that's a plus for sure. It is not clear how to get eggs though, and it glitches,so it wont let me do a gym! Im on level 7 and havent been able to go to a gym! Need better graphics. Addictive and fun, but I personally wish you could trade BEFORE level10.wish you could see other trainers playing in the world. I wish had accurate 3d graphics so it showed cars on roads.Hope this helps! Good game

It's a fun game! I love it!! But I've noticed lately it's nearly impossible to get any revives and some aspects of the game simply don't work for the current situation in the world lol. It's hard to play in certain rural areas where there's nothing for miles and you need special distance raid passes to do anything further away. But really there's basically close to no revives even when I do go to a gym stop and spin for forever

It's almost where it should be, but there are still some game breaking bugs. The main problems are travel tracking. I was standing in the same spot before my game teleported me to another location. Other times my I'll be on a bench at a park and the game will interrupt me starting that I'm "moving too fast", and as a repercussion I'm forced to either restart the app or simply go on without the game tracking my progress. Please fix this!

There's a lot to love about it, we all know that but heres some critiques. 1) I dont think its cool to only give one candy for transferring an evolved form, especially if you've evolved it yourself and just wanted another go at evolving something... It should give at LEAST 3 i think. 2) there should be a way to tell how much longer until a pokestop is available again. And 3) there should be a way to challenge players near you. I understand thats a big step, but i really hope it happens! EDIT: the friend feature was added in the year that i didnt open the app and it looks like a lot of other features that im really looking forward to exploring! great work was done improving this app and it really shows!

This last update is very frustrating. I had completed my first route twice and the game not only didn't register it either time, even though I was hatching eggs left and right, but it kept crashing when I got close to the end of it. The route even filled in blue but kept saying I hadn't moved. I can't complete the route and not track distance at the same time. Also, the game has just been freezing and crashing a lot lately. I've really been enjoying this game for years so this really sucks.

This is a regular game. But I wouldn't recommend it to anyone. Bugs everywhere and every time, an unfair system for players around the world. While in USA you can find a lot of poke stops, almost in every town or city, in other countries barely one for towns. PVP with 'weak connection' issue makes the worst system for a game. If I could, I rate it zero stars.

Too many bad changes. *Edit* 3-7-2017 Now the game keeps crashing when I click on a pokemon. Can spin, not even sure if the distance is adding up for the eggs and candies. Found out that the game kept crashing because of not having permission to access the camera. After changing permissions then settings i was able to play. Still had/have issues with the adventure sync turning off/not counting. Now i havent played in a while.

I really don't want to hate this game, but since the new update last night, my game crashes every 30 seconds or whenever I try to do something! I was really happy when I first downloaded this game because it was innovative and I made friends! So happy I was willing to overlook the constant GPS lost problem, lag, and overpowered gyms. But no game is worth this much frustration! I understand the developers are working on improving it, but until things change for the better, I intend to leave my review as is!

Still very glitchy in parts. Most of them dont really affect game play too much. But its still lagging too much when im trying to send gifts. And when i go in to look at my eggs, the screen 'splits' with another page on the way out. Its very annoying and i need to keep rebooting the app to fix it. However on the whole the app is excellent and is now a big part of my lifestyle.

In general, the game is geared toward both the masses and fans, though it gets stale quickly after maxing out on levels. Fun gimmicks, event tie-ins and other things aim to keep it fresh, but it will feel strange to those who aged out of the franchise early on. Quick advancement in early gameplay, but not very rewarding for the time required to play/advance at later stages. Game mechanics are decent but could use improvement.

This rating would be higher, but I keep having to exit out and go back in to play because it will randomly, sometimes while I'm in the middle of catching Pokémon, it'll say the device isn't compatible with Pokémon go and I have no idea why. I have a Samsung s8. It let's me okay for like five minutes or longer and then cuts me off with that message. My phone had an update recently so it leads me to believe its a problem with the app, not my phone. Help please.

It's a good game but I don't like how the pokemon break back out of the pokeballs and flee from you sometimes, it's very frustrating. I wish that feature was gone, and up here in Milton, Wa team Valor doesn't get to have as much time in the gyms either because the other 2 teams especially mystic are always kicking us out early and I'm getting tired of that too

Updated review: this game has had its ups and downs. I really feel that being a passenger in a car should still allow more game play than it offers. Also there could be more ways of getting/holding remote raid passes. A limited joystick addition would be nice to increase the game play ability. Especially with COVID making it so hard to be out in the world. The team R pieces should be reduced to 3 or 4 before getting the radar. Make the game easier for more people to enjoy it.

Amazing game concept--but the core game has not changed at all since release! No major features have been added or expanded upon, no friend battles, no events, not even smaller additions like shinies or even a costume piece added. Sad but it seems this game turned out to be a quick money grab. 2023 update: all my complaints were addressed (+1), just took a few years. Needs a complete revamp of the combat system though. Need more attack options and strategy.

Awesome game, love it, its really great for if you want to move more! But I have one problem with it, the limits on the inventory and pokemons, it's not fun to do anything if you they get full, you can't really do anything either except delete, I have a problem on the inventory limit especially, I can't collect anything and there's too much important stuff that I can't delete and it's making me not want to play and move anymore which I desperately need. I hope the limit at least goes higher!

The game itself is fun even though rural players get the short end of the stick. No pokestops anywhere except in town that's a 15 - 30 minute drive away. The servers are garbage & constantly have issues. The Unable to Authenticate message is continuous & there's no way to actually fix the issue. Oh, and you can't save your settings. So whenever the game crashes or won't log you in, you're stuck fixing your settings for the thousandth time. And the message to turn off AR? Doesn't work.

The gameplay itself is good. The game has added a lot of new features since I last played. I took a long break and recently got back in to it. There have however been some pretty bad bugs i have run in to recently. Really bad lag and issues with transferring to the professor. It says it can't transfer due to an unknown error yet the Pokemon is gone from my storage. There have been various other problems I have run in to across the app.

Pretty good game overall. I enjoy having this run as I work, but an issue I've been having is that.. I can't catch Pokemon. Everytime I press on one, the screen goes white. I can tab out and such but I just can't catch anything.. I've tried freeing up memory, reinstalling, but it still won't work! I know that I have the right amount of stuff for it to run, so I'm confused. Overall pretty good.. I recommend.

I got a 30 day block! I have been playing since the start(July/2016) and have never done any 'suspicious ativity'! When I recieved a 7 day notice I thout it was a fluke or something and wasn't too worried but I looked it up and they do this 3 times and then your account is lost forever! I don't want to lose the progess I've worked so hard for and it's almost impossible to get the block reversed. They'll take your money(which I've spent well over a thousand by now) but won't look into your issues

Been playing off & on for years. If the log in issues would get fixed I would be happier with the game. I constantly have log in issues. Just today after a few successful weeks with no issues it says failed to log into account repeatedly when I try to launch the game. So I gave up & was going to try logging out & back in. But, as usual, when I try to log back in it keeps saying it's unable to authenticate my account at this time. I run into this mess all the time with this game & even uninstalled because of it over the summer. It's frustrating to just not be able to log back in for days or weeks at a time because of some error that just randomly decides to fix itself & work whenever it wants. Maybe it's an issue that stems from having a pokemon trainer account. But, I've had that account for years with progress on it I don't want to loose. I just wish I would stop running into this issue over & over.

- Server issues means inconsistent gameplay, if I can even log into the game. - Server issues interrupting gameplay results in lost progress and lost items.  Not paying for any items while this is happening. - You have to have the game open for it to register distance traveled in order to hatch eggs, but the distances required are at least in the 2-10km range.  These distances means a lot of battery life (even with battery saving mode on) and you're out of luck if you want/need to use other apps during those walks.  Also problematic when server issues make it hard to stay logged in for any decent amount of time.  - Music and sound effects are ON by default.  If you get booted or have to close out due to server issues, the music is back on when you go to log in again.  You cannot turn off the sounds until you fully log back in.  Every time.  Considering how often the servers going down forces the login issue, I've had some embarrassing instances of the sound blasting back on....  Please provide a mute button on the login page!  Phone: Kyocera Brigadier System: Android Lollipop 5.1.1

The app doesn't register the distance travelled. I walked from house to morrisons and back which was ~2km and no progress has been made. The app has been open the entire time.  Registered I walked 2.8km but no progress has been made to eggs in incubators or with buddy. It's also impossible for me to turn on Adventure Sync. I just go through the same process repeatedly, it keeps telling me to "turn it on in settings" which I have been doing! Coms with developers is hard. Their email doesn't work.

I love this game, and especially love how it gives me something to bond with others over while getting me and my partner outside much more often. That said, there was an apparently unresolvable glitch with my old account. I was about level 25, and one day it just stopped letting me log in. I reset my password, reinstalled the app, contacted support, nothing. So I remade. So far so okay, but even without that issue, the game frequently crashes, sometimes freezing my entire phone until I shut off.

Needs improvement. It was doing fine for a while. The most recent update has caused me to not catch raid bosses, not be able to access friends list, open/send gifts, I've had to reinstall it multiple times this week to get it to work. Update. Got a new tablet and the forgot password and username features are useless. Keeps telling me my info can't be found when I try to go through the reset process.

I really want to give this game five stars. It's been no small part of my life since release, and I've been playing it consistently since then. However, as it stands right now, it's all but unplayable. With so many Pokémon in the game, Pokémon storage is a more serious issue, the lag which seems to worsen every update makes landing throws more difficult, and when I do land throws, the Pokémon break out all the time now, on top of being useless no star marshmallows when they decide not to runaway

Decent game in general with nostalgic. More and more features are added to this one of the best free games. The biggest problem is go battle league. The ideas are great yet the server is terrible since day one. Half of the time during battles, I've encountered go battle lag or opponent sneak in a fast move and my wifi is very good. I know the game made a lot of money and we still play the game even how bad the server is. Just because we're playing won't justify the never resolved server issues.

The graphics and flow of the game are awesome, but the servers have crashed no less than 8 times in the last 24 hours. They should have had a plan for the load before they released to the U.S. I'll increase the rating when the servers get fixed. Edit: obviously the server issues have been fixed. The game does not always update and move along as quickly as I would like, and so I give it four stars instead of five.

Really enjoying this game. It's a little buggy and lacks variety, but it has a compelling gameplay loop. Microtransactions could be rebalanced slightly in order to seem less predatory and to encourage exercise, incubators being the main culprit. PSA: if you cannot connect to let's go on your switch, TRY REMOVING THE JOYCONS. I have no idea why, but this seems to work.

Several bugs and glitches, and many can be game breaking if you're not careful. Most of the newer events have rewards that are locked behind paywalls. That's fine, but then these rewards are never available once the event ends. That's bad. The seasons aren't great anymore, most of them just introduce things that infuriate the community. There's so much that could be improved, because the core of the game is brilliant. Just wish the developers cared more about the game than making bank.

A very nice idea but very poorly executed. Many unsolved bugs such as GPS issues, steps not counted, crashing etc... Instead of focusing on optimizing the game, the focus seems mostly on simply adding more Pokémon generations and in game purchases. It's very unbalanced for people who have little time to play this. Very disappointing, it could have so much potential.

Game is clearly designed for large groups of people. Raids, which are the true way to acquire strong pokemon, need several people. However, even if you defeat a legendary, it's very difficult to obtain your reward. However, if you play with the same crowd regularly, you can get more chances to catch it through the friend system. However, this means that if you are only playing with 1-2 other people, you are at a huge disadvantage. Easy fix: Implement Remote Matchmaking!!!

This game breaks more often than a Kit Kat bar... Seriously. First, when it came out, my wife could play, then after a month something caused her model of phone to not work for it. And they never fixed it. So a few weeks ago, we upgraded her phone due to the new switch game. I expected most of the bugs to be worked out by now, but yet, I am once again sitting here, for the third or fourth time in 2 weeks, with a "failed to login" message. The game is decent when it works, but come on.

This game has potential to be the best app. If the developers could take the time to fix the issues it would make this app much more enjoyable. There are many times that you cannot log on. The tracking system is broken and makes it impossible to find a certain pokemon that shows up nearby. Also to hatch eggs you have to walk and most of the time it does not track you walking making the distance much farther than the 2, 5, or 10km. Update: Many improvements over the years. Hard to play rural area

When it first came out this was definitely a 5-star game. However, that is no longer the case. The recent updates have essentially ruined some of the core aspects of the game to those few of us that still actually play (which every year is less and less people). If Niantic wants this game to be even remotely playable (<- see what I did there), then they need to STOP alienating the player base. Angering those few of us that still played is a bad look.

The premise is great and very interesting, but the game is very laggy and inconsistent. Over the span of some three hours sitted on my bed with the app open, it tracked my movement on the bed and somehow reached the conclusion that I walked three miles total, even though I never left my room. Will give this another try in the future, but since it looks, plays (and lags) the same as during launch, I don't have a lot of hope. Quite a shame, because I really like Pokémon.

Still freezes here and there but it really depends on your connection. Overall I like it, just the freezing and 1hp gym battles that annoys me. Pretty sure it will update soon. Edit the game changed a lot since release. Still playable but lack the tracking system and communication. edit 3 very good improvements with pve and pvp. everything runs great. content isn't the best but has come a long way since release.

This game is very fun, and have been playing since day 1, but I have noticed there are a ton of bugs lately. Every time I have entered a raid, I am unable to attack, so I have to restart the game to get in again. Luckily most of the time, it picks up with the raid pass I used. But sometimes it just uses the pass, and then cancels the raid entirely. This bug is just making things much more difficult to play the game lately. Please just take the time to fix the bugs before releasing new things...

I like it, but it could use more details or options, like choosing which moves your pokemon will learn, or having a pokemon pop up in places appropriate for them, like Magicarp being near water (I got mine in the middle of a highway!). The tracking system still doesn't really work for me, but I do play it. It is entertaining. Tracking is better now, thank you!

I really hate that I have reinstall the app so often for it to work, it often logs me out and insists that I'm using the wrong login info which is never actually the case. And when a few days pass and it finally allows me to log in, it resets all my settings, including showing the tutorials again, and I have to change everything back to the way I had it. But other than that it's entertaining enough, when I feel like dealing with all the bugs and glitches.

Started playing again after 2 years. Really happy with the new pokemon and that the same ones weren't popping up as constantly as before. Major issue is how often I see "Network Error (2)" pop up during battling at gyms. It's so frustrating to be so close to winning then all of sudden see that the game has stopped working or is glitching so badly that I have to restart it every 30 seconds If u could please fix this, I'll give 5 stars bc other than not earning enough coins and not being able to discard eggs, this is such an amazing game that I will continue to play and purchase from.
Best experience for a maps tips of game especially for Pokémon. Huge hit once again!

I love the game itself, but there are too many issues with the servers crashing and the game freezing up. I've paid for 800 poke balls already and a good bit of those I lost while trying to catch pokemon and the game freezing after I had caught them. The game doesn't record 3/4 of my movement when trying to hatch eggs. I've mysteriously had eggs dissappear. If these issues get fixed I will give a higher rating.

Hard to get into since the real gameplay happens level 35+. Even then, the chances of being involved with anybody besides your akward self walking in public spaces is just not worth it. Every gameplay element is tied to some form of microtransaction, so that sucks some fun out of it too. Best played naive with no real purpose than an excuse for something else, and not as a game. TRNR Tips is a great example, as he uses it to vlog, other people for photography, etc. Check it out if you want.

The game itself is amazing. The developers work on it and update the app frequently, adding more fun content. However one of the main components of the game needs a lot of work: the GPS aspect. As a game that relies heavily on that, the GPS function should work as flawlessly as possible, which is clearly not the case. Please improve the GPS function. Whenever I close the app (but it still runs in the background) and I re-open it, nothing loads anymore and I have to completely restart the app.

Decided to stop playing again after the price of remote raid passes increased. The updates make the game less fun to play, while they try to get more money out of players. They already mine location data (with the option to do so when the game is closed), yet they still want to make free-to-play more difficult.

Update: downgraded to only one star. I made in-app purchases and they never showed up in the game. I've been trying to contact an actual person about it but I've been run around in circles. I've lost money on this and it's very frustrating. ----Love it when it works. But it freezes up frequently. Especially when it looks like I've captured one, but then the ball just sits there and I have to exit out to restart. Now, with the most recent update, I can't even log on. Please fix.

Great game overall. But the issues do present a significant problem. The problems I have are typically with balancing with bosses. They seem to have boosted damage output and defense that cannot be acquired by the player, or at least you have to spend money to get there without devoting your life to the game. It also seems that typing does little to nothing. I can use something that has double type advantage and still lose against something that would lose in any other situation.It gets old fast

While the game functions fine, Niantic has made several changes for the worse. Reducing the amount of coins a player can earn in a day by half, while raising prices of the bundles and individual items (even though inflation in a digital world is a crazy way to add to the immersion). I'll still log in and hunt for shinies, but as far as a fun way to pass any time- there are many more engaging options that aren't actively trying to squeeze the increasingly weaker dollars out of us.

Started to play again and it can be quite addictive! I can see why it does get people to go out to walk&explore more. The only issue I have been encountering is that suddenly the app doesn't allow me to login. I tried closing the app & restarting and clearing my cache out.. The only temporary solution I've found is deleting the app and reinstalling.. but it will bound to happen again at some point.. :/

Had to reinstall the game, you would think that in this the age of technology you could work out all the bugs in your programs. Still having issues, my character runs around even when I'm not moving (sitting at my house) this makes me lose battles and pokemon. This is the 4th time I've had to reinstall the game. I used to like to play but not it's not worth it. (10/15/19) Still not working right.

This is a game full of bugs. In the battle league, i am already taking damage, before the timer even gets to zero. I could have flawless reception. In a battle where timing is everything, how can you win, if you're taking damage, before you even start. I contacted help and they blame you and your device. I have no other issues in other games. Also, it shows you have a pending gift, when you dont. It shows you have a new task, when you dont. I will not be a paying player, until its resolved.

Will change once all the bugs are fixed. Constant crashing regardless or device, freezing, pokemon location glitches. And these only occur if you can actually get into the game. Been down all morning with no reasoning, no "We are working on the issue" or anything. Add another potato to your servers. When it DOES run, and runs well, it is a rather enjoyable and addicting game. EDIT: They fixed many issues, and its still pretty fun

Love this game so much. But I will not play PvP again until the bug issue is fixed. I've lost several games because of random crashes during charged attacks. Cost me plenty of wins and elo rating points. There's no way to refund the points or anything and that's ok but please fix this. I see it's been an issue for a while now, based on other reviews. Otherwise have really enjoyed this game!

The game is interesting and could be addictive if it didn't freeze regularly and drain the battery so quick. The animations get boring quickly, last too long and have no opt out. The GPS integration is not correctly lined up with the real world, so the mapping is a dud. When they fix all the problems this will be an awesome healthy game to play, until then...

I loved this. I played it with my mother in law for years! I had to move due to a natural disaster, and now live in a more rural area without pokestops and no car to drive. I was so hopeful about leveling up to 37 so I could request a pokestop on a nearby nature trail. I waited months and gave up eventually. Now, I can barely even play with so many changes, including the remote raids. This is impossible to play unless you live in a city directly. Sadly, we both are just going to call it quits.

Game doesn't even open anymore. When it did, it would just crash within 5 minutes of use when I last had it installed a while back. Decided to try again, so I reinstalled today, and it will not open. It goes to the loading screen, then black. Will probably not try again after reading the recent reviews on prices doubling and crashing that is happening to others anyways.

I enjoy this app. My husband and I play together. However at least once a week, sometimes more depending how much that week we play, my account crashes. It won't allow me to log in, it will say failed to log in and allow me to retry. I have clicked sign out, then sign back in, unable to authenticate. I have deleted the app and downloaded it again, same message. If I wait a little while, like 30 minutes to an hour, it will let me get back in like nothing ever happen.

It's a great game, and I've loved it for years. But again, I've just had to uninstall it due to the ridiculous battery consumption. My phone normally lasts 2 days but with Pokémon GO installed, its lasting 8 hours or so. Pretty sure it's the live GPS it constantly uses but I couldn't find any settings for this within the app. If you can stop the application using the phone's resources whilst closed, I'd happily download again.

Game is great when it works, and runs smoothly. Gets easily overworked and begins to bug out. Summers been none stop for outings, and raids, can't complain. Only complaints being every time I need an update (Which is becoming very often now) I can't update straightaway, always an error. I have to delete my whole app, redownload and start over again. Please fix this!

The game itself is ok as a walking companion app to encourage you to get out there. It is fun collecting the different Pokémon. To play it effectively, you all but have to use third party chat services to find and coordinate raids. Lately, they've been pushing premium content really hard and it is off-putting. With the latest patch, they want GPS data turned on all the time. I can't think of any good reason I should provide so much private data and feel like that crosses the line.

I used to love this game, recently reinstalled it a couple weeks back as I had enough storage space. Been really enjoying it (minus the OP bosses, that are just there to consume all my items). However, as of past 24 hours I was logged out and unable to log back in. I uninstalled and reinstalled it several times, as well as following the instructions on the support online. But nothing has fixed it. Incredibly annoying as I want to play this game but can't. Not to mention I've wasted money on it.

The addition of trainer battles could've been awesome, but it's just an activity I'll engage in maybe once or twice assuming there's someone wandering around that I can bother, scan their phone, then finally start a battle. I was expecting to be able to do this through servers and to have a reason to use this game while at home. My level of interaction with this game continues to dwindle and no I don't have any super friends I can battle anywhere in the world.

I love this game. I've been playing basically since release day, off and on, and I love it entirely. However the most recent update on the 16th or 17th has pretty much destroyed the ability to play it. I've never had lag with previous updates but I do now, and its made catching and battling pretty much a hit and miss type issue. Honestly likely to avoid the game till its fixed. EDIT: Curveballs have also been totally and utterly ruined by this update.

Suggestion:  In-game Appraisal should have option for Simple and Advanced. Simple being verbal interpretation only (as it is now) and Advanced being numerical data for exact interpretation. I don't want to interpret what "decent", "strong", etc means. I want exact numerical figures for the 3 IVs :)  Overall, awesome game! Battle should be improved, but I know you already know that.

Lost all progress with phone change even though I had set up an account. I had eggs incubating and quite a large number of captured creatures and lots of other stuff. All gone. Their system didn't recognize my account and it all disappeared...yes... I transferred the account over to the new phone. It was enough to make me stop playing. My rating was generous...should have given it a 1.

Good game. If you like going on hikes, road trips, stuff like that, I highly recommend this game. This game can be highly Intertained through out all ages. One big complaint, there is always so much pokestops in New York, California, etc. But there is never any where I live. Doesn't mean that the game can be boring, but it's just so upsetting.

After 3 years I would've hoped for some sort of improvement with the stability of this app. 2 to 3 times a day it logs me out, and I have to force stop the app to allow me to log back in. Every time I log back in I have to re-enable adventure sync. It's incredibly frustrating when I've been walking all day to find that none of my distance was recorded to hatch eggs.

The addition of periodic events has been a welcoming surprise, and while I haven't tried gym battles recently I have to say that automatically adjusting to the challenge is exactly what I asked for. Oh yeah, and I busted my first Ditto fairly recently. GPS drift adjustments are going to flat out suck for some, but for the sake of accuracy I personally don't even give a damn. UPDATE AS OF 2018 4 11: I think my access on LGV20 may have busted with the Google Fit update, if not before. I am getting "unsupported" when it worked before and I don't do root either (the obvious source of most false positive detections under the compatibility rules) which annoyed me during shift just trying to set and forget which is another bad idea to itself.

They are fixing most of the really broken parts of this game. I can respect that. Edit: 08/28/19 I'm updating this review as it has been a couple years. A lot of the things that made this game frustrating have been resolved. The addition of trades, battling and quests really turned the experience around for me. I am enjoying it immensely now and would recommend it to anyone. Its great when you are out and about and to go out specifically to play.

every so often I get signed out of my account and I cant sign back in. its gives me an error message saying unable to authenticate, my username and password hasn't changed either so I dont know what the problem is. this needs to be fixed. it happens too often (EDIT) It's been way over a week now since I emailed support regarding the trouble I've been experiencing, and I still haven't heard anything back. I'm so disappointed so I'm switching from 3 to 1 star rating. I'd give it a 0 if I could.

With all notifications turned off, it still pushes notifications unless you block them from Android directly. Even with AR turned off, the new update forces you into AR mode. The "buddy" icon overlaps your player icon and makes it harder to click it. Don't care for the buddy system when I click it on purpose, absolutely hate it after it keeps getting in the way. "AR turned off" means I don't want it, no matter how cool you think it is. I'd rather avoid the whole thing. So I'm deleting it.

Great game brings me back to when the first games came out. Does need some work. Servers crashing constantly is a little irritating especially when it happens as your using a lucky egg. Game does constantly freeze up and needs to be restarted. Overall though a fun game. Will update the rating when i feel comfortable that the current issues are fixed. Would also like to see trading amongst other trainers come up too. And as an added bonus maybe adding a smart watch feature would be awesome.

From first playing in 2018 and before pandemic seem to be the best times I've had on the app. Since then it's become a clear cash grab with microtransations almost becoming a necessity if you want to be a part of the community, especially if you live in a remote area. I want to keep using the app but the item limitations, item prices and daily coin limits are just not matching up and it's becoming a slog to play instead of fun anymore. Disappointed and frustrated at what used to be a good time.

Pokemon Go is an amazing app for all kinds of people from the outdoorsy to die hard fans of the series to those like myself using it as a tool to overcome anxiety and go outdoors more. I rate it 4/5 because it can be difficult to play without mobile data or unlimited WiFi (lagging, freezing, slow loadtimes, repeated errors make a few common annoyances) as well as the amount of storage space needed and difficulties downloading updates. Fully recommend to all, though be aware of above limitations.

First of all the game is fun when it works. However, that seems to be less and less the case. With the updates, the old server problems are back, and the game also crashes a lot more, making it nearly unplayable on slightly older devices. Half the time you are fighting some kind of technical issue, which really gets old quickly. And now they have stopped refunding coins if you have technical issues, which is just ridiculous. Avoid until they fix this. Update: they did not, today they were found lying again, and they will do nothing about it.

The game is just perfect! But it would have been better if it came with option to use it either with a joy stick or normal movement. I can't move here and there all the time to play this game. So, if you can, provide an inbuilt joy stick for movements and after it, providing bikes for fast travelling would be great which we would control with the given joystick. Try it and believe me this wonderful game would get millions of more users.

The game started off with plenty of potential for greatness, just as long as the servers were fixed along with a few small bugs. Within probably a week, the main element of the game (a tracker for actually being able to find the pokemon) was broken. Now another two weeks on, instead of fixing it, they remove it completely and take down any third party sites which were around to fix the issue of the tracker not working. Not worth playing without a tracker!

The game is fun but it takes incredibly long to load compared to any other app, and it frequently has bugs and crashes at least 1-2x daily. My latest bug discovery is that recently, it hasn't been counting my steps towards in-game distance which is incredibly frustrating. If you can live with the technical difficulties the game is fun.

This game is awesome if you need an excuse to go outside or struggle with that due to mental health problems. I do have problems with the purchasing items with real money though. Once I try to purchase something, it always fails and the item I tried to purchase will always disappear forever. Purchasing items is optional though, which is a relief. The occasional shiny Pokemon are always exiting, even if it's a duplicate Starly.

Its a great game. I love going around and seeing different types of pokemon, however, it seems it can only be played when you have wifi which makes it harder for me to hatch eggs. It would be great if they could make the game offline as well. It is a great game nonetheless. Edit: Every time it updates it always refuses to update on my phone. And everytime I delete it to reinstall after, it never wants to download.

Love the game, but it crashes too much. I lost several pokeballs due to bugs. The razz berry only makes it more difficult, curving the ball by itself, making you lose a bunch. The great ball isn't any better than regular pokeball. Server issues happens more often than I play it. New issue, can't play at all. Installed it and reinstalled it twice, the game doesn't work!v u

The game has definitely improved since it's launch. Compared to what it was then, the game is fantastic. But of course, there's still problems. Like remote raid passes for example. There's no reliable way to get a group together without a third party app or some sort of group chat. If you try to do it without one you or one of your group might end up completely wasting one.

Updating my review since I last left one in 2016 when the game was beta. Poke go is still really fun and holds up. My biggest issue is that it's resource heavy, so if you don't have a recent model phone it will be slow. I don't like that you're constantly fighting for inventory and pokemon space, and that it's locked behind a slightly advanced pay wall. Overall, it's fun if you're near a big town or city where there are plenty of people to battle gyms with.

Update: The focus on battling and the increased prices for some of the more fun aspects like remote raiding so I could play with friends in other states/countries means I almost never play anymore. Original: Even with the server issues this is a great game. Obviously no one could have planned for just how insanely popular this would be. It's an honest free to play that doesn't limit you if you don't spend real money and let's you fast track if you do. A great and fun app!

I used to love this game but the recent changes have made me change my rating from 4 Star to 1 star. I hate that the distance has reverted back for gyms and stops. I can no longer reach most of the ones near me without doing a 3 mile hike along a trail. I'm handicapped so it has made it impossible to access my neighborhood gyms. I used to be able to reach them from the nearby road. So bummed. Been playing since shortly after it came out. Might be time to find a new past time. Booo!

I have always liked this game. It's fun and can help when you are bored somewhere. But recently, Niantic has decided to increase prices on remote raid passes in an attempt to cash in instead of bringing players back. What a horrible decision that no one asked for or likes. As of now, I suggest everyone turns off adventure sync and if this will go through and not be changed, I will uninstall the game.

The changes introduced in the pandemic made the game better, and now not only have they rolled back in many of those changes, but their making the game less accessible by increasing the cost of remote raids and limiting them. As someone who has time constraints due to life and obligations, the remote passes made it possible for me to raid. I for one am going to be quiting the game, enough is enough, Niantic has ruined a good thing.

What you did with the romote passes is beyond stupid. It was nice to have the option to remote or go in person. I would highly suggest you drop the price on the pass back to what they where and get rid of the limit. I understand this was not how you intended the game to be played but having the remote options added so much more to the game and I was able to start playing again more regularly. I an very disappointed.

Got locked out after two years of playing, at level 35. I only received basic and generic help to resolve, clear this, reload that, with no resolve. My account will not athendicate. All my other games work just fine, nothing else has changed. I have wasted way too much time trying to fix and not being able to play. :-/ Had to buy a new phone to play again. Other then that I love the game. So a craptastic IT department doesn't mean a bad game, just bad help. It has gotten better.

Edit: Changed the overall rating b/c with the 2/22/19 update the app is no longer compatable with my less than 10 yr old phone. I'm not buying a new phone just to play a mobile game. It gets me out and exercising so that's a plus. The only thing that's annoying is the location services tend to go buggy if it's not perfectly clear out (sometimes even then).

extremely beautiful game with pokemon, smooth animation and whatnot, plus a great time killer but there's an issue; lag, it's not an issue for other people I know on other devices, but it lags my phone with how much space it takes up, otherwise? It's great, I just can't have lots of other apps with it and free space. Very likely just my device and not an issue on the games side, but nonetheless still pheonomnal gameplay.

This is my favorite video game by far! Although, Pokemon Go fest 2021 was a huge disappointment! The one complaint I have is that when you have to update in order to play, it takes up SO much memory! The game crashes if you try to move it to external storage. I just started uninstalling and reinstalling everytime it needs an update and it works! Hope this trick helps fellow trainers! 😊

It's a lot better than it was, but there is still 0 consideration for rural players. If you don't live near a city center, you'll have a pretty boring time, and the raid boss feature will be more or less unplayable. Other than that, it's fun and a great way to get me out and exercising. New features are more regular now and are by and large pretty useful, it's like the developers actually care about the playerbase after 2 years of neglect. If this game now was the release version 2 years ago, it would be astonishing.

A fun game however, every time I try to log in, it says unable to authenticate, and I'll have to change my password. Itll work, then the next day, same thing, and I'll have to change it again. I've changed it so many times now, this needs to be fixed. I always type in my pass right but it keeps happening, please fix! Also, it also shows gps error 11 quite a lot, even when I'm somewhere with excellent connection..

PoGo has continued to improve and add some QoL features, gameplay, and social function, which help make it fun. It still sucks that if you pay for items you also have to pay for space to hold them, but they've opted for money over usability here. More automated/configurable features to manage pokes and inventory would be great, but they won't add them because they want you buying more storage! I look forward to upcoming social features.

The game is going downhill. I used to love it but I hate how it keeps becoming more and more expensive and lags more often. I keep getting stuck on the loading screen of death and have to continuously reboot the game in order to get past it. Now they are announcing that remote raid passes are nearly doubling in price and they're going to limit how many we can do per day. Remote raids are how I can play with my friends as many of us are in different states. It was one of the best game aspects.

You know honesty, I have been playing this game for several years, but I've had to make new accounts because of had to change phones and emails. What I have noticed about the most recent version, is that I have to update it every 2 days and it still has bugs, defects and glitches. There's been several times so many that I don't even want to try to count, then my game is either frozen in the middle of a important battle of raid, or have lost out on items, prizes or daily event rewards.

Current review: Fun and improved so much. Play it with my son and we have very little issues with bugs etc. It is a good way to pass time =) 2016 review: A pointless game without tracking system, internal or 3rd party otherwise. Now nice, great and excellent throws don't even give extra exp..? Horrendous way to update a game without advance notice and also terrible gym system.

Fantastical magical experience. Really enjoy this game but recently the game has been randomly canceling out and going to my home screen while in the middle of a battle. Getting really bad now cuts out half way through battles, also freezes in raids and shadow stops. Update still having clitches have had to delete game and re download it again about 5 times now. Getting really sick of the game which is a shame because I have invested quite a bit of money and time, going to delete soon for good.

Really enjoy this game and have for 6 years. But as of the 6th of April, the game will not be played often or is uninstalled. Mainly due to a price increase that is almost double on selected instore items (remote passes), also limiting remote raids I feel is a step back. The game has changed since covid and niantic needs to embrace it, not change it. But I suppose making you get out and walk makes them money as they do sell the data collected. What's more important? Definitely not the user!

I only have trouble with the routes: they are not completed because I'm "missing meters" or something like that. But to me, it's the first game I ever got addicted to. The different approaches allow you to choose your goals (wether it's tasks, gyms, Pokédex, medals, battling, perfect-iv-pokemons, coins, shinies!) so it's never boring because there's always something you can pursue.

Been playing since March 2019, and loved it for giving me an incentive to go out and explore my city, but since the last update in this last December, the game crashes every 15 minutes. Really frustrating, considering it's one of the largest programs on my phone (almost a gigabyte!). Might actually uninstall if Niantic doesn't actually fix it.

App is stuck in a crash. Clearing data or reinstall does not fix it. Seems to only happen randomly. Without changing anything I go from crashing in a loop, back to no problems. Edit: No more crashing, but I haven't been able to login for weeks. Login details are known to be correct. Still can't sign in after having reset my password a couple times, nothing seems to work.

The raids would be a saving grace for a slowly dying game, but they bug out nearly every chance. Just finished one with 5 seconds to spare, and it timed us all out. Not to mention every time you do one, the first 10 seconds or so are wasted on the loading 'Go' screen, even on the best phones/networks. Just sad that they are a year into this and still have the same issues. I stand by this.

Been playing since release. A fun way to kill time when walking or taking transit...when it works. Unable to launch/log in more often than I can, which constantly kills my streaks. It never fails to pester me with notifications even though it won't let me play, though! Bought a Pokéball Plus on Boxing Day and haven't been able to try it yet.

Fun game to meet up with people and socialize. Even though it is a fun game, there are still many issues. I have wasted so much incense only to experience server issues. Game freezes constantly. Won't let me attack gyms. The battle style is also very shallow. It would be great to see it change to something like the handheld games. Very disappointed they removed the distance counter rather then fix it.

I used to play quite religiously before COVID, and the changes Niantic made to make the game accessible while ensuring players stayed safe during the pandemic were an excellent and welcoming addition to the game. Now, with their reversal of these changes, I can no longer play and remain safe. With my own health issues, on top of the pandemic steadily getting worse again, the game is inaccessible to me and many others. I used to love this game, I really did.

Sometimes or maybe all the times on low end devices it glitches but I like the concept and it is awesome. I have an S8+ and it's fine. I have so many Pokemon and it's really fun. The bag system and pokemon storage system could be changed though... why do i have to pay to get more item slots?! a lot of my previous concerns are now resolved and its a solid game, especially since now they added adventure sync which doesnt need data or gps!! thats useful for a lot of ppl w/o unlimited data.

The game is constantly getting better. Not fast, but constantly. It is still a bit of a grind, but with access to more Pokemon's, more gyms, more events, more everything, and the Adventure Sync feature to compensate for the app's crappy GPS, I have fun again. Having a Go Plus accessory also makes a large difference in quality of life, fun and access to more 'mons and options.

Broken game (again) For 2 weeks now i can't battle more than once before having to restart the game entirely. If I attempt another consecutive fight (like taking a gym) the splash screen bugs out with null values and then freezes in the arena sequence. No way around a force restart. Same issue happens when sending gifts. I can't send/receive more than 1 gift at a time or else the same freeze occurs. It's such a hassle and niantic seemingly doesn't care.

This game was supposed to be fun. Its gotten too hard and recently, very, very glitchy. Why are the raids impossible to beat without other players? The Rocket leaders are way too hard and I avoid them. I have a million quests and some are one time events so I know that I'm not going to finish them. And now, everything is laggy and I keep getting stuck on various screens, have to exit the app repeatedly and start over if I feel like it.

Decent experience for the most part however this weekend I entered approximately 4 raids got greeted with the black screen of death and was not able to participate or rejoin despite several attempts. I'd at least like to have my passes back for the inconvenience. Also I have not been getting 3 candies for trades exceeding the distance requirement for almost 2 months now. Not sure how you can rectify that one. Finally with this last update my game freezes as soon as it loads and multiple restarts

It keeps getting further and further from what we actually want. We know the battle system sucks. We all want it to be what the games are like. They've never fixed a single major problem that people have had and they keep adding more features no one asks for. all the events are locked to bigger places so you can't get what you want unless you live in a super city. There's no accessibility and they don't care if you have trouble playing it.

It is a fun game to play casually with friends and collect pokemon as if they are stickers, but if you like a more complex game that values the battling aspect of it and your connection with you pokemon, just stick to the games from the original franchise. I have played the game since it's beginning, with a few pauses. It was a simple but fun game. However, in the past few months the developers took a hard turn on the cash grabbing aspect of it. The only new mechanics are thought out with the specific purpose of taking money from you, bugs are endless and they do not bother to solve them (unless it gets in the way of them getting more money, of course). Another point that bothered me is that they have no late game content. A person who has been playing for 4 years will be able to accomplish the same as someone who has been in the game for a month, and that aspect got worse now with them making the pvp system a "participate and win", instead of having to actually be good at it to get to higher ranks.

Nice to play, except when it either randomly closes, randomly freezes, or randomly decides to reboot my phone, not to mention the heaps of bugs that have been here since launch. You'd think two years and millions in sales would be enough for a software company to fix their bugs, but I guess making a game properly is too much to ask. Everyone I know who're playing this have the same issues as me, so it's not an isolated case. Also, with all the millions in sales, you'd expect the servers to be somewhat decent, but no. Somehow they still haven't set up servers that can handle the amount of traffic from 10 million users, even though they have a concrete number of the peak amount of users to expect. TL;DR: Thanks Niantic, you've made a game with barely any gameplay and loads of bugs and performance issues that you haven't been able to fix after two years. EDIT: Also, why is the cheapest coin pack also the cheapest per coin? None of your actions make sense Niantic!

The original idea of the game still works. However, the amount of popups and long transitions zooming in and out of pokestops, gyms, etc. has made the game almost unenjoyable. There needs to be a way to stop seeing so many screens telling you about gifts, etc, and also a way to turn off the transitions that do nothing but waste time and battery life.

App keeps freezing... if it launches in the first place. Constantly getting stuck halfway up the loading bar on launch. Have to force quit and restart. A lot of times that works. Sometimes I can do that 20 times and never get it to work. Then when it does load, I get freezes all the time where everything just stops working and I have to force quit.

This game is still great. It got everyone in my family active. I've been playing it since it came out, and am surprised to see how far it's come. The one issue I have with it though is how glitchy it is when it comes to trying to load up gym stops and the rocket stops. Sometimes the camera will just freeze in place, forcing you to restart the app. Other times, it forces you back into the main part of the gyn when you're just trying to spin the stop.

Mostly every 90's kid dream come true to become a Pokémon master! It's very addicting! Edit: after using it since it's first day of release, it's hard to keep going when everything costs money and at a ridiculous price. You'd think they'd have more options on character features, certain features available years ago, etc. I don't blame people for spoofing or stop playing the game. Don't recommend it to anyone, save your time and money.

Update: It's much improved over the years. It still hijacks your audio. So if you're listening to something else and start the game, that audio will stop or you will lose control. In addition, the Niantic login is hit or miss. Original: It's a buggy piece of software. It hijacks your phone and turns off your music or podcasts. Crashes all the time. It could be great and who doesn't love Pokemon? Your love for Pokemon will tested because of this game.

Used to be a great game; I've been playing since July 2016. Now it freezes randomly while playing, often more than once per session, and is necessary to restart to continue. It lags a lot. And with the reduction in remote raids plus the huge price increase for remote raid passes that can only be acquired by buying them, I am already looking for a new game to play.

I don't know how to contact support but since the recent update when a Pokémon appears my screen goes to black. my phone is newer and the update was on the 2nd and I updated my game yesterday so I'm guessing it's most likelythe update. ....please fix this

Potential, but not quite there. At first, it was very very buggy. Customer service was (is?) non-existent. Today, it's ok and I do enjoy playing from time to time. Problems with it are more of its technological choises. Before the adventure sync just wasn't working. Now it seems to be working, but it drains your phones battery very quickly. One app with background use with 6% battery in under 1,5h is not acceptable.

The game is good enough a bit pay to win of late, but I'd love to be able to get rid of stickers, I appreciate they don't take up space in the bag that doesn't mean I want to keep all of them though. I think it would be cool to offer a suggestion box. Also would have loved for that level 40 medal to have been not limited time, especially since covid restrictions have limited a number players ability to play.

this game is a waste of time and money, even if you are a die-hard pokemon fan. this company does not care at all about their player base, they care about tracking and selling your location data. i have played for 8 years, hoping it would get to a point where it was enjoyable. instead, it is paywalled, laggy, unrewarding and simply just a joke of a pokemon game.

This game has come a long way. Originally I had given a 2 star review due to lack of battling, moves, TMs etc. But finally after 5 years I can comfortably give this game a 4 star. I feel there is still room for improvement and there always seems to be lag when it comes to battling. Possibly a server issue because my internet provider and service are really good.

This could be great, and aside from server issues it was, on launch. But since then the developer has seemingly been removing key gameplay features from the game, such as tracking via distance. If Niantic bring tracking back I might have reason again to head outside specifically to play, but as it stands this is now something I just peer at from my desk, as I've no hopes of finding anything deliberately. Edit: well, it now has a feature it should have had since launch; you now don't need the app open and active to track walking.

I like the game, this review is for the app functionality. It keeps failing to connect to servers. I have to force stop the app, login and sometimes reboot the phone. Why can't it remeber the last choice in settings for music and sounds? I have to turn them off every time the app crashes and I have to re-login. Which is all the time. I feel like I'm back in 90s with dial up and windows 98 setup.

The game is great - I hate the update process. As an example, I just finished a job 30 miles from home. Want to check out pokestops and gyms in this local area. However, out of the blue, the game requires an update. It doesn't give the option to postpone it until I get back home and can download using Wi-Fi connection, I have to update using a 3-g connection using limited cellular data allocation if I want to do anything here. Niantic should either place a notification that an update is ava

Those with the inattentive type of ADHD or otherwise wandering minds who have trouble staying aware of their surroundings are advised not to play this game. Maybe if the game was completely augmented reality, it might be safer in a way, but the AR battle mode makes the game more difficult and not really much more fun enough to make up for the increase in difficulty. Using AR maybe needs to be rewarded better since it's more challenging.

The game is substantially more stable, and more enjoyable to play than it was in 2016 when I first joined. I've enjoyed exploring, and raiding with my family more. I've updated my review to 4 stars from 1. Still some glitches with my avatar running off all over the map, but it helps with getting buddy candies so not really a complaint there. Except when it pulls me out of a raid. That sucks, and needs a definite fix.

I play the game in full screen, and I am unable to access the text input box when I am trying to change names or add friends. Please fix! This works a lot better on iPhone. The app is due for a much needed UI update! I can't believe it has been 2 years already and these features haven't been added. Having your buddy follow you on the map would be awesome. In game chat similar to Ingress' would be cool, and I believe it is one of the biggest things missing from this game. Another big thing the game is lacking is a Pokémon-Amie type interaction with our Pokémon.

Right now. I can't give it a good review. But if the problems the game is having gets fixed. I will change it. I spent an hour trying to name my character because it couldn't load the name screen. Crashed once while picking a character and froze trying to catch my first Pokemon. I know its new. But shouldn't these issues been ironed out before release? Or with more servers then needed? So its a fun successful launch with very little problems?

This is the sort of thing I've wanted since I was a small child. Going out to catch them all and meeting up with like minded people, everyone just coming together and catching them all. Four years later the hype has died down, the game seems to be declining in some aspects but getting better in others. Battling is gradually improving, however the game has an issue with accessibility overall now that the player population is smaller. Ex: High level raiding is impossible without a regular group.

Uninstalling after 3 years of re-installing. I just noticed pay walled events getting more frequent and expensive as time goes by. Missing the simple times when PoGo just launched. Also, as new features get introduced, the interface gets a bit too laggy. Too many going on, I guess. So, yeah. I imagine the game's gonna be heavily pay walled in just a few years. But it was fun 'til it lasted.

Still waiting for the newer gens to be added. It's taking foreverrrrr and I think that's really stupid. It shouldn't be that hard to add the newer gens into the game. Sometimes the app also crashes or freezes up or otherwise glitches. however, it's still a fun game and the addition of trading and adding friends etc are definitely helping this game stay afloat

So much potential, so poorly executed. The game really feels like a money grab, especially for suburban and rural players. The lack of communication from the developer and mystery behind some basic gameplay mechanics are ridiculous.
