Edit, 2020: Well I took a few years off of the game but decided to redownload it after some friends said it had been improved. Generally all my earlier complaints have been addressed. If the app was faster/more responsive it would be closer to 5-stars.

Eats battery, RAM, and CPU. I installed the game when it first came out in the US, and it was great fun then, despite the battery drain. Over time, I've played it less and less. I have a somewhat older phone, but it wasn't a problem when the game first came out. More recently, though, trying to play has been more trouble than it's worth. It just lags, freezes, and crashes. Especially recently, I usually spend upwards of 20min trying to connect to the servers. It took over half an hour today. I get constant errors and connection issues. It doesn't matter how the signal looks - I've spent half an hour connecting with 4/5 bars and strong, fast WiFi. I can't do raids; I can barely catch Pokemon. I frequently wait 10 or more minutes at a stop for the lag to catch up, hoping the GPS hasn't wandered me away from the stop. I really wish the game was still playable, and I still try to play it despite the issues, but it's just painful. Turning off music and sound effects seems to help with the extreme lag a bit, but settings reset all the time, particularly after updates or login issues. I really should give it fewer stars but it's fun when it works, and I wish I could enjoy it again.

I'm very annoyed and disappointed that Adventure Tracker fails to work. I've tried everything: Having the game open in the background, having it closed, having the game closed with the fitness tracker on. I walk more than four kilometers a day and those kilometers add up in achieving my goals, but if I'm still stuck at the point where I have to have the game open, I would at least like to know.

I really enjoy this game! I've been playing it for nearly two years now. .. (as hard to believe that is! ;)) but! ! Recently, the game has been requiring more and more updates to continue game play. It was fine the first time, and even the second. ..but, it's been several in just the past few months. The isn't even an option to bypass the update and continue play on an "older" version. If the update problem I continue to have -> -> -> by that I mean that the play store will not start

Playing is great, fun, and all, but when you have to drive significant distances for stops, its not fair to those of who don't live in the city. Has greatly improved (adding a star from my last review) but still get several crash notifications throughout the day. Would love an option to save power and time by limiting the graphics.

*update* 13/09 after around 4 years of playing ive decided to take a break. The game is weighted so heavily around raids now that the only way to keep up is to spend cash on passes. Ive lost the love for playing. Niantic if you read this please think about putting in more challenges or story mode types quests that allow you unlock more passes. Its insane how much you have to spend to keep up! Not good in the current climate (Covid-19)

Love the game for the most part, can't get enough. Only down side is when there isn't an event of some kind going on, it gets kinda boring. Community days have been nice and are something to look forward too. Niantic really stepped it up in 2018 with events and made this game awesome! The reason for 3 stars is the gym system is horrible. It's been out for over 2 years and needs reworked. So many glitches and problems which some have been here since the beginning.

Really good game, but... I've been experiencing a lot of issues when it comes to network changes. Whether it is because of my phone losing connection because of bad signal or sometimes just connecting to a WiFi network, the game stops recognizing my account; even after trying to log in again it just won't work. I have to uninstall and reinstall it again every time this happens (about twice a week) Please fix this as soon as possible, it's kind of annoying.

This is a great AR game and a good challenging activity for a group of like minded friends. I would have kept my rating at 5, but for almost a year now I've watched as my game gets needlessly stuck at 75% loading in title screen Every. Single. Day. It will usually take about 4 force quits and reopen to get the app finally running. It's shameful that this is a known issue and for so long. Definitely should be addressed by now.

That first summer was amazing. The more they added though, the more issues and bugs have come up. With the changes to the TOS in regards to their mistakes during events and the inability to get refunds when that happens and making harder for rural and people with disabilities to play the game, I don't recommend it. If you aren't into the PVP aspects of the game it has little to offer anymore as that's what everything is geared toward now.

Love the game but today's update has broken it. The battle mode just doesn't work. At all. And if I manage to finally get into a battle my Pokémon just sits there unresponsive and dying. I've reinstalled and cleared cache still it doesn't work. It's not quite juddery. Constant freezing and crashing. It's suddenly unplayable at the moment. Note 9 with all latest updates.

I got it, and I've had enough play time to actually enjoy it for a bit. But it REALLY needs work, it can be unresponsive, often glitches while catching pokemon, resulting in a restart, LEGENDARY battery drain (e.g., 20% in 20 minutes), there isn't any battle outside of gyms, GPS recognition is unreliable. If it's entirely rebuilt, it could be great. For now, sadly, I'mma pass... Still.

It's ok. Game could be better. The new adventure play is terrible. It doesnt work at all. I've even kept the game open and walked with it and it doesn't work. In fact, this game doesn't link up with steps at all. The rewards are not great either and the tasks for some of these quests are nearly impossible unless you travel daily. Great concept and graphics, just fix the adventure play and tasks and it will be the perfect game.

I love this game, pretty much play it everyday. Gives me something to do while walking the dog, and it's fun to collect the Pokemon. However, the game has always had issues. Still having tracking issues here and there that have existed since the game was first released. GPS on my phone works seemlessly with all my other apps, so it is definitely a problem with POGO itself. They seem fairly quick to fix critical bugs, but minor errors will exist for a long time (like Pokedex errors).

Constant server issues and log in errors. Fix it and I'll give more stars. Incredibly frustrating with all the glitches and freezes. Also my pokedex constantly cycles to bulbasaur no matter what I do, and then when I try to report an error, that page freezes too. Seriously, wait on this one till they fix stuff, or you are likely to give up from frustration despite how cool it is when it actually works. edit: many bugs have been fixed, less glitchy, and poke tracking system is less frustrating.

Frustrating. But fun. When the app operates the way it should, it's great, but it seems like every time there's an update, I get kicked off, have to delete the app, reinstall it, sign back in, then play. It's really frustrating!!! When I just want to click the app and play, sometimes I find there's been an update, and I have to go through the whole process of deleting, reinstalling, signing back in etc, etc.

Too hard to figure out what you need to do, needs better guides/tutorials for first time players. Also could use a way to re-read and enlarge the text. I literally can't read it unless it's on a dark background, which is very rare. Could also do with more places to get Pokeballs. By time you get close enough to the Stop to USE it, it's already deactivated, and when not a passenger in a car, they STILL don't work.Spinning when standing still often just shows it spin but instead of prizes, errors.

Lots of crashes lately. I don't know what's going wrong lately but more often than not, I will get daily crashes and the app will get stuck on the initial load screen. Having to close it and re open to get it to work. It will also regularly crash when catching a Pokemon. I'll throw a ball, shakes say once or twice. Frozen. Did I catch it or not? It used to run fine with zero issues but these latest updates seem to have caused more harm than good. Will update my review when the game gets sorted.

Edit: After a couple years they have balanced out some the pay to win aspects of the game. They've added regular events that keep the game interesting and for the most part giveryone an equal shot. There still are some pay to win aspects that can get annoying, but are no worse than any other game. Great concept with insane potential, but is constantly moving more and more toward being a pay to win game.

The only good thing that can be said about this game is that it provides people the opportunity to "actually go out and catch Pokemon". I stuck with it despite an ill-planned launch, the removal of the lackluster tracking system, and the limited tap-based battle system. The extra behavior control with their new, "secret" speed-monitoring system is the final straw, though...I'm done with being told how I must play this half-assed game. Nintendo, Game Freak...you could have easily picked a much better partner

It's a great app to play, it's very enjoyable. The only thing is every once in a while it fails to log in an I have to uninstall and reinstall which is very irritating... update. Now that the adventure sinc is enabled it does the "failed to connect to server" more often. I'm not sure if too many people play or what, but it's annoying to have to keep uninstalling and reinstalling

It's a fun game and they've added a lot to keep things updated and fresh. But in the couple of years I've been playing, I have never not had a problem with freezing and glitching. Just downloaded an update this morning ( for "bug fixes" apparently) and the app freezes and crashes within 5 minutes of having it on. Ridiculous.

It's a good game but I still have problems with it freezing. You do need WiFi or data to play this though. I do however wish there was an offline mode so I can get my steps done without the game freezing because I don't have Internet or extra data for it to use. It makes it very hard to hatch eggs when the program constantly freezes and then doesn't want to boot back up because there's no WiFi connection. The other suggestion I have is maybe have a way to input your steps when you open the game. I'm tired of it freezing every time it has no connection.

I've been playing this game for 5 years now and it's good fun for what it does. Best location based game. It will appeal most to collectors. The PVP side of things is not fun , it turns the turn-based strategy of main series pokemon battles into a real-time quick reaction game with lots of tapping. The game design of this bit feels like something that might have come out of the megadrive/SNES era, and not in a good way. Heavy "pay to win" to get shiny legendaries. Eggs are loot crates.

Could use improvements. Curve ball throws are just odd. I'd like to see type balls implemented. I would like to grow my own berries as well. Also, while this is a 'go' game and I understand the concept, I'm not capable of all the walking necessary to even get to the nearest stop. I have to drive which lowers the 'go' aspects anyway. Even if it's a premium or subscription feature a joystick, even if it moves slow, would be infinitely helpful.

I really like the game, but the bug issues really need to be fixed. Last week when I went to claim my weekly research, I got the, "white screen of death", as I call it now. I uninstalled the game and reinstalled it, and it has been very, very laggy. Did the same 3 times afterwards and still the same. Also getting a lot of ,"error" and "network error" issues frequently. I usually have to have my wifi off in order to play the game, but those messages still pop up even with it off. It's frustrating

Played the game since 2016. There's been a lot of nice features added since then, but it almost always feels like two steps forward, one step back. Monetization has gotten terrible the past year. Items have gotten 100-200% more expensive. Parts of the game are locked behind paywalls. The UI is in desperate need of an update. Raids are still extremely buggy. You can spend $1-2, lots of time coordinating with other people, just to bug out and not be able to finish. The game is becoming anti-user

Games are supposed to be fun and enjoyable, by making Froakie impossible to catch in a timed research event has put me off this game. Other issues like region specific Pokémon... What percentage of your players can afford to travel the world.... Games are fun if a little challenging, but when they are literally impossible to complete, they are no longer fun, but instead depressing and soul destroying. :(

Passive gamer in some things. But, even more passive in this. With bugs most linked to location services in which the game is based on...and more. Also, weird known issue is when you download the game; sometimes all of the login options don't load. This will entail you to delete and reinstall the game. For both issues. Unless you're just depending on the patches. Have fun with that.. Makes me wonder if re-downloads count towards their "total downloads".

I love this game a lot. It has so much to it it's hard to get bored. I only have one nag and it's the lack of personal customization of your character. There are a LOT of outfits to choose from which is great, but I'm talking hairstyle, facial structure, physical build etc. There are a few bugs but with every game comes bugs so I'll let that slide. 4 stars only because of the lack of character customization!

As a player from the very start, I'm still very much addicted to the game and I'm satisfied with all the new features Niantic added to the game throughout its existence. As a solo player I did think the raid system was very unfair, not expecting to get any of the Legendary types for a while, but the research system that was implemented a while ago ensures that players like me can also get Legendaries now. On top of that, the large variety of research goals adds a whole new level of addiction to the game and keeps it from becoming stale after almost two years now. Still my favourite app next to the Samsung Health app.

It's a really shallow game, and the combat is buggy. Not unplayable buggy, but it is unresponsive and lagging behind the server. On the other hand though, it's an excellent Pokémon catching game. It's not a bad game but personally, I just didn't see the appeal of having to go out exploring (because of work and school life). Furthermore, it's unplayable on public transport because of speed-locking. At least in Ingress you could time it, but here you can't, and that even biking or sprinting for awhile (minute or two) can still speed-lock you.

The game is great, fun to play, lots of Pokémon to catch and so many different features. However when you get to the battle system, I have noticed that when you're trying to click your charged move it doesn't work as quickly which sometimes results the other person being able to use there ability first despite the fact that you may have clicked it first, which can be really frustrating.

After so many years of playing this, or at least attempting to, I'm done. Absolutely done. It's no longer fun. There's no reward for the total grindfest it turns into. You can have every catch bonus, all manner of berries, and the best Pokeballs, but all of that is immaterial as you will end up spending 20 ultraballs and the Pokemon will still flee. The whole point of Pokemon is to be a fun collectathon. If you can't get the "collect" aspect right, then what's the point? Catching more Pidgeys!?

Niantic has improved quite a bit since the last time I made a review. It's still hard to be a solo player, but then again, it isn't impossible to be one either! With the addition of new features (such as research missions, gifts, trades, and now trainer battles), the game has not only gotten back it's thrill of the hunt, but now gives a directional end goal. It still lags at times. There is also the non-stop messages of GO having stopped working, even though I don't see the error, but I love it.

Game doesn't crash as much as it used to. Still has a lot of bugs. Sometimes the gameplay can get exasperated when you have a low-level Pokemon constantly popping out of the ball even though you've used a raspberry and an ultra ball Update: They have address the bugs, there still is a lot of gameplay issues like everything requiring raspberries but it's hard to get them and they'll suck them up twice as much during events even though you're just trying to pick up the same type of Pokemon.

Note that there are bugs but this is new and in beta it's expected. And servers crash when so many people go on it. People don't realize that. But I see great potential in this! Keep it up and add real time player vs player! Edit 4 years later: its actually not that great anymore but its still ok. Servers still crash 4 years later pvp is repetitive. But the events are constant

I won't comment on the game itself, it is what it is. But damn the technical side is atrocious. GPS location sucks, the game fails to log in at least a few times every week (sometimes for hours and when it does log in, it resets the damn annoying music to on, seriously!). Some animations slow the phone so much it's not even possible to throw a pokeball etc etc... Forcing updates at least once a week, usually when I'm out on mobile network. Considering it's the #1 grossing app, it's garbage.

I am editing my original review from when the game first started, and bumping to three stars. Lots of improvements have been made, BUT: The raid and gym UIs still have several bugs - when trying to spin a gym, it just zooms back out to look at the team. Pokemon appear that aren't really there. AR mode just doesn't work on my phone. Still lags. Pokemon randomly disappear and respawn a few seconds later. Stardust and coin systems need tweaking badly. Not unplayable anymore, but still annoying.

It was fun back in '16 because it was new. It was fun in '20 because they finally made changes that improved the game overall. Instead of keeping the improvements that made the game enjoyable over the past year (their biggest in terms of revenue and downloads,) they reverted back to the model that's been losing players until the pandemic hit. What a backwards decision! Uninstalling once again.

Love this game and the continuous new events. It does a great job keeping me interested and getting me active. I've been outdoors a lot more in the last two months since being back on this game. Two issues: battery drain is better than three years ago but could be better; there are still glitches, especially annoying after I've caught something and the game freezes. I'm also very unhappy there's no customer service, for a game that people do pay money and spend a ton of money on!

With the recent changes and updates the game is not practical to play. Especially for a person with disabilities, lives in more remote areas, and for those who simply don't have the ability to be close to stops and gyms. If the update could be reversed, the game would be great. Please keep the pandemic changes. Having the remote raid pass, the increase size of stops, and gyms is what helped bring this game back to life.

I used to play all the time, but for some reason it isn't working. I literally was playing Friday and everything was going well and then Sunday it wouldn't load. I tried to uninstall and reinstall in case it was my phone. Nothing. I can't even get the game to the opening menu. I am very annoyed because I spent money on the rewards system and now it's not working. I don't get how it is working fine one day and completely unresponsive the next. No, other apps aren't having issues. Disappointing.

An entire game based around a gimmick. Once the novelty wears off, the gameplay falls flat. Very grindy, very slow, with little thinking/skill/effort required. In addition, the game has severe technical problems on some phones. The app is unstable, and will frequently freeze or crash (or crash your phone completely). It runs slow, overheats your hardware, and drains battery. You will need a higher end phone to make it work well.

A Rediscovered Gem with Some Glitches Review: I recently rediscovered this game after taking a break for several years, and I must say, it's still a lot of fun. However, I've encountered some frustrating glitches that have hindered my experience. Firstly, I've noticed an issue with the game not registering my achievements accurately. For instance, today I threw three great curve balls, but only one of them was counted. It's disappointing when your efforts don't reflect in your progress.

I've played this game since it launched and it's come a long way in terms of features. However, the Go Battle League needs some serious work. The amount of lag that happens is quite infuriating and has cost me many lost battles. Your losing is also kept track of, which adds an extra stinging reminder to the situation. For a company that's made an ungodly amount of money off of this game, you'd think they would produce a more polished product.

So I absolutely love all the things that we get to do during this COVID 19 lockdown. But with all the app updates, it keeps freezing my game so I have to restart it. Unfortunately, I had to restart the app right after I beat the Team Rocket Boss and before I got the chance to rescue the Pokemon. And my super rocket radar is gone so I don't have the ability to fight the boss again. I'm irritated. Please fix this issue. I like playing this game but if it keeps freezing up I won't play it.

I was in the beta and it's very rare that the beta has less issues than the actual game. I have to force close to app several times just to get it to work properly. It freezes often, doesn't allow me to make selections, often does not allow me to get Pokestops, and freezes pretty much any time I try to catch anything. I'm heavily disappointed in the functionality. Update 6/6/19: Still have to force close often, raids have been made harder and often when you beat them out says you time out &lose

I have played from the beginning. The changes made for the increased pokestop distance was great for the pandemic, but also great in general. It made it easier for many people. I don't understand why it was changed back. I think in some cases, the distance is even smaller then the original distance. I was able to reach a gym from a parking lot pre-pandemic. Now, I can no longer reach it from the same parking lot. Bad decision Niantic!!!

I've been playing about 5 months now and while the game itself is very fun and I do enjoy playing, the glitches and crashing are constant and becoming very frustrating. Not only does the game take a long time to load, sometimes I'll wait several minutes on it to load and it will instantly crash when opening, which means I have to start the process over again. It also has a bad problem dealing with a temporary signal loss.

I've been playing the game every day for a good while now, but the past few months it's been frustrating because of all of the glitching and freezing. It especially freezes during my daily incense use which is beyond frustrating. On top of that, I have trouble opening the app every time. It either goes black or stops loading all together. I have the newest Samsung phone and still have continuous problems after updating, uninstalling, and reinstalling.

I've been playing this game since before it went public. Had a drop off for like a year and half then got back into it. Currently level 42. Upset as of late that the game has quite a few game breaking bugs for weird form factor phones. I got a Z Fold 2 and it has ruined this game for me. There are things that only work on the outside screen or the inside screen. I get it's a specialty phone that not many people own but this form factor is gaining in popularity. Please add UI rescaling.

I've had ongoing issues with logging in since I set up my account in July. Constant "failure to authenticate" notifications. It seems like I was lucky just to get on when I could. I'm very disappointed this time because I was looking foward to the new trainer battle. It's a feature I've looked forward to since the app was developed. I suppose I won't be participating in battles or anything in this app anymore. Hope you guys fix the log-in issues before you add anymore new features.

This app has improved a lot over the years. However, like many people im upset about the new updates. Most of the stops and gyms near me are on private property, for instance one gym is on hole 8 of a golf course which used to be accessible from the road but now I would have to trespass to access it. I've played a lot less since they rolled the distance back. Please fix it.

The game is beautiful, however... it looks like that's what the emphasis is on, not game play. There's so many sparkles and unnecessary animations that it bogs down the smallest of actions. The app is so laggy and glitchy that I can barely do anything. I downloaded it to play with my friends, but it just doesn't seem to work on my phone. My friends have better phones than I do, but I've noticed many glitches on theirs as well. Everything from crashes to pokeballs glitching through the Pokemon to the app re-starting (and taking a while to get back in after) in the middle of a raid or gym battle. I'd love to play this with my friends, but until everything gets fixed... I just don't see how i can. Based on the other comments, it doesn't look like that will be anytime soon. If there's only one thing I could ask of Niantic, it's that they scale back what they're doing. Get rid of the unnecessary animations and decorations, make it so the less beefy phones can run it, and figure out what's causing so many glitches. I'd rather have a game I can play than one that has a lot of features and aesthetics that freeze my phone.

Updated: A fun game. They continue to have a few bugs with the sheer volume of content they are pushing out, but it does keep the game new. Based on what I am seeing from various statistics sites, some accounts are definitely more apt to get the "random" extras, or unique items in the game (not sure why or how). Fun to play without paying, but to complete certain events or advance quickly will require you to pay to play.

Love this game but recently on this new update for some reason it can't detect my location. I keep getting the error 11 message for my location. It's very frustrating when I feel like playing and not even restarting the game makes it work. I try restarting it like 5 or 6 times and it still gives me the same error message. I've never had an issue before this

Had no end of GPS location not found errors, and I mean no end. Didn't matter if I turned on the permissions. Adventure sync had so many problems, eggs weren't hatching at one stage. Reported a problem and I never heard back off of anyone. That was two months ago...the app is a great concept. Honestly, I love Pokémon! So to have an app that has so many bugs and problems, it's honestly sometimes frustrating and a bit of a let down.

I do wanna start off by saying, I just Love Pokemon Go, but there has been soooooo many bugs/issues since the last update, I installed. My AR mapping scan tasks freezes up the app and you have to close out app and restart app. Then when incense is on, you go to click on the pokemon and if it's too late to catch the pokemon, but you already clicked on it, then Boom app freezes up and you have to start right over again. Just way too many errors anymore, but I still play as much as I can!

Update 10/26: I can only log in 10% of the time, and it's saved my login info. Even when I can log in, the game suddenly (and frequently) stops working, forcing me to attempt to reboot. If your servers can't handle a basic connection for five minutes, don't build your game around needing a constant stable data connection. As it stands now I can have full lte coverage and your app still can't even log me in. Older review: Constantly crashes and stays running after I close it. When I close an application, I expect it to close. When I close an application, it's so it doesn't keep running and draining my battery. Please restore basic functionality and I'll change my review. As it stands, it's just an app that constantly annoys me, like the Kindle app used to before they fixed it.

The network communication failures really hurt playing the game. Very frustrating when it freezes catching a pokemon, in a battle, or simply logging on. Fix your code so it handles dropped packets better! If I was to guess, you are using UDP, when you should be using TCP. It is terroble when I see full bars on 4G LTE and can't get a response! The only fix is to kill the program and restart it, often several times. Also, fix it so it remembers settings! The music, sound, and battery saver!

I mean it's a fun game and a great concept but poorly executed. I started playing this game again recently (the first time I played was when it first came out) and the presentation is very underwhelming. The music sounds awful like its been recorded on a device and muffled. The characters are stiff and really underpolished. Not looking for something crazy but anything is better than this. Also looking at reviews from seasoned players makes me sad I missed out on previous incense rates and such.

Really great game and very addicting. I've leveled up quick with tips from friends and other players. While it's true rural gamers aren't going to get it's full potential with limited stops & spotty signal, that doesn't mean the game is bad. A 5-10 min drive into a populated area with multiple stops is worth it if you don't want to spend money on the game. Furthermore, adding friends from different locations/regions is a great way to get items, eggs, etc. when both parties send gifts.

Played when it first came out, dropped because it wasn't great. Came back to give it another go, dropped it in less than 3 hours. Nothing's really changed for the better IMO, and is actively worse in others. For example: the game constantly harrasses you to give camera permissions, even though it can be played without it with no issues. There are more stops in my area than before, but the same boring loop with garbage progression is there, and the extra events do little to break that.

The game downloads to 100% but then gets stuck. Have re-downloaded couple of times on 4G unlimited connection but no help. It also doesn't work on Nexus tablet with 3G (in-compatible for unexplained reasons, Android version is higher than the requirement). *Edit: The game actually installed itself at some point after I had left it at 100% for 3 days.. it also installs fine on newer devices. Gameplay is fine, though repetitive.

This game is really fun with lots of new updates regularly. I would give it more stars if the game didnt crash every 10 mins. It has become really hard to play because of how often it will crash and my phone will return to its home screen even in mid battle or mid catch. That is very frustrating. I can understand not loading to start, but once I am playing there is no reason for it to crash mid game, this is unforgivable. Please fix the constant crashing and I will give more stars.

This game is alright, but like any other phone app it has its drawbacks. It runs fine for me, no technical issues or glitches. I got it originally when it first released, but lost interest. I redownloaded it last year and it's improved, but some things are unnecessary in game. First off, you need to be able to delete those missions with 2-3 separate things to complete, not everyone can do them because many don't even have a pokestop near. Also, fix my pokemon spawn. They almost never spawn now.

I like the game . Been playing it for a while, but i really dislike the frequent crashes and loss of location. My avatar keeps freezing making the app crash and close entirely or making me restart it just to catch up with the fact that im walking. Now im not sure if it's my phone being so crappy, i have an LG harmony lite phone, but i do notice alot of other people have the same issues. Would LOVE it more if it didn't crash so frequently, but i still try to play.

It needs some bug fixes. Here are some if not all the issues I'm having with this game. 1. The loading screen gets stuck constantly and is super annoying. Also, if you wait, it won't load the rest of the way. 2. Unknown Battle Errors. When Battling Team Rocket, once completed, it hits this error. I end up wasting resources. 3. When playing, it just gets stuck loading and freezing. I also am playing on a brand new phone plus a new account and honestly a horrible experience for "New Players"...

Too expensive for a "free" game. I've loved this game for years, but am highly disappointed the creators are constantly looking for ways to make it difficult to advance in the game without spending more money. Please make your features more affordable and accessible to those who live in more remote areas. It's a shame to charge so much for remote raid passes. Worst update choice ever. Won't be buying remote raid passes anymore.

It was fun...but then all of the sudden I started getting this one sprint ad popping up during weird times. I went to figure out what it was by letting it sit on the ad. Then the ad gave the new pokemon go thing asking if I was taking a break. So I uninstalled. Other than that...the app helped me lose 14lbs in 2 weeks for the military so I'll change my 1 star to a 2 or even 3 stars. Update: I did 2 stars. The ads were too annoying. They were popping up while I was using Chrome and Tor.

I've been playing since launch. Good game but I'd like to be able to merge my new account with my old one. Changed my email and lost my old account, losing my steps, pokemon and level 30. I would also like the ability to play offline, this game eats a lot of data. It would be great if Niantic took away the passenger button or if clicked once it shouldn't pop up again! Otherwise I like what they are doing and this is much better then when it started.

Overall, I enjoy it but lately the controls have become randomly non-responsive. I can open and close menus, but game controls won't work. When it happens, I can't manipulate the map, throw pokéballs, or attack in battles. It only fixes when I close and re-open the app. This is a major problem in raids which I can't re-enter afterwards without using a new raid pass.

It is a very fun game and I enjoy it plenty! However, the calibration is way off. In addition, you need internet to play, which makes no sense since it's a game where you walk all around. I don't have seevice, therefore no data, and can only play at home because of this. I would suggest a recalibration option that allows the app to locate the player more accurately. I live right next to a pokestop, and despite being just a few feet away, my character is JUST too far away.

This game is near entirely pay to play. Costs $2 to even attempt a raid, and then you play a minigame where you easily can run out of balls. $2 per try. Pay for your chance. Odds not disclosed. Prices for items in game are variable, as in, each player has a different real world price for the same item. The goal is so pay to win that almost every QoL improvement, like having any space, is a purchase in the shop at a obscene rate.

It's a wonderful game and I've been playing for quite some time now, but I must say it does need to be fixed here and there: For example the way remote raid passes work tend to mess up, raids tend to kick people out, the loading screen sometimes freezes, the game tends to crash every now and then, but other then those issues this game is perfect for a explorer and a collector! I diffently think you should download this game if you can get up and move around. Thanks for reading this!!

I want to love this game, but it freezes or doesn't work 80% of the time I try to play it on my new LG G4. I believe the servers cannot handle it, and honestly Niantic should have been more ready for this highly anticipated game. I paid money into it to support but i may not continue this exercise in futility. Update: I went back years later during pandemic, and its much better. Over the years they have improved things a lot.

UPDATE: through sleuthing, I found this game needs location to be on high precision as per the last few updates instead of battery saver. However, this means I can play the game for an even shorter time than before because my battery drains so quickly. Still a major issue. I've actually been playing this game for a year and loved it, recently, however... it is impossible for me to play. The app refuses to note my location at any point ( the GPS not found error, 11) and I have given all permissions I can with my location access through my phone settings. I had hoped my phone was reacting poorly to needing a new update, but I have the most recent version of the app. I uninstalled and reinstalled the app to freshly turn on location permissions and it still refuses to read my location. So at this point I may not play anymore, as there is no way to report this phenomenon and I don't know how to submit a ticket for help, though I've looked all over the website.

It is great, but I am having a problem with the app itself. I've now had for two days in a row, with a short break in between, problems with catching Pokemon and spinning stops. They will flee first try and the spins won't spin. I also won't get my candies from the select transfer method. I've g It,one to the extent of uninstalling almost every app on my phone, including this app, and it only worked for a few hours. Otherwise, the app is great, and is fun to play. Such a great time killer!

Game is no longer meant for casual players. Leveling up takes forever, and they added even more levels. Features will be locked behind those levels I'm sure, and it can take you actual months to get a level. Sad to see. Completely ruined the tracking system. Can no longer track one Pokemon. Have to shift through ALL the ones around you to try to get to the rare one. No way to tell when a raid will happen unless you you keep every gym in sight, which sucks... It is getting better though.

Game is a good concept and ive even worked out a problem with my account on my end and i still cannot get back in to play. Oh well. Another App gone. Game bites very much so if you dont travel or unable to. Its fun as a tinker yes but not much more then that. If you live in an area thats high population, game can be good, but if you are stuck in a low population area, dont bother. It is not worth more then a few rounds before you find your limitations to your location. Good luck.

I still can't take pictures! It's very disappointing since so many tasks require pictures to finish them. It would be nice to have a fix for the last update!!!! The newest update kicks me out of the game when I try to take pictures! Please fix the ability to take pictures. Now when I try it shuts the app down. No, my camera works perfectly outside of the game and yes my app has permission to use the camera!!!!! No it isn't my device.

I enjoy this game but I have been having massive issues with adventure snyc for the last 3 weeks. I walked over 4 miles today and it did not register a single step I took. So NONE of my eggs hatched. Very frustrating and all the hthings to fix it make no since as I don't even have those options. It's to the point I'm really thinking about just stopping. I never had this issue in the past. But it's constant now and upsetting.

Pay to win. If you're playing casually to collect, just play the games. It costs so much money to upgrade your item bag, and your Pokemon storage, and they dropped how much coins you can make without paying to an obscenely low amount. It's not possible to have a living dex without paying a lot, and you can hardly catch everything from even a single gen without spending. Not worth the trouble of starting, but if you've played in the past it's worth opening up again to see what's changed.

**EDIT: I've updated my review from one to three stars because they've made some positive changes over the years. Even though I still REALLY miss the footsteps fun times are definitely to be had.** This game, as bare bones as it is, still has potential to be fun at times. Removing the footstep tracking was an idiot move, though. Will continue to play when I'm out and about, but will not be paying anymore money for items. I'm sad I wasted $30+ on this screw-up.

This game... It needs more. More species of pokemon, trading, 1v1, and more pokemon in certain areas would be amazing. edit: They've really rewritten the formula with raid battles, trading, 1v1s, the redesigned gyms, and field research missions. Still not a perfect game, and took too long to update it enough to get it to this point, but definitely worth a shot if you haven't touched it since it first came out.

I had to reinstall this app because my phone crashed. Now app keeps saying it's not compatible with my phone. Worked fine just hrs before the crash. Not at all pleased. The first part of this was written in 2017. It is 2020 and I'm still playing because I like the game, but have bought 3 phones too keep up with all the extras that keep getting added on. It still crashes at will all the time and won't let players raid like its supposed to, even when you are at the gym in person. It's just bad.

I come back to this game time to time cuz I enjoy playing it. I come back to it today for the first time in who knows how long, I updated the app cuz that's what I needed to do to play and all that keeps happening is crashes. Gets kind of annoying when you're trying to catch something or battling. The whole game just crashes and goes right to my home screen.

Edit to original review (below): Updates have ruined more than helped the game. I rarely and I really mean rarely get nanab berries, great balls, or any eggs besides 2k. Has been this way for about a year now. Also, 75% of my wild catches run. It's fun, addictive, and a great way to want to get out and about and socialize. Servers have issues, but doesn't keep me from playing every chance I can!

Its been 5 long years since I first left a review. And the game has managed to stay alive in all that time. While the hype and player base from summer 2016 is way down, the game has improved and become something fun and interesting to return to even when i leave for extended periods. The game is a bit hefty so if your phone is older/dying it might not be easy to play with the constant lag and freezing. Aside from that, I dont have any complaints

When it was first released it was great, it worked ok, despite it's lack of features it was fun and got me up and walking. I could handle the battery murder it comitid. I could a few crashes. But then slowly the game started slowing down, it got slower and slower, until I couldn't even transfer my pokemon without waiting 15 minutes. I tried looking for a way to speed it back up, but there was none. Soon I'm going to uninstall the game. I might come back in a few months, but as of now it's unplayable.

I highly enjoy the game. Its fun and addictive. Yet, lots of problems. One, sometimes it freezes midway of capturing a pokémon. Sometimes it just freezes randomly. Second, servers are always down, it'd be good to add more soon. Some things you could add to make it better are more pokéstops in areas that barely have any or only have a few; same goes for gyms. You should also add a feature where you can add/friend other trainers, and maybe something where trainers can trade pokémon with others!

Continually freezes. Almost unplayable. Fun game when it does work but that's a big 'when'. Still needs vast improvement. Have lost a lot of good pokemon due to game freezing in the middle of a capture. Addendum for 2021 i would like to revise the stars to 4, the game is actually playable now, started playing it again to share the experience with my god son who is very into this game. Well done Niantic.

Concept? Great. Especially from someone who liked Ingress. This game? Complete garbage. I've had about 11 server errors. Despite relogging and restarting my GPS. When I'm on Wi-fi, the map loads. When I'm on data like everyone else, it takes forever to load. Pokéstops never load and thus I miss the items. If you guys make this game better and actually playable, I'll try.

Revisiting this after a few years. Still annoyingly reliant on the user having a high-end phone. Now I have one, and the problems arise with consistency and the intention of making the game fun. Unskippable encounters where the pokemon is supposed to be "given" to you are a mess. Adventure sync is good. Weird geographic limitations on pokemon feel ridiculous, but it's whatever. Wish spawn rates were higher in less populated areas, but I get it. Battles are fun.

The reason why i deleted this game is because of the lag, this game is awesome. You wont be able to find a game like this. Adventure, Strategy and more. Everything is perfect on this game, grafics, effects and even more. But the only problem is its too laggy. its hard to get smooth gameplay on 4gb ram. Everyone doesn't have high end phones. If you add things like grafics lower settings, mods disble option, then it would be great and It'll help to get smooth gameplay on low end phones.

I love the game concept itself. It could be a wonderful game... just my opinion on some of the mechanics of the game. Which i hope they are working on. Niantic has gotten better about fixing bugs and giving us some content we want. But still has a long way to go i believe. Like similar games has alot more stops to get items from than go does.. but game is much improved since launch

Decided to give it another chance, and was sorely disappointed. The GPS issues are crazy, at best, it freezes and tells me I shouldn't be driving when it catches up (this is when I'm on foot), at worse, I have to restart the game for the GPS to update my location. I don't have these issues with my other GPS apps, including Ingress. The game had issues before, that's why I stopped playing, but now it's almost unplayable

Currently, literally unplayable. Can't get into a single catch without white screen of death. Years later, and still feels not ready for release. Bugs, crashes, freezes, and random framerate death make it often unplayable. Balance issues galore and no action taken against cheaters. A huge battery/data drain, so play with caution. And now, a new feature that completely locks up. ..bravo.

This game is absolutely abysmal and does not deserve any of the credit it gets. It is exceedingly glitchy, the UI is complete and utter trash, and AR mode has not worked once. There is nothing to do other than walk around and catch pokemon, and even that is laughable. The pokemon are also extremely unbalanced, nearly all of the pokemon you get being complete garbage, even if it is rare. The graphics are also lazily done and feel rushed in comparison to other games they've made.

Everything is more smooth except for the servers crashing occasionally and some glitches. I've been having an issue with gyms where I beat every pokemon, bit get a message that "All of your pokemon have fainted!" Occasionally, there will be a glitch where all of the damage my pokemon does (that turns orange) in a gym is reverted and I lose the battle due to time running out. However, Many improvements have been made since the launch of this app and I look forward to more expansions and bug fixes

This game has came a long way from its launch phase. The game play is fun, engaging, and gets you out exploring. I will say, however, that if you like in a city you are going to have a far easier time than a rural player. The game is definitely geared towards high population areas, but can be fun if you can find other local players. And if Niantic would ever do something about the cheaters, it would make the game much more fun. Nothing like competing against unbeatable opponents.

I really want to enjoy this game, but it's currently mostly unplayable for me. Every time I move out of my home network I need to turn mock locations on and off. I've lost so many good pokes and incense because of freezing. I do like the game, just incredibly frustrated thus far. I think daily gifts would be good, and also something to do when you're not able to move.

I love Pokemon. Played all of them since Red and Blue. That said, this game is sadly still not so. They created a vast, beautiful framework, and a social experience unlike any other. But the problems overwhelm the attempt at a game. The battery drain is still murderous and leveling past 20 is also an impossibility for anyone that has responsibilities, but the game now has more options and attractions at least to keep the casual player entertained.

The app was ok, glitches and bugs here and there but overall it was stable. The concept got old a little quick as it was nothing more than a mini game compared to any actual pokemon game. I know new improvements are being made, but a long time has passed and the interest is simply not there anymore for such a repetitive concept. It was gun, but now it's time to say goodbye. Thanks for the fun times :)

The game is fun and addicting but needs some work to fix bugs. Update: game has made a lot of improvements. The next step in this game should be the option to see other trainers on the map and interact. Battle, trade, gift, etc. Another would be the ability to battle wild pokemon to make them easier to catch. I think we all wanted a live version of the original pokemon games/platform

First servers crash, then tracking literally disappears to having to commit to a "wild goose chase" trying to find anything and now curves nor THROWING a pokeball work! I have never missed throwing a pokeball, so this bug where no matter how far or fast i throw it, it doesn't even go far enough to even HIT the pokemon is pissing me off! I've wasted 20+ pokeballs and I was waiting for trading with my friends (like in the advertisement for the game said there would be!) but I'm done with this!

Okay, so the app takes forever to load anything and kicks me out at random. The game's been unplayable for like a year now and it gets worse with every update. Update came and I wish I could rate the app lower than a 1 star. All it is anymore is 2 minutes of being stuck on a single frame after the game loads, and then the game crashes. Absolutely horrendous.

I originally played this game back in 2016 during it's "Hype" phase. I stopped playing due to some issues that the game had back then. When I decided to download it again at the beginning of this year (2021), I was almost immediately hooked based on all the updates and quality of life changes that I've missed. There's no doubt that the game is 10 times better than it once was! Be careful though, I ended up spending over $100 trying to get shiny Heracross in raids and was unsuccessful. Bad odds!

Reminds me of my childhood and brings back a lot of memories. I wish the servers were more stable. The last problem I had with GO is that I have no pokestops near me and the closest one is 3km away and I don't have access to a car. Even with these problems I still think is deserves 5 stars! Way too many game breaking glitches should not have been released!

Edit: great fun and great way to exercise. it was really buggy in the beginning but it has improved greatly. only thing i would include is the ability to contact friends in-game. I really, really, really, really want to like this game. It's just too buggy. The servers are always down, I waste 5 pokeballs to catch a Pokémon and when I finally get him, the game freezes and I have to kill the app and lose my pokéballs and the Pokémon.

Great concept, but very buggy. Game crashes frequently and the servers are down at the least once a day. I lose pokéballs everyday because the game crashes mid-catch. It needs a turorial where it explains how to play more in-depth because the instrutions it gives you are not very helpful. Also I think there should be a log in bonus everyday of a few pokéballs or something. Overall it is a very fun game that gets you up and moving but it needs alot of work.

Updated for the new versions. When it works it's great but the new battle arena is full of issues. Constantly freezing or lagging is very frustrating and being an important part of the game it sorta ruins all the joy. When it works though: Fun diversion when you are out. Kinda dull if your just in one spot. The fun is about hunting for the Pokemon in the real world.

I've played since day one of release. Lots of bugs & lag to speak of but still continued to play.
