If your starting out, please listen to the tutorial because there's much more than just running around catching pokemon. Trust me. Once you get to know it, the game is extremely fun and great to play with friends, even if your not walking around there's still loads of things to do, I definitely recommend. Update: I also feel there are some significant negatives. The number one negative is catching the pokemon after raids. It is nearly impossible to catch it even if you use a golden raspberry.

Really enjoy this game even though it seems it doesn't run as well on android in comparison to IOS. Been playing for years and there's still features I wish that were in the game. This game can he very repetitive and when you can't skip and evolution scene or a purifying scene ect. It's draining because it can take hours to transfer all the shadow after purifying them.

Everytime I open the game it lags more and more its to the point where today alone I've opened it 4 time's in under 10 minutes and it keeps lagging and freezing. A quality feature desperatly needs to be added to help halt the constant lagging. A new engine to smoothen the game and alleviate more lag. Look I know as a company your doing your best but please fix the frame rate issues and consider the option's I've laid out, I think this game is fantastic but these issues need to be sorted out.

This game is a joke. The only interesting feature is the PvP and even that keeps crashing and lagging players out, wether it be me or my opponent. And I'm playing on a Galaxy S23 Ultra with perfect 5G network. This is ridiculous and frustrating. There is literally no point in putting effort trying to climb the ranks because you always end up losing elo due to lag and crashes. It's the most frustrating game I have ever played.

Overall not bad. Unfortunately, when I moved to my new phone, I would be notified that the app crashed without the app actually being open (possibly due to Adventure Sync?). Adventure Sync also does not work on this phone - on my old phone, I could easily sync Google Fit and Pokemon Go, but now, none of my activity syncs (I walk a lot, so it's a bit unfortunate). I'm reinstalling to see if that helps either of these; otherwise, i might just try to sync with my old phone.
love this app totally recommend it for pokemon lovers no ads! and every pokemon

I really love the game, but I've been having issues since I got a new phone. Sometimes, with no explanation or obvious reason, when I open the app a message appears that reads, "Failure to Intialize! Your hardware doesn't support this application. Sorry!" This makes no sense since my phone can run the game perfectly and meets all the criteria to operate the app. Niantic probably won't read this so this review shall be in vain, but at least I can post my problem somewhere. Still a great game (when it works) though.

Game is fun, but many times when my egg is about to hatch nothing happens, I wait for it to pop up. Or the field research pokemon will fail catching over and over, I swear catching a stupid shedninja used up about 70+ pokeballs using the berries to help as well. For a game that generates as much money as it does for the 6+ yrs its been around these glitches would get dealt with. Even the "I'm a passenger screen" pops up randomly canceling out pokestop swipe rewards.

Vast improvements since 2016, tons of features to make it more interesting to play, better servers, more pokemon, you name it. Good to play casually or otherwise. Every day, pokemon spawn around where I live and work, compared to before where I could go a couple days without seeing a thing.

Let me start off by saying yes, I used to play this game a lot. i mean a lot a lot. But now barely at all. The game has become pretty much unplayable. Not do to errors or glitches. But I've caught every pokemon available in my area. I've done all the raids trying to get legendaries. I've signed in for 7 days to get the same pokemon over and over again. I've walked and hatched more eggs than I can remember. Just be disappointed every time with the same pokemon. Im done at this point.

This was a 5 star app for me. Have been playing daily and very happy with this game for over three years until the latest upgrade. Kept saying: "Can't Install Pokemon Go". Tried clearing cache and data of Google Play Store Storage, and Rertarted my phone a few times, still not working. Now, I can't even open the app! Your help to have this issue fixed would be greatly appreciated!!!

Come on guys, you had to know the amount of people wanting to play this would be massive. So why didn't you get a large enough server to handle the input. So far today, I've wasted a shot at a gym, and lost a lot of chances in catching Pokémon. Once I'm actually able to stay on for a decent amount of time, I'll give this more stars. *EDIT* servers are doing a bit better.

Niantic has come a long way with this app. Despite the slow release of features and patches, the game has gotten exponentially more stable since its release. Gone are the days of GPS issues, but the spoofers still remain, and some still ruin the experience by taking over gyms and guarding them. Even so, Pokemon Go is a great mobile game to exercise with, meet friends, kill time, and catch Pokemon.

The Go fest was a cash grab. Those who didnt pay a ridiculous $15, didnt even get access to most of the pokemon that were supposed to be available. The fest was very short. Apparently they think that most of their players have the 24 hours a day to play this. Oh and everytime I go to buy any pass in the store, it turns blank and it prevents me from buying anything. So I feel super cheated.

The recent decrease in radius to hit pokestops has made me decide to stop playing. I work full time and can't go running around town all the time to hit these pokestops. It was easier and funner to play when I had two that were right at my job so I could collect items easily to catch my pokemon when they came up as I walked around work and other places for errands.

Been playing since launch. Lots of fun & lots of events. My only issues are the Pokémon with horrible stats you get from research and raids, they should be 90% on the minimum, and the darn Pokémon Go Plus, the one sold by Ninatic, clicker doesn't stay connected. There are other issues too like 50 coins max a day for gym occupation, but those 2 were my main issues

What do you get when a company that doesn't know how to run a live service game buys the rights to make one for a very lucrative IP? Pokemon Go. I've never played a game I have to actively try to enjoy aside from this one. Niantic continues to make and double down on changes that make things worse, in order to really progress you have to spend money, and the amount of glitches is inexcusable for such a massive IP. I truly hate it here, but at this point I've wasted too much money to leave.

Love the game itself. Bugs are annoying as hell. If you're going to create a game to create money then use some of that money to make it better. Just fix the bugs as it's sometimes unplayable and really ruins the experience. One change that I would make: when you have a quest to evolve a pokemon that you have already evolved previously after saving up months worths of candy how about register you have already done it!! LISTEN TO YOUR AUDIENCE DEVS!!!

Overall love the game and concep. My app experienced issues like.... not seeing Pokemon after putting lure, being kicked out of guns during a raid, phone freezing siding catching, spinning or fighting, I have a number of suggestions or possible updates like sharing items, exchanging items for an upgraded version and more. PS some of these issues may be my cell.

Right now it's a 2 because my game keeps crashing. It's not my phone either. I just got a new phone and the app was crashing on the old one as well. I've been playing since 2016 all be it taking a break for a while but my game crashing while trying to catch a raid pokemon I used a remote pass for made it to where I didn't have a chance to catch it. It crashes randomly when I'm trying to play and is becoming more frequent.

The game is good but needs to fix the various problems with the login system to the spawn rates. Not to mention the Level cap that is required just to add friends. This feature should have been added and enabled the day of games launch. I should not have to be lvl 30 or 40 just make friends with other Trainers. As the saying goes. The customer is always right. Without customers Niantic the game falls.

The game is great at developing personal connections between yourself and your Pokémon. I'd imagine the same with friends as it works just the same, however, it's very tough to make new friends (should be able to add recently battled opponents in premier League and people you see at gyms). The game also tries to do far too much. The time it takes to load into an encounter, catch, appraise, return to the map and repeat is so long and jumpy(slow). I can't possible play this game going on a run.

I was excited for the launch, but the servers have put a real downer on everything. The actual game layout is amazing and if Nintendo and Niantic follow through it will be 5 star worthy. Once the servers are fixed and a bugfix is done, we have some real potential. Edit: One year later and this game still has my love and attention. It comes with it's flaws, but my childhood is recaptured every day by this.

This game is quite good, but a problem is the spending. Like with most games nowadays you have to "pay to win". Only difference with Pokémon Go is you can earn the coins from battles, only problem with that though is it's maxed out at 50 coins per day. I think this should be increased to. Also you have to spend 200 coins for ONLY 50 spaces for the poke storage and items, which isn't really fair. As you basically have to be in gyms for 4 days to be able to only get 50 spaces and that's just for 1

I have played this game from the start, and it makes me sad that I have to edit my review. The overt, greedy monetization efforts and the refusal or inability to fix bugs and lag are both getting to the point where it's hard to find enjoyment in the game. The events are no longer fun, new content comes in at a trickle (and is usually behind a paywall anyway), and PVP is in its most broken state ever. It hurts to say it, but if you didn't get in on it years ago, don't bother starting now.

I played pretty serious on and off, with the new price change for remote passes, me and my wife used to help others for raids here and there, but now it's just not going to happen, we're deleting the game as now we don't really have a reason to play. It was fun, 2016-2018 was the games peak, and now they're just money hungry. If you're a new player trying to get into the game, with all the pay walls now, you'll need to spend money to be competitive, or help in raids in any way, not worth it.

I'm having to edit my score. I'm really digging the revamp to the game. The only annoying thing at the moment is the egg hatching. I have to stop everything while the eggs hatch. If i can tap them to hatch at my leisure, that'd be better. Or at least stop with the egg hatching graphics. It's cute the first two times seeing it, after that it's annoying. Still, liking the game now.

Now that we can't track pokemon, it's impossible to "catch them all" unless you are a retiree or unemployed and can roam around 24/7 to stumble upon rare pokemon. Without the ability to track location and distance there's no way of telling what you are doing and if you can make it there before the Pokémon disappears. I find myself playing less and less. Great idea for a game but inability to support it, sustain it, and address MAJOR faults is going to cost Niantic all their money-spending players.
Used to enjoy this game. Now they have taken most of the gyms away and reset evolution requirements. Worked on one for months that they reset back to the beginning.

I have been Playing Pokemon Go, on and off for more then 3 years. It has its ups and down but Niantic has been really working hard to make it to where it is accessible for everyone. There are millions of people playing and yes its not easy to please everyone but from the past few months since the pandemic hit they had been trying so hard to where people can enjoy the game from their homes. The game play is amazing. They could work on lowering prices of the coins, othewise its a good game. Enjoy.

The improvements to the game are really good, the only major problem I have with the game now is how hard the Sinnoh Stone is to get. I understand that you can't just give it away, but the odds are already ridiculous, even more so for the ones of us who don't really want to battle. maybe raise the odds just a bit or let it drop at pokestops or something. There's just too many pokemon that need the stone to evolve to make it that hard to get.

Trades adjusting stats is whack (their explanation on why this is a good mechanic is even more whack). Allowing players to BUY remote passes (x3) when they already have 2 but capping what they can actually have on-hand at 3 means you wasted coins on an item that was not received and will not be reimbursed (theft). So many other issues which you can read in other reviews or online. They lucked out getting pokemon ip. If not for Pikachu and the gang this ship would've sunk long ago.

EDIT: in light of the communication Niantic has begun, ive changed my rating to be more favorable. Once mechanics are changed to more acceptable level, I'll rate it even higher. Recent updates have made the game a chore to play. There's no way to even have a general idea of where to find Pokemon now, and renders the "nearby" tab useless. If there was at least some form of communication from the Devs on what they plan to do or a roadmap/game plan of sorts, this wouldn't be nearly as big of an issue. Would gladly give it 5 stars if I could actually play, until then, 1 star.

I am loving all the changes and updates. I downloaded this game back in 2016, and it has come a long way. Most criticisms I can offer are little more than nitpicks. In fact, this is probably the only game I actually don't mind having microtransactions. It's very playable without buying anything. However, I think this game could benefit from an exchange system for Pokemon candies. Even if the rate was 10 to 1 or you could only redeem candy for berries, I'd like to do something with my excess

It doesn't connect to my fitness app. It doesn't count the full amount of walking you do either, I have a pokemon go partner that walks with me yet it shows different distances. Not to mention it decreased my distance. I didn't go into pokemon go for a day and I know longer had the 25km reward . When I bike and run it doesn't track the full distance. It is constantly glitching during battles. The program for pairing competitors is shoty work, they need to be more evenly matched.

PokemonGo is a fun experience, but it could be improved. I would like to be able to raid Legendary pokemon in Gyms without being forced into one of the 3 teams (Mystic/Valor/Instimct). I'd also like to recommend a Camera Off option for the Buddy system (like with catching) instead of being forced into AR. I've used older phones that can't process using the camera with a virtual overlay at the same time. I've tried it on 2 phones: one lagged, the newer closed the game.

I'm in the Middle of the raid, and suddenly my game froze. Niantic can you please fix this? it's not my internet problem. and also, sometimes I can't even login to my game, i don't know why but it's always black screen

This game is a phenomenon in New York City. People are playing it everywhere. It's very addictive, however on my Nexus 5 the game is so unfortunately broken. Besides the expected server disconnects, the app freezes after at least half the pokeballs I throw, forcing me to kill the app and start it again. Sometimes it gives me the Pokémon, sometimes it doesn't. When around a high concentration of lures sometimes the game will just quit unexpectedly. When it works it's great, but at times it is barely playable

I have been unable to log into my account for over 4 days now. I have attempted to contact customer service and have tried to discuss the situation with them. All I have been told is to ensure I've done everything from the help page, which I have and told them about, and when I say I'm still having issues they copy and paste the help page to me! I used to love this game! Catching new Pokemon and have been playing since the beginning watching the growth of the app and all the changes.

New updates have streamlined the game but also pushed the game into a non free to play space. You are now very limited in the only way you have to make currency for the game gym battle. But overall everyone should try it, you will figure out very quickly if it's for u You or not. But beware new updates regularly break the app. Mine currently crashes or locks me in a deep blue sea of limbo when I try to play. Hopefully I full reinstall works. Fingers crossed.

Edit: aside from the covid accessibility updates that were put in place but now removed again, thus making it less disability user friendly/accessible... For past 2-3 days, I haven't been able to log into my account.. It kept saying that I needed to update the game in order to continue yet when clicking to update it, it just turns into "pending" status; tried restarting game & phone, cleared cache, uninstalled it, etc. Now it won't reinstall. Help! *Not very user friendly for rural areas.

The game is neat as a social experience, but frustrating as a game itself. Catching is inconsistent in difficulty, you have no metric to measure how far a Pokemon is from you and thereby know how far to throw a ball, and battles are ridiculously simplified. I stopped playing once I realized I was only playing it for nostalgia and due to its addictive mechanics like daily rewards and notifications to remind you to play.

This game is fun, however the amount of times the app has crashed on me is unacceptable for its overall game features. I use it as an idle game so the graphics are good especially when you use the AR to catch pokemon. The controls get buggy along with the location services. The first time it crashed was when the game had been out for a few months. I was forced to create a whole new account. There were a few more minor incidents that made me uninstall and now that l reinstalled I'm locked out.

Do not bother downloading if you have an Android phone. I gave this game 1 star because I couldn't give it 0. The game itself is fun if you can manage to get into the app long enough to play it. Have tried everything to improve its performance on my phone. Unless your phone is iOS or has insane processing for an Android, the game is unplayable. I've been trying to accept a gift from my friend since December 22nd. This game could break the record for most times crashed in under 5 minutes. -12/10

Don't play while driving.....great. but this warning should not come when I am walking. Tracking distance.....I walk several km a day for work. None of this gets tracked, I assume because I don't have the game up. But, I can walk a proven 500m, with the game on, and on the screen, and it still won't track the whole distance. Sometimes it will track 400m, other times none etc. That makes it rather frustrating. Update Feb 2020: still occasionally gives me the warning but tracks better

This game is wonderful. Yes the servers are going down, but that is to be expected. For being just released, I haven't hit any major issues and am catching Pokémon like a boss. It's expected to be a bit bumpy for the first little while, but definitely worth toughing it out. :) Thank you to everyone who put time and so much hard work into building this for all of us. The Pokémon community has been waiting a long time. No words to describe the excitement of finally being able to be a Trainer in real life ;)

I've used the incense multiple times on several occasions, and it REPELS pokémon rather than attract them. No matter how far you walk or what distance you've traveled, it doesn't work. It's a waste of time and money. Pokéstops work about a quarter of the time when driving past them, (I have no idea of there's a cool down or not, it's not like I can tell) and it seems like I have a better chance at throwing pokéballs indirectly instead of trying to get it within the circle. It's inconsistent.

Whilst I love this game, I am very frustrated with the lack of support regarding users with the new Samsung note 20. The game now spends more time loading than it does actually working - if I go to catch a poking straight away I might get 45 seconds before it crashes, but it usually happens within 15 seconds. It has been over a week since niantic were aware of this issue, but no suitable update to sort it out. Doesn't look good on them!

I first started playing on this app back in 2016. They've added a lot of fun updates, having friends is now more interactive with trading and battling, and there are now fun quests and missions as well as pokemon stats playing a bigger role than combat power alone. The buddy system is a lot of fun, and raids with friends is too. Now you will get rewards in game just for walking certain distances, rewarding players for being active and moving around. It has improved a lot in four years.

Extremely fun and addicting but the failure to connect and crashes are killing it. I get they didn't expect so much traffic but the server problems needs to be fixed soon or I may abandon this game. Yesterday I bought a nice lunch to go and some lures planning on picnicking at a poke stop. I was so disappointed when the server crashed just as I arrived there and didn't start up until I finished my food and just before I needed to go to work. I felt like I lost precious time and money.

Still years later and the same bugs seem to never be fixed. You either end up wasting your time or your money with this game. Developers are too lazy to fix the issues, the same ones that have been there from the start. If you want fun this is not the game. And they refuse even with proof to do refunds for purchases that didnt go through.

This game had me out walking around my city the entire summer. I made a new account after losing my info from my previous account and I leveled myself up to lvl 29 in just 2 months. I'm addicted to the game, however, it's really disappointing when you battle daily and can only recieve 50 coins per day. I'd also like to see raids going on in the evening because I don't get much time to do it in the day anymore because of school and work.

EDIT: Took a few years but the game has at least what was promised in the launch trailer. the battle system is underwhelming compared to the main series. And with the way they implemented trading they need to remove regional pokemon. This game promised a lot in the trailer. Its just not there yet. Trading and trainer battles are the big two and both are now in the most underwhelming way.

I've been on & off playing since it started. Level 43 & my account is old. They try to entice you to join the trainer battles & you can't level up unless you do from 43 to 44. The problem is- the trainer battles are far from fair battles. You can be battling a trainer with the exact same pokemon even, and yet they will have available twice as many charged moves as you get. It's rigged against you & it sucks. This is why I always stop playing this game. It's statistically impossible.

I love this game! It make me reminisce when I would watch Pokemon and want to be a Pokemon trainer. This app is a distraction from my busy life and I get to explore new places not only around me, but help me get out of my own city and travel. I love the challenges as well as events. The down side I would say is only getting 50 coins a day when leaving several pokemon at different gyms. I would appreciate it if we as players could get more in return atleast stardust, when leaving pokemon at different gyms, but either than that it's an amazing game and I love playing it!

This game is fun, but it lags, wastes a lot of battery, and some of the quests can be kind of ridiculous. One of my quests was to catch a Ditto, and 3 months later I still haven't caught a single one, let alone see it. Another quest was to evolve a Feebas. However, you first have to walk it for 20km, and then you have to get 100 Feebas candy, which is nearly impossible considering the fact that they are super rare.

I've been playing since literal day 2 and the game has turned into just micro transactions. They don't release new pokemon very often and when they do, they are often associated with spending real money. I can't go out and "catch them all" because the spawns don't rotate very often and so many pokemon are locked by region specific areas like continents It is disappointing that I will never get a full completion dex without finding someone who cheats to help me

This would be a 5 star review if not for the location jumps & log in issues interfere with a game that's based on location & regular activity. I love this Pokemon Go and play with a group of my friends, but it's frustrating to only be able to play sporadically like this. Uninstalling & redownloading seems to be the only way to actually keep playing every time this game updates but I lose days to weeks trying to reinstall.

The entire app is AMAZING!!! There are a few things that could be changed though. Like if you want to set up personal pokestops so you could get items once per day. The pokestops should be unable to be seen or used by other trainers so people aren't flocking around your house. you shouldn't be able to use lure modules on them either. The pokestops should be limited to how many you can set up. Like maybe three then the rest you have to buy with pokecoins.

I really wanna give it a 5 out of 5 but I noticed if your walking it can take 3 plus hours to hatch a 10k egg. I heard it only takes 30 minutes to an hour but I think you have to be moving at least 20 mph. So unless your riding a moped everywhere it's going to take a while. Also it seems it tracks by speed but distance, so go no faster then 35mph everywhere. Niantic doesn't seem to encourage walking much with this game.

Adventure sync won't work no matter what I do. Game doesn't count any of my distance. Keep getting a failed friends list error so I can't add friends or even get my trainer code. Trying to get support from Niantic was useless.I uninstalled and reinstalled a dozen times trying to fix it. I was so excited to finally be able to play.

Niantic Support is a Joke. Contacted them for simple issue and got an answer via email and a promise to fix the issue. Next day they retracted and said they couldn't help me. After reaching out again, they told me they were unable to offer further information. Beware, if you have technical issues your problems may not be worth Niantic's time.

Great fun if you live in the city. Completely contrary to the lore and world of Pokemon, the more you go into nature, the less pokemon you find. Really disappointing and practically non functional both in terms of finding pokemon or the ability to find pokestops and gyms in the country or suburbs. Still cannot submit requests for new stops or gyms.

Update: I love the game when I can actually play it. I've been logged out for years. I've just redownloaded this game to see if I could regain access to my account, and it FINALLY let me!!! Best part is, I didn't lose ANYTHING that I had paid for or earned!!! Now we just gotta see how this goes and if this will allow it to keep the updated 5☆s

first I paid twice for the deluxe ho pass pack in March somehow. Mind you there was no secondary bonus. second the catch rates for male combed and others like it is far too high red circles with an ultra ball and crazy berry for a regular male combee. is excessive.

I have been playing since release. This game has buggy and relatively dull gameplay, but it is a fun way to waste time with friends and collecting pokemon never gets old. Unfortunately the developer has clamped down hard on my primary way to play, after being perfectly fine with it (and me spending money on it) for years. Even before the changes I would argue that the extreme grind made it a bad choice for a new player - now it's an even worse one.

This game drains the battery is the phone even for more gaming focused phones extremely fast making it impossible to have a normal day even while the game runs in the background completely out of focus. I was forced to uninstall this after seeing the battery drain readings from that app for safety reasons, it definitely doesn't only do Pokemon searching on the background from the looks of things.

The new updates are stupid. If PoGo is reading this, which they probably aren't, I might uninstall the app. For one, to many bugs, I can't load the game, and if I do get past the first screen, I always have to update it, in which solves nothing. Number two, to pricy,I had my dad's old account, and I'm glad I switched before the team switch thing was upped in price. Lastly, there's no real reason to play anymore. It's getting old, and nintanic has to do something.

Has become a cash grab. While the game itself has improved since the original launch with more content and less bugs, Niantic has truly gotten so greedy I'll no longer be playing. Previously buying items as bundles was cheaper and I could justify spending a little money. They now for no positive effect are raising the cost of remote raids, meaning I can no longer afford to play eith the friends in other states I've made along the way. We've all decided to delete the app and find something else.

I had never heard of Niantic before, but their game is alot of fun. I hope they keep adding the different generations. Being able to trade pokemon is a lot of fun, I just wish we could trade items as well. Other then those grievances I've been playing since its inception and dont plan on stopping anytime soon.

Niantic is actively sabotaging this game. They DOUBLED the price of Remote Raid Passes while limiting the amount you can do a day. This is on top of numerous other negative changes, such as cutting Community "Days" from 6 hours to 3. This game is also loaded with many, many bugs — even worse than Pokémon Red/Blue in this aspect. Every event (like elite raids) is fraught with technical issues, and it often takes several attempts just to start the app. Niantic is a disgrace to the Pokémon brand.

Elite Raids stink. They're in too few gyms for too short a time, for time periods that aren't player-friendly. What about people who work or study weekends, who don't have cars or accessible transportation? When you make the gyms too rare it really just gets discouraging. Or encouraging for others to tamper with their GPS and spoof. Niantic says they're trying to encourage social interactions, but with how bad this update is, it's more likely to encourage quitting and rule-breaking activity.

Great game. However,,, a lot of bugs. The game is glitchy and online connectivity is horrible. People can not interact efficiently through the game. Online status for many people is wrong, battle or raid invitations show up very late.. For a game this big (and earning that much money), i would expect a lot smoother gameplay and connectivity.

When I first started playing it was amazing! My first review gave 4 stars! Over the years it's slowly turned into a money grab.. and trainers now find ourselves considering options to transfer to home and walk away with as much loss prevention as possible after all we've invested. I still play but not nearly as fun. Feels more like throwing hard earned money away for the developer to tell u why it's ok for them to keep taking your money and not holding up their end of anything.

I played the game back when it launched and still played it on and off up until recently. In short, It's still a buggy game with poor customization options for worsening avatars. It also still suffers from being close to unplayable in rural areas. I love the communities that were built around this game. I also love Pokemon in general and being able to have this link up to the main games was awesome. That's why it pains me to give it the current rating.

Great game, sucks that I have to buy Pokeballs for the game to be entertaining after I run out. But other than that 5 STARS!! Edit: As of a recent update the game has become unplayable, I can almost never even log in, and on the few miracles I do, the game plays normally for about 15 seconds before saying it's not compatible in my device, which is obviously not true. For now, my review stays at 1 star. Edit 2: The game works after getting a new phone but it's unreasonable I had to get it to play

Game was first released as a really fun app that had me travelling everywhere both alone and with friends. Tracking hadn't worked so we used 3rd party tracking as a temporary substitute until they fixed it. Instead of fixing the core mechanic of the game, they removed it entirely as well as the substitute, now leaving you to wander aimlessley around draining your phone's battery. Unless the app is repaired I will not be playing what would be an otherwise good app.

Been playing for several years, recently upgraded to OnePlus 12 and the game keeps crashing out of nowhere (I believe Samsung S24 users are having the same issue). It makes the game borderline unplayable. New review 2019 Edit to 4 stars. I think this game is good and they are putting some effort into improving it. The raid system is fun. Combat could be better. A couple things i think would be great: selling items i don't want for coins (maybe with a limit like the gym earnings). Please just make the default setting non vibrate. Now my older device struggle with the loading process and it lagged a lot to catch up with the HD. Yes, i loved it. My device also still fine. Incredible game. Even in smaller towns, like the one I live in, this game is still fun, but if you want to get into it you should probably go to your nearest city, even if it's not that big. If you ever have trouble looking for pokestops, churches are always pokestops. I have yet to see one that isn't. 8.5/10

Popular because Pokemon. Niantic released a game called Ingress prior to this and it's essentially the same game but wasn't as popular because it lacked Pokemon. The game will continue to fade unless they add player to player battles and trading. Which is what everyone wanted this game to be in the first place

Played the game since 2016 despite so many issues, bugs, glitches etc but its just not worth it anymore. So many positive things about the game have diminished or paywalled. This is a terrible error in how this app caches information and must be looked into ASAP, it's infuriating.

I did have it rated at 5 Stars, had to lower my review because of recent changes. It seems like they're trying to put too many things in the game and it is causing it to slow down and crash a lot. It seems like every other day it has to update for you to play. Very frustrating when all I want to do is catch Pokemon. I don't need a hundred friends to send me gifts and trade and all the other weird stuff they're adding in now.

Wasted over 80 dollars on in game content for most of it to not work correctly. Dont waste your money on this game. I requested a refund or to receive in game currency to resolve this issue. Instead every two weeks I get an automated email asking if my problem has been solved. EDIT-After over a month of fighting with the customer support they finally replaced the items I had paid for to be used in the future. However this game has become completely pay to win and I have lost complete interest.

This game had the potential to be one of the biggest and best games of all time. Unfortunately, Game Freak and The Poke'mon Company left Niantic in charge. Niantic is a terrible company when it comes to communication, feedback, design, development, implementation, and direction. They do NOT understand how to make a fun and engaging experience through the video game medium. Do not play this game - go back and enjoy the original Red and Blue versions instead.

I'm just so done. I finally tried participating in some of the new features of the game (in this case routes) and my route gets rejected for being a unsafe area! It's literally a tourist trail around a lake with Park rangers! Yet sketchy parking lots in the city get approved. I highly doubt a human even looked at the route with how quickly it was rejected. I see no reason to continue putting effort and money into a game where they can't even be bothered to put forth a little effort themselves.

Lost my first account, contacted Niantic on an attempt to retrieve it, never heard back from them. I have to log in several times a day, each time more nerve-wracking than the last. The price gouging on the raid passes and loot boxes is getting out of hand. They manipulate it so you have to buy more coins than is needed for a raid pass (195 for a pass, but you can only buy coins in groups of 100). I shouldn't have to pay 3 dollars for a single pass. Don't bother with this game. Zero stars.

Why can't we transfer many pokemons in the same time with just one click then select (like sharing photos) cause it takes too much time. For the pokemon in sightings, can you add up a radar or just general direction to catch it, it will be more helpful. One more problem in my country, there are too much pokestops in shopping centres or monuments but it makes traffic jams worse, meanwhile in countryside, people are really struggling to play it. Anw thank you Niantic, it's really a creative game

Terrible customer communication, I have had countless passes I have paid for not work for me. Every time I am invited to a raid remotely, it does either one of two things, more commonly, it doesn't allow me access at all, claiming that I am too far away, even though I was invited. The second, is that it let's me in, but once the battle starts, it doesn't allow me to attack, and once all my pokemon are defeated, it kicks me out and doesn't allow me back in, wasting a pass. Waste of time.

I've been playing this game since 2016 and still going strong! There have been many positive changes to the game over the years, but here are a few more suggestions I would like to see: 1. A higher limit on special trades 2. Instead of the "2+" days in my friend list, a more accurate date when they last played, so I have an idea who is inactive so I can better manage my friend list. 3) No limit on coins from gyms. I work hard to put my pokemon in gyms every day, and 50 coins just is too little.

If I could, i would give negative stars. It really sucks when you have a company making as much money as Niantic and they don't have customer service that responds. The app has been stuck for 10 days now. I've un-installed and re-installed several times a day... it's not my device because my friend tried logging in on his device and it's the same. He logged into his account on my device and it works. SO what gives.

I have had to uninstall and reinstall 2 times now. I have lost numerous pokemon balls and characters due to freezing servers. This game is not entirely bad, but the log in issues make it horrible. After some time playing I'm changing my review. it is an awesome game with very few issues now. I'm not sure what all they updated but it works great!

Super fun, a great way to get out of the house and meet people. You can do everything for free, it's definitely not pay to do well but if you decide you want to spend money they will definitely gouge you. You don't even need to know much about pokemon to have fun (although it helps in raids and PvP). I've been loving the new PvP system and it adds new twists on the pokemon I try to catch. The lag during the games are super annoying and and will always cost you the match if it occurs.

The improvements made over the last couple years, immensely improve the game from when it was first launched. The introduction of friends and remote raids actually made this game enjoyable again. I wish they'd come out with new special research tasks more often. But they at least have timed and daily research tasks to keep players busy.

I started playing in the summer of 2017. It was so fun and I absolutely loved it. Come a year later and something happened to my account. It was logged out and unable to log back in. Contacting support took far too long and with no help at all. I gave up on getting my account back and running. I even came back a few months after that to set up a new account, but I was still not able to create a new account.

PvP is a pain. It's a very good way to progress in the game. HOWEVER, i often loose due to bugs/exploits (block with shield but none depleted, more shields used than available, pokemon switching under the minimum time, pokemon just put on terrain using charged attack before being able to attack/spamming...). Stuff like that happens 40% of the time ON A GOOD DAY (sometimes i get stuff like that all the time for days) ! The paid currency you supposedly earn often does not register. Score 5/100

Played this game since the beginning. Niantic has made a lot of bad game changes in the past but the new remote raid changes are the final nail in the coffin. Uninstalled unless the change the prices back to what they were before. Niantic has shown time and time again that they are out of touch with reality and could care less about what their players want.

The collection and exploring aspect of the game is the BEST, but the PvP itself is broken as a concept. Pokémon was always about turn base combat and NOT about a "blind pick" against an opponent where both of you are tapping the scene and praying for a better connections. TLDR: You are collecting monsters but there is nothing to do with them :D Sorry Niantic it's been 4 years and you are still making baby steps.( + new "check if a friend is online" feature drains the battery like a BEAST)

For some.reason I can't seem to.log in. I never had an issue and I noticed that no update was being needed. I've also experienced GPS and lag at.some point but nothing that major, I've sent a report about this when it started. I've reinstalled the app, change accounts, create (well tried) a new account but I'm still unable to log in. What else can.I do? I'm an android user.

Fantastic family entertainment. I have noticed a lag on my phone when there is an event taking place (assumed it's from the servers being overly used during the event). Generally, when it's over, the lag tends to stop. I also a heavy lag when there is an update being released. Here lately, I'm not a fan of only getting certain pokemon or items from the handheld switch. This was supposed to be a fun game to hunt pokemon. It feels like a uneven playing field.

Long time player since day one of the game. The latest update now makes my avatar look nothing like me and more like a lanky ape, totally disgusting and off-putting to look at. There is no longer a difference between male and female types, just one body type, which is unrealistic. If this was an option, it wouldn't be a problem, but this new version has been forced on us and purchased items no longer work and or clip. Unacceptable by Niantic.

I paid for a ticket to get a research for Shiny Diancie and was never given the research. I contacted support and was told they have no record of me making the purchase. Niantic have stolen my money and won't do anything about it.

The thing is, this game would be great if there was any form of consistency to the catch rates. A rare/strong/legendary pokemon i get will be difficult to catch, it's part of the fun. But when it's taking 5+ berries and balls to catch a freakin' Caterpie -well, you see where I'm going with this. Also, i live in a big city and the calabre of the pokemon available to catch is garbage 99% of the time, so i dread to think how awful it is out in the sticks.

Fun for exploration, Terrible for battle I have no qualms with most of the game's mechanics. Overall, it is a decent Pokemon experience. However, every aspect regarding the "battling" system is inherently flawed and screwed up. The controls are stupid and repetitive, especially when you're forced to tap on the pokemon relentlessly to deal damage. And nearly all my attacks don't register in time, let alone give me a chance to deal damage before fainting. The battling should be like the games.

My wife and kids enjoy the game, and have spent a chunk of money on in-game purchases, have played it since it first came out. However, the app crashes all...the...time. With last night's update, it won't even complete loading. Looking online, this is not abnormal. I wish they'd fix the silly thing so it stops crashing, because it makes the experience infuriating, especially when you're trying to trade or do raids.

This game has got my whole family playing and walking outside. It's a cheap source of entertainment. The economy in-app isnt outrageous, provides good value. I would only ask that more in-app tutorials could cover stuff for beginners. Not everything is explained clearly up front and you learn a lot as you play the game more. A short 101 video for each aspect of the game would be helpful. Great job devs, winning concept with this game. Wish more games were like this.

Absolutely loved playing this game, everything about it was fun until I got a notification that someone hacked my game. (2019) I was in the middle of playing the game so the notification disappeared. The next day, Pokémon Go notified me that I had cheated and got my first strike against me! I contacted them and Pokémon Go wouldn't even tell me what I did wrong! Still to this day it takes too many pokeballs to catch anything! People won't wait for me while raiding! Lower shiny rate! & MORE! 😥

I was enjoying playing again but recently I keep getting nothing but freezes and then I have to restart the entire game. This happens when trying to interact with gyms constantly, so I can't even do half of the things I do on a daily basis. Adding that to the increase in remote raid passes and I basically never get a chance to do any raids at all! Disappointing.

I think the game itself is a lot of fun, and its a main driving force to get me to leave the house. However, i cannot support the substantial price increases for the items in the in-game shop. To make it so that a free to play player has to get the max coins from a gym everyday for 4 days to get ONE remote raid pass is awful. (4/3/23) Further more, I've been playing off and on since launch and today i got anaccount strike and a 7 week play ban, and trying to appeal it lead to nothing.(10/26/24)

One star only because cant give less. The game was great, then Niantic disabled the in game tracker, and went after everyone who attempted to   help make the game continue to be enjoyable.  With no way to actually track the pokemon I actually want to catch, the game has become way less enjoyable and the experience not worthwhile.  Maybe Niantic will listen to its customers and make some changes but all in all I recommend steering clear of this company.

Unfortunately the way to gain coins in the game requires you to be on gyms for a set amount of time. Being located in a small town there is a local group that takes down your gym within maybe half an hour of you taking it. This makes it difficult to obtain any coins at all. I also don't really have many friends that I play this with, making legendary raid battles almost completely impossible. It's unfair to those without friends.

When the game actually works, it's awesome. However, right now, the game won't even load my save file. It's done this several times in the past as well. It's completely unacceptable that as much as stuff costs in this game that it's completely unplayable with as much as some people pay for add-ons. This review will remain 1 star until they fix this far too prevalent issue.

While I don't care about remote raid situation, I have 1 huge complaint. I recently got go+ and am playing more. So I catch a lot of mons. And it takes hours and hours to find and delete all unwanted ones. It is absolutely ridiculous to go through 3300 Pokemons couple times a week. There is way to many to do that efficiently even with search tools. This game needs a PC app that lets you manage your collection on big screen/keyboard/mouse. If I can't find solution. Will most likely delete

Relatively fun with friends to play and explore, but the framerate drops often to 15fps, making the already near-impossible raid challenges practically unbeatable and only reliant on luck. It is also apparent that the different Poke Balls seem to have no difference in chance to catch, because I've had (very low-level) Pokemon break free from regular balls and Ultra Balls alike. This game still has plenty of issues that it needs to fix and I seriously hope they get fixed, rather than excusing it due to the Pokemon name in use. Also the connection is terrible

Worst customer support. The distance travelled isn't getting registered for both my buddy and eggs. I've tried playing with other accounts on my phone to check if that's the problem, but it's working fine for any other account. I've emailed the developers and also reported in-game. Its been a week and nothing's been done by them. Its so frustrating to find out that the distance is not registered after walking for 3 kms. Had to quit playing the game before i even got to enjoy it.

Can't really expect much gameplay without spending real money to get what you need to succeed (lucky eggs, raid passes, etc). When players invite me to a raid and I tap their invite, it refuses to let me enter the gym (persistent issue), saying "no groups found with that code". Glitching is starting to get irritating. Update: cannot scan pokestops or gyms as requested. Won't let me pick a team I want when battling balloons, makes me use game-selected team (which never works).

Pokemon is a great, storied franchise. Pokemon Go has the potential to join the main series in greatness, but it's missing a few key things... namely a compelling and fun core gameplay loop. If niantic adds a proper PvP system, Pokémon GO will ascend. But until then, it's a mostly gameplay free infinite grind fest with very little to do. There's potential here, but it hasn't been realized yet.

The core spirit of the game has been lost, it isn't Pokémon "Go" in the sense of go and explore your area and find cool things. It's go to the shop to buy incubator boxes and gamble to get something good. I have felt this way since they took most evolutions away from being wild spawns, made certain non-legends raid exclusive and made some wild spawns almost impossible to find.

The game has a lot of potential, too bad there are a couple major problems. PVP is riddled with bugs and the developers are more interested in making money rather than making the game fun (see e.g. the recent mega evolution mechanic). Also you guys REALLY need to make the egg drop rates public. They are loot boxes for all intents and purposes, so not showing the drop rates is VERY shady (if not illegal).

I would say it is great, but everything is force funded, and none of the shiny pokemon from Pokemon go look any different than their original forms. The events are virtually no different from regular gameplay, so the whole set up is rather disappointing and lack luster. The evolution manner is neat, and the original forms look pretty decent, but beyond that, the game has no real purpose, other than getting large groups of people all in one location, and bank info.

I love Pokémon GO. It's fun, and, who doesn't love certain Pokémon? There is 1 thing I'm not 100% satisfied with: on my oldest field research, A Mega Discovery, my last quest is to battle in a mega raid. I've battled 3 times in a mega raid, and it still hasn't counted it. I'm not sure if this glitch is just for me, or if it's going on with other people, but I do want it fixed. It's starting to get annoying.

Yeah. I was doing nothing while walking to the office and going back home from the station so, why not download the game and play it to entertain myself? The gameplay was constantly evolving and the special events becoming more creative everytime, so there's always something to look forward to. I seldom spent money at the shop because I'm a cheapskate, so I'm actually in a snail crawling speed in Pokemon Go world, spending 3+ years and still haven't achieve the highest level. But that just me.

Pokemon was massive part of my childhood and I think most other kids. Technology has advance so much since pokemon red and blue come out and if my 10 year old self saw this I would be going crazy. But even now as an adult I find it very fun! Great for getting our and about. Already lost weight and even meeting up with friends just to walk around and play. The app itself is very good. Wish they work on them servers crashing but with every game it will keep developing. There is no other game like this out

This used to be a great game but lately all the game does is freeze and crash. Now a days the only thing that works is the store. Event time got smaller while the prices got higher. It's a shame that the makers used to care about the player, but now it's just a cheap cash grab. Go spend your money somewhere else because it's not worth it on this game.

I find this game to be in theory a great community building and cooperative encouraging platform, but in reality it is plagued by real world conflict in physical playability (ableist), fair rewards (pay to play, which has been improved), achievable level growth, and ease of playing with your friends. I will continue to bring these able exclusive issues to the awesome Niantic team. Yes, this is still a nostalgic game worth playing! Just impose your own 6ft rule when visiting Pokestops and Gyms.

They wanted to have a rolling global release. But they didn't account for all the servers, and people they'd need to pay for. Why wouldn't you have that stuff all in place first? I'll increase my rating IF they fix the tracker. The good Pokémon are almost all impossible to find without 'cheating'. So game is unplayable.

Just downloaded the game again after a two year hiatus. The game is still doing the stuff it was when I quit before. I'm still stuck catching the same Pokemon as before. Apparently, the release of new ones has been extremely slow. Anyway, the same problems that drove me from the game before are still there. It'll fill the time but that's about it.

Great original idea: catch pokemon in the real world.  What it has become: An anxiety/FOMO-inducing addiction game, with careful optimizations to get you to spend money. Don't play this game if you have addictive tendencies, it will take over your life.  While Nintendo usually strives to create masterpieces, Niantic sets its goals at "minimum viable product", as startup-speak goes, and builds from there in a business-oriented way rather than forging a brilliant gaming experience. Kudos for trying to get people outside and bring them together, but unfortunately the addictiveness purposefully baked into the game outweighed that, and ultimately caused me to quit.

Updates killed the game Edit: I've been playing this game for most of 2021. It's fun, especially if you have friends to play it with. May 2022 edit: I want to love this game but they keep making changes to make it less fun. Most recently, doing away with the 1 PokeCoin Weekly Remote Raid Pass. And also raising the price of remote Raid passes when they're already expensive. I have family in multiple time zones and we Remote Raid together as a way to bond.

Beyond infuriating. I heard that at some point, Pokemon GO would no longer work on certain phones (regardless of the phones being brand new), and now I suddenly can't install the update to the app. I'm assuming that my issue is that my phone is no longer a part of the "elite" club of iPhones and Samsung Galaxy S#. Bad move, alienating players like that, especially around Go Fest.

Honestly, if this game wasn't Pokémon, it would not have been around as long as it has been. Tis sad. For everything the company does right, they do four things wrong with the management of this title. With a few small quality of life improvements, more generous catching rates, and better planned events, this game could be fun again. And I would love for there to be more ways to play from home. Sometimes, people simply aren't able to travel.

I managed to get into the game just fine but when I went to catch my first Pokémon, they were all in the same place and I was unable to catch any of them. I can't access the menu from this screen to report an issue or ask for help (that's what their website said to do when I went to try find help), I've restarted and reinstalled the game, I've emailed them (got an automatic response telling me to check the website) but I keep coming across the same issue.

So much just doesn't work. Lack of a tracker makes things just so random and sometimes not worth it. Loading issues, server crashes....and the game hasn't even been released everywhere. Customer support non-existant...suppory email goes to a unmonitored address. Expected so much better game play wise after having played Ingress. Disappointed and hope they can make things right.

It's had its ups and downs, but it's finally getting more and more better. Megas aren't terrible now, and the newer Pokemon are making their appearance! It's still fun to play, and there's still a community online, you just gotta know where to look! Another plus is you can transfer your pokemon to Pokemon Home, and then into the games. A WARNING THAT THE TRANSFER IS ONE WAY. The game will warn you about it, but I thought I'd drop it here. Game is a bit too cash shop heavy, though.

Hey, just thought I'd let you know. During this pandemic, otherwise known as world wide emergency, it would be irresponsible to encourage going outside. Maybe allow an opportunity for at least one pokestop equivalent to always spawn within range for now and of course higher spawning if you haven't already. Dont make me believe you'd try to encourage spending money on this for basic level playability. We all know you cant play without pokeballs. You have a chance to do something minimal to help.

I've been playing Pokemon Go for a few years now, and I don't know why - but the game has just lost most appeal for me. I really enjoyed it around the time Let's Go came out for Switch, and the connectivity between HOME and GO. However, in recent months, it just feels like too much money and too much time is needed. A neverending stream of *events* that don't really mean anything, a community that cares more about "shundos" than an actual game to play. It's lost it's community and charm.
This game is fun and all but I git saw someone get run over looking at his phone saying he was playing Pokémon go. This game is gud tho.

Go Battle League is still extremely laggy. And I don't think it's my internet connection because no matter where I am I still encounter problems. I do like the system better now that it's just how many wins you have and not based on who you played against to rank up or down. The remote raid feature is amazing, but I really wish they would increase the limit to how many can be held or purchased at a time.

Used to play this quite a bit, then it started freezing and crashing like crazy. Uninstalled the app and reinstalled it... now I can't log back in at all. Just keep getting the authentication error despite having great wifi and cell service. I am seriously ready to just get rid of it permanently. The game needs a massive update and fix. The developers don't answer either!!

In a mere moment, Niantic has taken their game from a game that I would actually want to play, to one that I wouldn't. Truly impressive. The new character designs are attrosive, and in my opinion, the only thing worse than no character designer or a very simple one with good art, is an in-depth character designer where you can't make a good design.

Fun game with friends. Since initial release the app has been updated and improved in many ways. Community events are fun and frequent. Battles and gyms have become more balanced and it's not too difficult to earn in game currency. Although too much is locked behind that currency. A key item is incubators to walk eggs for hatching. The only way to get these is through purchase via in game currency or if a community event happens to be going on with them offered which isn't always the case.

I am just dissappinted with Niantics lack of communication through the game. I would understand as it is still early in release but because no one is telling us anything many many people are getting turned off from this game, it has too much potential to go down the drain, and this is my fear... Edit. I am still playing this game since it came out and I made this review. Obviously i love it. Changing to 5 stars. I'm sorry for leaving it at one for so long!

For some reason since a few days ago, anytime I try to play with my buddy Pokémon, I get an weird error message saying "buddy_phone_not_ar_capable_title". I don't understand where this is coming from all of a sudden since I been able to play with other Pokémon as buddies for months and all of a sudden this is now popping up. If someone could get in contact with me to give me a fix, I would apperciate it.

This game is really addictive! I've been playing for a few months since I got a new phone that is capable of running it. I just had a two week break from work and spent most of it walking around, catching Pokémon and participating in raids. It's motivating me to get out and exercise when I'd usually be sitting and using my computer all day. I've even met some new friends. Make sure you join your local raid group!! It's good to plan meetups for higher tier raids so you don't have too few people.

In all honesty the game is great but it does need a joystick, a joystick with the ability to move in an area of maybe 500 meters, that way I don't have to go all the way into that dark alley just for a pokemon, or into that house's grounds or even in the middle of the water when im on a bridge, it doesn't even need to count to the km for eggs or candies just for the accessibility issues and to help people be safer.

Game is amazing, always has been and always will be. Raids are tough for folks who work all day, since it's hard to find groups to go with - this limitation also impedes the ability of a mostly solo player to finish research tasks. With the newest update, on my Android s10, i am unable to open the Buddy functions without the game crashing. I'm sure this will be fixed quickly, but it does mean that i won't be able to use these functions indefinitely, which is disappointing.

People keep hogging the gym in my area. If you have no friends, you're not going to be able to beat the three and five star raids, not to mention when there's a raid you can't battle.The gym need to have a second option so you can either battle battle the gym or do the raid and I'm slowly starting to hate this game more and more everyday and the ar camera sucks because it doesn't work properly anymore Please make it better

I love pokemon ❤️ It helps me spend more time outside and explore my town, also good for my health condition. It's just that I encountered many troubles/bug during Pokemon catch. Please this bug asap. Thank you

Tooks photo of Tornadus in the wild for a special ever research which I waited months to see in a raid as it is never in the wild. After taken photos, it didn't register I completed the event. Reported the issue and told to try again and take a photo of this Pokémon in the wild even though the issue was a glitch and out of my control. Very disappointed.

I have been playing on and off since 2016 and just started playing more regularly a few months ago. I was really getting into remote raiding, but unfortunately it's now kind of dead. It was great to connect with people around the world but now it's not only unaffordable but unaccessible. Living rurally, there are no people to connect with for in-person raids and apart from that, it's difficult to catch any of the pokemon needed for research when you just get the same ones day after day. :(

Pokémon GO is one of my favorite mobile games to ever exist. Everything about it is great, like the trainer battles, exploration, and the variety of Pokémon. Despite this, there's a few small issues I have with the game, I feel like it's not optimized the best, the game can lag a lot, adding an option to reduce lag would be nice. Second, no matter how long a Pokémon defends a gym, you only get 50 coins. It could be a week of defending and you only get 50 coins. Maybe fix these 2 things and 5/5.

It's been almost 3 years since my last review which was 3 stars. I had stop playing for a couple years and only recently got back to the game but the Pokemon Go that I came back to is far improved over the version I left. To put things into context, I stop playing shortly before Adventure Sync became an option. Special Missions, Field Research, better ways to interact with friends, and other improvements have has really made this a better game for me.

The core gameplay is a series of rugpulls. It's built in a predatory manner and if it wasn't attached to a beloved franchise, nobody would like it. It has almost no merit of its own gameplay-wise. The "Pokemon" coat of paint is the only worthwhile thing about it. It wastes your time and money and undermines your agency as a player constantly. It is a neat way to game-ify going for a walk, bc of that Pokemon coat of paint, but I can't, in good conscience, compliment the actual gameplay design.
The game initially was lagging a bit but it got better. But, now I can't even open the app without it crashing! I don't want to restart again..fix please?!?!?

The game is alright and I like pokemon. The problem comes from the lack of support and treatment of players the longer you play. Not focussing on poor help/support. The items drop off once you start getting to higher levels and getting certain pokemon becomes difficult if you are not playing this game full time. The events have been reduced and put in extention conditions that dont work more than they do. Paid or otherwise the result is that you lose limited everything. So why buy the passes?

I would give a zero rating if possible. Niantic is nothing less than greedy. I reached out for support when the game kicked me out of a raid and wouldn't let me back in. Sent video support and was told they would not refund me the pass after being refunded *one* raid pass during go fest. There were several times I never asked to get refunded thinking Niantic would get the bugs worked out. Problems persist and Niantic has begun to charge for everything while cutting back on free and useful items.

I think the game is good. I read through some reviews and I have never run into the issue of space or lag in the game. Most of the issues I face or my boyfriend faces is on our phones. Some phones just can't support the game and I am sorry for that. But low budget phones won't do it. A game like this is not made for them and if it were then it would be more similar to the actual games and that isn't what their goal is. But I will say that adventure sync could use some work.

Have completed multiple quests one being the ripple in time evolve a grass type. It never completed in the game. I evolved my sunkern with a sunstone and nothing. I have done this with other quests and put in feedback and got no results or answers if its a system issue or what. Dissatisfied with the way the game is progressing because of these issues and this is just one of the missions that hasnt completed among the others that i have had this issue with

I have good signal, a good phone (edited: MI A1) AND THIS KEEPS CRASHING ON AND ON... Its outstandingly inefficient. Thank you Nintendo. You have plenty of money and you are unable to invest just a bit so It can run properly. GREAT upset. Edit: 2 years later all the networking and GPS errors keep happening.Edit2: 6months later, same issues, love it. I will stop playing it eventually due to the lack of effort invested fixing the game... They dont care. Thanks!

Everytime Niantic does something stupid, I feel the need to make sure my review stays one star. Raising the prices, of remote raid passes, again. Surprised that they're not decreasing the amount of coins players can earn in one day while they're at it. Events don't last long enough, cause the rest of us have a job that isn't playing this game. I submitted a review of 1 star back in 2016. Mostly this was because I was 1) incredibly disappointed with the quality of the AR, which was only as good as a tutorial I ran through in Unity 3D in a few hours, and 2) because some of the core aspects I consider to make a Pokemon game a Pokemon game, fighting in battles, trading Pokemon with friends, etc, were not available. I would like to revise this review now at the end of 2018. The AR, while not perfect, is pretty dang good and engaging. I can battle my wife from our living room. I can battle to take over gyms. I can trade Pokemon with friends. I still like the idea of leveling Pokemon up through battling, and letting my Pokemon battle wild Pokemon, but I'll say I am very pleasantly surprised at the dedication of Niantic to make something great. I generally play nightly while walking our dog, and plan to continue doing so.

Finding an Exeggcute is harder than finding a Sinnoh stone right now.

Pokemon spawn more where there are more people. Since multiple players can catch the same Pokemon, this does nothing but encourage people to go sit at Starbucks or McDonald's all day and outpace people who are actively out looking for them. The distance tracking system has been removed and replaced with a tracker that shows which pokestop the Pokemon is near. That's great if there is a pokestop every block or so. Not so great if you are in the suburbs or farther.

Right now I would rate this a zero if I could. My husband and I both have Android's and mine is constantly making me update to even play, never his. But in order for me to update I have always had to uninstall and reinstall. This last time I have not been able to reinstall. Played first time back in 2016. Functionally it's the same game, few features added and few pokemon generations. Apart from that... The more you play the more annoying it gets. RNG mechanics are especially annoying, designed to waste balls, and depending on where you are it's not easy to replenish them. Especially annoying mechanic is pokemon moving and jumping AFTER you throw the ball. So yeah, there isn't any skill in this game, only randomness.

I love the game, but the game play isn't sustainable for people that live and work outside a metropolitan area. In those areas pokestops are common enough to provide the steady supply pf pokeballs necessary to keep playing (with a few purchases here and there). Personally thefe are only three stops within walking distance of my home and none by my office. Even with an above average yeild of pokeballs I only have about 10 throws per day without paying.

every time i try to use this app, it says failed to log in so i log in again and it lets me. then when i try to catch a pokemon or do a battle, it logs me out again and it doesn't have an update to do. please fix it so i can play the game again.

The avatar changes ruined the clothes I paid real money for. All the body options look like trash. I'm a female and want to look like a female. Not a androgynous blob. F2P use to be decent and I would pay 5-20$ every so often for clothes and pokeballs. But no more. The prices went up. The challenges are too much for a small player base. The bugs are never fixed, we're always ignored. UNINSTALLED FOR GOOD! thanks for wasting my time and money..

I played 2016-17 and took it back up starting in October 2023 to play something free and easy with my 5 year old daughter. We love pokemon so wanted to just enjoy this game. It has come a long way, but still needs a lot of help. Raids are fun, the events are all fun. I enjoy collecting shinies and legendaries. There are in game purchases but they're never necessary. But, the battle league pvp system is so broken that it is enough to lose several stars on a rating, and I hope they fix it soon.

I hate exercising. I hate the gym and working out, but I credit this game for dropping 2 pant sizes, and losing 20 lbs in a month of playing Pokemon Go. I didn't change my diet at all. The game is designed to only really be fun and engaging if you're walking around your own world. I look great, I enjoy and want to go for long walks often in different varying terrain to try and catch different Pokemon. My brains entertained and my legs, waste, and heart thank me.

First off, finding and capturing pokemon and the pokestop system seem to work well. Though it should be more clearly explained how close you need to get and come places like buildings should have larger effective areas. However, the gym battle system is clearly broken. I have tried 3 times and had the app lock up every time when the last defending pokemon should have fainted. I think I successfully reduced the gym's reputation, but that was difficult to tell as the battles never ended properly.

I love this game but this latest update it won't load. I get the loading screen and the bar loads all the way to the right and then nothing. Ah yes, the game that got us all to GO outside, I love this and still boot it up from time to time, You never have to spend money, and can get free stuff by going to Pokéstops, very memorable, I still remember the first catch I made, and would recommend this to anyone who loves Pokémon and needs to exercise. Just watch out for traffic and light poles.

I used to enjoy the game and I'm not sure if it was the latest update or a bug but my friend lost disappeared and a lot of the features are gone and I can't access them anymore. Still enjoyable in 2022! Almost every region is out now. Theres the 'free' way to play, and the 'premium' way to play. Egg incubators and storage upgrades are the "costly" microtransactions but coins can at least be earned through defending gyms (but thats hard to do when early level with low CP mons) and you can only get max 50 coins a day so 'saving up' takes a long time. Ive spent a whole $5 on PoGo in 5 years. I play casually. I just like catching, spinning stops + sending gifts!

I had more stars for this game but then I got a go plus and found out the the catch rate is so low that it is not worth the money. I like it. Only wish you could trade and battle without having to be right beside the other player. I can see where people with lower quality phones could have issues playing, having a option to turn the higher quality background would be great for people. The trading system is awful! Years after first debuting Pokemon go still has major connectivity issues whether on wifi or out and about. This undercuts the fun of everything from EX Raids to the PvP battle format. I wish the game performed better given all the money and time the Pokemon Company has had to fix it but unfortunately they've pushed more flashy content on an unstable base.

it's a fun game. requires you to be active, but everyone needs a little exercise. great community, great experiences. ive made a few acquaintances while playing, making it even more fun. for those wondering why AR mode isn't working, only certain phones are compatible. you'll have to upgrade to a phone with built in gyroscope. regardless, you should try it out. its fun and quite addictive.

Was able to play....but for some reason NIANTIC decided that a phone that is barely 6 years old is 'not compatible' with them anymore. I am updating my ratings... I see more stops in more rural areas...thank you. Also lately I have been having A LOT of problems loading and freezing. At first i liked the ideas and concepts it brought to the table. but honestly this game is just boring. i get it needs money to keep its servers up, so i wont touch on the micro transactions. this game just isnt really that great. it would be awesome to see a better battle system, some better music, i nicer graphic style, and maybe a little more love to the original concepts of exploring to discover things, hide some cool stuff through out the world, this is alots first impressions on pokemon

very great game, runs smooth, would love if they made it like the pokemon games on console where encounters are randomized by randomized I mean where grass has encounters so you don't see the pokemon you encounter

Pretty good. It has much of what you would want if you are a Pokemon purist. So there's little to complain over. Just that the appearance of the characters base design, is unchangeable. Previously loved the game and played almost everyday building up my pokedex and my collection, but with recent changes from niantic it is becoming difficult to do this, with the ban on remote trainers for certain raids, increasing the price of remote raid passes and even making the community day last only a few hours makes this game less of a joy to play and more of a head ache. Niantic continuing to mess with distance, aggressiveness and size of circles for various pokemon when catching. Been playing this game since it was first released in its beta format. I played this game since it released. It was fun and I stuck with it during the boring time. However this game has become a pay to play game. You can't do raids without spending money. Very buggy, crashes multiple times each day, freezes up, poor integration with GPS, bad server connectivity. Overall very shoddy coding. Would not be popular except it says Pokémon. Yesterday was an active day for me and the pedometer on my phone clocked in at a little over 10,000 steps, but Pokemon go says I traveled less than 2k steps (most of them were walked inside my house or my church, so GPS shows I am not moving even though I am). I will continue to play the game, but would adjust to 5-star rating if there would be an update to sync a pedometer with the app as well. Hatching eggs would be so much easier.

The game was fun at the start. But as I play , more of the lags and glitches in battles and in the game in general is annoying, for such a game played by millions all round the world. Until niantic fixes all the problems in this game , it is subpar game compared to how hyped up this game is.

With most apps I get that, but you can't play Pokemon Go from your couch so you spend a lot of time on data. I've had to download updates on my data because I was at the park trying to play and it didn't give me a chance to wait until I got home onto the wifi. I'd have no complaints at all if it just gave you three reminders or something instead of locking up wherever you are until you update.

Honestly not impressed anymore. I live in a very rural area, without wasting a lot of money on gas it is nearly impossible to play this game. No pokestops, no gyms, nothing in my town. The game had been a lovely thing to sink into as a rural player for a while. It got me out and about so much more than other things. I've become more active outdoors and spending time with my children since I started playing.
