If you have been drifting away from the game recently, come give the new Team Rocket stuff a try! It's reinvigorated Pogo for me.

Love the game. Been playin since the game came out. There's lots of things fixed throughout the years except one thing...you can't take your pokemon out of a gym that's been in there for months. I have played this game loyally every day since I started in 2018. It has gotten me through hard times, as well as creating them. I started playing this game day one of release and loved it but felt it wasn't reaching its potential so dropped it. I enjoy the game! I feel that something is missing in the game play. Once trainers can work to train their pokemon more. I feel it will be a better game. I love Pokémon and love the idea, I've been on the app since 2017. Almost 4 years later it's still glitchy and almost unplayable. The game can be fun, the problem is Niantic makes terrible product decisions that in many ways often feel like they are intentionally designed to upset people or incentivize them not to play. Game is great, really. They're behind on the available pokemon. Battle system needs a complete overhaul. Hopefully they continue to improve on this game, though it's been years and the progress is slow. But. Its pokemon in the real world. It gets you active and social. Cant beat that :)

Fun app with plenty to do. Love the challenges and special events. However, it is a huge battery drain even with AR turned off. The daily 50 coin limit also really sucks. It does seem like a relaxing way to scape, I know its a kids game but it does remind you how at any age you can decide to enjoy a game that seems so simple maybe , but with it characters you do travel at the very entrance of your imagination, the very into that street that you walked so many times , suddenly a few steps you dive in , and discover , the homes in the entrance , the bus stop, even the corner store its a distracting game.

I changed my review to five stars in June 2020. Having gone back to the game after couple of years I can say it's a much better game to play than before. I love the game. The game is fun. Especially if you have kids. Mine are 5 & 7 and love playing it with me. The game is not without it's flaws. can be pretty money-hungry in terms of pokemon/item storage, but it honestly isn't horrible. over the past few years they've made it more accessible for people who can't travel all the time to still have a chance to catch pokemon and play the game (i like the daily free incense for that reason) and they've added a lot more trainer appearance customization which is nice. it's also very easy to connect to other accounts. I would give this 0* if I could. Crashing constantly, plus the Niantic money grab is beyond greedy. I played on an off since 2016, every day since lock down. Enjoyed remote raiding which became my main reason for playing. The game is fun, but not always stable. The developers listen to the community and usually change the game for the better. This game is very fun to play. However, there's frequently bugs within the game. It doesn't happen all the time but frequently enough to disrupt the enjoyment of playing the game. Raids often crash or boot someone in larger parties. Incense spawns freeze the game if selected as the spawn expires. Spawns from incense often spawn on top of or at the same location as something else that was currently spawned. The first time I used a poffin for my buddy it didn't reward hearts for walking progress.

This game is great! IF you want to make this game more desirable and worldly involved, create a world section and communication section.

Awesome game to play with friends or family, love the community days they set up. Definitely worth checking out whilst growing yours level up in the game.

I've been playing this game since 2016. When it first came out, it was great. Also, since people are not playing in my city anymore, there's no way to win challenging raids. And about the new routes update, there is absolutely no route anywhere close my city, not to mention all the bugs and glitches in the game.

I've been playing this game since release and I feel like you never fix all of the issues. The scheduling of events is also pretty terrible since it's always Saturday morning to noon, where people potentially have work to do. Also, please fix the raid boss lobby. My family and I sometimes waste raid passes by accidentally creating a new lobby because the time wasn't enough to join the lobby the other players are in.

Was wonderful, then terrible. The game is getting better but still not as good as it was during the first week. Players still can not actively hunt for pokemon because there is no working tracking system ingame. Update 12/2018: Game is slowly getting better but still gets constant bugs pushed out in manditory updates; usually small, but sometimes not. Still no reasonable way for a player not living in larger cities to play competitively with those in larger cities, let alone cheaters.

If you play this game and want to do well, be prepared to spend all your free time doing tasks, pay for events after events, and have no life other than PoGo as you have to basically spend all your free time and weekends and holidays away from family doing PoGo tasks and chores. Be prepared to pay more and more money as you play and when there's certain features that you like, rest assured Niantic will take that away and make it more difficult for you to play and enjoy the game. Don't bother!

So I've been playing GO since the field test went out and I gotta say this might be the most addicting and fun pokemon game out there, not only can you see pokemon in real time locations but you can also catch and battle them :D this is for the casual and the hardcore players. Take it at your pace and just have fun with it. If you plan to stay out long make sure you have a portable charger or take your charger so your phone won't die while catching those diglets!

Pokemon GO's biggest flaw is that it's barely a Pokemon game. It's more like Niantic took an existing game and wrapped it in a Pokemon skin. It has familiar elements, like gyms, battling, and the pocket monsters themselves, but little in the game operates in the way it does in the main Pokemon games. The result is substantially less entertaining. Watching the trailers provides a more thrilling and immersive experience than the game itself. Also the character customization is bad.

wth are these graphics? I just redownloaded out of nostalgia. With the new updates before the last one many of the problems had been resolve like the gps, the crashes of the app and the problems to log in. Could be great, but isn't. Massive release hype. Loyal playerbase for years. Spin off of a beloved classic series. Niantic focuses on meaningless new content pushes that often involve/rely upon the same broken game mechanics and cost the player money to advance quick. Test your impatience with Pokemon GO!

This game has fixed every little nitpick i had with it from when it first came out. I can now hatch eggs and get candies without keeping the app open, pokemon battles are actually enjoyable (team rocket GO fights are fun and eventually require some thought into what pokemon to use), there are challenges that feel good to complete, and there are various new pokemon to carch and collect. Its a great passive play game, and anyone who got bored of it i'm sure will now find something they like!

They ruined my pokemon trainer... My character looks hideous now. What happened to the classic design? 1-star until this gets fixed. Character avatar designs should never drastically change within the same game over unavoidable updates. There isn't even an option to revert back to the classic style! There is also no option to easily pick between the boy and girl trainer like before. Not only did they change the 3D models, but they changed the way the menu selection works for editing the trainer.

Sometimes the game runs smoothly, other times it doesn't. It's rather frustrating. Too many bugs and other issues. Biggest issue: throwing mechanics. Should have been fixed this years ago, especially, for raids. Just awful. Makes me feel like I'm wasting my time and resources. And, assuming you can hit the raid boss with the very limited premium balls they give you, chances are low you will catch the Pokemon even with golden razz berries. Refund players their remote raid passes for failing to deliver on good mechanics and absurdly low catch rates Time to play a different game.

Lower the game's weight so it's better on 1GB/2GB RAM phones. I can play it on my Asus Zenfone 2E, but freezes a lot, lags 100% of the time, I get black screens, crashes, and random location hopping. It's cool to see that your game looks fancy and all that, but it's better to get good gameplay and ok graphics, than good graphics and almost null playablity. It would benefit all phones around, including high-end ones. At least try and add an option to lower graphics quality.

This app has been the dream of every kid from the 90s. Despite the server issues. this game really does bring people together. Even for being just the initial release, with the international release not finished yet, I can't stop playing it. I'm so ready for some bomb ass updates.

I Love Pokemon, but it took forever to get trainer battles started when... that's the main point of Pokemon. That's how the masters were exhibited. Then getting currency for the game as well as other power ups... there should be many multiple viable ways of finding game items, balls, etc... It should have been Pokemon taken from the cartoons and movies and brought to real life.

Honestly my favourite mobile game ever, but it is just a shell of what it could be. Broken features like adventure sync, a lack of playability for rural players, issues for ppl with disabilities, and just overall cash grab mechanics make me sad. I have gotten so many people to play, but I don't recommend this game to anyone anymore, and I am a little ashamed when people who know I used to play a lot being it up. during a taken over event rocket balloons were not appearing other than on their 6 hour mark customer service as usual blames the player for not looking hard enough. the next day after the event rocket balloons popping up way more frequently not the first time the player has been blamed for absolute garbage customer service and glaring game issues

Refuses to open beyond the initial "be aware of your surroundings" message upon launch, force closes itself every time despite strong wifi connection and having the latest update. Used to be great. Especially since I lived in a city. With the recent changes plus having moved to a more rural location I can't take part in as many gym battles. This game is awesome. My whole family plays it whenever we are out and walking. I love all the shiny Pokemons and the hundos. This game have giving any issues unless it's time for a new update. Once I update the game it works perfectly fine for me. Thanks Niantic.

The updates are slow and they don't listen to their customer base. They have lost so many players do to slow response or no response at all. This former review was from 2017. Absolutely addictive. I do a lot of walking lately, and a coworker talked me into downloading the game. And I love the postcard feature! If you have friends in the games from distant locales you can see little bits of their hometowns and local culture you may otherwise never know existed!

This app really lets you immerse yourself in the Pokémon world! You can customize your character, catch your partners in picture mode (which allows some creativity lol) or a standard encounter background, you get analysis from team leaders about the EV stats, get to have access to already established in game items from the series and with their consistant updates you can look forward to unlocking more Pokemon! In game purchases are also available and don't break the bank! CAN'T WAIT FOR MORE!

Rewards are broken. Explained to customer service and was told I needed to complete and collect rewards in time frame. It was based on adding friends. I traded a perfect pokemon from one account to another and it got weaker. This mechanic is absolutely stupid and it needs to be removed. Where's the incentive in trading? While I do genuinely enjoy this game, I'm giving it a 1 star rating to spite this ridiculous gameplay mechanic.

painful to play, need to keep restarting - have to do this a couple times a day: 1 chose to login as a different user, then close the app, 2 in settings->apps & notifications, select Pokemon Go, force stop, 3 in settings->apps & notifications, select Pokemon Go, storage, clear cache. 4 now start the app. This seems to happen when the wifi goes out of range or is turned off. my game constantly freezes!!!! no updates available. grrrrr. this is so aggravating 🙄. and I mean it freezes EVERY TIME I GO BACK TO IT AFTER IT'S BEEN IN THE BACKGROUND FOR EVEN A FEW MINUTES. LIKE HELLO. FIX IT

I had been disappointed by this game when it first came out but they seem to have addressed almost every single criticism i had with the new updates. It encourages gamers to get out and exercise, i walked 45kms last week because of it which saves sitting down for hours. I feel really fit and healthy at the moment!

Went from something fun, helped enjoy exercise to free data collection full of dark gaming tactics. Constant events drown out seasonal, habitat & nests pokes, missing one for your dex? Penalized for not playing daily, weekly research for nothing worth it, poor paid "bundles", QOL removed to force you to play THEIR way to collect location data and spend. I have since found out this happens regularly. It would cost them nothing to fix this, but they choose to do the wrong thing instead.

Game has some moments where you think they've learned their audience and improve things but the months later they say "opps we misspoke". This game gives me so much pleasure! You can make many friends to give gifts, battle, or trade with! They also keep adding new things on a unknown basis, but it's frequent! I like that! I also like that you can catch really high level Pokemon without having to lower its health! This game is fun! I recommend this for anyone who's a fan of catching Pokemon!

Where are the streets? Over the weekend, I was driving along and when I got to a red light, I looked at my screen and the streets and structures were gone!! I've been playing for days without the map displaying anything but open green fields. Other players mentioned clearing player data, but you'll lose your battle teams AND there's a chance it'll glitch again. So doing it multiple times is not going to happen. As someone who has played since day 1, I can truly appreciate how far along this game has come and how much Niantic has added to the game to keep it fresh and exciting. I hope this game continues to grow and will be around for many more years.

This does offset your sense of isolation in the game in rural areas somewhat. The gym locations are rigid and currently require you to play a separate title provided by Niantic called Ingress. There is also no official platform for communication and organization between players so they have a tendancy to rely on social media platforms. Even with a couple of drawbacks this is simply the best collecting game out there. With the Pokemon lore backing it up and significant graphical polish I find myself still keeping up with it every day.

After playing this game for 9 years my account was stolen. After attempting to contact Niantic for over a month I am told they cant find my information despite my having receipts from my transactions. Ultimately if you want to get a specific pokemon to transfer over to switch it is not a bad idea, but all progress can be lost overnight never to be recovered again.

It was fun while it lasted. Everyone except for whales are being pushed out of the game. Frequent complaints that have been around since launch have never been addressed, items have gotten more expensive or entirely disappeared, and changes that made the game better for lots of players have been rolled back. From the moment you open the app you're overwhelmed with FOMO by a company that has showed time and time again they don't care about their own hard won community. Really, such a shame.

The game is great but the fact that the servers are down at least 50% of the time makes the game unplayable and makes it hard to keep up with other players ruining the game. 7/17/16 Started playing again out of the blue 3 years later and the game in total is actually worth playing only complaint is the new adventure sync is never working properly. 5/15/2019 played for a while, the new battle mode is fun but the servers are always done and getting cheated constantly making it unplayable so done..

The number of updates are a little annoying, and I wish it were truer to other Pokémon games (e.g. having to weaken a wild Pokémon in order to catch it instead of just bludgeoning it with pokeball after pokeball). My greatest frustration, though, is that it records my walking but not my running. I run 15+ miles a week, but because of my pace, it thinks I'm in a car. So, those 15+ miles per week don't count for s***. There aren't words for how frustrating that is to me.

The recent changes by reducing the distance of poke stops and gyms have made it very difficult to play. I will not be doing the Eevee community day. Will not spend 99 cents on a game they have made very hard to play. I have been playing since 2016 and earned my XP the hard way. I am now level 47 with very good overall stats.

Pokemon Go is an excellent app, for the times we live in. Get kids out and active, walking around. It's good to do. There are almost no bad things about it. The few things that are, are also a product of our time: less and less people around, bad planning, and odd things coming out. Given all that, this is the only game app that has stayed on my phone since I discovered it, ages ago. I love it and can't wait to see what happens next.

I am disappointed about how one of the recent updates turned Adventure Sync off. The fact that this was done without warning means that for more almost a month I've made very little progress steps-wise in game, despite having walked a substantial amount during that period of time. I can let Adventure Sync turning off on its own fly, but not letting your player community know that this happened / could happen is unacceptable.

I've had this game since it was released. It has had bugs but it hasn't been nearly as glitchy as it used to be in the beginning. The game has developed so well! and it isn't tailored for those who are level 40+ and can only make it to certain events at certain times anymore (mostly). As an always busy player who sometimes logs in once a day just to keep my streak, I feel valid and have fun still.

Been playing on and off since 7/6/16 with 141,506 Pokémon caught. Whats the worst change to this game? Remote pass prices. I stopped playing for 2 years because of that. Keeping 1 star until the price comes down. Ridiculous.

Reinstall again after more than one year break and this game has just become more attractive. But it's kinda difficult to nominate a pokestop. And please do take some serious action for those flyer/spoof/fake gps player.

If you like catching pokemon it is fun. Can be a nice addition when outside walking or on break. But.. If you like battle.. it's one of the worst gaming experience around. From the "weak connection" errors to the rigging of go league battles, its beyond frustrating. Winning a battle can still be counted as a loss. Happens quite often. Making suggestions or bringing up game breaking issues results in Niantic just giving out a free pass and they close the ticket.

This game is really addicting with it's idea of exploring the open world out there, but it just doesn't have the same kind of action that I'm looking for on Pokemon go. I mean I love Pokemon and i like hunting for them but it's no fun if I have to meet up with someone to battle. Will it be ok if there was a Pokemon league to battle in? Battling trainers and there Pokemon around the world, without having to find anyone else playing the game nearby, it could really help without us having to walk to a gym that's not there or too far away. Game is requiring a second startup in order to properly start running, and is often crashing after a few minutes. Issues I haven't experienced before on an Android device in the ten years I've played the game. Please look into this!

Price of items to $$$ for what it is. Get bombard with notification. Bags are way to small. And yes you buy extra slot for but fills up with pokeballs I'm about 2 minutes. The devs have a knack for making absurd and confusing decisions that often only hurt the gameplay experience. It's a great game, amazing twist on the classic Pokémon style. However the main problem I have is the lack of ways to earn coins. You can only earn 50 coins per day and when the prices of raid passes are nearly 200 coins it's extremely difficult to be free to play. And your almost required to pay for events and storage etc to be able to enjoy the game at its fullest.

The game app sucks more every day. it always gets stuck, now. Moreover, it always happens when I try to put my pokemon into a gym, which makes me lose the chance after restarting it. And legendary Pokemons with good IV are nearly impossible to catch. Love the game, but the animations are so long. Usually, animations on other apps and games only last for 500 ms. In this game, they last for like 15 seconds. It's very annoying. I think trading, opening gifts, gifting, sending friend requests, catching Pokémon (things you do multiple times a day) should not have these convoluted animations.

It was fun at first but a bit buggy. With every patch they have whittled away at the fun and emphasized the bugs. This is a cash grab game about finding crashes with the occasional appearance of a stray Pokémon. The nearest spawn from me is over 5 miles away, as is the nearest Gym/Pokéstop. Terrible 0*

Whenever a legendary appears on screen, I can't catch it. Even with all the precautions (curve throw, golden razz, ultra ball, and excellent throw). Turns out the only way to have a decent chance at catching one is to pay for master balls. And it's not specific to just legendaries, any Pokémon above 2000 CP is impossible to catch.

They don't care about the users. After 150k catches and being 10M XP away from lvl 50. I've decided to be done. I loved this game but over the last 2 years it has been poorly managed at best. extreme battery killer! Great way to kill time and get out and exercise. Not playable. Anytime I try and open it, it says it has crashed. Even deleted and reinstalled. All my software is up to date. Been playing this for years without issue.

Came back 4yr later to notice that you get trash from completing the 7 research daily. I love this game and I've seen it develop over the last 2 years, but it has taken a massive beating, the catching of pokèmon feels very sluggish now as opposed to how it used to be, and now in the GO Battle League, for some reason my pokèmon's fast moves just don't work as they should, an example being if I use Dragon Breath or Water Gun, instead of it being the usual 1 turn fast move, it does one attack, stops, one attack, stops, same with all my other fast moves, which costs me matches.

out of other pokemon games by pokemon company this one is the best. deleting the game because all the new updates have really put a damper on overall play. There are tons of glitches now that never existed before. I don't understand why they keep making the game worse. I keep thinking they are going to realize their players don't like any of the changes they make, but they seem to be completely oblivious/indifferent. There are way too many overpriced and uninspired special research tickets. They have made remote raids way more expensive. Event times have been cut. The only positive from all these changes is I have more time to do other things. I rarely am excited to play.

Been a huge Pokemon fan since, well forever. Played the game on launch and picked it back up couple months back. Some things about the game are awesome and others kinda sucks. Pros: -You can catch Pokemons from mixed generations. -Play anywhere.* -Doesn't take much data to play. -Continuous updates + Various events. Cons: -The play anywhere feature is kinda bs since you won't get much spawns if you aren't somewhere with lots of cellular activity. -Legendaries are caught mostly through raids which requires many player to fight the same pokemon to then be able to catch it. But completing such raids in small towns or places where there aren't many players is basically impossible. Therefor you can never get legendaries.. -The pay to play ratio is too high in my opinion. Don't get me started on the battle system. Might aswell say battles are non-existent. TL:DR: Game is good, But be prepared for much deception if you expect to play a bit and actually get some nice pokemons.

Soon after launch I would have given 4 stars. It's honestly a fairly mediocre game but the Pokemon skin is what makes it alluring. Then thought it would be a wonderful idea to shut down 3rd party sites like Pokevision which were the only thing keeping the game playable. Now all you can do is aimlessly wander 3 city blocks, not knowing if you're any closer to that Vulpix.

Until EX Raid Passes are fixed to where spoofers are no longer the only ones receiving them, the game where you "Gotta Catch 'Em All" provides no enjoyment. 5/11/23: Outdated and lifeless now, and still fishing for your money as much as ever, if not worse. It was fun for a little bit on a brand new account, but really anything good is tucked away behind Raids. As many issues and as little documentation as before.

Nowadays the game crashes and has to be started multiple times during my typical 30 minute play session. Good response to the covid situation and lockdown, even if you are trying to make a money still... 1 coin bundles but not free. Fun for a while but very buggy. I really love this game. And it just keeps getting better. I would however like to see the trading aspect expanded on. I have friends pretty far away who play this game and we love to trade pokemon. the skin is really falling off throughout the years. it hasn't really had any of the player base since 2016 I live in a very large city and I've only ever met two other people who play this game. there's a lot of things in this game that you can only do with other people so there's a game play elements that you're not able to participate if you can't find anyone. it doesn't matter though because this game is used to train pathfinding AI without user consent.

Reward Pokecoins for achievments alongside gyms, & you'd have a pretty fantastic game here - Even as is, this game has improved vastly since I last played in 2017, very impressed😎 Additionally, lowering the requirement to make Pokestops + routes would breathe new life into rural areas. Very fun!!,& Very addictive!!. they have added a lot of new things to the game and they are continuing to add more with each update you do have to update frequently and it doesn't automatic update when there are new events going on with the game. you not only are a solo player but you were also playing with other team members face to face or battling with them anywhere you are depending on your friendship level with them.battles and special events frequently, and Community Days once a month!5*

Whether this is your first Pokemon game or not, the virtual monsters are fun to catch, battle, and show off to your friends. Have loved it until yesterday. I got into Go way late but have absolutely loved it. It's had a few minor bugs but they've generally been fixed. great game, fun grind, just wish I could open all gifts at once

Changing my review to a 1 star. Niantic has made changes that jeopardize the health and wellbeing of players during a global pandemic. The 80 meters distance for interacting with poketops and gyms, should be permanent. More accessible.

This app/game has become too much trouble, it's wasting so much time and money for nothing - as nothing has changed in the past 4+ years (besides new pokémon that everyone else has gotten - no wonder none of my friends/family play, when it seems to be set up for some people to succeed). Og hard-core player here. Thousands of dollars spent on my account. LET US SPOOF please. It's amazing how you can catch so many different Pokemon everywhere you go! Good game overall and really great graphics, it has no ads and is great competitively or casual, my only concern is it gets boring over time. Also shinies are awesome.

Great Game! Edit: Still great after 1 year. The only problem for me us the inventory space. I run out so fast because I play so much. I personally think that it should be infinite. I also run out of poke-a-balls really fast, I think that there should be more pokeballs in a pokestop Tbh. But this game is still great so Its still five for me! I recommend you get this game.

Don't play this game, just dont. It relies so heavily on random chance to get garbage items to evolve worthless pokemon and its unexceptable! How a game this basic relies so heavily on a randomization system is almost crazy! Pokemon show up randomly and thats fine, but necessary items that rarely show up and I mean RARELY, like a yeti sighting rare, is a good definition of bad game design and execution.

Logged in today & realized my character was different. Niantic spends far too much time blocking sites that can track pokemon, mainly because they have no idea of how to achieve this. The game started off brilliantly, fun and exciting everytime it vibrated but now it's boring and stale. Fix the in game tracker and listen to your fans. I'm sure your frequent player numbers have dropped substantially in the last months and will keep dropping unless you fix up!

This game glitches so many times that I'm not even joking. I couldn't log in multiple times. It's just been sitting on my phone for over 6 months, and it won't let me log into my account. I re-downloaded it over 5 times, but I just ended up deleting it. I feel since November 2024. It has had more bugs than ever. Please fix the bugs!

The game started fun. I really enjoyed it during and just after lockdown, but Niantic keeps pushing up prices for the best features of the game and I do not intend to pay an arm and a leg for something that used to be given to us for free once a week. The remote raid pass issue needs to be fixed.

Pokémon itself is great, but there's many game functions this game is missing. And because of this, this game is time inconvenient. Overall it's not a bad game at all. If you have the time to be outside 24/7 to go to gyms and stops, then this is your game. If you don't like to have some form of communication in game, then this is your game. At the very least I'm sure you'll like the game because it's Pokémon.

Wont load most of the time and really slow, but it may just be an overloading of the servers i give it about a week to get everything running smooth. Edit: this was originally posted on 7/7/16 when it first released, and it has since become my most played mobile game and really the only mobile game I continue to regularly play. It's a great game and not intrusive with microtransactions with a dev team that keeps it going. This is peak mobile game.

The adventure sync feature is utterly useless, even with the fitness app they force you to install. Also, when you seek help, they leave you in a chat room with a bot (with poor ai), and when you indicate you need to speak to a person, you don't get a response for hours. The adventure sync gypped me out of over 50 kilometers, which adds up to many eggs, the chance to catch a riolu and a ton of effort. Awful service and sub-par app. Do not get this.

In game support is a complete insult to the people who play this game. If you experience an issue that's a result of a problem in the game, support will basically refuse to solve your problem in a meaningful way. They have almost no options to speak to an actual human being so all requests just get denied and you can't do anything about it. Highly anti-consumer.

The new graphics are absolutely horrible!! Seems like the higher in levels you are, the less rewards you get! Stop updating and fix the hundreds of bugs! I'm so very disappointed! As a mystic team member (level 37) I've been playing since the beginning. I was already annoyed that I had to walk to evolve my pokemon like the rest of the people who've been playing since the beginning. this past week really upsetting. I have caught 3 Charazade's in the wild!!! then hatched a lugia a shiny no less

This game used to be fun but now it's becoming pay to play. Everything costs money now, if you want better pokemon. gone are the days where you battle to get them. Now it costs just to try and get them. New updates make this game not worth it.

-edited review- got back into the game and so many new features have been added! very addicting and not age limited! (i mean obviously babies cant but my 2 yr old can) with everything being added, it made it even more interesting, but i gave it 4 stars because some things could be different with some catch rates/shiny rates. overall wondeful game that gets you active and out in your community.

What a downhill fall for Niantic, who has made inexcusably bad decisions while not adding much-needed features. The shop items are obviously baiting players into spending real life money, all for overpriced items (remote raid passes) that won't guarantee a catch. Seriously...195 coins for one remote pass?! I uninstalled this miserable app and won't reinstall until Niantic greatly improves their customer experience.

I really like this game! I've been with it for a short time and i'm already in love with it. It gets me up and moving. I have been walking more in a week than in nearly 3 weeks before I got it! Catching pokemon is fun, everywhere from using the right balls and berries to the little 'ding' once you catch them. The game is frequently updated, which is nice. A big complaint I see is crashing. I don't get it a lot, but it is still annoying. Overall, it's an amazing game that WILL get you walking!

I remember playing this game a lot when I was in secondary school(high school) and the game was fine, but when I started playing again during my college years, now the adventure sync didn't help keep track of the walking distance, especially if I want to hatch Pokémon eggs, it won't track the distance. GPS is also on, along with my data and it still won't track. Not only that, this game also drains most of my battery despite having battery saver on the game.

The game is interesting and gets you out and about, but the app has some major issues. The most notable issue is the recurring Failed to Login prompt, after which your only option is to Clear App Data and hopefully you remembered your password because it clears all of your settings including credentials. Another is it now seems to require a rather high end phone as the Nexus 5X only barely runs the more recent updates. The 5X's 2GB RAM won't let you multitask between any other applications while playing the game (it used to) and most likely filters down to the other recent issues like unreliable Pokemon GO Plus connections and constant 'GPS Signal Not Found' errors, meanwhile it's sunny outside and Google maps and U-Blox have no satellite locking issues.

The updated avatars are horrible. Usually, I don't pay that much attention to my character unless it's at least Fallout 4 level of customization, especially as a girl who's used to playing since the 90s with few options (if any). This though... it hints at being inclusive, but falls massively short. I'd rather have no options than be teased like this.

This game is a chore that wants to nickle and dime you. For every hour I spend catching Pokemon, I feel like I spend 2x that managing inventory & figuring out what's worth keeping. You can buy more pack space so you can let the clutter build longer, but eventually you're managing inventory. Want to hatch all those eggs? $. Want to participate in events every couple of weeks? $. Just buy a real Pokemon if that's your thing, or gameify walking with something less tedious.

The game is great, but I bought coins and tried to buy a bag for storage and it never have it to me. I went to support and the only thing it said was to wait a few days and see if it loads. I've waited for a few days now and nothing's happened yet. I even uninstalled the app and resigned in to see if that works and my bag still wasn't there. It's a really fun game to play, but when something goes wrong it's hard to find support or answers to your issues.

Lately have been having massive problems with GPS error 11, and nothing has helped. Unplayable for most of my day. Overall though, we finally have the features that should have been there from the start. Friends list. Trading. All we need now is being able to battle friends one on one.

Don't download, and definitely don't give them your money. Niantic is in the middle of a money grab, while also giving a huge middle finger to what used to be a loyal community. The bigger they are, the harder they fall, and I hope Niantic crumbles for what they're doing. Losing what was once my favorite game sucks, but it'll be no big deal if they don't reverse these greedy and restrictive changes.

Just like what the other reviews mention. Lots of bugs, lag and issues. Input lag and overtuned enemies make enemy battles (not other players) too hard. Then they have a hidden soft ban which can activate, preventing you from catching anything or spinning stops. Their customer service won't help with anything either. Trading is all random and more often than not give you a downgrade in stats. Also, isn't it odd how all these reviews and there are no dev replies? Really shows how little they care

The current app is so buggy that one shouldn't even call it a beta. The energy consumption is just of the chart, leading to an incredible heating up of the smartphone. Crashing or freezing of the app is rather a standard. Add not being able to log in a couple of times a day for good measure. This is actually quite an achievement seeing as the makers are supposed to have gained experience with apps like this through their Ingress game.

It's a great game, I play every morning when I walk my dog. The only thing I would change is the friend/gift system. A multi select option is needed! Especially after increasing the amount of friends you can have to 400. There are 4 different animations just to open a single gift. if you have 50 gifts to send and/or receive, it makes it worthless because you spend most of your time with the gift system. Rather than walking, catching pokemon, gyms, or joining raids.

please please please please PLEASE add a way to get rid of max particles, they are so easy to overfill on and too hard to spend and make completing the "To The Max!" special order completely impossible. PLEASE add a way to just get rid of excess max particles

It's getting worst every update. Long animations does not bring thrill anymore, rather, it gives anoyment. Because of that I cannot play well while in pasenger mode because almost no pokemon that appears, cannot spin a gym or pokestop and start a battle. The lack of pokestop and gyms in a lot of areas. And they even remove the free remote raid passes.

good but buggy. ever since I got the latest update I haven't been able to get my steps tracked which breaks my heart as I could have hatched 3 eggs by now. I also noticed that I'll have my character surrounded by Pokemon and then suddenly they'll disappear and after a few loading spins they'll pop back. I hope this can get fixed soon as the original reason I stopped playing was because of having to keep the app running to get the kms in.

I have been trying to update it for a month. I even have auto-update on. It's the only app I allow to automatically update. I had to restart the update 4 Times because it never got past the installation part. It never said there wasn't enough space either. Raids are even harder 3-stars raid I use to be able to do solo. You need 5 people now. I'm no longer interested in playing. I'm not spending money to buy coins for raid passes. You use to be able to get a daily raid pass at a pokéstop.

this game disconnects music when you run it, doesn't matter the app, I've tried even disabling the vibration yet the game still doesn't allow me to play music in the background, the game is boring without it and makes it unmotivational

I play daily. The game is best when you can play with family or friends. Sure it has its glitches and bugs, but what game on this scale doesn't? Sometimes it gets aggravating and this game does hate me. Never giving me shinys during events. Ugh. I have never played a game for my phone this long before. And I have meet many new friends and nice people playing this game. I find that if you come across Pogo players of your same team, there great and will show you all the tricks. Gotta catch em all!

The game is highly addictive. Unfortunately, the server is finicky & tracking nearby Pokémon is hit or miss. 10k eggs r ever elusive & the higher ur ranking the more difficult things become 2 catch including CP 100's w/ Ultra Balls ... 1600's ok but CP 100's (seriously). U get addicted so u end getting over it but it's kinda ridiculous. Only other quam is u must chose a team or u miss out on certain aspects of the game. Guess there were no loners in the series that were contenders.

The game is great and it has a lot of nostalgia for the older trainers. There are server issues and such, but honestly you need to be patient. I've also seen a lot of complaints about this app not being a "true" pokemon game. People, this is not 100% like the other pokemon games. Think of this as a new game in itself. This is pokemon's way of getting people to get up and feel like trainers. You go out and catch pokemon and level them. Also, money is not required. I've been on 60 to 100 pokeballs.

Good game overall. My main problems would probably be that it needs to be a little more engaging but I have no suggestions as to how to accomplish that. Additionally there's this weird problem it seems to have whenever I defeat a gym where it says that all my Pokemon whited it out even though I won. (Annoying but not necessarily harmful) ALSO if it could run a little bit faster that would be great....and maybe if it let you do some things without Wi-Fi?

Most incompetent company so far I thought cod was bad for a triple a game but this is a mobile game I play mostly go battle and after this last (update) the game just crashes mid battle ( normally in a perfect battle where the odds was on my side) and it doesn't let me back in until I lose the battle, with how much money they're making and how more greedy they're getting this is unacceptable, not even something in place for when the game crashes to be recognized by some algorithm and not lose.

Throughout my years of on and off play, I have concluded across multiple devices that this game sucks. OK so I rather have control of when I hatch eggs. I stopped doing that because I'm struggling with a lack of space. When will I have that control?

Im not one for normally leaving reviews but feels this time it is needed. Any time there is an event, the server crashes. Graphics are pretty, menu system is trash, particularly the item menu. The game is fun, if you have other people you can play with. Rural areas supposedly have no PokeStops or player base, making raids impossible. I wouldn't know from playing heavily populated cities. No long distance trading is stupid.

Can you fix your game please, adventure sync needs work. every time I hit an excellent throw, they break free, but the next throw is garbage, and it gets caught.... Galaxy Ultra25+

I love this app so much and I am not surprised about it having any bugs because of how new it is but it is kinda annoying that when I logged out and tried to log in with my trainer club id it won't let me and it actually lovked me out and I know I wasn't getting the info wrong cause when I got on the actual pokemon website it worked. Once fixed will change to 5 stars and other than that keep up the great work.

If they want money, this is not the way to get it.

Greed took another one of my favorite games. I've been playing since day one, but will no longer support this game in any way. I know 400.00 a month doesn't mean much to them, but hey, if we all stop, then maybe they'll stop taking advantage of us.

I really love this game (but I can't give it the whole five-star yet) whenever I'm bored walking around I can just pull out my phone and play Pokemon Go, it keeps me entertained and it's great to play with friends. Me and my boyfriend play on a daily basis and we really like it. We even have little dates where we just go battle gyms and play around together. Now, it's good and all but there's only one tad problem. My avatar is cool and all but can I change her hairstyle? It gets boring seeing the same old hairstyle, I wish to give her something new. I wish there was a option to pick different hairstyles. If this gets fixed I'll definitely rate it it's full 5 stars. But thank you so much for this game and for fixing the problems! (Ok I even love the fact that even when I'm not in the game it still registers how much km I've walked during the day!)

Worst tech support I have ever dealt with. I have had issues with the game freezing, crashing, or not loading at all. This has been happening since the release of the game and has spanned at least 6 devices, but Niantic refuses to admit that it is anything but a device issue. My friend can login and use their account on my devices with no issue at all, but according to them, it's a device issue. No. -2020 update: Same issue never resolved.-

Enjoyable game. My only issue is the one and only pokestop in my rural small town is not at the correct location. I've tried contacting Niantic about it several times but I never get replies. I still enjoy the game even if I can't use the one local pokestop. UPDATE: It took a few years but the pokestop has been moved to its correct location and a second pokestop was added to the area!

I do really love this game, and the the franchise as a whole. But pokestops are lacking at my place, although there are many establishments here now compare than before and some local landmarks and its not up to date. also there is a pokestop claerly on water thats is too far away which represents a port yet from the dock. as well as gyms that are to far from the community itself that takes long days for people shifting the current gym masters

Played this game for years upon years (I'd say even since the game was released) and until recently it's been an amazing experience. Recently I got pokemon go on my new phone (a Motorola for others who may be having the same problem) and ever since Pokemon Go has been extremely prone to crashing and not loading properly. Not sure if anything can be done but it's very disappointing since I really enjoy this game.

I played when this game first came out and ended up quitting after a while. My wife started playing again so I joined her in the beginning of 2023. There are a lot more Pokestops and Gyms now making it far easier to play without paying for anything and they let you earn 50 coins per day just by leaving pokemon at the abundant gyms. There seem to be events several times per month as well. All in all, a very fun experience but I hope they eventually make it easier to raid remotely with randoms.

4 star for couple reasons. I love pokemon, this game is a way to be active. Pokestops give little Items. Increase amount of items gained when rank increases plz. Ditto is near impossible to find.. been playing since 2016 only caught like 4 dittos. Catch rates are lacking. Medals increase catch rate but I dont see a difference. Still takes 5 - 20 balls just to catch 1 pokemon sometimes. Raids are difficult, lots of raids not enough people please make easier for solo. Game is fine not the best

Overall, this game has been fun for all those drunk nights. (During the summer of course.) Please allow us to be more interactive, Niantic? I want to see my buddies. I want what they do to affect me, within proximity. If they place incense all friends nearby should see Poke'mon appear. Allow us to randomly come across legendaries. The elusive Mew was never caught during raids... Give us a reason to GO, by making distance more valued. If we walk 1km we get 100xp for example. Just my opinion. GL.

I've been using this game as motivation to be on my feet more, but I'm not sure if I want to anymore. I get that the new customization options are supposed to make the game more "inclusive" and all that, but everyone is now forced to be androgynous and the clothing doesn't seem to have been adjusted to make up for the new shapes. I love customization. So much fun. I'd get all the outfits if I didn't have the discipline to not spend all my money. But this just kinda... I think I'll take a break.

This game is going downhill again. Niantic is a company that cares about one thing and one thing only, money. The reduction of the radius shows that. It was helping keep people a safe distance away from each other during this pandemic. Not to mention it made it so you wouldn't have to cross a busy street constantly to get stops. This game would be better in a different company's hands. Not one that blatantly ignores those who play it and disregards their safety.

They keep changing things that are not broken. I have given up on the game since they have changed how easy it is to change the pokemons name. It is a shame as they have just introduced the buddy system, but the fact i cant easily change the name is so aggravating I cant enjoy the game!! (it the last drop in the glass full of bugs, such as not counting your walk randomly, just as a single example).

Honestly i love the game but when you pay $5 for a limited time pass to encounter a legendary with a special attack, you'd expect the damn thing to be at least a 3 star. Unfortunately, thats not the case. I feel like these limited research tasks rob the players of time and money due to the fact that we cannot even expect to get a good deal for real cash. Please fix this or give us a refund option.

I uninstalled this game 3 years ago bc there were too many glitches. 3 years later, I've reinstalled with the hope that maybe Niantic has finally gotten their s*** together and unsurprisingly they haven't. Good job guys 👍🏻

After having this game since 2016, I'm finally uninstalling. Niantic will not listen to its customers, and the app is constantly buggy or lagging even on newer devices. It was a great game until post-covid, and every change Niantic has made since has been a serious downgrade. If you want to play Pokemon, go back to a gamefreak game instead of this.

This game has almost as many problems as it did in its first months if not more. Every update for bug fixes brings in as many problems if not more than it fixes. So my rating is dropped to 1 star overall due to the incompetence of Niantic. Nintendo shouldn't have outsourced to such incompetent morons. Or to either America, one is greedy arrogant and selfish, and the other doesn't have the funding for proper education for something this big.

The game no longer exits with the 'back' button. Game keeps crashing & freezing. Items aren't dropped at stops but they still go pink. There are other problems do so if you're going to play it, be prepared for the game to freeze every 5 minutes. It's ridiculous. I'm over it.

The game design is designed to make the gamer spend money. Game design should make players want to play the game. After three days of playing, I filled my storage. Now, it is no longer a game of Pokémon. It is now a storage management chore and no longer fun to play. The fun is either hidden behind a paywall or the chore of storage management just to be able to add more pokeballs to the inventory. 1 star until they give gamers more game to play and less chores to chore.

I still like the game because I still love pokemon and it's a fun way to play the game. Unfortunately recent updates and changes to the game are making it harder for me to play. Shop prices have all gone up and remote raids are now limited. It's discouraging watching Niantic get greedy at the cost of lowering gameplay quality. And I have a fear it's only going to get worse.

Hi Niantic, this is so awesome. When I play this game, I always remember all the GBA games I played before Pokemon GO and it's just amazing. But I think it's a little bit frustrating about getting 9 2km eggs. Can you guys do something about it? Like transfer or discard an egg? It would be cool. But after all, it's you guys have the power to do that👍 Anyway, the game is awesome. Works fine, crashes a little bit. Buts its okay. No ones perfect😊👍 Keep up the good work. And may Arceus lend his powers to you.

Addicting, fun, nostalgic. Now I have a request! The whole point about the original Pokemon games was training pokemon, but this game is not. It does tease the idea... but I want it to be fully training focused, not as a side thought! To address this, for one Star Dust cost is too high. There's no point to save or use it to train. Please reduce star dust costs, and then please add training items like increase defense, increase attack, and increase hp!

Amazing game. Very addictive, easy to level up, and no pop-up Ads. To everyone complaining on the exercise portion of the game, really? What's the point in complaining about a game MEANT for exercise? It literally has rewards for walking a certain amount of km a week. This game is a lifesaver to those needing exercise and getting outdoors. It is also a great way to explore the areas around you. I found a park that was right near my house I've never seen in the 5 years I've been living there! Also, this is a great way to meet new people! I've met many new people while playing this game. The ability to battle with others in gyms is a very great contribution to the 'making friends ability'. This game got me off my couch and WANTING to exercise. Definitely recommend this game. 5 stars hands down.

1 star: As a concept, this is fantastic. But in reality the game is depressingly buggy, mind-numbingly monotonous and often utterly demoralising. You also look like a total bellpiece when you are playing it or putting yourself in mortal danger. All in all. It needs work. - 2016. 2022 edit: 3 stars. Now playable, fun and addictive. But despite all the additions since release there is very little to it. The repetitive mechanic of catching pokemon is completely unchanged: janky and awkward.

I like the game and the core concept. Things I'm looking forward to in the future will be the next generation of pokemon they release, actually being able to see other trainers would be AWESOME. A little more control on battles instead of just clicking, making it more similiar to pokemon stadium battles or something would be much better. I do like the game and I'm sure after some updates and more interactions with other players like a friends list and stuff and trainer groups or something, I'll 5star it.
Unless you play in a big city with Pokéstops and Pokémon spawns every 5 steps, you're playing a different game where you're lucky if you get 5 spawns an hour.

I thought this game was to get people up, out, off the couch, & moving to get healthier! That was a fun & great incentive in the beginning! Now it's centered around $$! Played it when it first came out then had issues and stopped got back into it for the last 2 months enjoying it. Then I guess a new update update happened and made this game not fun again. This game went from something I was addicted to and now I don't even want to open it for more than fifteen minutes. I used to love this game and played it constantly. I put alot of hours into it until recently. I got a new phone and when I tried signing in I kept getting an error. Game has slowed down alot. Events all feel the same. GPS is still an issue but I can see past that. It's just a little boring at the moment. A highly disappointing GoFest didn't help. New pokes are great but we are still missing the old ones! I'll still play as I do find it fun but I'm not into it all like I used to be.

Gotten better with the updates. Just wish trading didn't cost stardust. And that a Mons CP didn't change after being traded. Also allow us to trade Mons back and forth instead of a one time deal. Also, should make it to where other player's can't take over a gym after a certain period of time. Kinda hard to get my 8hrs in to earn my coins if other players can just take over my gym out. Good game that promotes exercise and visiting new places. It's fun to catch new Pokémon. The new online battle league is very good. The battle system has improved a lot over the years. I never feel pressured into buying anything. The rewards are always enough. My only complaint would be that Kanto Pokémon are still the most common even though there are now 5 generations in the game. I am still seeing the same Pokémon over and over again.

This game has seemingly become nothing more a money grab for the developer.
